localization.aciedo_commarray_desc_shared: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.
localization.aciedo_repui_description: Following the conclusion of the First Tevarin War, Humanity was eager to begin exploring the stars again. Aciedo began life as fledging ship manufacturer focused on creating long-range exploration vessels. While they saw moderate success with their initial ship design, it was the included communication drones that stood out for their reliability and transmission success. Captains across the newly formed Empire began asking Aciedo to sell them commdrones directly. Within the first year of offering them, sales skyrocketed, and it wasn't long before Aciedo decided to stop manufacturing ships entirely. Today, they are the UEE's largest communication service provider, handling over 70% of all comms, and operate commrelays, commarrays, and commdrones across the Empire.

localization.adagio_basicsalvage_desc_01:
Attention:

Rights to a new Salvage Claim are available for purchase. Exclusive access to the ship’s verified coordinates in monitored space will be provided upon confirmed credit transfer. The coordinates will remain accessible as long as the accepted contract is active. When you are satisfied with the amount of material you've salvaged, you may abandon the contract early with no penalty to clear the coordinates from your Starmap.

Claim #~mission(ClaimNumber):
• SHIP: ~mission(Ship)
• CAUSE OF ACCIDENT: ~mission(ShipStory)
• LOCATION: ~mission(location)

Adagio Rights Division
localization.adagio_industrial_component_salvage_levs:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent special order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC) and components by stripping abandoned ships and removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>. 

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points, maybe in one of Nyx's asteroid belts, or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. We advise extra caution since there have been Vanduul sightings in the system, especially with how long it might take for you to track down this specific order.  

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

localization.adagio_locatesalvage_desc_01,p:
Attention:

The rights to a new Salvage Claim in unmonitored space are available. Exclusive access to the unidentified ship’s general location will be provided upon confirming credit transfer. The location will remain accessible as long as the accepted contract is active. 

Claim #~mission(ClaimNumber):
• SHIP: Unidentified
• CAUSE OF ACCIDENT: Unknown
• LOCATION: Near ~mission(location)

DISCLAIMER:
Purchasers assume all risks and responsibilities for salvaging claims in unmonitored space. Adagio is not responsible for any damage licensed pilots, or their vessels, suffer while on purchased claims. Proceed with caution consider hiring your own security.

Adagio Rights Division
localization.adagio_repui_description: Founded by retired Naval logistics personnel, Adagio found success supporting the voracious resource appetite of the Messer-era military-industrial complex through their salvaging operations. After the end of the Messer regime, Adagio, like many other military contractors, lost their contract, and the company was forced to find new sources of revenue. This ultimately led Adagio begin reselling salvage rights they’ve acquired to independent captains and other enterprises of various sizes.
localization.advocacy_repui_description: he Advocacy is an inter-system police force overseeing law enforcement in the UEE. Advocacy agents are authorized pursue crimes across jurisdictions within the empire, and often coordinate large scale investigations targeting some of Humanity's worst offenders.
localization.alerts_beingarrested: Remain Where You Are, Arrest In Progress
localization.alt_criminal_collect_reclaimer_desc:
Need a basher who's looking for something heavy. I got a side hustle operating out of the October Rising, but it got pinched by private security while on a run. Not gonna get into the details of what it was doing out there. Let's just say I'm okay cutting ties with the ship, but there's a special package on there that I can't leave to the mercs. Client paid out serious creds, so I can't just let it drift.

Want you to get aboard the October Rising, get my shit, and get out. 

Word is that security are still on site so you might wanna pull together a crew if you got 'em. If you're feeling really highline, shut down the nearest comm array to cover your tracks. Point is, they probably won't react well to you showing up, but just remember they aren't the priority.

Drop the package off at the clinic on Grim HEX and we'll transfer the creds.
localization.ambassadorflights_repui_description: Ambassador Flights has earned a reputation as the preferred shuttle service of executives and VIPs across the empire. While they operate their own fleet of premium vehicles that are contracted to fly their wealthy clientele around, to expand their services further they also contract with private pilots who meet their high standards of hygiene, comfort, and privacy.
localization.ambassadorflights_repui_headquarters: New York City, Earth, Sol System
localization.antibombingrun_description,p: A hostile faction has sent ships to destroy critical infrastructure at ~mission(Location|Address). Intercept and clear all attacking craft whilst protecting the marked assets.

localization.asd_experimentbodytext,p: Utilizing the unique properties of Vanduul biofluid, I will modify a Human imprint via the introduction of a catalyst and reagent. The result will be a viable recombinant that is not only suitable for regeneration, but that improves upon the original source.

Anyone caught attempting to leave with proprietary information will be terminated immediately and prosecuted.

localization.asd_hypothesisbodytext,p: While Humanity has embraced the technological marvel that is the ability to create imprints, they have missed the most important lesson from the Vanduul that we’ve stolen it from Recombinant Evolution. The Vanduul freely combine imprints and genetic information from their best warriors to create their next generation of fighters. I propose that Humans, with a few slight genetic adjustments, could likewise make an evolutionary leap forward through imprint modification. Think of it, with each imprint, we refine and evolve ourselves.

localization.asop_exechangar_claim_message: By continuing, this vehicle will be linked to your account.
localization.assassin_danger_0001: If even half the rumors about them are true, you're going to want to take them out long before they see you coming.
localization.assassin_danger_0002: Apparently, this is supposed to be one of the more dangerous hitters in the sector. Do not make the mistake of underestimating them.
localization.assassin_danger_0003: Make sure to bring your full arsenal when you go hunting. Something tells me you might need it to take them down.
localization.assassin_danger_0004: Word of warning, no way someone like ~mission(TargetName|Last) is going down easy. You want to take them out? Do it hard and fast.
localization.assassin_danger_0005: While you should be careful, cause you never know - my guess is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is gonna drop easy. Poor sod chooses to fly solo and hardly ever bothers with anything more than a few escorts.
localization.assassin_danger_0006: As for gearing up for this little job, you shouldn't need anything out of the ordinary. ~mission(TargetName|Last) prefers to fly alone. I mean, for a real special occasion they might travel with a friend or two, but I'd be surprised.
localization.assassin_danger_0007: Apparently, there's a good chance this scav's not gonna be traveling alone either. Seems that their little multicrew ship hardly ever flies without at least one or two friends along for the trip.
localization.assassin_danger_0008: Word is that the small multicrew ship ~mission(TargetName|Last) captains is being guarded by a few hired escorts. Can't say for sure if it's true, but good to be careful just in case.
localization.assassin_danger_0009: Rumor has it that ~mission(TargetName|Last) typically travels with a full escort so be ready to hit hard. Even if you do get lucky and catch them alone, you'll still have their ship to deal with and supposedly they captain a bit of a beast.
localization.assassin_danger_0010: Make sure to bring your full arsenal when you go hunting. Since ~mission(TargetName|Last) usually captains a bigger multicrew ship and springs the extra credits for escort, something tells me you might need the extra firepower.
localization.assassin_desc_0001: Looking for someone who doesn't mind getting their hands dirty. Not talking guild work or anything, just someone who's good enough to aim and squeeze. Got some good creds available to see ~mission(TargetName) permanently gone. \n\nStart looking at ~mission(Location). ~mission(MultiPlayer)~mission(Contractor|AssassinationTimed) ~mission(Danger)
localization.assassin_desc_0002: Got a mess that needs cleaning up. Paying solid credits for it too. The mess goes by the name of ~mission(TargetName). ~mission(Danger) \n\nBuddy of mine saw them around ~mission(Location), but the rest is up to you. ~mission(MultiPlayer) ~mission(Contractor|AssassinationTimed)
localization.assassin_desc_0003: There's a price on ~mission(TargetName)'s head. ~mission(MultiPlayer)Credits go to whoever bags the bastard first. ~mission(Contractor|AssassinationTimed) I'd recommend starting at ~mission(Location) but hey, don't let me tell you how to do your job. ~mission(Danger)
localization.assassin_desc_0004: Guess who just got themselves placed onto the 'no-breathe-list'? Some dragger named ~mission(TargetName). Yeah, I never heard of them either, but better them than us, right? \n\n~mission(Danger) ~mission(MultiPlayer)Word is they've been haunting ~mission(Location) lately, so you'll probably want to start there. ~mission(Contractor|AssassinationTimed)Good luck.
localization.assassin_desc_0005: I don't know what ~mission(TargetName) did, but they sure pissed off the wrong people. Credits go to whoever can give them a last lesson in manners straight through the head. ~mission(Danger) \n\nThere isn't much to go on, just some scattered sightings around ~mission(Location), so maybe start there. ~mission(Contractor|AssassinationTimed)~mission(MultiPlayer)One last thing, the client wants you to say '~mission(Phrase).' when the trigger's pulled. Don't ask. Just do it.
localization.assassin_desc_0006: ~mission(TargetName) is breathing borrowed air. Time's come to punch their ticket for good. ~mission(Contractor|AssassinationTimed) I can give you ~mission(Location) but you have to provide your own transport and clean weapons. ~mission(Danger) ~mission(MultiPlayer)
localization.assassin_desc_0007: You know how they say the good die young? It's definitely true in this case. A hit's been put out on ~mission(TargetName), a local security thug that's hellbent on being a hero. ~mission(Contractor|AssassinationTimed) ~mission(Danger) ~mission(MultiPlayer)
localization.assassin_desc_0008: Why don't these security assholes ever learn to mind their own damn business? It's like they want to get murdered. Especially this one. Name's ~mission(TargetName). Been stirring up huge trouble lately, but you're gonna put a permanent end to that.\n\n~mission(Contractor|AssassinationTimed) ~mission(MultiPlayer) ~mission(Contractor|AssassinationDanger) Knowing these security types, don't be surprised if they call for back up.
localization.assassin_desc_0009: About time someone put ~mission(TargetName) in their place. This security hackjob's been taking bribes to look the other way, but the greedy little idiot decided to raise the rates. Big mistake! \n\nNow instead of those credits going to pay the smug bastard off, they're being used to pay you to murder their ass. That's some poetic justice right there. ~mission(Danger) ~mission(MultiPlayer) ~mission(Contractor|AssassinationTimed)
localization.assassin_desc_0010: This bounty hunter by the name of ~mission(TargetName) made the mistake of messing with the wrong crew. They're looking to even the score and are offering pretty decent creds to whoever does the deed. ~mission(Danger) ~mission(MultiPlayer) ~mission(Contractor|AssassinationTimed)
localization.assassin_desc_0011: I love it. This is one of those classic 'the hunter has become the hunted' scenarios you always see on the spec. \n\nA big bounty's been placed on the head of bounty hunter ~mission(TargetName). ~mission(Danger) It'll be interesting to see how they like it when they tables are turned. ~mission(MultiPlayer) ~mission(Contractor|AssassinationTimed)
localization.assassin_desc_first:
Listen, I know you don't know me, but that's kinda the point of this little experiment. We're just two complete strangers helping each other out. 

Here's how this works - I give you a name. ~mission(TargetName), for example. Then I'll tell you a place: ~mission(Location). Now, if by some complete and utter coincidence, they wind up shot to death a little while later, a bunch of credits will mystically appear in your account. Long story short, ~mission(TargetName|NickOrFirst) has some bad luck, you have some good luck. Everybody's happy.

Of course, there are plenty of other people eager for the help of a dependable stranger and if you do a good job here, I'll make sure they know you're the stranger to talk to.

Good luck out there.
localization.assassin_fps_boss_obj_long_01: Draw out ~mission(TargetName) by eliminating enough hostile forces.
localization.assassin_fps_boss_obj_short_01: Eliminate Hostiles To Draw Out Target
localization.assassin_fps_targetonly_obj_long_01: Limit focus to the target and do not cause collateral damage.
localization.assassin_location_0001: the coordinates where they were last spotted
localization.assassin_location_0003: where they like to hang out
localization.assassin_location_0004: one of the spots they're known to frequent
localization.assassin_multiplayer_0001: Probably worth it to mention you might run in to some competition out there since this isn't an exclusive contract.
localization.assassin_multiplayer_0002: This contract is non-exclusive. First-come, first-serve.
localization.assassin_multiplayer_0003: And just so you know, you most likely won't be the only one on the hunt since the ~mission(Client) made this an open contract.
localization.assassin_multiplayer_0004: You should expect there to be some stiff competition on this. A lot of people out there are eager to see this scum dead once and for all.
localization.assassin_phrase_0006: Looks like your birthday came early this year
localization.assassin_sync_obj_long_01: Simultaneously eliminate ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2). As soon as one target is attacked you will have until time runs out to eliminate both targets.
localization.assassin_timed_0001: You drag your feet on this, don't be surprised if they vanish.
localization.assassin_timed_0002: With a slippery bastard like this, you might only have a limited window of opportunity to hit them before they go to ground.
localization.assassin_timed_0003: Need this taken care of yesterday. Drop everything and get it done now.
localization.assassin_timed_0004: Urgent's an understatement on this one. Client's already comm'd me three times to ask if it's done yet.
localization.assassination_obj_long_01: Search for ~mission(TargetName) at the coordinates provided.

localization.bacchus1_desc: A Super-Earth located close to the system's binary stars resulting in its rocky surface boiling away and the formation of an incredibly hot and smoggy atmosphere.
localization.bacchus2_desc: An ocean planet dotted by many populated islands and archipelagos featuring a wide variety of climates and biodiversity. Though the Banu have so far not confirmed if Bacchus II is their home-world like some in the UEE theorize, it is known that the planet hosts the 'Gathering'; a special event where Banu congregate to make species-wide decisions.
localization.bacchus3_desc: A gas giant featuring dynamic swirling clouds and frequent electrical storms.
localization.bacchus_asteroidbelt1_desc: Heavily mined by generations of Banu, this asteroid belt has become a junkyard over time.
localization.bacchus_desc: Many in the UEE believe that Bacchus, a binary star system, contains the Banu's homeworld, though, to date, the Banu themselves have not been able to or have chosen not to confirm one way or another. Like with most Banu systems, the trade lanes are always packed with travelers from Banu, Human and Xi'an space. A large permanent flotilla in the system's outer reaches is a popular destination for haulers and traders.\n
localization.bacchus_flotilla_desc: A large cluster of ships that has become a permanent floating marketplace. Conveniently located near a jump point, it attracts a wide variety of travelers and traders entering and leaving the system.
localization.bacchus_jumppoint_garron_desc: This jump point connects Bachhus to the UEE controlled Garron system.
localization.bacchus_jumppoint_geddon_desc: This jump point connects Bachhus to the Geddon system.
localization.bacchus_star1_desc: A class-G main sequence star that is part of a binary pairing with Bacchus B.
localization.bacchus_star2_desc: A class-K main sequence star that is part of a binary pairing with Bacchus B.

localization.battaglia_rpt_boardship_01_desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Ship In Distress

WORK BRIEF: 
Got an urgent distress call from one of the Miners Amalgamated crews I sent out, saying they’re under attack by a gang that ambushed their ship. 

I need you to rush down there, board the <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> and help protect my people out there.

Please let me know ASAP if you can help.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon elimination of all targets.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
localization.battaglia_rpt_createuplink_01_desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Movements

WORK BRIEF: 
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to <EM4>infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and plug a small listening device into their server</EM4>. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but <EM4>it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there</EM4>, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon successful installation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
localization.battaglia_rpt_createuplink_02_desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Need some intel

WORK BRIEF: 
The Governing Committee have been looking for more information to help strategize a way out of our current situation with the Moraine. They’ve asked for people willing to <EM4>plant tracking programs aboard Moraine stations</EM4> in order to gather data to better understand their movements and locations in Nyx.

You’ll need to <EM4>head out to ~mission(Location), get access to the Moraine station, and plant the device in their servers</EM4>.

It’s entirely possible that this station may be occupied but hopefully violence can be avoided.

Good luck.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon successful installation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
localization.battaglia_rpt_createuplink_03_desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Tapping Moraine Servers

WORK BRIEF: 
It’s no secret the Moraine have been escalating their attacks against People Alliance crews just trying to make an honest living in Nyx. While the PA won’t condone open hostilities against them, the Governing Committee wants to try to keep away from them as much as possible.

We need someone to head to a Moraine station near <EM4>~mission(Location) and implant a data card in their servers</EM4>. There’s a tracking program that will autorun and feed us the location of Moraine ships. The Committee hopes that we can use this data to warn our crews and save lives.

Any help you can provide would be appreciated. I won’t lie, it’s possible that <EM4>there might be Moraine on the station</EM4> who won’t take kindly to you being there, so be careful.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon successful installation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Data Retrieval

WORK BRIEF: 
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to <EM4>infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and make a copy of their server data</EM4>. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
localization.battaglia_rpt_misscrew_01_desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Crew Hasn’t Checked In

WORK BRIEF: 
Just got word that one of the mining teams is unaccounted for. They were supposed to be back hours ago, but no one’s heard from them. Family have tried to reach out but haven’t gotten a response from anyone on the crew.

I can send you their last known location, so we’re looking for someone to go check in and see if they’re okay. If the worst happened, <EM4>please identify anyone you find</EM4>. I’m sure the families would appreciate some closure on what happened.

Thanks

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

RE: Missing Mining Team

WORK BRIEF: 
One of our local crews set off for a dig and haven’t checked back in. With everything going on out there, people are starting to get a little worried, so <EM4>we’d like someone to try and get eyes on them</EM4>.

I hate to say this, but if something happened to them, could you <EM4>please identify everyone you find</EM4> so we can let next of kin know?

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger

WORK BRIEF: 
We had another ship attacked out near ~mission(Location) and received conflicting reports about who did the ambush, so we're looking to hire someone to fly out and <EM4>retrieve the blackbox</EM4>. Last thing we want to do is blame the wrong people. You should be able to carry it, but <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage.</EM4>

Just be careful, there's a real good chance <EM4>the ambushers are still there waiting</EM4> for someone to claim it.

If you're able to get it, <EM4>deliver the blackbox to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> and we'll get you paid.

Got a big mining job with your name on it. We're looking to update our records about mineral yields so we need someone to scan and extract about <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4> <EM4>~mission(MineableType)</EM4> mined if possible. ~mission(Rarity)

Let me know.

Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

Battaglia, Recco

******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Welcome to the System

WORK BRIEF: 
Hello, the People's Alliance is committed to providing opportunities to miners, prospectors, and salvagers in the system and have an exciting opportunity to offer you as a welcome to the system.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
localization.battaglia_story01_obj_long_02: Go to the Blinding Hope and rescue the crew.
localization.battaglia_story01b_desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Mining Opportunity

WORK BRIEF: 
One of our contractors came across a deposit of <EM4>~mission(ResourceType)</EM4> around <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4> but couldn't extract it themselves.

Figured this would be a good opportunity for an enterprising new visitor to the system.

Like I said, if you need a ship, we've arranged a loaner for you. <EM4>Just remember to bring it back.</EM4>

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate for extraction of resources.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
localization.battaglia_story01c_desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Emergency

WORK BRIEF: 
Received a frantic distress call from Captain Amir Lucas of the Blinding Hope. They've come under <EM4>attack from a gang of Moraine and are in desperate need of assistance</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
N/A

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
localization.battaglia_story02_desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blinding Hope in trouble

WORK BRIEF: 
We received a distress call from the Blinding Hope that said they were under attack from the Moraine again before they were cut off. I just want to know if they're okay. <EM4>Head to their last known location and report what you find</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
localization.battaglia_story02_obj_long_01: Go to the Blinding Hope's last known location.
localization.battaglia_story02_obj_long_02: Find information on Isaac at Moraine Asteroid base.
localization.battaglia_story02_obj_long_03: Go to Recco Battaglia at the Employment Center in Levski to drop off the data drive.
localization.battaglia_story02_obj_short_03: Go To Battaglia For Data Drive Dropoff
localization.battaglia_story02b_desc:
Recco here. This isn't a contract through the People's Alliance so I thought I'd just reach out personally.

Thank you for searching the wreckage of the Blinding Hope and confirming who was lost. As discussed, I need to find out what happened to Isaac Kepler and think that the Moraine might have taken him. I've sent along the location of a nearby Moraine base that they may have taken him to, head there now and see if you can find any data on what happened.

Be careful. I don't know if the station is abandoned.

Thank you for doing this. I need to know what happened to him.

Recco
localization.battaglia_story03_desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Idea for Isaac

WORK BRIEF: 
I need your help with a plan I've come up with for Isaac. <EM4>I'll give you the details in person</EM4>, but it will involve heading back into Moraine territory, so you'll need to be prepared.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
localization.battaglia_story03_obj_long_01: Go to Isaac's location and escort him to Levski.
localization.battaglia_story03_obj_long_02: Head to Isaac Kepler's location and establish contact.
localization.battaglia_story03b_desc:
Hey, I've passed along the location for Isaac. Head there now and bring him back to Levski. I think we've got a real chance of saving him, but want to make sure the Moraine don't get to him first.

Good luck,

Recco
