If available, please accept and head to ~mission(Location|Address) immediately to protect the client and take out all the hostiles. Payment will be processed once the client is safe.

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
localization.foxwell_destroynarcotics_e_desc_001:
Some folks will do anything for a few creds. There’s a group of upstart outlaws over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> that have decided to start manufacturing drugs. Turns out they’re not too good at it, or maybe a little too good. The junk they’re pumping out is stronger than the normal stuff and a real danger to anyone who uses it. 

We’ve been hired to knock out their operation and destroy whatever drugs stashes are on site. Armed guards are protecting the place, but they don’t seem too skilled. Our surveillance teams observed one of them almost shoot himself in the foot. Can’t say for certain, but odds are they won’t give a pro like you too many problems.  


Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
localization.foxwell_destroynarcotics_h_desc_001:
Reports of a spike in drug overdoses around Stanton has security services worried. Seems like some two-bit crew is juicing their profits by cutting their stuff with toxic chemicals. Shutting down this crew and stopping the distribution of their drugs has become a top priority.

A Foxwell informant has revealed that part of this crew has currently set up shop at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Hiring a contractor to hustle over there and destroy whatever drugs they’ve got stashed before they’re spread across the system. Better be careful though, word is this crew is armed to the teeth and determined to profit off that poison no matter what.


Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
localization.foxwell_destroynarcotics_m_desc_001:
We’ve been contracted to take care of a problem at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. There’s been a recent surge of activity in the area tied to the drug trade. It appears to be a well-run operation and there’s a growing concern that it’ll expand wider if not stopped. Any chance you’re available to make sure that doesn’t happen?   

Job is pretty straightforward. Head to the site and destroy their stash of drugs. That way they won’t have the creds to expand their operations any further. I wouldn’t expect them to make this easy on you though. Armed guards are regularly seen around the facility, so be sure you’ve got enough gear to deal with them too. 


Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
localization.foxwell_destroyprobe_e_desc_001:
A client has reported the presence of illegal surveillance monitors around <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. They’re extremely concerned that these monitors might be accessing sensitive information related to their operations.

We believe there are <EM4>~mission(Contractor|DestroyProbeAmount)</EM4> that will need to be destroyed. Tracking them is difficult with their low EM signatures, so you will need to determine their exact location once you’re in the area.

These 'skimmers' are outfitted with security protocols that will trigger data transfers if they are directly attacked. Make sure that you destroy them before the upload can complete. Whoever planted these things will also be notified. If they have any forces in the area, don’t be surprised if they show up and try to stop you.
   
  
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
localization.foxwell_destroyprobe_e_title_001: Yellow Level Contract: Eradicate Illegal Monitors
localization.foxwell_destroyprobe_h_desc_001:
Looking for someone to handle an issue one of our clients is having at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Guess someone has set up several illegal 'data skimmers' to steal sensitive info. Need them taken offline pronto. 

You’ll need to scan the area to locate the <EM4>~mission(Contractor|DestroyProbeAmount)</EM4>, which will be tricky because of their low EM. Once found, destroy them quickly before their security override kicks in and they upload their datastores. Also, you should keep an eye out for hostile forces in the area, so plan accordingly.
 

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
localization.foxwell_destroyprobe_h_name_001: Orange Level Contract: Destroy Data Skimmers
localization.foxwell_destroyprobe_m_desc_001:
After a contractor successfully recovered data stolen from one of our clients, a security analyst verified that it was captured by unauthorized surveillance monitors illegally installed around <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We’re looking for someone to follow up and take out those monitors.

You will need to find the <EM4>~mission(Contractor|DestroyProbeAmount)</EM4> and destroy them before any more data can be gathered. Passive 'Skimmers' like these typically are hard to find so be thorough in your search.

Once attacked, their security protocols will cause them to begin transmitting the contents of their drives, so it’s imperative that you stop the upload before it can complete. There’s also a good chance that whoever’s responsible might be in the area, so be careful.


Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
localization.foxwell_destroyprobe_m_name_001: Orange Level Contract: Handle Security Threat
localization.foxwell_destroyprobe_s_desc_001:
One of our clients is growing frustrated that their convoys are coming under constant attack. We’ve increased patrols in the area and it looks like outlaws have placed 'skimmers' around <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> hoping to steal important data, like flight routes and cargo manifests, from our client. 

We need you to search the area, locate the <EM4>~mission(Contractor|DestroyProbeAmount)</EM4> and destroy them. They use a passive form of data collection designed to keep their signature low, so they're going to be pretty hard to spot. Make sure that you scan the area carefully to find them. Once you attack one, they'll shift into emergency data transfer mode, which will make them easy to see once they start transmitting, just make sure you destroy them before they finish. 

It’s also possible that when attacked, the outlaws will send some ships to respond. Best be on your game so you defend yourself and destroy those monitors before any data can successfully transfer. 


Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
localization.foxwell_destroyprobe_s_name_001: Red Level Contract: Dismantle Spying Op
localization.foxwell_destroyprobe_ve_desc_001:
<EM4>We’ve learned that local criminals are operating ~mission(Contractor|DestroyProbeAmount) around ~mission(Location|Address) to case potential targets.</EM4> Several of our clients operate in that area so it would be good to clear these out before they become a problem. 

The monitors are designed to keep a low profile which means finding them will be a bit of a pain. You'll have to sweep the area to identify their exact location. Once you do that, destroy them. 

Whoever’s running these monitors probably might try to stop you. Also, they tend to rig these monitors with defensive protocols that automatically back-up the data when attacked. Once you start shooting, you'll need to finish the job quickly before the transfer is completed.


Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
localization.foxwell_destroyprobe_ve_title_001: Yellow Level Contract: Unauthorized Surveillance Monitors
localization.foxwell_destroyprobe_vh_desc_001:
We got reports of illegal 'skimmers' over by <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> that are targeting our client’s operations. The data collected could lead to all sorts of trouble, so we need the <EM4>~mission(Contractor|DestroyProbeAmount)</EM4> located and destroyed. 

Easier said than done, though. Monitors like this are designed to be unobtrusive, so spotting them won't be easy but once you scan the area and locate them, you can take them out. But be warned, as soon as you start attacking, it’ll trigger an emergency data transfer. It's important that you take them out before the upload can finish. 

There’s also a good chance hostile resistance will show up and try to stop you. Better stay situationally aware out there so you don’t get surprised.


Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement

localization.foxwell_haulcargo_atob_olp_desc_01:
Looking for a contractor with the right skills and ship for an important mission. Outlaws ambushed a Hull C carrying a <EM4>~mission(CargoGradeToken)</EM4> load of cargo and took it to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We’ve been hired to get it all back.  

The cargo is being stored somewhere at a defunct Hathor facility. The place is big and crawling with outlaws. Need someone to retrieve the goods from the freight elevator there and deliver it all back to the <EM4>freight elevator at ~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Don’t think this will be a walk in the park. Bring lots of ammo and a ship that can handle <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>.

localization.foxwell_haulcargo_atob_paf_desc_01:

We’re getting reports of these outlaws using old Hathor facilities as stash houses and we believe the stolen items are currently at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.

Doubt you’ll be able to slip in and out of that PAF without being noticed either, so best be prepared to clear the location. Once safe, grab the goods from the freight elevator and deliver them to the <EM4>freight elevator at ~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. 

It also wouldn't hurt to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.

localization.foxwell_haulcargo_multitosingle_desc_01:
Something weird is going on at the old Hathor mining facilities. Both the platform alignment facilities and orbital laser platforms have been abandoned and gathering dust for decades, but outlaws have started using them as a base of operations.

We’ve been hired by a concerned party who’s recently lost a lot of important cargo to one such gang. Currently, their stuff is stashed at <EM4>~mission(Location1|Address)</EM4> and <EM4>~mission(Location2|Address)</EM4>, but there’s a growing fear that the gang may be offloading their goods soon. That’s why we’ve been hired to hit both of those Hathor facilities, retrieve the cargo from the freight elevators, and bring it to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. 

Here’s the specifics on what to grab from each location. Doesn’t matter in what order you do this, as long as it all gets collected and delivered. Just be sure to bring a ship that can handle <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>.  It also wouldn't hurt to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.   

~mission(MultiToSingleToken)

Foxwell hasn’t been able to scout these locations, but if I were you, I’d expect to face some serious armed resistance. Best bring a bunch of gear and some friends.


Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

localization.foxwell_mercenary_intro_desc_001:
Are you an experienced contractor looking to increase your income with some security work? Or maybe you’re new to the field and are looking for some hands-on experience? 

Foxwell Enforcement are looking for enthusiastic new contractors to help with local law enforcement. To see if you’re the right fit for us, we’d like for you to head over to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)<EM4> and support the security forces on site. Local gang members have been giving that spot problems. Help the local forces take care of these outlaws to qualify for more contract opportunities with Foxwell.

Contractors are employed on a strictly freelance basis. Foxwell expects contractors to supply their own weapons and armor and does not accept any responsibility for any injuries, damages, or deaths accumulated during the contract.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
localization.foxwell_mercenary_intro_title_001: Exciting New Opportunities with Foxwell Enforcement
localization.foxwell_mercenary_rehire_desc_001:
Due to a corporate restructuring, Foxwell has some new vacancies that need to be filled immediately. Foxwell knows you’ve previously expressed interest in this line of work, and we’re wondering if you would want to take another crack at a contract.

One of our clients needs support at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> where their security forces are struggling to handle an outlaw incursion. Head there and help the local forces get rid of the problem before it’s too late. 

Successfully complete this contract, and Foxwell would be happy to send more work your way.


Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
localization.foxwell_repui_description: Founded by retired police officers in Lo, Corel system, Foxwell Enforcement provides low-cost security consultancy to those who need it most. The company hoped this altruism would lead to financial reward, but instead they’ve been forced to cut corners and loosen hiring practices to survive. Many companies still hire Foxwell because they’re affordable, but their low wages makes it hard to retain skilled security contractors.
localization.foxwell_retrievecargo_olp_desc_001:
Got an interesting one here. Outlaws ambushed a supply convoy and made off with some vital cargo. All signs point to this being a professional job. They didn’t leave any witnesses, grabbed specific pieces of cargo, and left the less valuable stuff. Their one mistake was forgetting to check the cargo for trackers. The cargo is now sitting at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, and we’ve been contracted to get it back promptly. 

Looking for someone to retrieve the stolen cargo from the orbital platform and bring it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Designated a red level contract because you’ll have to go up against some real pros to get the goods back. Credits will be paid upon the return of the cargo.
  

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

We need someone to go retrieve the stolen cargo and return it to the rightful owners at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Those old platform alignment facilities are quite big and we aren’t sure exactly how many outlaws will be there, so be careful.

Satellites in that region have been acting up recently. Not exactly sure what’s going on out there, but best be prepared in case there’s any trouble.

localization.foxwell_securitypatrol_s_desc_001:
Need a battle-hardened pilot for an important patrol. A prominent client is fed up with outlaws targeting their ships and satellites. We’ve been hired to scan the areas in question and deal with any hostile forces. The patrol begins at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD before moving to a number of other locations we’ll expect you to clear.

Not sure what you’ll run into out there, but based on intel shared by the client, they’re frequently seeing fighter groups of five to seven ships roaming the region. Some even have larger ships leading the charge. That means you better be ready for a serious fight. If you can, try to recruit at least <EM4>three friends</EM4> to the cause. Even a seasoned pilot will need all the help they can get against this crew.   

Since this is going to be a tough one, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> at the end of the patrol.

Good luck,

localization.foxwell_securitypatrol_vh_desc_001:
A client needs our help. Outlaws are roaming certain sectors where they do business and attacking anyone they come across. Our client has already lost several ships and can’t afford to lose anymore. 

We need someone to patrol those areas and draw out any hostile forces. The job begins with you heading to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scanning. Then we’ll share a handful of other patrol points for you to scan. 

From the sound of it, these packs of ships feature skilled and aggressive pilots. Best be ready to rumble if you run into any of them. Would be good to have at least <EM4>two trusted pilots</EM4> by your side for this one.

At the end of a successful patrol, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.</EM4>

Stay chilly,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

localization.foxwell_shipambush_e_desc_001:
An outlaw who’s been on the run finally returned to the system. Seems like they hoped that disappearing for a bit would make us forget about them. They’re not even trying to hide their identity or vary their routine which means we know exactly where they’re going to be.

Latest intel indicates that they’re flying a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> and will be passing by <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> soon. I’ve already scoped out an emission cloud that’s a perfect place for you to find cover, power down your ship, and wait. Only real variable is if they’ll be alone or not. We’ve heard they sometimes roll with friends that all fly single-seaters. Landing that first surprise strike will be important as this crew is battle-tested, but we’ll have reinforcements at the ready to provide support if you need them.

Get this done and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

localization.foxwell_shipambush_h_desc_001:
Recently, a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> baited Foxwell forces with a bogus rescue beacon. By the time our forces realized what was happening, a squad of ships unleashed a devastating attack and only one Foxwell contractor survived. Their scan logs identified the bait ship, and we’ve had scouts monitoring them ever since.

Our surveillance has revealed the squad has a regular flight pattern that we think we can exploit. There’s a sizable emission cloud at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> that makes it an ideal spot to post up. Think you have what it takes to handle this for us? 

It’ll be you against the <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4>, other large craft, and a sizable escort. Wish I could be more specific than that but this crew regularly rotates ships in and out of the squad. Would be smart to bring some support, so you don’t get overwhelmed by their numbers.   

Complete the job and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

localization.foxwell_shipambush_m_desc_001:
Foxwell has been tracking a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> used by outlaws and discovered a pattern to its movements. The ship should be passing by <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> soon.

Looking for a contractor willing to hustle there, hide in the emission cloud, and then spring the trap when the time is right. There’s usually escort ships with the <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4>. Careful not to jump the gun and blow your cover. The element of surprise is crucial from what I’ve read.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton

localization.foxwell_shipambush_s_desc_001:
We’ve received a handful of comms about recent attacks undertaken by an <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> and its escort ships. After opening a file, we started tracking the ship’s movements and noticed that it frequently passes an emission cloud near <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We want to use that to our advantage to launch a surprise attack. 

Once on site, you should hide in the emission cloud to cloak your signature enough to allow you to make the first strike. Unfortunately, Foxwell can’t provide additional reinforcements for this operation, so you’ll be responsible for bringing any support forces. You might need the help too. The crew of the ~mission(AmbushTarget) is aggressive and battle hardened.        

You get this taken care of for us and there's a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> in it for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

localization.foxwell_shipambush_ve_desc_001:
Care to help us ghost a bad guy? 

We’ve been hired to hunt down an outlaw flying a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4>. Shouldn’t be too hard since they take the same flightpath each day. That makes them a prime target for an ambush if I ever saw one. I’ve analyzed the route and determined that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is the ideal spot to strike. There’s an emission cloud there that’ll be perfect to hide your ship’s signature while you wait.   

Job is simple if you’re interested. Head to the location, hide out, power down, and then wait for them to fly by. Sometimes they roll alone but they often have other single-seat ships with them. Shouldn’t be too hard to handle for a pro. Plus, we’ll still have reinforcements nearby and ready to deploy once it pops off.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,


Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

localization.foxwell_shipambush_ve_title_001: Yellow Level Contract: Ambush An Amateur
localization.foxwell_shipambush_vh_desc_001:
Foxwell got word from an important client that outlaws have put together a squad that’s been stalking the system with sub-capital ships and escort fighters. Our client is concerned that if left unchecked, outlaws will create more of these attack squads and destabilize system security. We’ve been hired to wipe out this group before that happens. 

We need a confident and skilled contractor for this task. Good news is that we have a plan in place. One of the ships used by this squad, a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4>, was stolen from our client, who’s still able to track its movements. They’ve shared the location data with us and we’ve discovered that this squad often goes by <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We’ve scouted the location and discovered a large emission cloud makes an ideal spot for an ambush.  

Not going to lie, this isn’t going to be easy. We don’t have any additional forces available to deploy, so it would be good to bring your own support. 

You manage to pull this off, I've arranged for a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

Once your crew is ready, head over to ~mission(Location|Address) and take the hostiles there down. Now, these bastards are a bit clever so they tend to split up into smaller packs. Make sure you wait around to clear every last one of them out.
 
Good luck,

localization.foxwell_x2_attackidris_desc,p:
We have a fix on a XenoThreat Idris with fighter support at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Their comms discipline's lousy. According to the radio chatter, the Commander's on board the Idris. Can't remember the last time we had such a strong fix on him. This could be a chance to decapitate the whole operation. 

Want in?

localization.foxwell_x2_drawoutboss_desc,p:
We have intercepted a location beacon that puts <EM>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> and their personal attack wing at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. They have been one of XenoThreat's most brutal enforcers since their founding. 

<EM>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4>'s not one to back down from a fight so hit their ships hard enough, do enough damage and they won't be able to resist joining in the action. Once they're out in the open, they'll be your main target.

Ready to go?

Been handed some strong intel on a XenoThreat strike wing's flightpath. Looking for contractors who can dust off now and be set up at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> ahead of them. Local conditions will mask your scanner signatures so you can give them the surprise of their lives. Let's turn the hunters into the hunted.

Interested?

localization.foxwell_x2_shipdefend_desc,p:
A distress beacon came in from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> about a ship under attack from XenoThreat. The pilot reports that their shields are failing and they can't outrun the attackers.

The ship's a <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4>, but the pilot's Human, which  according to XenoThreat's twisted way of thinking, makes them a traitor to Humanity and a target for their hate.

We're looking for operators to head out there and do some good.

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

localization.foxwell_x2_shipwaves_desc,p:
Multiple reports are coming in of XenoThreat ships massing at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>
We're looking for contractors ready to take the fight to them. 

They want us to believe that they have right on their side. They want us to believe that they have overwhelming force. This is a chance to show them we know better.

I won't lie, this is more than just a simple security contract to me. I really hate those intolerant assholes and everything they stand for.

You with me?

Eugene Walton

localization.ftl_delivery_desc_intro:
FTL COURIER SERVICES IS HIRING!

Are you a committed, industrious and punctual individual who enjoys travel and is looking to work independently? 
If your answer is yes, then FTL Courier Services may have the ideal opportunity for you!

Handling over a billion collections and deliveries every year, FTL has been consistently rated the Empire's most trusted courier service by providing businesses and consumers a safe and reliable way to send and receive their shipments wherever, whenever.

To make all this happen, FTL contracts with thousands of self-employed couriers across every system in the UEE and we are currently looking for new people to join our ranks. 

FTL offers:
* Great earning potential based on how many deliveries you complete.
* Convenience of selecting only the routes that appeal to you. Stay local or explore father, the choice is yours.
* Flexibility to accept multiple contracts, even from other companies. With our non-exclusive employment agreements, we leave it up to you to maximize your schedule.
 
In order to apply you’ll need:
* Your own means of insured travel.
* The right to work in the UEE and no current CrimeStat rating.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to plan your own travel routes.
* Successful completion of the below Employment Evaluation.

EMPLOYMENT EVALUATION
To make sure that you're a good fit for our company, we would like to see you in action! This trial contract will have you collect a package from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. ~mission(Contractor|Timed)This is a paid evaluation. Participation is not a guarantee of any future work with FTL or FTL associates.

Don’t wait! Complete your Employment Evaluation today and start your journey with FTL Courier Services.
localization.ftl_recoveritem_e_desc_001:

FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 
RECOMMENDED EXPERIENCE LEVEL – ENTRY

PICKUP LOCATION – Courier needed to retrieve lost package from a downed ship at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Once obtained, deliver package to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>.

localization.fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_04: I give us solid odds. The plan is as good as they come and the IFFI tech's impressive. Only question is if we got the right people to pull it off.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_05: Is this about me bailing for that stormwal tour?
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_06: Come on, man. You know I didn't mean you. Just worried about the download.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_07: It's gonna go fine. Even if they find out what's going on, it'll be too late to do anything.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_08: Yeah, especially since I got the system locked tight with a password generated from the first digit of all your codes.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_09: Well, there you go. Pretty much the only way they'd be able to stop us is if they pull a Globy and guess the damn thing.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_10: Out of curiosity, how was the tour?
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_11: Shit was crazy. Saw two of them out there in the last second.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_13: Yeah, yeah. I know you don't give a shit.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_admin_msg_14: Let's get through this and maybe I'll start.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_02: Here's your code. Now, I want you focused on keeping Brushwood safe and those AAs gunning.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_04: We're not going to have a problem are we? I don't need another Della happening today.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_05: Last time I checked, Nine Tails still got paid for the Della.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_brushwood_msg_06: That was a rain drop in the ocean compared to this job. Which is why I need you focused. We clear?
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_01: Here's the code for the containers.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_05: Yeah, sure. Why wouldn't I be?
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_06: Just want to make sure that we'll have enough cover to get the job done.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_07: Not sure what you're getting so worked up about. With us owning the skies, it all seems pretty straight forward to me.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_08: Right. Let's just keep on task and not get creative.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_09: This again? I keep telling you, mate. If you want to scare people, you gotta do some scary shit.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_10: Is that what you call gutting Hender's whole family one by one?
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_11: Look, I get it. You don't like getting your hands dirty. Fine. But how about you worry about doing your job and stay the hell out of my business.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_hartmoore_msg_12: My job is making sure you do yours. That's why I got picked to run things and not you. Don't forget it.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_mendo_msg_05: Everything is set up. Expect things to kick off on schedule.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_mendo_msg_07: Who needs luck? Those IFFIs are impressive bits of tech. Thanks for the hookup.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_mendo_msg_08: Glad you like the new toys. Onto business, that special package I prepped for you should match pretty seamlessly with their system.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_mendo_msg_09: No doubt. I'll let you know once the transfer's complete.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_01: Here's the code for the containers on your platform.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_03: Hell yeah! Crusader's gonna be kipo surprised when we take over.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_06: Whatever. Just focus on doing your part and everything should be fine.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_07: No worries, boss. I'll keep 'em busy enough to get the job done. Doesn't matter how many times they regen me.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_08: We talked about this. It's better if you don't need a regen.
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_10: But if I do regen, you remember you swore to get my armor, right?
localization.fw22_nt_datapad_solanki_msg_12: Don't die and I won't have to.

localization.genlocal_maintenance_e_desc_001,p:
Putting the word out to see if anyone has some spare time and parts for a quick patch-up at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. You just need <EM4>three fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to fix up three or so of my pipes.</EM4>

I can pay you for your time.

Heck, even if you have done this kinda work before, give <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal a read and then give it a shot. Won’t be worse off than we are now.


~mission(TargetName|First)
localization.genlocal_maintenance_e_title_001: Anyone free to make a couple of repairs?
localization.genlocal_maintenance_h_desc_001,p:
Hope someone can help me. We've suffered some severe damage to some of our machinery at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and could really use some help with repairs.

If you've got <EM4>spare fuses (six should definitely cover us)</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to repair up to eight pipes</EM4>, please get in touch. We can pay you for your time and effort.

But please know at least the bare minimum about what you’re doing. The last person who tried to help us hadn’t even read the <EM4>”Cornerstone Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in their mobiGlas Journal before trying to take our money and making a proper mess of it.

Thanks,

~mission(TargetName|First)
localization.genlocal_maintenance_m_desc_001,p:
Not sure if you all have seen it, but some of the machines here at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> took a lot of damage in the storm last night and I could really use some help.

Looking around, you probably won't need more than <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters</EM4> to patch up about five pipes.</EM4>

At least that’s what reading the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in my mobiGlas Journal seemed to say. But I don’t know, you’re the expert.

Thanks,

~mission(TargetName|First)

localization.gfs_invictustraining_mission01_desc:
If travelling to different star systems around the Empire, helping those in need, and protecting our borders sounds like a rewarding career to you, then maybe you’re ready to become a pilot in the UEE Navy.

The overall demand for naval pilots has increased in recent years which means there’s now more opportunity than ever before. However, to become a Navy pilot, you need to go through specialist training and gain many hours of flight experience.

To give you a small taste of what life as a combat pilot would be like, Gilly’s Flight School has partnered with the UEE Navy to offer a unique opportunity to take a special Patrol Training course that will run you through three scenarios covering a basic patrol. 

<EM4>SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #1 – Scanning a Patrol Point</EM4>

I believe that folks learn best by doing, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding out there. This is about throwing you into the deep end and giving you a chance to swim. You never know what you’re capable of until you’re given the chance.

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip. Plus, completing all three will get you a special keepsake.

Can’t wait to see you out there,
Instructor Gilly


ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
localization.gfs_invictustraining_mission02_desc:
Congrats on completing part one of this three-part course.

For your next patrol scenario, things are going to become even more intense.

Be prepared to encounter some hostiles and dogfight them in a realistic combat scenario just like real Navy pilots do while out on patrol.

The hostile ships are all specially equipped rigs made specifically for training purposes and will be piloted by graduates of the flight school to provide an engaging and educational experience.

<EM4>SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #2 – Neutralizing a Hostile Threat</EM4>

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.

Make sure you pick a ship ready for combat and I’ll see you out there,
Instructor Gilly


ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
localization.gfs_invictustraining_mission03_desc:
Congrats on completing part two of this three-part course.

For your next and final lesson, you will learn how to assist a ship in distress just like real Navy pilots do while out on patrol. They will be under simulated attack by our specially trained hostile pilots and it will be up to you to neutralize them as quickly and effectively as possible.

<EM4>SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #3 – Ship in Distress</EM4>

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip and a special keepsake.

I know you’re going to do great out there,
Instructor Gilly


ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
localization.gfs_shipwaveattack_mission01_desc:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.

Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing. 

That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. <EM4>The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.</EM4>

GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter

So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly    


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL 
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
localization.gfs_shipwaveattack_mission02_desc:
Congrats on completing part one of this eight-part course.

Scenario two will focus on how to deal with multiple targets at the same time. Goal here is give you a better handle on how to balance offense and defense.   

Whenever you’re set, grab a combat ship, and head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Pick Your Fight - For situations where you’re coming up against multiple targets of equal threat, your best strategy is to focus on neutralizing one target at a time to gradually reduce the amount of incoming fire.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
localization.gfs_shipwaveattack_mission03_desc:
Congrats on completing part two of this eight-part course.   

The third scenario throws tactical considerations into the mix. This time around the attacking ships are from distinct classes with distinct battlefield applications. Knowing what targets to prioritize is vital to surviving engagements against multiple ships.      

Whenever you’re ready, head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to get started.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Bigger They Are – Try to evaluate which threat is the most dangerous and take them out first.
- Shields – If you’re taking a lot of damage, don’t be afraid to boost away and let your shields regenerate.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
localization.gfs_shipwaveattack_mission04_desc:
Congrats on completing part three of this eight-part course.

Good combat pilots know not all threats are apparent. It’s the threats you don’t expect that can be the most devastating. Scenario four is focused on how to identify and deal with stealth targets. Hopefully by the end, you’ll understand just how important your radar is in determining who you’re really up against. Expect to have regular and stealth ships hunting you down.    

Make your way to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> whenever you’re ready, and remember to keep your eyes on your radar.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Surprise Attacks - Pinging your surroundings can sometimes reveal hidden ships. Be ready for contacts to show up unexpectedly.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
localization.gfs_shipwaveattack_mission05_desc:
Congrats on completing part four of this eight-part course.   

The fifth scenario focuses on defensive tactics. Knowing when to take evasive measures and deploy either decoys or noise countermeasures is essential to your survival. That’s why the aggressors in this exercise will be armed with missiles.   

Ensure your countermeasures are fully stocked and then go to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to start.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Ready to Launch - Easy access to your decoys and countermeasures can be critical in your success in dealing with incoming missile fire. 
- Stand and Fight - Resist the temptation to hit the afterburner to escape as you’ll increase your signature and make it easier for the missile to hit you. They’re almost certainly much faster than you anyway.
- Close the Gap – While it may seem counterintuitive, getting closer to an enemy ship can be an advantage. Missiles have a minimum range and if you’re inside of it they won’t be able to get a lock on you.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
localization.gfs_shipwaveattack_mission06_desc:
Congrats on completing part five of this eight-part course.

I’m bringing out the big guns for scenario six. Time for you to go up against larger, multi-crewed ships, which provide a few new challenges. Not only will you have to contend with their enhanced firepower but their multifaceted shields means you’ll have to target one shield face continually to do real damage. Easier said than done when both of y’all are moving at such fast speeds.      

Find your way to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> whenever you're ready.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>. 

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Size Advantage – When going up against a larger ship, try to stay away from their front as typically this is where the majority of their offensive fire is located. 

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
localization.gfs_shipwaveattack_mission07_desc:
Congrats on completing part six of this eight-part course.

You’ve gained a lot of experience across the past six scenarios, and now it’s time to put it all to practice. Scenario seven puts you up against a corvette-class ship and its escorts. This extended encounter will push you to the limit and test everything you got.   

The only thing left is to understand the limit of your skillset. To put it simply, you can’t do everything yourself. Developing and maintaining relationships with fellow pilots that you can call upon for support is really the last piece of the puzzle. Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.    

Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to kick off the encounter.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Strength in Diversity – Think about the roles your allies will be filling and choose who to bring carefully to help balance strengths and weaknesses. You’ll want ships capable of taking on the Corvette while others deal with the escort.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
localization.gfs_shipwaveattack_mission08_desc:
Welcome to the final scenario of the Combat Gauntlet.

Throughout this course, you’ve gotten to experience the advanced combat and defensive tactics needed to survive a variety of encounters. Time to take all those new skills and knowledge and see how they hold up against a large capital vessel and some escort ships.

You know the drill by now. Once you and all your allies are set, find your way to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to see how you do when truly pushed to the limits.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Patience is a Virtue – If you’ve balanced your squadron properly, you should be able to come out on top, just don’t expect it to be a quick fight. Ships this big don’t go down quickly.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
localization.gloc_bartender_conv_001_2,p: No problem. I've got just the thing.
localization.gloc_bartender_conv_001_3,p: Things have been quiet lately, sorry.
localization.gloc_bartender_conv_001_4,p: You let me know if there's anything else I can get you.
localization.gmcapture_desc:
To test the preparedness of our response teams, we would like volunteers to simulate an assault against a CDF Idris by neutralizing and taking control of the vessel.

To be clear, the goal of the exercise is not to destroy the Idris, but for you to attempt to board the craft and maintain control of it as long as possible. Volunteers should expect to meet full resistance from the Idris' highly trained crew and are encouraged to get an updated imprint beforehand.

Coordinates will be provided upon confirming your participation.

Thanks and good luck.
localization.gobling_arccorp_haulcargo_l_desc,p:
El here.

If you’re looking to make some creds and have a ship that can take at least <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>, head over to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. This is a big haul, so it’d be good to bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, and maybe even a <EM4>couple extra hands</EM4> to help you out.

Once you’ve got the resources from the freight elevator, take them to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. I’ve got someone on hand to process them for you and then we can sort your payment out.

Every bit helps ArcCorp get closer to securing a win.


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp
localization.gobling_arccorp_haulcargo_l_title: RESOURCE DRIVE: LARGE CARGO NEEDS HAULING
localization.gobling_arccorp_haulcargo_m_desc:
Hey it’s El.

Need a quick turnaround on this so I’ll get right to it.

One of our haulers miscalculated how much storage they had and has left a bunch of cargo over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We need someone with a ship that can handle <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> to pick them up from the freight elevator for us.

Don’t come unprepared like the last contractor. You’ll need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and probably <EM4>another crew member</EM4> if you want to avoid spending all day moving boxes.

Grab the cargo and take it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>.

Go team.


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp
localization.gobling_arccorp_haulcargo_m_title: RESOURCE DRIVE: MEDIUM CARGO NEEDS HAULING
localization.gobling_arccorp_haulcargo_s_desc:
El here.

We need a hauler who can pick up a couple of pieces of cargo for us ASAP.

You’ll just need a ship that can handle <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>. If you've got one, get over to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, scoop it all up from the freight elevator, and bring them to us. Drop the cargo off at a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>.

It’s as easy as that!

Thanks and good luck.


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp
localization.gobling_arccorp_haulcargo_s_title: RESOURCE DRIVE: SMALL CARGO NEEDS HAULING
localization.gobling_arccorp_recovercargo_l_desc,p:
Hey, it’s El.

We’ve got a situation over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. One of our contractors who was in the middle of transporting a lot of cargo for us stopped returning our comms. Hopefully it’s just a glitch, but being realistic, it’s probably something much worse. While that sucks and I feel bad, we all still got deadlines, right?

Anyway, we want you to head out with a large hauling vessel and grab their shipment of cargo. It’ll be pretty big so I’d definitely make sure you pack your <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and <EM4>bring someone reliable</EM4> to help you out. Expect to find between <EM4>100-125 SCU</EM4> of various box sizes.

Take it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. I’ll make sure someone’s on site to take care of it. We’ll pay you a proportional amount for whatever you’re able to return.

If you don’t have a big enough ship, you could always fly the abandoned cargo ship back. Though, you’d have to bring another pilot with you unless you plan on leaving your ship behind.

Hope you have better luck than the original haulers did.


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp
localization.gobling_arccorp_recovercargo_s_desc:
El here.

Bit worried about one of our contractors who’s been ghosting me and hasn’t completed their delivery of resources for the UEE initiative.

I need someone to head out to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> where they were last seen and bring back that cargo for us.

It was only between <EM4>50-55 SCU</EM4> of various box sizes, so it shouldn’t be too hard for you to move them if you have a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>, but that doesn’t mean you should take this job lightly. I’m a little worried there’s a reason our pilot isn’t responding. Be sure to keep an eye out for any hostiles in the area.

Get the cargo to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. I’ll ensure it gets to the right place.

Actually, if you have another pilot with you, you might find it simpler to have one of you fly the cargo ship instead. Your call though.

Thanks for the assist,


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp
localization.gobling_arccorp_recovercargofps_l_desc,p:
Hey, El here.

Got a big problem. Outlaws have taken out one of our transport ships and stolen the cargo.

The resources on that ship were flagged for that UEE initiative and we’re going to be in a lot of trouble unless we get them back.

Fortunately, I had the good sense to put tags on the cargo, so we’ve managed to track it down to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Corporate has approved a sliding pay scale based on whatever you can bring back. Ideally that’s all <EM4>~mission(ItemsToRecover) cargo boxes (all ~mission(MaxBoxSize) SCU or smaller)</EM4>, but we’ll take what we can get. Once you’ve got the cargo loaded up onto a decently size hauler, drop it off at a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. One of my colleagues will take care of the rest.

These outlaws mean business, so make sure you’re stocked up on weapons, supplies, and a <EM4>few friends</EM4> before you head out.

Good luck! I’m sure you’ll do great.


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp
localization.gobling_arccorp_recovercargofps_l_title: RESOURCE DRIVE: GET OUR LARGE CARGO BACK
localization.gobling_arccorp_recovercargofps_s_desc:
Hi, it’s El.

Looking for a decent enough contractor who isn’t afraid to take on some outlaws and recover the cargo they stole.

Since my boss is breathing down my neck about the numbers we’re pulling for this Second Life thing, we’re organizing multiple teams to hit all of the gang’s stash houses. You’re being assigned to go to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, deal with whatever’s going on over there, and bring the <EM4>~mission(ItemsToRecover) cargo boxes (all ~mission(MaxBoxSize) SCU or smaller)</EM4> stashed there back.

When you’ve got the stuff, take it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Our staff will get it logged for you.

If you can do your part and get as many boxes back as possible, we’ll make sure you’re given credit for everything the whole team brings back.


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp
localization.gobling_arccorp_recovercargofps_s_title: RESOURCE DRIVE: GET OUR SMALL CARGO BACK
localization.gobling_arccorp_resourcegathering_desc,p:
ArcCorp is still competing for top spot in the resource race, so we need reliable contractors like you to supply us with refined materials. Unsurprisingly, every shop is completely sold out of these, but luckily we’ve got a list of suggestions where to mine them along with what you'll earn:

- <EM4>Copper</EM4> (surface of Aberdeen) - <EM4>803 aUEC</EM4> per SCU
- <EM4>Tungsten</EM4> (surface of Lyria) - <EM4>1080 aUEC</EM4> per SCU
- <EM4>Corundum</EM4> (surface of ArcCorp) - <EM4>810 aUEC</EM4> per SCU

Make sure you get them refined before you hand them over, otherwise you’ll just make more work for us. <EM4>ARC-L1 Wide Forest Station</EM4> is a good option, but we don’t mind where you go so long as it gets done. Then, all you have to do is take the refined materials to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Oh, and make sure to submit the contract when you’re happy with the total amount you delivered.

If you haven't mined in a while, I suggest taking a look at URW's <EM4>“The Fundamentals of Mining”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. That should give you a few pointers.

And just so you know, each company has to declare publicly how much they’ve given to the cause. You can track this information, including who is leading in the initiative, in the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> Journal entry. ArcCorp have very generously agreed to give out additional rewards when contractors meet certain delivery thresholds. How nice is that?

Good luck and talk soon!


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp
localization.gobling_arccorp_resourcegathering_desc_i:
ArcCorp needs your help.

Under Imperator Addison’s new Second Life initiative, they’ve introduced a government program that will reward whichever company gathers the most resources to help with the regen crisis. ArcCorp is eager to win, and to do that we need plenty of reliable and dependable contractors.

If you can knock out this easy hauling job and show you’re competent, then I can start offering you some more complicated work next.

For this job, you’ll need a ship that can take <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>multi-tool with a tractor beam attachment</EM4>. Once you’re ready, head over to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, grab the cargo from the freight elevator, and deliver it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Easy, right?

If you want to keep track of how ArcCorp is stacking up against the competition, you can go to the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> section of your Journal. If you do really well and help us get to the top, I’ve been given permission by my superiors at ArcCorp to reward the hardest working contractors with some extra stuff on top of whatever credits you earn.

Come work for ArcCorp and be part of the winning team.


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp
localization.gobling_arccorp_supportattackedship_l_de:
Outlaws have hit an ArcCorp transport ship over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and they need urgent help defending it.

The cargo aboard is of vital importance to our standing in the Second Life resource drive, and we can’t afford to lose it. The captain and crew said they’re doing their best to hang on and get their quantum drive repaired, but honestly, I don’t think they have a chance at escaping unless they get some help. If they do make it back in one piece, I’ll make sure you get shared credit for the delivery.

Don’t underestimate these outlaws. <EM4>Bring as much firepower as you got and some backup</EM4> if you can.


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp
localization.gobling_arccorp_supportattackedship_l_ti: RESOURCE DRIVE: LARGE CARGO SHIP NEEDS HELP
localization.gobling_arccorp_supportattackedship_s_de:
Sending out an urgent request to any available contractor with combat pilot experience.

A small transport ship of ours is currently being attacked by a group of outlaws at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.

There’s a huge push for each delivery to help us to win this Second Life initiative, so we need someone to get over there, sort those outlaws out, and allow our transporter time to escape.

Needless to say, we’ll pay you if our hauler manages to deliver the goods and you’ll get credited for the SCU.

Gotta go,


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp
localization.gobling_arccorp_supportattackedship_s_ti: RESOURCE DRIVE: SMALL CARGO SHIP NEEDS HELP
localization.gobling_crusader_haulcargo_l_desc,p:
Your work for us is making a real difference, but there’s still more to do.

We’ve just received a generous donation of mining minerals over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, but unfortunately we don’t have anyone to transport them.

We need these materials picked up and safely delivered to us. Please make sure you have a ship that can handle at least <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>. These are large containers and will require a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor to move them</EM4>. I’d also <EM4>strongly suggest bringing some additional hands</EM4> to help out.

Once you’ve picked them up from the freight elevator, deliver them to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Our team will get them processed promptly.

Thank you for considering this contract, Crusader needs people like you.

Travel safe,


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries
localization.gobling_crusader_haulcargo_m_desc,p:
Your work for us has not gone unnoticed, we really appreciate it.

If you have a ship that can accommodate a shipment of <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, we need you to head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and collect the cargo there. You should be fine to complete this by yourself, but if you’re in a hurry, you might want to consider <EM4>bringing a friend</EM4> with you.

When you’ve finished collecting the cargo from the freight elevator, place it on a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. We have staff on hand that will process the delivery from there.

Thank you for your help as always.


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries
localization.gobling_crusader_haulcargo_s_desc:
Thank you for your hard work so far.

We have a small shipment of resources that need to be collected from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and delivered to us.

We’re looking for any capable pilots with a ship that can transport <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>multi-tool with a tractor beam attachment</EM4>.

After picking up the cargo from the freight elevator, deposit it on a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. A member of our team will be on site to receive it.

All the best,


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries
localization.gobling_crusader_recovercargo_l_desc:
One of our contractors, who was due to deliver a large shipment of cargo for us, has been forced to abandon their ship at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.

Trackers are indicating that the cargo is still intact, but we’ve been unable to contact the pilot. We have reason to suspect there may be hostile forces onsite. We’re looking for a pilot with a large hauling ship to head out there and bring the cargo back.

These resources are crucial to helping us win the UEE’s incentive program, so try to recover as much as possible. Expect to find between <EM4>100-125 SCU</EM4> of various box sizes. You’ll need <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to move it. If you are unable to retrieve all of it, we can only offer a partial payment for what you bring us. <EM4>We highly recommend bringing back-up for this one</EM4>, for your own sake.

Once obtained, take the cargo to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. We’ll take care of the rest.

When you find the deserted ship, if you think you or your co-pilot would be able to fly it back instead of extracting the cargo, that might be easier for you.

Be safe out there.


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries
localization.gobling_crusader_recovercargo_l_title: RESOURCE DRIVE: LARGE CARGO SHIP RECOVERY
localization.gobling_crusader_recovercargo_s_desc:
A contractor of ours has abandoned their ship at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and we need someone to recover their cargo immediately.

Expect to find between <EM4>50-55 SCU</EM4> of various box sizes, so a <EM4>standard multi-tool with a tractor beam attached </EM4> should suffice for moving everything to your hold. It’s likely that there are still hostile forces in the area, but please recover as much of the cargo as possible, every contribution, great or small, matters. We’ll pay you for as much as you can retrieve.

Once you’ve found the cargo, safely transport it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Our team will be sure to process it swiftly.

If you can find another pilot, it may be more convenient to fly the cargo ship directly, rather than having to transfer the cargo between ships. I’ll leave the details to you.

Take care.


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries
localization.gobling_crusader_recovercargo_s_title: RESOURCE DRIVE: SMALL CARGO SHIP RECOVERY
localization.gobling_crusader_recovercargofps_l_desc:
One of our transports was recently attacked by outlaws and while we’re relieved that the crew was spared, the cargo was stolen.

It’s of the utmost importance that we get the <EM4>~mission(ItemsToRecover) cargo boxes (all ~mission(MaxBoxSize) SCU or smaller)</EM4> back, as it contains a large amount of vital materials needed for the UEE’s resource contest.

Luckily, the outlaws that took our goods haven’t noticed that our trackers are still intact. Our cargo is being held at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.

These outlaws are highly dangerous, so please arm yourself accordingly and <EM4>consider bringing allies</EM4>. Ideally, you’ll be able to recover all the cargo, but considering how dangerous the situation is, we will offer partial payment for whatever you’re able to retrieve.

When you’ve recovered the cargo, safely transport it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Once it’s delivered, our team will handle it from there.

Take care of yourself out there.


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries
localization.gobling_crusader_recovercargofps_s_desc:
A small transport ship of ours has been intercepted by outlaws and its contents were stolen.

The good news is we’ve managed to track down some of these outlaws to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and are looking for contractors with combat experience to deal with them and recover our <EM4>~mission(ItemsToRecover) cargo boxes (all ~mission(MaxBoxSize) SCU or smaller)</EM4>. You’ll be working as part of a team covering multiple locations, so it’s crucial that everyone brings back as much of their assigned cargo as possible. Also, be on your guard, these outlaws aren’t likely to part with the cargo easily.

Once you’ve recovered the cargo, take it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Our logistics team will make sure it gets processed.

If you’re able to do this, we’ll be sure to credit you for the total amount of SCU recovered by all teams.

Good luck.


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries
localization.gobling_crusader_resourcegathering_desc:
Crusader still needs your help with the ongoing Resource Drive. Only by working together can we help end the regen crisis.

Your work so far has made a real difference, but we need continuous deliveries of the below refined materials to help with the Empire’s Second Life initiative. Due to the increase in demand, you won’t be able to purchase these in commodity markets, but they can still be mined. Below is list of the materials, suggested locations to find them, and the price we're offering:

- <EM4>Copper</EM4> (surface of Daymar) - <EM4>803 aUEC</EM4> per SCU
- <EM4>Tungsten</EM4> (surface of Wala) - <EM4>1080 aUEC</EM4> per SCU
- <EM4>Corundum</EM4> (asteroids near CRU-L3) - <EM4>810 aUEC</EM4> per SCU

Once mined, we would recommend refining at <EM4>CRU-L1’s Ambitious Dream Station</EM4> as it is near our drop off facility, however any refinery will suffice.

The refined ore can be delivered directly to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Just submit this contract when you’re satisfied with the amount of resources delivered.

If you're an inexperienced miner but still would like to contribute, consider looking at URW's <EM4>“The Fundamentals of Mining”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal for support.

As a reminder, each company is required to publicly disclose their contributions. You can track this information, including who is leading in the initiative, under the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> section of your Journal. As an incentive, Crusader will grant additional rewards when you’ve satisfied delivery thresholds.

Thank you for helping Crusader make a difference.


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries
localization.gobling_crusader_resourcegathering_desc_:
In response to the ongoing regen crisis, Imperator Addison has just announced the Second Life initiative, a coordinated government-led effort to find a solution as quickly as possible.

As part of that initiative, Crusader Industries and the other governing corporations of the Stanton system have been asked to contribute towards this important endeavor by gathering vital resources, with incentives and rewards being offered to the corporation that provides the most SCU of materials.

To win, we need hardworking, effective people like yourself to complete contracts for us. To get you started, we were hoping you could transport a shipment of the sought-after materials. Once you have completed this, we will be able to offer you a variety of work to further support us.

You will need a ship that can handle <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>multi-tool with a tractor beam attachment</EM4>. Once you’re ready, please head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, collect the cargo from the freight elevator, and deliver it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>.

In the interest of fair competition, each company is required to publicly disclose their contributions. You can track this information, including who is leading in the competition, under the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> section of your Journal. Those who personally contribute significant efforts to Crusader’s totals will be eligible to receive additional rewards.

With your help, I know Crusader can make a difference.


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries
localization.gobling_crusader_supportattackedship_l_d:
Putting out an urgent call to all trusted contractors.

One of our large hauling ships transporting resources intended for the Second Life Initiative is currently under attack by a group of outlaws and needs help.

The ship has sustained some damage, but they’re holding on for now. We need a contractor with combat experience who can <EM4>defend them long enough to allow them to get their quantum system back online and escape</EM4>.

Our system was tracking them to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> before we lost contact so I would start there. Due to the presence of a sizeable hostile force, we also <EM4>strongly advise bringing combat support with you</EM4>.

We’re desperate for help on this. If they’re able to complete their delivery, I’ll make sure you get credit for whatever SCU they drop off.


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries
localization.gobling_crusader_supportattackedship_l_t: RESOURCE DRIVE: DEFEND LARGE CARGO SHIP
localization.gobling_crusader_supportattackedship_s_d:
To all contractors with combat pilot experience: we need your help urgently.

A small cargo vessel of ours is currently under fire from a group of outlaws at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We need a capable pilot to head out there and <EM4>help defend them as they prepare to quantum</EM4>.

They don’t have much time. The resources they’re carrying, however small, will make a difference in the UEE’s call for resources. If they can deliver them, we’ll be sure to compensate you appropriately.


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries

localization.gobling_hurston_recovercargo_l_desc,p:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Resource Drive
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: A. Carmichael
RISK ASSESSMENT: High

One of our contractors failed to complete their resource shipment and is now missing.

Owing to the time sensitive nature of the UEE’s current resource initiative, our focus is on ensuring those materials get delivered ASAP. Procure a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, head out to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and deliver the recovered cargo to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. A member of our team will ensure it gets to the right people.

Hurston will pay for whatever can be recovered, but I would strongly encourage a full retrieval. Expect to find between <EM4>100-125 SCU</EM4> of various box sizes.

Since we don’t know the cause of the shipments delay, I would advise that you prepare for a fight and bring a competent fleet of <EM4>allies</EM4> with you. Just make sure you prioritize getting the cargo back safely above all.

Also, in the interest of efficiency, if you bring another pilot along you may wish to fly the cargo ship and its contents back directly.


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **
localization.gobling_hurston_recovercargo_s_desc:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Resource Drive
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: A. Carmichael
RISK ASSESSMENT: Moderate

According to our trackers, an important shipment of cargo appears to have stopped moving over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.

The pilot isn’t answering, so we assume they’ve been compromised. My superiors have written this off as a loss, but if any of the materials can be recovered, we are prepared to compensate you. Any standard <EM4>tractor beam</EM4> should be fine to facilitate the transfer of cargo to your ship after any hostile ships have been dealt with. Expect to find between <EM4>50-55 SCU</EM4> of various box sizes.

Bring what you find to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. I’ll send a member of our team to inspect them.

If the abandoned vessel is still intact, and you have an available pilot with you, you could avoid having to transfer that cargo and just fly it back.


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

Following a recent theft, we have learned that the outlaws responsible have distributed the stolen goods amongst various hideouts. As such, we are coordinating several strike teams to target each stash and take back our resources.
