localization.gobling_hurston_resourcegathering_desc,p:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Resource Drive
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: A. Carmichael
RISK ASSESSMENT: Low

Hurston’s mission isn’t complete yet.

We need every available SCU of the following refined resources in order to secure Hurston’s win of the UEE’s Second Life Resource Drive. Demand for them is so high, they are no longer available in shops and must be first mined. In the interest of efficiency, we’ve listed their most common locations in proximity to our processing plant along with the price you'll recieve: 

- <EM4>Copper</EM4> (surface of Aberdeen) - <EM4>803 aUEC</EM4> per SCU
- <EM4>Tungsten</EM4> (surface of Lyria) - <EM4>1080 aUEC</EM4> per SCU
- <EM4>Corundum</EM4> (asteroids near HUR-L2) - <EM4>810 aUEC</EM4> per SCU

Once you’ve mined the materials, you'll need to refine them. I recommend <EM4>HUR-L1 Green Glade Station</EM4>. Take the completed resources to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Submit the contract when you’re satisfied with the total amount you’ve provided.

Additional guidance on mining can be found under URW's <EM4>“The Fundamentals of Mining”</EM4> section of your mobiGlas Journal.

To help you realize what’s at stake here, you can see every company’s contribution in the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> section of your Journal. Remember that Hurston Dynamics rewards those who serve the company’s interests well.


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **
localization.gobling_hurston_resourcegathering_desc_i:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Resource Drive
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: A. Carmichael
RISK ASSESSMENT: Low

To solve the regen crisis, the Empire has put out a call for resources and Hurston Dynamics intends to answer. Whichever company donates the most wins government sponsored benefits, and we have no intention of losing.

As a first assignment, you are being tasked with making a small cargo delivery. More lucrative and complex work will follow the successful completion of this contract.

This assignment requires a ship that can carry <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>multi-tool with a tractor beam attachment</EM4>. Once you finished your preparations, head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, collect the cargo from the freight elevator, and deliver it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>.

The Second Life initiative requires us to publicly declare Hurston’s contributions. This information, along with the other corporations' contributions is available in the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> section of your Journal. Be aware that milestone bonuses are available for contractors who fulfil delivery quotas.

localization.gobling_microtech_haulcargo_l_desc,p:
The logistics involved with this Second Life competition are proving to be quite the challenge. It’s difficult enough to procure the resources and then when we do, there are not enough ships around to transport everything.

We’re looking for pilots with a vessel that can transport <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> to transport a shipment waiting at the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Please also bear in mind you’ll need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> for this and <EM4>a crew</EM4> that can help with handling the containers. Cargo is to be brought to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>.

Thanks again for helping us beat the other corporations.


Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech

The cargo is awaiting collection from the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and should be delivered to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Bringing <EM4>additional crew to help with the haul is advised</EM4>.

All the best,


Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech

localization.gobling_microtech_haulcargo_s_desc:
An influx of donations has left us short staffed, meaning we have an abundance of small tasks for competent haulers.

We’re looking for a contractor with a ship able to transport <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> to collect a delivery from the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.

Once acquired, deliver them to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Logistics will handle the processing.

Awaiting your response,


Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech
localization.gobling_microtech_haulcargo_s_title: RESOURCE DRIVE: SMALL CARGO TRANSPORT NEEDED
localization.gobling_microtech_recovercargo_l_desc,p:
We were due to receive a large shipment of refined minerals from a contractor, but they never showed up. Our trackers indicate that the ship is currently stationary at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> but we haven’t be able to raise anyone on comms.

Corporate just approved a contract to recover that cargo.

First, get yourself <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and head to the ship’s location. We suspect you’ll encounter some resistance, but nothing you and <EM4>a competent crew</EM4> can’t handle. Once you’ve dealt with whatever’s out there, take the cargo to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Expect to find between <EM4>100-125 SCU</EM4> of various box sizes.

In case the ship does still appear to be intact, you might find it easier to fly it with the cargo already onboard. You would of course need an additional pilot for your other ship.

Keep up the good work.


Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech
localization.gobling_microtech_recovercargo_s_desc:
It seems that a contractor of ours had an issue with their delivery and abandoned their cargo over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.

This cargo is incredibly important to the resource drive and we need them recovered.

Once you’re ready, head over to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> with the appropriate equipment (like a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>) and retrieve the cargo. Expect to find between <EM4>50-55 SCU</EM4> of various box sizes. 

Also, in order to guarantee the cargo’s safety, be on the lookout for any hostiles in the area. Once secured, deliver the resources to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. My colleagues will secure it.

You may even find that the cargo ship is still operational, so if you have another pilot with you, it may be worth using that ship to deliver everything. We’ll leave that decision with you.

Kind Regards,


Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech
localization.gobling_microtech_recovercargofps_l_desc:
Outlaws have been targeting the valuable resources we need to compete in the UEE initiative. Fortunately, implanted trackers in the cargo indicate that it’s being held at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We just need someone to go and get it.

This situation is far from optimal, but I’m hoping you’ll be able to deal with the thieves and return the <EM4>~mission(ItemsToRecover) cargo boxes (all ~mission(MaxBoxSize) SCU or smaller)</EM4> to us. I’ve done some quick calculations on the number of reported outlaws and would advise bringing <EM4>additional support</EM4> if possible.

After you’ve recovered the cargo, you can bring it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. Our logistics team can process it from there.

Obviously, the more you can recover the better, but we’ll take whatever you can get.

Best of luck with this one, you’ll need it.


Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech
localization.gobling_microtech_recovercargofps_s_desc:
A group of outlaws have been targeting our smaller transport ships and as a result, a number of crucial resources that are needed for the UEE’s drive have been stolen from us.

Our trackers are showing that these outlaws have spread the cargo across several locations. We need someone who can work as a part of a wider recovery team and retrieve the portion of the shipment being stashed at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. The outlaws there will be heavily armed, so plan accordingly.

Once you have the <EM4>~mission(ItemsToRecover) cargo boxes (all ~mission(MaxBoxSize) SCU or smaller)</EM4> in your possession, deliver them to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>. In addition to the specific materials you personally return, you will share credit for all the stolen items recovered from other sites.

Looking forward to hearing of your success.


Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech
localization.gobling_microtech_resourcegathering_desc:
We really appreciate all that you’ve done so far, but we’re still seeking additional resources to help secure our position in the Second Life initiative.

If you have any of the refined materials listed below, please deliver them to us. I doubt you’ll be able to find these in commodity markets at the moment, so we’ve attached a list of suggestions as to where these important resources can be extracted from and the price you'll receive:

- <EM4>Copper</EM4> (surface of Euterpe) - <EM4>803 aUEC</EM4> per SCU
- <EM4>Tungsten</EM4> (surface of Wala) - <EM4>1080 aUEC</EM4> per SCU
- <EM4>Corundum</EM4> (surface of microTech) - <EM4>810 aUEC</EM4> per SCU

Ensure you refine the ore before bringing them to us. This can be done at the conveniently located <EM4>MIC-L1 Shallow Frontier Station</EM4>. Then you can deliver it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>.

Should you need assistance with mining, URW's <EM4>“The Fundamentals of Mining”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal provides a basic overview of the process.

You’ll find all the details of the Second Life initiative, including the other corporation’s standing in the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> section of your Journal. As an extra incentive, microTech will provide bonuses to contractors who meet productivity goals.

Let’s get to work,


Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech

Here at microTech, we are committed to supporting the Empire and its people through these turbulent times. That’s why we’re delighted to announce that we will be participating in Imperator Addison’s Second Life initiative and competing side by side with the other corporations of Stanton to provide the resources needed to end the regen crisis once and for all.

We’re looking for highly skilled contractors that can help support us in our work. If you believe you’re able to do this, we would welcome you to complete this preliminary hauling contract before providing you with additional work.

You will need a ship able to transport <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>multi-tool with a tractor beam attachment</EM4> for this delivery. The shipment is waiting to be collected from the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and should be delivered to a freight elevator at: <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address|ListAll)</EM4>.

The public declaration of each corporation's donations is a key part of this initiative. To access this information, please consult the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> section of your mobiGlas Journal. As an added reward, microTech will provide bonuses to contractors who meet productivity goals.

Let’s work together for the betterment of Humanity.


Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech
localization.gobling_microtech_supportattackedship_l_:
This one is urgent. A transport ship of ours is currently under attack. They were able to share their last known location of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> shortly before losing contact.

Since this is a high-risk situation, <EM4>we strongly suggest you bring backup</EM4>. I have every confidence that you and your crew will be able to <EM4>occupy the outlaws long enough for the ship to complete repairs and escape with its cargo</EM4>.

Outside of the contract’s payment, you’ll receive credit for the resources they deliver.

Looking forward to hearing of your success.


Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech

Aster Remmington

localization.goss1_desc: The abundant farmlands that cover most of this planet's massive mono-continent are used to exclusively feed the large population on neighboring planet, Cassel. \n
localization.goss2_desc: Hundreds of millions of tourists from all over the universe come to visit the beautiful coastlines of this biodiverse world.  \n
localization.goss3_desc: Access to this large sub-tropical world is restricted to those who receive clearance from the military base on its surface.  \n
localization.goss_desc: Generally regarded as one of the most visually stunning parts of the Empire, Goss is a binary star system situated near the massive stellar phenomenon known as the Olympus Pool. Consequently, the bulk of the system's economy comes from tourism, but Gossians pride themselves on being self sufficient as the system produces its raw materials internally, mining and harvesting resources on their own.\n
localization.goss_jumppoint_helios_desc: This jump point connects Goss to the Helios system.
localization.goss_jumppoint_osiris_desc: This jump point connects Goss to the Osiris system which is protected by the Fair Chance Act.
localization.goss_jumppoint_tayac_desc: This jump point connects Goss to the Tayac system.
localization.goss_jumppoint_terra_desc: This jump point connects Goss to the Terra system.
localization.goss_jumppoint_tyrol_desc: This jump point connects Goss to the unclaimed Tyrol system.
localization.goss_star1_desc: A class-K main sequence star that is part of a binary pairing with Goss B.
localization.goss_star2_desc: A class-K main sequence star that is part of a binary pairing with Goss A.

localization.guidestartaxi_repui_description: GuideStar began life as a service that would rent private ships that were stored in ASOP, so that owners could offset storage costs. The program did not prove as popular as GuideStar's secondary service of offering a safe and secure ride share program matching people in the need of transportation to available pilots. Today, the company has thousands of verified contractors across all systems in the UEE who affordably shuttle millions of passengers.
localization.guild_united_wayfarers_club_repui_descri: The UWC represents a vast network of repair, refueling and recovery specialists spread across the UEE. The network has even grown to include a handful of Banu and Xi’an affiliate clubs.  The UWC's expanding reach aims to ensure safe travel for all Club members, no matter how far from home they may find themselves.
localization.guild_united_wayfarers_club_repui_focus: In-flight repairs, refueling and re-arming. Vehicle rescue and retrieval.

localization.hadrian1_desc: A gas planet with a rocky core, Hadrian I's atmosphere is too volatile to terraform.\n
localization.hadrian2_desc: A Class III gas giant, Hadrian II is a featureless blue globe.
localization.hadrian3_desc: Nicknamed "the Watcher" thanks to the large dark spot in the planet's otherwise pale color, Hadrian III is a massive ice giant on the fringe of the system.\n
localization.hadrian_asteroidbelt1_desc: Located near a jump point, there are still some undetonated anti-ship mines lurking about in here lingering from the cold war. As such, the asteroids were never mined, so daring miners will risk it. A path between the Terra jump point and the remaining jumps was cleared through the belt (buoys were placed to make sure people stayed on the path).\n
localization.hadrian_desc: Known as "No Man's Land", Hadrian's location near Xi'an space made it a militarily strategic system during the cold war. Now it is famous for being a main shipping checkpoint between the UEE and Xi'an Empire. Travelers are advised to stay in the system's safe space lanes, which are demarcated by buoys. Those who ignore the space lanes are liable to encounter unexploded anti-ship mines left over from the cold war.\n
localization.hadrian_flotilla_desc: On the lagrange point of Hadrian II, there's a mini-mall cluster of former military stations that have been converted into a massive bazaar. Some newer trade stations have opened in recent years as the site has become a mecca of trade to the Xi'an.
localization.hadrian_jumppoint_castra_desc: This jump point connects Hadrian to the Castra system.
localization.hadrian_jumppoint_gurzil_desc: This jump point connects Hadrian to the Gurzil system.
localization.hadrian_jumppoint_kiel_desc: This jump point connects Hadrian to the Kiel system.
localization.hadrian_jumppoint_oya_desc: This jump point connects Hadrian to the Oya system.
localization.hadrian_jumppoint_pyro_desc: This jump point connects Hadrian to the unclaimed Pyro system.
localization.hadrian_jumppoint_terra_desc: This jump point connects Hadrian to the Terra system.
localization.harvestable_armillaria_desc: Preferring to spore in the depths of dark caves, the fruiting mushrooms of the Bluemoon fungus are often collected as a highly-valued petroleum-free lubricant used across a wide-variety of industries.
localization.harvestable_armillaria_lev_desc: First discovered in the sewer lines at the QV Mining Station built into the Delamar asteroid in Nyx, this quick growing fungus has become a useful manufacturing component for the settlers of Levski thanks to the strong mycelium fibers that can be dried and used in a variety of ways.
localization.harvestable_molinamold_desc: This aggressive fungus was first discovered growing within faulty air filters installed in Levski. The spores, when inhaled in high enough concentrations, can make Humans fatally ill.
localization.hathor_hathor_keycard_terminal_update: Hathor Employees will be held responsible for lost or compromised keycards.
localization.hathor_keycard_terminal_olp_paf_bunker_b: Terminal used to activate a mining laser. Only functional when a matching laser activation keycard is inserted.
localization.hathor_keycard_terminal_olp_storage_body: This terminal grants temporary access to OLP Storage doors.
localization.hathor_keycard_terminal_paf_maintenance_: This terminal grants temporary access to PAF Maintenance doors.
localization.hathor_keycard_terminal_paf_security_bod: This terminal grants temporary access to PAF Security doors.
localization.hathor_laser_datapad_001_text:
Congratulations on your relocation to Stanton from the Hathor Group!

We’re delighted to have you join us for this exciting new mining project.

Hathor has always been an ambitious company, and we believe that by opening multiple facilities across Stanton, we can firmly cement our status as leaders in Extracting Value.

That’s why it’s important that employees (both old and new) continue to maintain high levels of output and productivity whilst on site.

To support this, we’ve implemented a new personal monitoring initiative to ensure we stay on target. At the end of each shift, you must submit the total volume of ore you have extracted, list any wastage or unusable ore, along with reasoning as to why it could not be salvaged. Submitting this information is compulsory and failure to do so will result in sanctions, disciplinary procedures, and, in extreme cases, suspension of pay.

If you have any questions about the new extended working hours, overtime policy, or ore initiative, do not hesitate to contact your site foreman: Rufus Dunbar.

Jona Trevena
CEO
Hathor Group
localization.hathor_laser_datapad_002_text:
Listen up people, I know a lot of you aren’t happy about the current situation and the recent attacks but what y’all need to understand is that all your whining and bellyaching ain’t gonna get you anywhere.

Now I know we’re all a bit shaken about what happened to JJ, but there are certain risks that come with the job and that was one of them. It's important we learn from it and move on.

Because that’s what real miners do. They just get on with it. Even when it gets tough. Especially when it gets tough.

So let’s get to work.

- RD
localization.hathor_laser_datapad_003_text:
To: Rufus Dunbar
From: Armaan Ascher
Subject: RE: Letter of Resignation
2855-07-15 10:01

Hi Rufus,

Thank you for your message.

We appreciate your honesty and welcome your feedback.

It is unfortunate that you feel like you no longer have a future within the company and we hope that we can work together to resolve that.

Before we officially process your resignation, we would like to update you on some recent developments within the company:

1. As of tomorrow, all employee paychecks will be suspended until after the completion of the mining projects in Stanton. Whilst this may seem drastic, we want to ensure that everyone is focusing on their duties and responsibilities in relation to the project and are motivated to see it through to completion.

2. This change to payment schedules applies to all on-site staff, and includes backdated and future payments.

The Hathor Group cannot emphasize enough the importance of the completion of these mining projects, not just for the individuals involved, but for the success of the company as a whole.

We look forward to hearing your response.

Kindest Regards,
Armaan Ascher
Head of Staff

-----
To: Armaan Ascher
From: Rufus Dunbar
Subject: Letter of Resignation
2855-07-15 08:40

Dear Armaan

I’d like to thank the Hathor Group for giving me this opportunity but I’d like to formally hand my notice in. I’ve been offered another job over in Leir and I’m planning on accepting.

After what happened with JJ, Issac, and Milford, it just ain't worth it. This isn't what I signed up for and it isn't what I was promised.

I’m still owed my last 3 paychecks and would appreciate if you could pay me as soon as possible before leaving.

All the best,
Rufus Dunbar
localization.hathor_laser_datapad_004_text:
2853-02-02

Found out this week I’m being relocated to Stanton. Honestly I’d be more excited about leaving this dump of a system behind if it didn’t mean I have to leave Barney and Lola here too. Rufus says there’s no pets allowed on site which feels kinda personal but whatever.

2853-02-09

We stopped in at New Junction for a refuel and I got to talking with this Banu. Told him about my dogs and he said he had just the thing. He showed me these weird worm things and at first I thought you’ve gotta be kidding me, but then he said they make great pets. I picked one of them up and started playing with it and turns out they’re kinda friendly. They sorta feel like old leather. Anyway this guy said I should be careful but I didn't really know what he meant.

I ended up buying both of them and naming them Julie and Jim. I figured I could keep them under my bed and no one has to know about them. I hope they get along as well as Barney and Lola did.

2853-02-18

Little Julie and Jim aren’t so little anymore and I’m getting kinda worried. They’ve almost doubled in size since last week and I don’t know what to do. Julie’s almost the size of my arm now and she seems really pissed all the time. Had to seal them in a crate after they broke out last time and they don’t like it at all. I should really tell Louis but I have a feeling I know what he’ll say. I don’t want to lose these guys too.

2853-02-24

I decided to let Julie and Jim go. They weren’t happy in the crate and it wasn’t fair on them. I drove them far out into the desert at night and let them out. Julie jumped straight into the sand and was gone just like that, but Jim seemed a bit scared. I waited with him for a while and kept telling him it would be okay and eventually he went. Still can’t believe they’re gone. Hopefully, someone else finds them and can give them a home.
localization.hathor_laser_datapad_005_text:
To All Employees,

Hathor has updated the security protocols regarding the storage of certain supplies at Orbital Laser Platforms (OLP). High value items will now be kept in a secured storage room with access restricted to my Supervisor keycard. Anyone needing these supplies must comm me with a list of requested items, which corporate must approve before being released. 

Please take this new approval process into consideration for scheduling work, as immediate access to some items is no longer an option. Corporate has made it abundantly clear that a slowdown in productivity due to this new workflow is also not an option.      

Thank you for your patience and understanding with these new protocols. The success of Hathor’s Stanton operations depend on us being able to work efficiently and within budget. Please reach out to me with any questions. 

Ayana Reyes
OLP Supervisor
Hathor Group
localization.hathor_laser_datapad_006_text:
To All Hathor Employees,

I write to you today with a heavy heart. After 465 remarkable years, the Hathor Group will be shuttering all operations. Despite the best efforts of me and the board, we were not able to keep this company solvent amidst adverse economic headwinds, onerous environmental protection laws, and increased competition over dwindling resource reserves. 

This isn’t the way any of us wanted it to end, but there’s still much to be proud about. Hathor was the first company to purchase mining rights to an entire system in 2468. Now named Nexus, many UEE officials have told me that they wished the system’s original name of Hathor was still used to honor this incredible achievement. Furthermore, innovations created by this company revolutionized and streamlined strip mining by allowing for faster and more efficient resource extraction. Finally, despite our business being targeted by well-intentioned but overzealous politicians with the Fair Chance Act, Hathor not only survived but thrived as many other mining concerns of our size failed. Though the Hathor story may end today, you can be certain that our legacy will endure.        

It’s been the honor of my life to run this company and work with all of you fine folks. I wish you all the best in your future endeavors.

Jona Trevena
CEO
Hathor Group
localization.hathor_laser_datapad_007_subject: FW: RE: urgent access needed to security room!
localization.hathor_laser_datapad_007_text:
To: Armaan Ascher
From: Rufus Dunbar
Subject: FW: RE: urgent access needed to security room!

Armaan,

Forwarding this on to you. With Louis' performance review coming up thought you should know about the quality of his work.

- RD
 
-----
To: Louis Spitzer
From: Rufus Dunbar
Subject: RE: urgent access needed to security room!

Louis,

Don’t worry, I’ll sort it. On my way in now.

- RD 

-----
To: Rufus Dunbar
From: Louis Spitzer
Subject: urgent access needed to security room!

Hey Rufus

I’m really sorry and I know you’re not working today but I’ve made a huge mistake and thought I should let you know as soon as possible.

I printed a security keycard to access the room with the alignment blades and I don’t know what happened but it got stuck and I start messing with it and it snapped off in the printer. I finally managed to get the other half out but now the printer says it won’t be ready for another few hours and we need to get the dishes aligned for tomorrow's excavation.

Is there anything we can do to get another one printed? I know I messed up but I really wanna make it right and I can’t afford to lose this job. 

Louis
localization.hathor_laser_datapad_008_text:
IMPORTANT UPDATE ON ATLS SUIT

To all ATLS Suit Operators,

ATLS suits will now be housed in secure storage at the large warehouses. While not in use, they should remain in there at all times and must NOT be used outside. Due to the extreme weight of the suit, its movement causes enough seismic activity that will disturb valakkar. The number of work-based incidents has almost tripled in the past week and we are rapidly falling behind schedule.

To absolutely guarantee the correct usage of the ATLS suit, the following rules will be put into place effective immediately:

1) The suits will only be accessible when the dish has been fully activated.

2) Any member of staff caught misusing the suit will immediately be reprimanded by their supervisor. This includes (but is not limited) to the following:

- Leaving the ATLS unsupervised for any amount of time
- Throwing objects using the tractor beam rather than placing them
- Not returning the suit to the warehouse after use
- Using the suit for recreational activities

We are serious about making this site a safe working environment whilst maintaining high levels of output.

Please work with us and not against us.

Gary Copley
Site Foreman

localization.hdactivist_assassination_danger_001: Don't take this target lightly. There's a reason Hurston's relied on them to do so much dirty work.
localization.hdactivist_assassination_danger_002: You're going after one vicious bastard, so best come prepared.
localization.hdactivist_assassination_danger_003: I'd recommend hitting them hard and fast before they have a chance to comm for backup.
localization.hdactivist_assassination_danger_004: Watch out for this one. 'Mercy' isn't part of their vocabulary.
localization.hdactivist_assassination_desc_001:
To anyone who knows Hurston's recent history, they know that ~mission(TargetName) is responsible for some truly vicious crimes against the honest men and women who are trying to improve worker conditions on Hurston. Time and time again, they have acted well outside the bounds of UEE law but, of course, Hurston denies that ~mission(TargetName|Last) has anything to do with these crimes and refuses to even investigate them. This miscarriage of justice means that we must take matters into our own hands. 

Recently, an insider sympathetic to our cause says ~mission(TargetName|Last) can be found around ~mission(Location|Address). I will happily pass along this information, and a substantial payday, to anyone willing to bring vengeance upon them. ~mission(Danger)~mission(Contractor|Timed) 

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_assassination_desc_002:
Any chance you've heard of ~mission(TargetName)? Hurston recently promoted this bloodthirsty thug to a special task force that makes dissidents disappear. ~mission(TargetName|Last) has proven to be quite effective and even taken a perverse pleasure in the new position. It's obvious that the universe would be better off if ~mission(TargetName|Last) was taken down.

~mission(Danger)I managed to get a hold of their latest deployment orders. You should be able to find them at ~mission(Location|Address).

~mission(Contractor|Timed) 

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_assassination_desc_003:
Let's just say the less you know about this one the better. We want you to find and eliminate a Hurston lackey named ~mission(TargetName). ~mission(Danger) 

Details containing their last known sighting around ~mission(Location|Address) will be provided. ~mission(Contractor|Timed) 

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_assassination_timed_001: Word spreads fast around here. Don't wait too long on this, or you might lose the element of surprise.
localization.hdactivist_assassination_timed_002: For the sake of the movement, it's vital this gets done soon.
localization.hdactivist_assassination_timed_003: There's chatter that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is planning something big. You've got to stop them before it's too late.
localization.hdactivist_assassination_timed_004: We need you to move fast on this. Who knows what the target is working on.
localization.hdactivist_basesweep_danger_001: They aren't expecting you, but don't think for a second this is going to be easy. Those bastards love to fight.
localization.hdactivist_basesweep_danger_002: Make sure you have more than enough ammo. There's no way to know how many of 'em will be down there.
localization.hdactivist_basesweep_danger_003: Make sure you're armed up and prepared for war.
localization.hdactivist_basesweep_danger_004: I'm not gonna lie, this will get bloody, but that's what we have to do to secure our future.
localization.hdactivist_basesweep_desc_001:
Recently, Hurston security forces have been increasingly more violent to anyone voicing opposition to their authority. We've tried all legal channels, but it seems that an equally aggressive response will be the only way they'll hear us. I'm looking to pay someone to deliver that message.

We've learned that security forces have been operating out of ~mission(Location|Address). I'll send you the coordinates. You go in and clear it out. ~mission(Contractor|BaseSweepDanger)

Hopefully there will be a day where we can resolve this through rational discourse, but they've made it clear that it is not today.

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_basesweep_desc_002:
Looking for a heavy hitter interested in some serious action. ~mission(Location|Address) is crawling with corrupt, armed assholes working for Hurston. I need them gone, pronto. Don't care how you handle it, only that it gets done. ~mission(Contractor|Danger) 

Do this right and you'll be compensated accordingly.

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_basesweep_desc_003:
If you found this, it's probably safe to say that you have an axe to grind with Hurston. I don't know about you, but I'm sick and tired of waiting for things to magically get better. What we need are bold actions to show Hurston that the status quo must go. 

That's why I dug up some info about ~mission(Location|Address). It's where corporate thugs hang out and plan their attacks on the people of Hurston. Clearing that location would send a bold message to Corporate that we're willing to fight fire with fire. You interested? 

It'll be dangerous, but you'll be paid well. ~mission(Contractor|BaseSweepDanger) 

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_basesweep_desc_004:
We got intel on ~mission(Location|Address) that says it's staffed with corporate thugs. We aren't just going to sit around and wait for them to crack down on our brothers and sisters who are just trying to make Hurston a better place to live. I don't have the skills to handle this type of op, but I've got the creds to fund it. Interested? 

Should go without saying, but this job will be highly dangerous. ~mission(Contractor|BaseSweep)A lot of good people will get hurt if someone doesn't stop them.

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_basesweep_desc_005:
Looking for someone who's willing to fight for what's right. For far too long Hurston has used violence to keep its people in line. Now it's time to show them that their intimidation tactics won't go unanswered.

I've recently obtained intel that's identified ~mission(Location|Address) as being key to their security operations. Anyone willing to clear out the location will be doing the people of Hurston a great service. It'll be risky, but I'll also make sure you're paid well for your trouble. ~mission(Contractor|BaseSweep) 

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_stealfromship_outlaw_desc_001:
One of the smugglers we work with on occasion, ~mission(TargetName), refuses to complete our arranged delivery unless we triple our agreed-upon payment. As you can imagine, we can't allow their greed to endanger the movement, nor can we afford to pay their unreasonable demands. 

Instead, we're hopeful that you'll be able to track them down for us and forcefully retrieve our rightful property. Once you successfully bring the shipment to ~mission(Destination|Address), we will gladly give you the credits we had originally promised ~mission(TargetName|Last). 


** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_stealfromship_outlaw_desc_002:
Recently, one of our much needed supply runs got hit by an outlaw. Before our hauler died, they managed to confirm the identity of their attacker - ~mission(TargetName).

We need you to hunt this bastard down and take back what's ours. And of course we'll pay you for delivering the supplies to ~mission(Destination|Address).


** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_stealfromship_outlaw_desc_003:
~mission(TargetName) betrayed us. 

An important shipment we had smuggled in to ~mission(Destination|Address) went missing a few days ago and we were finally able to track it down. One of our operatives, ~mission(TargetName|Last), had stolen it.

We need that traitor tacked down and the shipment brought back. Do whatever you need to.  


** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_stealfromship_outlaw_desc_004:
Hurston Security is taking active action to cut off our supply routes. They're even turning a blind eye to outlaws in the area as long as it's our ships being attacked. We need to respond before our resources are completely cut off. 

We've been able to track down the location of one of these outlaws, ~mission(TargetName). Bring the stolen goods aboard their ship back to ~mission(Destination|Address). I don't expect ~mission(TargetName|Last) will give it up without a fight.

Hopefully this'll show Hurston that we will not back down.


** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_danger_001: Things could get dangerous. Gear up just in case.
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_danger_002: Watch yourself out there. Pretty sure Hurston will do whatever it takes to keep us from getting this thing.
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_danger_003: Fair warning, but security might be at the site. If they come after you, do what's necessary to get that crate.
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_danger_004: As always, a gig like this can be dangerous. So plan for the worst, hope for the best, right?
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_danger_005: Be careful. Security could be all over that location.
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_desc_001:
Got information on the location of a certain package that would greatly help our cause. We're looking for someone willing to hit up ~mission(Location|Address), retrieve the item, and deliver it to ~mission(Destination|Address). Interested? 

~mission(Contractor|Timed)~mission(Contractor|Danger)

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_desc_002:
Want to support a good cause and earn some solid creds? 

If so, then help us get our hands on specific crate that's supposed to be in ~mission(Location|Address). If you find the crate and bring it to ~mission(Destination|Address), I'll make it worth your while. ~mission(Contractor|Danger) 

~mission(Contractor|Timed) 

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_desc_003:
There's a growing movement focused on making Hurston a better place and we need some help. We've been tracking a certain item for some time that could help our cause in multiple ways. With Hurston's recent escalation of oppression, we believe now is the time to acquire it for ourselves, but with security forces watching our every move, we need someone else to collect it from ~mission(Location|Address). 

If you bring the crate to ~mission(Destination|Address), we'll pay you a price commensurate with your troubles. ~mission(Contractor|Danger)~mission(Contractor|Timed)  

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_desc_004:
Recently, Hurston fabricated charges against a hauler working for us in order to confiscate a very important delivery. Their actions aren't legal, even by Hurston standards, but they don't care and we can't wait attain it through legal channels. That's why I'm looking to pay someone to do it for us.

An insider who's sympathetic to our cause claims it ended up in ~mission(Location|Address). I'll send you the exact coordinates. ~mission(Contractor|Timed) 

Once you have the crate, bring it to ~mission(Destination|Address) and I'll transfer the creds. ~mission(Contractor|Danger) 

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_desc_005:
The Lorville customs office claims to have lost a crate that was being sent to us by a prominent supporter outside the system. I've got it on good authority that's a lie. Those Hurston bastards simply seized it to mess with us. I can't let this injustice stand and hope you're willing to help right this wrong.

I just got word that they moved the crate to ~mission(Location|Address). I need someone to find this thing and bring it to ~mission(Destination|Address). ~mission(Contractor|Timed)~mission(Contractor|Danger)I'll make sure you're paid well for all your trouble.

** Ex Malo Bonum **
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_desc_006:
I need your help. An old friend was desperate for work, so I threw him a gig hauling a valuable item for us. Turns out he had an active crime stat, and Hurston Security arrested him before he could make the delivery. Now I'm in hot water. That crate needs to get to ~mission(Destination|Address) or I'm screwed.

I pulled a few strings and discovered that the cargo actually ended up in ~mission(Location|Address). I'll pay you if you can retrieve it for me and make the delivery. ~mission(Contractor|Danger)~mission(Contractor|Timed) 

** Ex Malo Bonum**
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_timed_001: Don't drag your heels. Who knows how long that crate will be there.
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_timed_002: I can't stress how important it is that you get this shipment to us.
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_timed_003: The clock's ticking on this contract. We need this thing as soon as possible.
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_timed_004: Need it sooner rather than later.
localization.hdactivist_stealitem_timed_005: Hopefully, this thing isn't already gone. Better hurry up and find out.
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_e_cfp_desc_001:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life. 

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet. 

Go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_e_cfp_title_001: Take Out Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Supply
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_e_desc_001:
Some competition has taken root at ~mission(Location|Address) and they've really been gumming up the works for our operations in the area.

Now part of me sees some potential in the upstarts so I'm hoping to bring them into fold, but at the same time, I can't really afford to have them flying around causing trouble.

Instead, I want you to go and blow up their fuel tanks. That should keep them grounded long enough for me to talk some sense into their thick heads.

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_h_desc_001:
Look, Headhunters don't waste time on petty revenge, but I'm not about to let this nonsense fly either.

Some asshole took out a bunch of my crew and has been bragging all over about it. I've also heard that this nullbrain is stockpiling quantum fuel over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. I'd like to see how they deal with some real heat when you fly over there and burn everything they've built to the ground. Oh, and with the amount of firepower they got gathered over there, wouldn't be smart to fly alone on this one, so take a crew with you.

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_h_xt_desc_001:
It seems that XenoThreat has gotten the same intel we did and are looking to pull off the same job as us. 

I want you to knock the competition out of the picture. Go to ~mission(Location|Address) and take out the fuel tanks they got there.

Then my people can finish up without worrying about XenoThreat crashing the party.

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_killship_m_desc_0:
Everyone has been talking about a new player named ~mission(TargetName) who is operating out of ~mission(Location|Address). They've become a real concern for the Headhunters. 

It's time to shut them down. 

Head over, take out ~mission(TargetName|Last) and then clear out any fuel stores they have there to convince anyone remaining to leave. 

Figure after you pull this off, nobody will even remember their name.

-Stows
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_m_cfp_desc_001:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong. 

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at ~mission(Location|Address) and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_m_cfp_title_001: Blow Up Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Reserves
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_m_desc_001:
Feels like everyone wants a piece of our pie these days. Scouts are reporting that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is crawling with some new gang who've got it in for us.

So let's show them why you don't mess with us. Take out their fuel stores and leave them stranded.

That oughta send a message.

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_multi_e_cfp_desc_:
Every day it seems like Citizens for Prosperity is out here trying to snatch up more people for their shitty little cause and make life more difficult for hardworkin' folks like ourselves. 

I figure they could use a reminder about who really is in charge here. Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and really mess the place up. 

Nothing like a bit of property damage to get a point across.

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_multi_e_cfp_title: Teach Citizens for Prosperity A Lesson
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_multi_e_xt_desc_0:
It's no secret that there's no love lost between Headhunters and XenoThreat, but a full out war between us doesn't really benefit anyone.

Still, we aren't about to give them a total pass, you know? Instead we need to be a bit more subtle. 

I want you to head to ~mission(Location|Address) and blow up the fuel tanks there. 

Subtle, right?

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_s_desc_001:
We've heard news that a new gang are planning an attack on a place over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. They figure if they can take out the fuel supplies there then it's theirs for the taking.

But little do they know that we're gonna send you in first to blow the fuel tanks so we can claim the place before they do. If it all goes to plan, we can clear the location out and stick it to that gang at the same time. Two birds, one stone.

Only problem is this place is armed to the teeth. Bring a crew and get those fuel tanks out of action. We'll take care of the rest.

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_sabotage_killship:
We got a new player in the system, ~mission(TargetName), trying to make a name for themselves. They've even taken over ~mission(Location|Address). Giving me nothing but headaches. 

It's time to shut them down. 

Head over, kill the ever loving shit out of ~mission(TargetName|Last) and then disable the station so that none of their followers can cause any problems.

Should send a message to anyone else looking to get bigger than they should.

-Stows

XenoThreat is edging into our territory by setting up shop at ~mission(Location|Address). I'm not having it. You're going to kick the bastards out for me. 

Head there, kill ~mission(TargetName) who's their lead asshole in charge, and destroy their fuel stores and power generators. 

Lets see what they think about that. 

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_sabotage_servers_:
When will people learn that they can't just do whatever they feel like on Headhunter turf? These idiots are planning a big job and thought that I'd just let them get away with it? No way in hell.

I want you to fly to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy their fuel tanks and data servers. Show them what the Headhunters really think of them.

Let's see them try to pull off anything after that.

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_ve_desc_001:
Headhunters didn't get to be what it is today by playing nice. We've tracked down the hideout of a bunch of scraggy upstarts that have been making inroads into our territory. Need you to send a message.

Head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and blow the crap out of their fuel tanks. They'll think twice about muscling in on our operations when their ships are grounded.

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_vh_desc_001:
Got a plan to take care of a rat I've been dealing with and need a hand.

Had a client default on some debts and now they've decided they ain't going to pay up. Got a tip that they're hiding out over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. If you can take out their fuel tanks they'll have no choice but to reconsider their crap decisions.

Just be sure you don't underestimate this slimebag. They might be dumb but they're not stupid, if you get me. I've heard this place is swarming with ships and turrets, you'd have to be a total nullbrain not to bring backup.

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_bombingrun_vh_xt_desc_001:
I won't get into the long and complicated politics of why I'm asking you to do this, but it's enough for you to know that I want it done. 

Go to ~mission(Location|Address) and blow up the XenoThreat fuel reserves there. It'll really be helping me out of a tight spot.

-Stows
localization.headhunters_bounty_desc_001:
The Headhunters recently loaned credits to ~mission(TargetName) under some clear conditions. Specifically, pay us back or we’ll kill you. Wild to think that wasn’t enough of an incentive, but here we are past the payment deadline. Now as much as we like ~mission(TargetName|First), I need you to make good on our promise.

~mission(TargetName|Last) was last seen at ~mission(Location|Address). Track ‘em down, ghost ‘em, and get paid. It’s as simple as that. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_bounty_desc_002:
Time is up for ~mission(TargetName). The skav is way past due on paying back the Headhunters, so I need you to punch them out. 

Kill ‘em, not hit ‘em, just in case that’s unclear. 

Someone recently spotted ~mission(TargetName|Last) around ~mission(Location|Address), so head there and take ‘em out.  

Full disclosure, we’ve gotten reports they used some of our creds to hire extra protection. Prepare accordingly. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_bounty_desc_003:
~mission(TargetName) borrowed a bunch of creds from the Headhunters and thought the smart move was to try and hide instead of paying us back, so I need someone to make an example of ~mission(TargetName|Last).

They were just spotted at ~mission(Location|Address), so I’d recommend heading there now before the trail goes cold. ~mission(TargetName|Last) is a paranoid sort, so don’t be surprised if they’re not alone. Handle it however you want as long as ~mission(TargetName|Last) is dust when you’re done.   

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_bounty_xenothreat_desc_001:
Headhunters got word there’s a XenoThreat op in the works that's targeting one of our crews. We don’t have precise details about the plan but we know that ~mission(TargetName) is organizing it. Instead of sitting back and waiting for something to happen, we’ve decided to be proactive. 

~mission(TargetName|Last) was just spotted with others around ~mission(Location|Address). We can’t mobilize anyone fast enough to get there. I want you to rush there and deliver a preemptive strike.   

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_bounty_xenothreat_desc_002:
XenoThreat recently hit a Headhunters' stronghold. I’ll spare you the details, but they did some truly heinous shit to our crew. We’ve identified the leader of the op as ~mission(TargetName) and are looking for a little payback. We don’t care what you do to get the job done. Only that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is dead. 

A source just told us that you can track down this XenoThreat scum over at ~mission(Location|Address). This sicko’s a pro and never travels alone, so don’t expect taking them out to be a walk in the park.  

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_bounty_xenothreat_desc_003:
~mission(TargetName) was recently revealed to be a mole for XenoThreat. It all makes sense now because the skav was a major asshole. Unfortunately, they split before we could handle it ourselves. 

Based on all they learned about our ops, we need ‘em taken out pronto. They see one of us coming and they’ll just run again, but I figured someone like you has a better chance of getting close enough for a killshot. 

We just got word ~mission(TargetName|Last) was hanging around ~mission(Location|Address). Looks like there’s other ships around protecting ‘em too. Think you got the skill to rid the ‘verse of a traitorous bastard and their bastard friends?  

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_chainelimall_1c_attackcfp_e_:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to ~mission(Location|Address) and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_chainelimall_1c_attackxt_m_d:
Just got clearance from my Judge to start banging back against XenoThreat. Been eyeballing some spots under their control near ~mission(Location|Address).

I'll give you the targets to hit, you kill everyone you find. Hell, I'd love to go myself, sounds like fun.

-Stows
localization.headhunters_chainelimall_1c_elimspec_att:
We've been trying to play nice with these Citizens for Prosperity people, but they've made it abundantly clear that we don't have a place in their 'safe system.' Their use of mercs for security have been causing all kinds of unreasonable violence like when this asshole ~mission(TargetName) opened fire on a group of settlers to drive them away from an outpost they'd been eyeing. So now the gloves are coming off.

I need some hard workers to go hit ~mission(Location|Address) and take out ~mission(TargetName|Last). Odds are, they'll stay hidden until you prove you're enough of a threat, so make sure you do some damage.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_chainelimall_1c_elimspec_xta:
XenoThreat's sure making a full time job of pissing us off. They just attacked ~mission(Location|Address). Word is ~mission(TargetName) was spotted, so we got a great opportunity to kill some more XenoThreat (always fun) and take out this bastard.

Head over there and clear out any XT dirtbags you find, that'll probably draw out ~mission(TargetName|Last). Put them down and have a brew.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_chainelimall_1c_xtattack_m_d:
I can't wait for the day we finally stomp these XenoThreat assholes out of existence. They just launched an attack on ~mission(Location|Address) and we need some heavy-hitters to kick them out. 

We got some nearby buildings outside the main outpost that'll need to cleared too, but these guys didn't attack one of our more populated outposts, so odds are they'll be pushovers.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_chainelimall_2c_elimspec_att:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near ~mission(Location|Address) that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is ~mission(TargetName). Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.
Sweep and clear some CFP haunts

Need some good soldiers with a taste for violence to hit some XenoThreat hideouts located around ~mission(Location|Address). I'll get you the specifics if you're down, but you'll have to wipe out two separate clusters of hideouts. 

We've also gotten word that ~mission(TargetName) is lurking around down there. If you take out enough XenoThreat dirtbags, they'll pop they're head up. 

When they do, put a round in it.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_chainelimall_2c_elimspec_xta:
A helluva large group of XenoThreat just broke atmo near ~mission(Location|Address) and are about to attack. Based on intercepted comm chatter, it looks like it's a crew of hitters under ~mission(TargetName). We need someone to get out there and take back our outposts before they dig in. Headhunters put a lot of time and effort building up those spots and we aren't just gonna roll over and let them go.

You'll need to clear out several clusters that are in XenoThreat's crosshairs. I'll send you the specifics if you're gonna go. One more thing, we want  you to give ~mission(TargetName|Last) a dirt nap. Take out enough of their underlings, they'll pop up.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_chainelimall_3c_elimspec_att:
Got a big one here. We need a team to head out to ~mission(Location|Address). Word is CFP are dug in at three different clusters in the area. Our judge wants them all cleared out. Seems one of their mercs, a real mean skag named ~mission(TargetName), is holed up at one of them. We want you to go there, clear them all out and take out ~mission(TargetName|Last).

Get yourself a nice little payday in the process.

Stows out.

Got a juicy assignment for any big-time enforcers who want to clear a big payday. Over at ~mission(Location|Address) we got some XenoThreat turf run by a real bastard named ~mission(TargetName). Now if you've been in the system long enough, you've probably either heard of ~mission(TargetName|Last) or at least seen their work. Skag has a tendency to leaves bodies wherever they go.

Anyway, Judge wants this area swept clean, that means you gotta hit all three clusters and kill every XenoThreat dirt you find. Kill enough and ~mission(TargetName|Last) won't be able to hide.

Take them all out and have one on us.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_chainelimall_3c_elimspec_xta:
Got a big emergency. XenoThreat apparently knocked over ~mission(Location|Address) a couple hours ago. They hit hard and fast before they could even get a distress out, so they've been running riot in the area unchecked.

Word is the attack was led by ~mission(TargetName). A real piece of work who dropped Headhunters for XenoThreat because we kept stopping 'em from torturing people. Guess XenoThreat don't really care about that sort of thing.

Anyway, get some people and get out there, wipe out XenoThreat and take down ~mission(TargetName|Last). At this point they're spread out over three different clusters of outposts, so you'll have to sweep them all.

Good hunting,

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_chainelimall_attackcfp_e_des:
Looking for anyone with an itchy trigger finger. We're looking to move against some CFP at  ~mission(Location|Address) and take it for ourselves. You gotta play this smart though. There are a bunch of satellite outposts around the main one and all of 'em got security, so you should take out each of these before you take the main base.

But hey, if you wanna jump right in the deep end and fight off all the reinforcements, that's on you. As long as you get it done.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_chainelimall_attackgen_e_des:
Looking for some hitters to go drop some violence on some local dipshits who've been pulling jobs in the system against Headhunters. We tried reaching out to explain the error of their ways, but they shot our messenger, so now we go with option B.

You'll find them holed up near ~mission(Location|Address). Go there and repaint the walls with their blood.

Have fun.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_chainelimall_boss_xenothreat:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at ~mission(Location|Address) to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_claimsweep_desc_easy:
Some numbskull is trying to dig up dirt on the Headhunters. Some orbital sentries were dropped at ~mission(location|address) to spy on us. We’ve also spotted a ship checking on them. Simple proposition for you. Go wipe out the sentries there and we’ll pay you for it. That sound like something you’d be into?

As for the ship, you can do whatever you want with it, but if it spots you, don’t be surprised if it tries to go get some back up. That’s just how these things go.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_claimsweep_desc_hard:
Some idiots think they can blatantly spy on the Headhunters and get away with it. They’ve set up several orbital sentries at ~mission(location|address) and have a few ships patrolling the area. We don’t know who’s behind it but we honestly don’t care. We just need it gone. 

Let us know if you feel like putting some real brash bastards in their place. We’ll pay you well and deliver the creds the second the job is done. 

Keep in mind that it’s really only the sentries we care about. The ships they got patrolling are only a concern if they get in your way or if they try to call in some friends to stop you. 
 
Stows out.
localization.headhunters_claimsweep_desc_intro: Got a minor annoyance the Headhunters need dealt with. There's an orbital sentry at ~mission(location|address) that some pesky little troublemaker set up to spy on our ops. Want to make some easy creds and go blow it up for us?\n\nStows out.
localization.headhunters_claimsweep_desc_medium:
Headhunters are looking for a merc to do a little clean up for us. Found out that someone’s trying to spy on us over at ~mission(location|address). Can’t let that stand. We need a skilled operator to take care of the orbital sentries they dropped there, and if needed, deal with any of their ships that get in your way. Seems like a decently run op, so hitting it might not be easy but it sure should be fun. 

Let us know if you’re the right one for the gig. Creds will be transferred once our scans show it’s gone. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_claimsweep_desc_rand:
Headhunters recently discovered some orbital sentries focused on our operations and we don’t like it one bit. I’m looking to pay someone to go to ~mission(location|address) and make it abundantly clear they should stay the hell out of our business. Doubt they’ll be receptive to a discussion about it, so I’d be prepared to evict them with extreme force. 

Based on our scans, this won’t be a walk in the park. Wouldn’t be a bad idea to come prepared with plenty of ammo. Payment will be sent promptly once the job is done. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_defend_generic_m_carvers_des:
I swear all the local scumbags have gotten a lot bolder since Citizens for Prosperity moved into here. Now we got a group attacking ~mission(Location|Address), so I need someone to take it back and remind them that Headhunters are still the power in the system.

If you take them out, I don't have to figure out who they are, so get to it.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_defend_generic_m_desc_001: Some geniuses thought it would be a good idea to try and knock over ~mission(Location|Address), so we're putting together a response to put them in the ground and also show everyone else what happens if you touch Headhunter turf.\n\nStows out.
localization.headhunters_defend_generic_m_goldenriver: Call's out for anybody itching to cause some violence. Some stupid skags thought they could knock over ~mission(Location|Address) and we wouldn't kick back. Go show them how wrong their thinking was.\n\nStows out.
localization.headhunters_defend_generic_m_theyard_des:
Putting the word out. We got a Headhunter outpost near ~mission(Location|Address) under attack and could use some backup. Haven't quite figured out who's doing the attacking but don't really care. You step to the Headhunters, get ready to get clapped back.

Get over there pronto and take them down.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_defend_generic_m_windfall_de:
Need some triggers to get over to ~mission(Location|Address) and defend one of our places that's under attack. Not sure who's looking for an early death, but we can figure that out once they're cold and still.

Bring some people if you want just make sure we take it back.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_defend_xt_desc_001:
Those XenoThreat punks launched an attack against ~mission(Location|Address) so we're looking for people to go fend them off. 

Get out there and waste every XenoThreat you see.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_defend_xt_h_desc_001:
Not sure how familiar you are with what’s going down in Pyro, but we’re currently in a hell of a turf war with XenoThreat. It’s been pretty brutal lately, and I just learned that XenoThreat are about to attack ~mission(Location|Address). Thing is that I can’t rally any Clips to get there in time to defend it, so I need you to do it for us. 

Grab your gear, get some friends, and get to the location as fast as you can. Xenos like to stagger the arrival of their troops, so don’t blow through all your ammo during the initial defense ‘cause there’s a good chance more are coming. 

Keep them from taking over the site and I’ll pay you for the trouble.

-Stows out
localization.headhunters_defend_xt_m_desc_001:
XenoThreat’s looking to dig in further by getting their grubby hands on one of our locations. They’re gearing up to attack and then occupy ~mission(Location|Address). We can’t let that happen but don’t have any forces available to make a stand. That’s why we’re hoping you can step in.  

We need you to head to the location pronto. Would be smart to arrive well-supplied and with allies. Xenos like to think of themselves as strategic geniuses, but in my experience, that just means they don’t send all their forces at once. So keep an eye out for more incoming after the initial attack.

Do whatever you can to keep those skags from taking control of the site and we’ll make it worth your while.    

-Stows
localization.headhunters_defend_xt_vh_desc_001:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm ~mission(Location|Address) next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it. 

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely. 

Think you can rise to the occasion?  

-Stows
localization.headhunters_defenddestructibleentites_e_:
Some morons with some seriously inflated notion of their place in 'verse made the damn foolish choice of attacking the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We've got some things in play over there so we can’t let ‘em get away with it.

If you're interesting in helpin' out, get there and deal with these luggers before they can do too much damage. Don't figure you'll break too much of a sweat dealin' with them.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_defenddestructibleentites_h_: Got word from some allies of ours over at ~mission(Location|Address) that they're coming under attack. A gang we've had run-ins with before are trying to take them over by first destroying their ~mission(Objects). This crew are mungers through and through, but they mean business and can handle themselves in a fight. It will take a bit of doing to make sure they don't blow up everything. You might even think about bringing some help along. Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip. - Stows
localization.headhunters_defenddestructibleentites_m_:
Our friends at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> have been compromised. A new gang in the area  are threatening them by targeting their <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4>.  

If those get destroyed its going to be seriously bad for business, so I want you over there pronto on protection duty.  
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows
localization.headhunters_defenddestructibleentites_s_: Our partners at ~mission(Location|Address) need help. A rival outlaw crew are swarming the area and attacking the ~mission(Objects) there. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site is absolutely critical to our future plans in the area and its damn important that it remains in working order. With the scale of this attack and the skill of these pilots, there's no doubt that some reliable backup would serve you well. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and stop these bootlicks before they can do any lasting damage. To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong. - Stow
localization.headhunters_defenddestructibleentites_ve:
You don't need all the details, but Headhunters have an interest in what happens over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and I just got word they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts. 

The dumb sods are trying to cripple the place by taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. I'm not having it.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed. These chumps are lightweights so shouldn't be too much of a problem for you to handle. 

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

- Stows
localization.headhunters_defenddestructibleentites_vh: A band of hired guns has been sent to mess with our interests over at ~mission(Location|Address). Seems someone has been tipped off that if the ~mission(Objects) there are destroyed that it will severely interrupt Headhunter operations in the area. That's a problem I want you to fix. Not gonna lie, theses mercs are no joke. It'd be foolish to go it alone. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor ~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip for a job well done. Stows out.
localization.headhunters_defendentitesandescort_e_des:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_defendentitesandescort_h_des:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows
localization.headhunters_defendentitesandescort_m_des:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows
localization.headhunters_defendentitesandescort_s_des:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow
localization.headhunters_defendentitesandescort_ve_de:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows
localization.headhunters_defendentitesandescort_vh_de:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_defendlocation_e_desc_001:
Some idiots with a deathwish are attacking our ships around <EM4>~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address)</EM4>. Can’t let ‘em do that without paying the price. Want to do the honors?

If so, head out and get after ‘em. The crew there is tracking the attacker’s movements and I’ll pass along situational updates as they come in. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor a bonus of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_defendlocation_h_desc_001:
Got word that Headhunters ships heading to <EM4>~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address)</EM4> are coming under attack. Scans have revealed enemy forces in the wider region intent on targeting our ops. 

There’s enough of them that it’s gonna take more than one person to clear away all that trash. If you can grab your gear and a few friends, I could really use you out there.  

The specific attack areas and targets are evolving. Don’t worry about the details now. Just get there and I’ll let you know where you’re needed.  

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows
localization.headhunters_defendlocation_intro_desc_00:
I don’t think you’ve ever done anything like this for the Headhunters before, but I think it’ll be right up your alley. See, some punks have gotten it in their head that they can take over. <EM4>~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address)</EM4>. Problem is, that’s ours. 

I want you to fly over, and teach these good-for-nothin’s a lesson about knowing their place in the universe. Once you’re in position, I’ll update you so you can take care of ‘em. 

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

Hopefully, this will be the first of many more jobs like this.

- Stows
localization.headhunters_defendlocation_m_desc_001:
Our airspace around <EM4>~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address)</EM4> has been compromised. Enemy ships are threatening the base and any of our ships in the area. Gotta put a stop to this immediately, so get your shit in order and get over there. Just get going and I’ll update you with any relevant info on where you’re needed. 
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding a bonus <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows
localization.headhunters_defendlocation_s_desc_001:
Our crew at <EM4>~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address)</EM4> needs help. Enemy ships are swarming the area and attacking anything and everything they can find. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site has some absolutely crucial gear and personnel that we can’t have destroyed or compromised. 

Considering the size and scale of the attack, you’re gonna need a fully supplied ship and some reliable wingmen. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and I’ll send you specifics on where you’re needed most.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn a bonus <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow
localization.headhunters_defendlocation_ve_desc_001:
Headhunters flying in and out of <EM4>~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address)</EM4> are being harassed by some aggressive upstarts. Need them dealt with before they become a real pain in the ass.   

Get there and I’ll update you on what these pests are doing so you can hunt ‘em down. 

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

- Stows
localization.headhunters_defendlocation_vh_desc_001:
Looking for someone who can not only dogfight but recruit others to the Headhunters cause. Our operations center at <EM4>~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address)</EM4>, along with any ships going to and from it, are being targeted by hostile forces. We need support there pronto. 

Not gonna lie, but there’s lots of heat around there. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. When you get your crew together, head out there and I’ll update you if there’s any flare ups in the area that need your attention.
