One of our crews just had a run-in near ~mission(Location|Address) with some assholes who thought they could step to us. I think they learned their lesson, but now there’s several ship’s worth of salvage ready for anyone who wants it.

I’m selling the coords for someone to get access to this salvage. Should be a decent payday, but there’s always a chance that these nobodies have had friends who might come sniffin’ round. If that happens, handle ‘em quick and you should be fine. Just more to salvage, right?

- Stows
localization.headhunters_salvage_multi_xt_vh_desc_001:
Read fast. Lots of credits on the line. 

XenoThreat came after a Headhunters crew recently and it wasn’t pretty. Lots of ships went down near ~mission(Location|Address) and I got wind that those bastards are out there trying to recover their ships – and ours – so they can use the parts again or whatever those assholes do. All I know is I’d rather someone else clean ‘em out first.

That’s why I’m selling the coords to someone allied with us. Won’t even make it too expensive. Last bit of advice – you might want to bring some back-up – these nutjobs field some serious firepower.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_salvage_ve_desc_001:
Some idiot flying a ~mission(Ship) got a little too close to one of our convoys. Bad for them, but great target practice for some of our newer members. The convoy couldn’t salvage the ship because they had an important delivery to make, but they did tow it to a spot near ~mission(Location|Address).

Selling the exact location details. Just send over the creds and that ship is yours to salvage. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_searchbody_danger_outpost_de:
Some of my people were involved with a raid over at ~mission(Location|Address). Most of them got out clean, but after the dust settled nobody is sure of what happened to ~mission(TargetName).

A lot of other gangs would just leave the poor bastard to rot, but that’s not the way the Headhunters do things. I want to know for sure if ~mission(TargetName|Last) is alive or dead and I’m willing to pay you good credits to find out.

Just be careful when you get there because I bet the assholes who live there are still gunning for a fight.

- Stows
localization.headhunters_searchbody_danger_station_de:
We’re on the market for a new stash house, so I sent ~mission(TargetName) over to ~mission(Location|Address). They were supposed to just have a quick look and report back to me if any of the hangars would work for us, but I haven’t heard from them since.

My guess is that someone else was already using the hangar, but I’d sleep better knowing for sure.

If the credits seem right, head over and see if you can find out what happened to ~mission(TargetName|Last). Just be careful. I’d hate to have to hire someone to find your body next.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_searchbody_nodanger_outpost_:
I know better than to send someone like ~mission(TargetName) out by themselves, but that didn’t stop me from being a fool and doing it. Now the dumb SOB hasn’t returned my comms and nobody has set eyes on them in a few days.

If you got the time, I could use someone to go over to ~mission(Location|Address) and see if they’re still there. You get paid even if they wind up being dead.

-Stows
localization.headhunters_searchbody_nodanger_station_:
So, I sent one of our people, a new recruit by the name ~mission(TargetName), to do a hand-off over at ~mission(Location|Address), but now the bastard’s gone missing.

I’m thinking they either ran off with Headhunter credits and they’re good as dead, or they were robbed and now they’re lying there actually good as dead. Either way, I’d like for you to go have a look and see if you can find them.

If you settle the matter, I’ll give you what their cut would have been.

-Stows
localization.headhunters_securitypatrol_e_desc_001:
Headhunters have been expanding, but still need help getting a lay of our new territory. I’ve got a run to check spots we want scanned ready to go. 

This one kicks off at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and will look at a few more locations after that, but I’ll update you as we clear them out. Not expecting you to run into any trouble but no guarantees. Trouble seems to follow us.

Get this done and I'll toss the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> as a thanks.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_securitypatrol_h_desc_001:
I’ve noticed an uptick in attacks on Headhunter ships and it's got me feelin' jumpy. Got an important resupply shipment that we can’t afford to lose, and need help determining what route to send it. I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there? 

The route starts at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to <EM4>bring a friend</EM4> to watch your back.

You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 

- Stows
localization.headhunters_securitypatrol_intro_desc_00:
Not sure if this is your kind of bag or not, but the Headhunters need someone to fly our turf to make sure no one is trying to edge into our business. And if someone is flying where they don’t belong, you’re going to deal with them. 

If you’re amenable, head over to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. Start by scanning that region and then we’ll guide you to a few more spots that we want info on. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

- Stows
localization.headhunters_securitypatrol_m_desc_001:
The local Clip wants current intel on several of our sectors. Not sure what they’re looking for but I’m not about to ask. My job is to find someone willing to swing through and scan these locations. You available? 

All you need to do is head to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD, run a scan, and if it’s clear, move to the next spot. If you run into any issues, take care of it. 

Ain’t sound too tough now does it? Plus, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 


Stows out.
localization.headhunters_securitypatrol_s_desc_001:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?

See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.  

I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.

Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least <EM4>three friends</EM4> onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor that pulls it off. 

- Stows
localization.headhunters_securitypatrol_ve_desc_001:
Headhunters want some intel on what’s happening around territory. We’ve already set up some monitoring satellites, but nothing beats a good ol’ patrol. You up for it?

If so, get on over to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. Start by scanning that region and then we’ll guide you to a few more spots that we want info on. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

- Stows
localization.headhunters_securitypatrol_vh_desc_001:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off? 

If so, start by seeing what’s around the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing <EM4>two friends</EM4> to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_shipambush_e_desc_001:
Any interest in taking out a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> for us? 

Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.  

They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.

You pull this off and I'll toss <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor for a job well done.

- Stows
localization.headhunters_shipambush_h_desc_001:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.  

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right. 

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_shipambush_intro_desc_001,p:
Got an opportunity for someone eager to show off their flying skills. Headhunters have been running afoul of this numbrain flying a<EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> and we’re gonna put a stop to it once and for all.

You’re gonna help us set a trap for them. See, there’s an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> that they fly by frequently. 

Head there, hide inside the cloud by powering down your ship, and attack the asshole as soon as you see ‘em and other single-seaters dumb enough to fly with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And in honor of this being your first surprise attack for us, there's a bonus of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_shipambush_m_desc_001:
One of our Clips put out a kill order on a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4>. Feel like making ‘em happy by taking it out?

Here’s what you need to know. The target and their escort are scheduled to pass by <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Looks like there’s an emission cloud nearby that can hide your ship’s sig. Wait there until you’re ready to strike. 

The Clip only cares about wiping out the target. Anything of value you find floating in the wreckage is all yours. 

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount)</EM4> Council Scrip to sweeten the pot. 

- Stows
localization.headhunters_shipambush_s_desc_001:
Headhunters are looking for someone with the skills and crew to execute an elite op. A military frigate and escort ships are stalking one of our Clips around the system. Don’t know their intentions but it can’t be good. Figure while they’ve got their eyes focused on their prize, we get someone to gather a crew to hit ‘em.  

Already got a spot picked out. If you get to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> there’s an emission cloud that’s exactly what we need. Head there with friends, power down your ships, and wait for the <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> and its escorts to pass by. 

With a bonus of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor, payment alone should make this worth your while, but you can also keep anything you scrounge from the wreckage.

- Stows
localization.headhunters_shipambush_ve_desc_001:
Some numskull flying a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.    

There’s an emission cloud near <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_shipambush_vh_desc_001:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us. 

We got eyes on a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_theft_derelictoutpost_e_desc:
Get this. There’s a new crew trying to make a name for themselves. From what I’ve heard, they’re in way over their head, but that didn’t stop them from spending some serious creds to acquire ~mission(Item).

Currently, some of them are holed up at ~mission(Location|Address). Go there, relieve them, of the ~mission(Item), and then bring it to ~mission(Destination|Address). Hopefully when word of what happened there spreads to the rest of the crew, they’ll reconsider their choices in life. 

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_theft_intro_desc_001:
Headhunters are always on the lookout for talented folks that can quickly and discreetly acquire items that we have our eye on. If that’s you, I’ve got a job that should test your skills. Ace it and I have plenty more I can start sending your way.  

There’s a crate of ~mission(Item) currently at ~mission(Location|Address). Go liberate it from its current owners and deliver it to ~mission(Destination|Address). Should be quick and easy. 

- Stows
localization.headhunters_theft_occucave_cfp_m_desc_00:
CFP recently got a delivery of ~mission(Item) that we want. Think they know that too, because they hid it in a cave near ~mission(Location|Address) and have a handful of mercs watching over it. Let’s show ‘em that nothing gets by the Headhunters around here.  

Raid the cave, grabs the goods, and bring them to ~mission(Destination|Address). Sound like a plan?

- Stows
localization.headhunters_theft_olp_desc_001:
With the Frontier Fighters stirring up shit in Pyro, Headhunters figured that it’d be good to take a look at our operations in Stanton. We want to be smart about it though. Don’t want to raise red flags by bringing too much gear through the jump, or hit civilian targets and get security forces on our ass. Instead, the plan is to work over the local outlaws first.  

Been picking up a lot of activity around <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Guess it just got a delivery of <EM4>~mission(Item)</EM4> that has our name all over it. You wanna grab it for us?

Once you’ve got the stuff, bring it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. I’d get geared up before going. Sounds like the locals are pretty entrenched there.  

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_theft_outpost_cfp_m_desc_001: Our crew at ~mission(Destination|Address) is running low on ~mission(Item). Want to get them restocked, and know that the CFP outpost at ~mission(Location|Address) has some lying around. Wanna go there and grab it for us?\n\n- Stows
localization.headhunters_theft_outpost_xt_vh_desc_001:
Seeing a lot of foot soldiers and supplies coming in and out of ~mission(Location|Address), so it feels like XenoThreat’s planning something. But one thing in particular really piqued my interest. Looks like ~mission(Item) was brought to the site. Don’t ask why, but we want to get our hands on it and are worried they might be moving it again soon.   

We’re looking for someone to take a run at that site and steal the ~mission(Item). If you can get it, drop the stuff off at ~mission(Destination|Address). This shit ain’t gonna be easy. Bring as many guns and friends as you can.

Stows out
localization.headhunters_theft_paf_desc_001:
We’re getting ready to take our ops in Stanton to the next level. Our scouts tracked an outlaw ship that unloaded some <EM4>~mission(Item)</EM4> at an old Hathor platform facility at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Whole thing feels like a prime target for a raid. 

Need someone to hit the site, grab the <EM4>~mission(Item)</EM4> stashed there, and bring it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. That old Hathor facility is buzzing with activity. Go in unprepared and you’ll regret it. 

- Stows
localization.headhunters_theft_regionlink_e_desc_001:
One of our Judges put out a bulletin asking Headhunters to keep an eye on for ~mission(Item). Got word yesterday that some can be found at ~mission(Location|Address). Feel like making a high ranking Headhunter happy?

All you need to do is get your hands on the goods then run ‘em across system to ~mission(Destination|Address).

Stows out.
localization.headhunters_theft_xsoutpost_cfp_e_desc_0: Been looking for ~mission(Item), and one of our people inside CFP let me know some was just delivered to ~mission(Location|Address). Should only be a few soft CFP guards around for you to deal with. Then grab the shit and bring it to ~mission(Destination|Address).\n\nStows out.
localization.headhunters_theft_xsoutpost_m_desc_001:
Less you know about this the better. Trust me. 

There’s some ~mission(Item) sitting at ~mission(Location|Address). Go deal with anyone there and steal it. Then hustle it over to ~mission(Destination|Address). 

Should be a breezy job and easy creds, so get it done. 

- Stows
localization.headhunters_theft_xsoutpost_xt_h_desc_00:
We’ve been watching ~mission(Location|Address) for a while. Felt like a primo XenoThreat spot to hit, since there are fewer guards around protecting the goods, but didn’t want to kick down the door until we knew something worthwhile was inside. Well, that glorious day has come.   

Got word that the latest delivery left ~mission(Item) there. We want to get our hands on it, so are looking for someone who can swipe it and then bring it to ~mission(Destination|Address). Sure the forces there won’t make it easy for you, but do this right and try to get out before anyone from the main outpost knows what’s going on.    

- Stows
localization.hexpenetrator_bounty_desc:
Our analysts have examined the intel seized from those XenoThreat recon teams but the data appears to be locked behind a sophisticated encryption system and requires a custom cryptokey to access.

We've managed to locate several XenoThreat lieutenants operating in the system, you are to find and engage the suspects and see if they are in possession of a cryptokey that will allows us to access the intel.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.
localization.hexpenetrator_bounty_obj_01_long: Go to last known position and neutralize the target
localization.hexpenetrator_bounty_obj_03_long: Deliver the Encryption key to a delivery locker
localization.hexpenetrator_comm_description:
One of the suspects captured during the recent attacks revealed that XenoThreat is looking to remotely access a number of comm arrays around the system.

Having XenoThreat listening into comms is extremely dangerous for the people living here, so the CDF has been enlisted to reset the comm array, then defend it from any XenoThreat Vanguards that will attempt to reconnect to the servers. 

Once those Vanguards have been defeated, clear out any remaining hostile ships in the area.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.
localization.hexpenetrator_comm_obj_04_long: Prevent XenoThreat Vanguard ships from remotely overriding the Comm Array.
localization.hexpenetrator_comm_obj_05_long: Neutralize all remaining XenoThreat ships around ~mission(Location).
localization.hexpenetrator_dataheist_description:
We've received tips that XenoThreat's intending to launch another attack on Stanton system. The CDF has petitioned the Advocacy to create a new initiative called Operation Overdrive to stop this attack before it happens. 

The CDF is dispatching volunteers to infiltrate and obtain any intel that could give insight into what they're planning. Needless to say, expect heavy resistance from any XenoThreat on site.

As an added incentive, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.
localization.hexpenetrator_incursion_desc: Waves of XenoThreat ships have been pushing into Stanton system and attacking random civilians. We can't tell if this is an isolated attack or a reaction to our recent initiatives, but we need them stopped.\n\nAs a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.
localization.hexpenetrator_incursion_obj_long_01: Travel to incursion site and stop XenoThreat hostiles.
localization.hexpenetrator_incursion_obj_long_02: Neutralize all XenoThreat ships in the area.
localization.hexpenetrator_kareah_desc:
Attention all CDF volunteers, we received a distress call from Security Post Kareah. It turns out XenoThreat used the comm arrays as a distraction to lure law enforcement away so they could launch an attack on the station.

We've learned that they're attempting to access their systems, so all volunteers must immediately divert to retake Kareah and clear out all XenoThreat forces.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.
localization.hexpenetrator_kareah_obj_long_01: Reach Security Post Kareah to secure station.
localization.hexpenetrator_kareah_obj_long_03: Gain access to the Criminal Database.
localization.hexpenetrator_recoverdeliver_description:
Attention CDF volunteers, XenoThreat's gone off the grid. We suspect that they have gone dark in order to prep for the final phase of their plan. 

History has proven that XenoThreat like to fight so it stands to reason that this might be an attack of some kind so we're calling on volunteers to deliver supplies to the Gateway station near the Stanton-Pyro jump point to shore up for a potential assault.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.
localization.hexpenetrator_rewardrecord_desc:
Thank you for your diligence on this Overdrive Initiative. 

As promised, we've approved you for an upgrade from a civilian F7C mk ii to a military grade F7A mk ii if you have one.

In addition, you've been given a temporary rental of a military F7A mk ii that you can access in your ASOP.


_________________

To upgrade, visit the RSI website to apply the token, then restart the game and access the ship.
localization.hexpenetrator_rewardrecord_long: CDF is submitting your request to the ship transfer.
localization.hh_ch2_journal_intro_desc:
We’ve got a situation here. This group from Stanton calling themselves the Frontier Fighters have stormed in Pyro proclaiming that they’re here to clean up the system, but really they’re killing everyone they see.  

We’re putting the word out to all friendlies to get back to Pyro and show these bastards they aren’t welcome here. 

Stows out
localization.hh_ch2_journal_reveal_desc:
Well I’ll be damned. Remember how the Frontier Fighters stormed into Pyro declaring that they were here to stop gangs, like the Slicers, from attacking Stanton? But none of us had ever heard of anyone calling themselves Slicers? 

Well, mystery solved. Turns out the Frontier Fighters made up the Slicers to piss everybody off and sign off on their little witch hunt.  

Anyways, none of us care what this bunch of blockheads call themselves. They’ve been nothing but a pain in our ass since arriving in Pyro. They even pissed off Citizens for Prosperity enough for them to work with the Civilian Defense Force to drive them outta the system. Word is the Council has been debating what to do and decided this is one of those ‘enemy of my enemy is my friend’ situations. If the Civilian Defense Force wants to spearhead a campaign to drive a bunch of murderous thugs out of this system, then we shouldn’t get in their way.    

Hell, feel free to help ‘em, if you want. Just be discreet about your allegiances. Having a few of our own involved in the operation isn’t a bad idea. Good way to ensure they’re here to do what they say, getting rid of the Frontier Fighters, and nothing more.   

Stows out.

localization.hh_ch2_journalbody_phase1: Across Pyro, Headhunters’ sites and personnel are under constant attack by the Frontier Fighters. Help them respond by successfully carrying out six strikes on Frontier Fighters’ supply convoys and/or outposts (and continue to assist in future missions) to be eligible to receive a special reward. Those who also met the requirements of 'Save Stanton' will be eligible to receive an additional reward.
localization.hh_ch2_journalbody_phase2: Headhunters want to hamper the operations of the Frontier Fighters. Help them by completing six operations against Frontier Fighters locations, and meet requirements from the launch phase, to receive a special reward. Those who also met the requirements of 'Save Stanton' will receive an additional reward.
localization.hh_ch2_journalbody_phase3: Citizens for Prosperity have exposed the Frontier Fighters to be the Slicers, and are out to punish them for their crimes in Stanton. Headhunters want to help drive the Frontier Fighters out of Pyro by wiping out their outposts.
localization.hh_ch2_journaltitle_phase1: Headhunters Op. Protect Pyro - Launch Summary
localization.hh_ch2_journaltitle_phase2: Headhunters Op. Protect Pyro - Phase 2 Summary
localization.hh_ch2_journaltitle_phase3: HH Op. Avenge Pyro - Phase 3 Summary
localization.hh_killanimals_e_derelictoutpostscaves_d: Headhunters need someone to take out a pack of kopions that've been giving our guys a hard time. Last saw the things at ~mission(Location|Address). There's some creds in it for you if you finish the job.\n\nStows out.

Got a bit of a problem. Some kopions interrupted a handoff yesterday and scared off the client. We lost out on a valuable deal. Headhunters have been using this place for years and this is the first time any of these things have given us trouble. 

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and clear the place for us. 

Stows out.
localization.hh_killanimals_h_derelictoutpostscaves_d:
Huge swarm of kopions ran down one of our Clips the other day. Never found the body. Word is they ate the poor bastard. 

We need someone to head to ~mission(Location|Address) and shoot every kopion they see. Don't stop ’til the assholes are all dead. 

Watch your back when you go in. If you can’t guess, these bastards are mean. If you get yourself killed, that's on you. 

Stows out.
localization.hh_killanimals_m_derelictoutpostscaves_d:
Bunch of kopions set up shop in Headhunter territory. Mean ones. Having to fight off wild animals every few hours is making it tough to do business. 

If you get rid of them for us, you get paid. Do it however you want – as long as they end up dead. 

You can find them at ~mission(Location|Address).

-Stows

The Chief has her eye on some prime territory for a smuggling drop point over at ~mission(Location|Address). Trouble is, it's swarming with kopions. Mean bastards, too. But hey, you got guns and they don’t. Clear them out for us and I’ll get you a decent payout.\n\nStows out.
localization.hh_killanimals_m_derelictoutpostscaves_t: Big Payout for Kopion Kills at ~mission(Location)
localization.hh_missingperson_inv_chain_h_xenothreat_:
Those XenoThreat assholes ambushed one of our outposts. We eventually kicked their ass out of there but once the cowards knew they'd been beat, they took ~mission(TargetName) hostage as a Human shield. We let 'em go, because we don't betray our own like that, but we're not planning on letting this stand. 

Word is that they fled to their base at ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to break in, find ~mission(TargetName|Last), and relay the info back to me. There's a lot of creds in it for you if you do the job right. 

Keep in mind this isn't their only outpost in the system. If they give you the slip, you may need to track them to another sector. 

Stows out.
localization.hh_missingperson_inv_e_criminalbase_desc:
Sent ~mission(TargetName) out to check out a strange noise in one of our storehouses and haven't heard from them in a while. Turns out they got themselves kidnapped. We've got intel that says they're being held at ~mission(Location|Address), but we're not sure about the source. Need someone to swing by and make sure the info is legit.  

Whether it's good news or bad, there are some creds in it for you. 

Stows out.
localization.hh_missingperson_inv_e_faunacave_desc_01:
A few days back I dispatched ~mission(TargetName|Last) to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and ~mission(TargetName|Last) isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.
localization.hh_missingperson_inv_m_criminalbase_desc:
Last night, some no-name drifters threw down with our enforcers and ran when things got too hot. Didn't find out 'til they were long gone, but they made off with one of our Prospects when they split. Goes by the name of ~mission(TargetName). 

Last we saw, they were headed in the direction ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to head there and track down our missing Prospect. 

If you take any of them down while you're at it, all the better.

Stows out.
localization.hh_phase1_a_desc:
Calling anyone working Pyro. Headhunters are looking for cohorts willing to help us drive these invading forces from Stanton back to where they belong. 

Citizens for Prosperity have already spread across the system faster than anyone expected. Now the Frontier Fighters have entered the fray intent to piss us off because they’ve already attacked several of our outposts. They’re saying they’re after some group called the Slicers but we ain’t ever heard of ‘em. Certainly hasn’t stopped them from wiping out every outpost they come across, so if the assholes want a fight, Headhunters are always happy to give ‘em one. 

We’ve got ships and orbital sentries working overtime tracking the Frontier Fighters, and just spotted one of their supply convoys at ~mission(Location). Need someone to take a run at the convoy and knock out those supply ships and escorts before they reach their destination. You interested?    

This contract can’t be shared. That way we know what contractors we can really trust going forward. 

Help us and show those other pukes from Stanton who you really stand with.

Stows out.
localization.hh_phase1_b_desc:
Calling everyone working Pyro. Headhunters are looking for cohorts willing to help us drive these invading forces from Stanton back to where they belong. 

Besides the Citizens for Prosperity, there’s now this new crew in the system called Frontier Fighters that sure as shit seem motivated to piss us off and have already attacked and bombed several of our outposts. Word is that they’re hunting some group called the Slicers, but they attacked us. I don’t know why they think the Headhunters are just gonna sit back and let these attacks continue without fighting back. 

We’ve got ships and orbital sentries working overtime tracking forces of the Frontier Fighters and think it’s about time to pop in and say hello. Our scouts report a flurry of activity at ~mission(Location) which looks like they're about to stir up some shit, so I’m making this a priority. Need someone to get over there fast and stop whatever they’ve got cooking up.    

This contract can’t be shared. That way we know what contractors we can really trust going forward. 

Help us show these pukes from Stanton who you really stand with.

Stows out.
localization.hh_phase2_a_desc:
Here’s where we’re at. We knocked out several of the Frontier Fighters’ supply convoys but some survived or slipped through. Didn’t take long for us to find a bunch of their locations stacked with supplies and ground vehicles. Now we need some muscle to go and destroy whatever shit is stored there. The fewer assets the Frontier Fighters have, the fewer headaches they’ll be causing for us. Since you’ve helped us before, you down to help?     
 
We got ~mission(Location) next on our list of places to hit. Head’s up though, they’re armed and have active air space defenses, so plan accordingly. Also, this contract can’t be shared. We only want contractors we know and trust on this.  

Stows out.
localization.hh_phase2_a_title: Protect Pyro - Phase 2: Sabotage Frontier Fighters’ Outpost
localization.hh_phase2_b_desc:
When tracking and attacking Frontier Fighters' supply convoys, we discovered that they had started taking over asteroid bases across the system. Don’t want to let them get too settled in. Easiest way to do that is by destroying the generators that power the base. Feel like helping us again by spreading a little mayhem? 
   
Looks like ~mission(Location) is one of the sites claimed by the Frontier Fighters. Head there, destroy the generators, and deal with anyone who gets in your way. Also, this contract can’t be shared. We only want contractors we know and trust on this.    

Stows out.
localization.hh_phase2_b_failreason: Generators still power the asteroid base.
localization.hh_phase2_b_title: Protect Pyro - Phase 2: Sabotage Frontier Fighters’ Base
localization.hh_progresstracker_bodytext: The Frontier Fighters have invaded Pyro to wipe out the outlaw presence. We need all allies to assemble in Pyro and show these bastards they aren’t welcome here.
localization.hh_progresstracker_longtitle: Headhunters Op. Protect Pyro Mission Status
localization.highpoint_killanimal_onetype_desc:
We’ve been monitoring a situation at <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4> regarding an uptick in the <EM4>~mission(Creature)</EM4> population over the past few months. Our models indicate that if this continues many of the native plants and animals will be adversely affected. It’s imperative that the <EM4>~mission(Creature)</EM4> population is reduced before that happens.     

If you can help, please refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal for more specifics on the targeted creature.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
localization.highpoint_killanimals_atlocation_desc:
There’s a growing <EM4>~mission(Creature)</EM4> problem at <EM4>~mission(Location|address)</EM4>. Looking for a contractor to quickly and professionally take care of this infestation issue.  

For further details on the targeted creature, please refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
localization.highpoint_killanimals_atlocation_desc_in:
Highpoint is currently looking to expand our roster of contractors to help us with an ongoing animal population issue. A combination of terraforming practices alongside other environmental policies have led to a rapid increase in certain species, and as the leading experts in the field, Highpoint has been hired to spearhead the culling program.

To see if you're a good fit with our company, we'd like you to try your hand at dealing with the <EM4>~mission(Creature)</EM4> problem at <EM4>~mission(Location|address)</EM4>. 

Before heading out, I strongly recommend that you refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal to learn about the species and what you can expect.

If you knock this job out of the park, we've got plenty more work I can send your way.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
localization.highpoint_killanimals_atlocation_multi_d:
A client has contacted us about resolving a <EM4>~mission(Creature)</EM4> infestation issue before it gets any worse. Several locations around <EM4>~mission(Location|address)</EM4> are currently beset by the creatures. There’s a growing concern that if this goes on for too much longer, then the natural habit will be ravaged beyond repair. Are you available to take care of this issue?

You can refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal for more specific information on the targeted creature.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
localization.highpoint_killanimals_derelictoutpostsca:
Highpoint Wilderness is seeking a contractor to cull a pack of kopions that are threatening to overrun one of Citizens for Prosperity's outposts. After an initial assessment, it has been decided that relocation is impossible and a culling of them is the only viable option. If you're interested, head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>  and once we've received confirmation that the task is complete we will send payment.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

We’re putting out a contract for anyone who is capable of hunting animals responsibly. Citizens for Prosperity needs a group of aggressive kopions who have been harassing their people culled from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. After some initial monitoring, it looked as if they may on, but unfortunately we’ve been forced to take action. This is a relatively straightforward job, but when dealing with dangerous animals, cautious is always advised.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Members of the group Citizens for Prosperity were recently ambushed by several packs of kopions at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and have requested Highpoint's services in dealing with them. For the safety of everyone trying to settle in the area, we require the immediate services of someone who can deal with this on our behalf.

Expect a large number of animals and prepare yourself accordingly.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Citizens for Prosperity recently reported to us that one of their scouts was injured by kopions during a routine exploration mission. According to them, this isn't the first time this particular pack has posed a problem, so they've requested our services to clear out the area. The report shows they were last seen at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.

This behavior is typical of kopions looking to expand their territory, so it is highly likely that you will be dealing with more kopions than initially observed. Caution is advised. 

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Highpoint Wilderness needs someone to exterminate an overpopulated pack of kopions that's threatening one of CFP's settlements. This pack can be found at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Remember to exhibit caution when approaching them and arm yourself accordingly.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Citizens for Prosperity have approached us with information that multiple groups of kopions have been attacking people at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> without provocation. Currently, no deaths have been reported, but they are concerned their most vulnerable will be at risk if these kopions continue running rampant.

Ensure you are prepared adequately, kopions hunt in packs and it is easy to become overwhelmed by their sheer numbers.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
Protect CFP Members from Overactive Kopions
localization.highpoint_killanimals_multitype_e_desc:
A sudden spike in the population of several invasive species near <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4> have the locals concerned. We’re looking for a contractor to help bring those numbers down to acceptable parameters. 

For more information on the animals in question, refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
localization.highpoint_killanimals_multitype_h_desc:
Native plants and animals near <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4> are on the verge of environmental collapse due to the dramatic population spikes of several invasive species. We’ve been contracted to dramatically reduce the current population of these species to help avoid an environmental collapse. We need a dedicated and highly skilled exterminator to carry out this contract.     

You can better acquaint yourself with the creatures in question by referencing <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal.     

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
localization.highpoint_killanimals_multitype_m_desc:
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists are dedicated to keeping the delicate ecosystems of the empire in balance. A client recently hired us to evaluate the environmental impact of a number of invasive creatures near <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4>. We’ve determined that to preserve the natural order of the region a conscientious culling of these species is necessary.  

Looking for someone able and willing to help in this effort. Please refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal for further information on the creatures being targeted.     

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
localization.highpoint_killanimals_paf_kopion_desc:
We’ve recently received reports from our team in <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, that a particularly virile pack of kopions are causing a surge in numbers. As a result, their prey is being over hunted, and if left unattended, will ultimately lead to the starvation of the kopion population there.

We are looking for a skilled contractor to cull this pack of kopions in a swift and efficient manner, assisting with bringing a natural equilibrium back to <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4>. Access to combat equipment, transport, and a familiarity with wild and unpredictable animals are all required for this job.

For further details on the targeted creatures, please refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
localization.highpoint_killanimals_rockcracker_desc_e:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.
 
We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.
 
Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.
 
Best,
 
Wanda Werkheiser

Contract Manager

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
localization.highpoint_killanimals_rockcracker_desc_h:
Unfortunately, <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4> is on the verge of being overrun by Valakkar and we are in need of a contractor prepared to perform an extensive culling of these invasive creatures. The People's Alliance, who have sent scouting parties to investigate returning the station to operation, are reporting numerous injuries and damage to their equipment as a result of this infestation. In order to prevent this situation from being completely untenable, there's no choice but extermination.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
localization.highpoint_killanimals_rockcracker_desc_m:
We've received numerous reports that the recent infestation of Valakkar at <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4> is becoming increasingly problematic. Despite the Valakkar being primarily native to desert biomes, they've shown surprisingly adaptability in cold environments too. Relocation of these creatures is simply too dangerous and in order for our client to be able to begin their work at making these stations operational again we need a resourceful contractor to deal with culling their numbers.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
localization.highpoint_killanimals_storm_h_desc_001:
As a consequence of the ongoing radiation storm on Pyro I, some of the invasive kopions have become irradiated. This poses a threat to the health of the indigenous wildlife and to those who live and work in <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4>. 

We are seeking out a skilled contractor who can cull any irradiated kopions in and around <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Do not accept this contract unless you have the proper weapons and equipment that can reliably function in a radioactive environment. 

Your compensation will be adjusted to match the risks associated with this contract.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
localization.highpoint_repui_description: After watching precious ecosystems on their home planet of Noble deteriorate due to invasive animals, Larkin Boden became inspired by the Fair Chance Act and environmental movement of the late 28th century to do something about it. In 2795, they founded Highpoint Wilderness Specialists with the goal of preserving the natural beauty of the UEE through wildlife control. Initially, the company specialized in the removal of invasive species and population control. They have since expanded into animal handling and leading expeditions to view wildlife in their natural habitats.
localization.hint_refuelingprovider_landingservices: Submit a refuel request via the Landing Services option on your mobiGlas.

localization.hints_actorstatus_pitmenuinjury: To review a full list of your current injuries, symptoms and their severity, along with current medications, use the mobiGlas Health app.
localization.hints_actorstatusbuffapplied: A "+" or "-" symbol next to a HUD icon represents an active buff or debuff is being applied to that system.
localization.hints_actorstatusclothingchanged: Some armor and clothing can protect against extreme temperatures as detailed in their descriptions.
localization.hints_actorstatuscorpsemarkershown: Your previous body and any items on it can be found at the Corpse marker. To dismiss, open the Personal Inner Thought menu, and go to Actions, Player.

localization.hints_actorstatusdigestionabsorptionempt: Eat and drink regularly to avoid negative effects as your Nutrition and Hydration levels decrease.
localization.hints_actorstatusdownedenter: While incapacitated, ask others in your party, in chat, or through rescue service beacons to revive you before the 'Time to Death' timer expires.

localization.hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotman: You cannot mantle while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.
localization.hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotste: You cannot pilot ships while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.
localization.hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannottak: You cannot perform a take down while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.
localization.hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockcannotuse: You cannot use a mounted gun while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.
You cannot use a trolley while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.
localization.hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockdropitem: You cannot carry heavy objects while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.
localization.hints_actorstatuseffectarmslocklowerweap: You cannot raise weapons while your arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.
localization.hints_actorstatuseffectarmslockstart: You arms are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.

localization.hints_actorstatuseffectpronelockstart: Your legs are experiencing Partial Paralysis. Treat with an Opioid like Roxaphen to temporarily regain function.
localization.hints_actorstatusfooddrinkitemheld: While equipped food can often be eaten in a single bite, beverages can be consumed in small sips or a long continuous drink until the meter is empty.
localization.hints_actorstatusfooddrinkitemininventor: Use your personal inventory menu to view consumables and equip or discard them.
localization.hints_actorstatushospitalenter: To gain access to a medical bed, use a lobby check-in terminal to receive a medical room assignment.
localization.hints_actorstatushospitalroomreserved: For help navigating to your medical room, check nearby signs for directions. It may be on a different floor and require the use of an elevator.
localization.hints_actorstatushungerthirstdamagestart: When Nutrition and Hydration levels are too low, you will take damage and eventually become unconscious. Eat and drink to replenish your levels.
localization.hints_actorstatushungerthirstdeath: Your depleted Nutrition and Hydration levels have rendered you unconscious. Remember to eat and drink to replenish them.
localization.hints_actorstatushungerthirstfull: When Nutrition and Hydration levels are full, consuming items no longer grants the full effect. Consider saving them until you are hungry or thirsty.
localization.hints_actorstatushungerthirststatusstart: You are suffering ill effects from low Nutrition and / or Hydration levels. Consume food and drinks as soon as possible to restore your levels.
localization.hints_actorstatushyperthermiadamagestart: Your body temperature is too high and you're taking damage from hyperthermia. Seek shelter or equip clothing and armor able to withstand the heat.
localization.hints_actorstatushyperthermiastarted: You are too hot and hyperthermia is beginning to set in. Seek shelter or equip clothing and armor able to withstand the heat.
localization.hints_actorstatushypothermiadamagestarte: Your body temperature is too low and you are taking damage from hypothermia. Seek shelter or equip clothing and armor able to withstand the cold.
localization.hints_actorstatushypothermiastarted: You are too cold and hypothermia is beginning to set in. Seek shelter or equip clothing and armor able to withstand the cold.

localization.hints_actorstatusintoxicatedenter: An elevated Blood Drug Level can cause feelings of intoxication, making getting around or piloting a vehicle difficult and potentially dangerous.
localization.hints_actorstatusmajorinjurystarted: You have received a moderate injury. Use medications to relieve symptoms, and a Tier 2 Medical Bed to fully treat any issues.
localization.hints_actorstatusmedbedenter: The bed has restored your health and reset your BDL. Use the Treatment tab to heal injuries (depending on tier), and the Medication tab for dosage.
localization.hints_actorstatusoverdoseenter: A high Blood Drug Level (BDL) can make you stunned, losing health, and eventually incapacitated. BDL lowers naturally but a dose of Resurgia can help.
localization.hints_actorstatusoxypenconsumenoundersui: An undersuit must be worn to use OxyPen.
localization.hints_actorstatusrespawncriminal: Due to your current CrimeStat, you have been regenerated at the nearest facility outside of the UEE's jurisdiction.
localization.hints_actorstatusrespawnlocationset: To reset your regen location to your primary residence, use a terminal at any medical bed or insurance office.
localization.hints_actorstatusrespawnmedbed: By default, you'll regen at your primary residence, but a new location can be selected via medical beds or at insurance offices.
localization.hints_actorstatusrespawnprison: Due to your current CrimeStat, local authorities have incarcerated you after regeneration.
localization.hints_actorstatustemperatureabovemaxresi: You're experiencing high temperatures and are at risk of hyperthermia. Seek shelter or equip clothing and armor able to withstand the heat.
localization.hints_actorstatustemperaturebelowminresi: You're experiencing low temperatures and are at risk of hypothermia. Seek shelter or equip clothing and armor able to withstand the cold.
localization.hints_actorstatustemperaturedeath: To avoid negative effects and becoming unconscious, remember to equip clothing or armor rated for the temperature you are in.
localization.hints_actorstatuswearinghelmetconsume: You must remove your helmet to consume food or drink.
localization.hints_actorstatusweatherlocomotionentere: Be aware that severe weather and strong winds can drop temperatures and make it difficult to move. Have equipment ready in case a storm breaks out.
