localization.item_descgoldfish: Found in the rivers on Cassel in the Goss System, the Midas fish's golden color and nocturnal schedule make it a highly sought after addition to aquariums around the universe.
localization.item_descgolem_paint_black_green_grey: The Rockfall livery blends green and grey earth tones with black to give the Golem a look fitting for a ship made to rip apart rocks.
localization.item_descgolem_paint_black_red_black: The Strongheart livery for the Golem is a bright and bold red with black highlights.
localization.item_descgolem_paint_blue_black_green: Striking green and blue highlights elevate the black base paint of the Cypher livery.
localization.item_descgolem_paint_gray_metal_metal: The Greysteel livery artfully deploys various shades of grey across the Golem for a subtle yet captivating look.
localization.item_descgolem_paint_grey_black_black: Mine and make yourself less visible against the dark expanse of space with the black and grey Coalheart livery for the Golem.
localization.item_descgolem_paint_luminalia_green_red: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.
localization.item_descgolem_paint_luminalia_white_blu: Equip your Golem with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.
localization.item_descgolem_paint_orange_white_orange: Prominent use of orange offset against white makes the Golem Flashpoint livery highly visible on busy and dangerous work sites.
localization.item_descgolem_paint_silver_teal_white: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.
localization.item_descgolem_paint_workersweek_white_b: Crisp white with blue accents, the Keystone livery celebrates the workers whose mining, refining, hauling, salvaging, and more have made the empire what it is today.
localization.item_descgolem_paint_yellow_gray_white: Yellow and white highlights atop a grey base paint gives the Golem a distinct look thanks to the Sunstruck livery.
localization.item_descgolem_paint_yellow_grey_orange: The Golem gets a distinct look with the Faultline livery with strategically placed yellow and orange stripes making the ship more visible.

localization.item_deschammer_propulsion_twin_hm_4_3: The luxury version of the HM4.3, Hammer Propulsion's HMX4.3 engine system features customized racing parts from some of the league's top engineers to help weather corrosion and general part decay.

localization.item_deschapr_hl24_s4_q2: Hammer Propulsion's HL 2.4 utilizes award-winning Gated 4 Grid Iron technology to provide a high output thrust with minimal emissions.

localization.item_deschapr_vp_esi_s2_q2: Hammer Propulsion's HM 4.2 thrusters are built with Electrostatic Ion technology, tuned for maximum thrust at the expense of signature profile and fuel efficiency. Making this an ideal option for racers or anyone who doesn't mind making an impression.
localization.item_deschapr_vp_esi_s3_q2: If speed is what you're after, the HM4.3 engine can give it to you. Built under supervision of the Racing Division at Hammer Propulsion, the 4.3 is a single-thruster system iteration of the award-winning Twin HM4.3 propulsion units made famous by the Origin 350r racers. The 4.3 has been specifically crafted down to the smallest pinion to give you the most boost possible in a single engine system.
localization.item_deschapr_vp_esi_s4_q2: Capable of powering a medium class vessel, the HM4.4 is all speed and no caution. It's main selling point, the heavy output, becomes its biggest detriment as the engine flash will make conventional countermeasures useless when attempting to distract missiles. But, like the ad says, if it's speed you want...
localization.item_deschapr_vp_rmi_s5_q2: Hammer Propulsion's HE 5.5 offers the same high quality, high output design that you find in the 5.3 but amplified to handle larger class vessels. the 5.5 is one of the most durable and robust thrusters on the market for commercial and shipping vehicles.

localization.item_descherald_paint_green_black: Embrace Day of the Vara mischievousness and mayhem any time of the year with this custom Herald livery. It combines metallic green and black for a striking look that highlights the holiday's classic colors.

localization.item_deschermes_paint_indigo_gold: The Paragon livery consists of a cool, crisp white, with regal blue and gold accents worthy of admiration.
localization.item_deschermes_paint_paint_red_blue: Carve a path through the unknown with the Dauntless livery. Featuring a deep, slate blue and striking red details, this color palette is for the bold and the brave.
localization.item_deschermes_paint_purple_black: Primarily a brilliant purple offset by a vivid orange, the Pulsar livery blends these contrasting colors into an interstellar mix.
localization.item_deschermes_paint_sand_blue: Evoking the sandy browns of an arid savanna, the Navarra livery is offset with a splash of bright blue.
localization.item_deschermes_paint_white_blue_blue: Crisp white with blue accents, the Keystone livery celebrates the workers whose mining, refining, hauling, salvaging, and more have made the empire what it is today.
localization.item_deschermes_paint_yellow_black: Featuring yellow highlights that pops against a rich black hull, the Lockdown livery is sure to make a statement.
localization.item_deschornet_f7a_mk1_paint_blue_blue_: Inspired by the deep blue skies frequently seen in the Navy's home system, the Kilian Blue livery was designed in 2880 to celebrate the 500th anniversary of Pax Humana and the formation of the Navy. Made specifically for the Hornet Mk I, the livery is dark blue with grey highlights and crisp white UEE logos.
localization.item_deschornet_f7a_mk1_paint_green_red_: Show your support for the UEE's most elite fighting force with the Corin Camo livery for the Hornet Mk I. localization.item_deschornet_f7a_mk2_paint_desert_cam: Gain an advantage when patrolling or exploring deserts in the Hornet F7A Mk2 with the Simoom livery, which mixes tan camo with black highlights.
localization.item_deschornet_f7a_mk2_paint_lovestruck: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your Hornet Mk II.
localization.item_deschornet_f7c_mk2_paint_black_gold: Primarily black with bronze highlights, the Ironscale livery gives the Hornet Mk2 a subtle yet elegant style.
localization.item_deschornet_f7c_mk2_paint_white_blue: The Icebound livery covers the Hornet Mk2 in crisp white with light blue highlights.
localization.item_deschornet_f7cm_mk2_paint_bluegrey_: The dynamic Hornet Mk II deserves a livery to match. The Tigerveil livery consists of a steely blue with bold orange and subtle black highlights.
localization.item_deschornet_f7cm_mk2_paint_grey_grey: Primarily dark grey, the Fortitude livery uses vibrant blue highlights to accentuate the silhouette of the iconic Hornet Mk II.
localization.item_deschornet_f7cm_mk2_paint_grey_oliv: Featuring various shades of green, the Silva livery brings a bold and distinct look to the Hornet Mk II.
localization.item_deschornet_f7cm_mk2_paint_heartseek: Made for pilots whose true love is the thrill of a harrowing dogfight, the Heartseeker livery for the Hornet Mk II features a white base paint, red highlights, and a heart decal near the cockpit.

localization.item_deschornet_f7cm_mk2_paint_silver_bl: The Shikari livery gives the Hornet Mk II a unique silver and blue camo design.
localization.item_deschornet_f7cm_mk2_paint_tan_tan_b: Bring to bear the incredible firepower of the Hornet Mk II in distinct style with the tan and black Quicksand livery.
localization.item_deschornet_f7cr_mk2_paint_green_ora: Mark the occasion with a splash of color thanks to the Bracken livery featuring a sage green hull paired with deep orange accents.
localization.item_deschornet_f7cs_mk2_paint_black_gre: While few would describe the Hornet Mk II as understated, the sleek two-tone black and grey finish of the Blacksmith livery comes close.
localization.item_deschornet_f7cs_mk2_paint_green_gol: Not every pilot was meant to fly a Hornet Mk II. Mark your distinction with the Regalia livery's emerald green hull paired with eye-catching gold accents.

localization.item_deschoverquad_paint_lightspeed_oran: Speed across picturesque landscapes in this sublime HoverQuad Lightspeed livery, which is orange with yellow flourishes.
localization.item_deschoverquad_paint_lovestruck_pink: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your HoverQuad.

localization.item_desclightning_f8_paint_iae_black_gr: Bring a distinct look to the F8 Lightning with the Nightweaver livery. It features a black fuselage intersected by green highlights in a unique and irregular pattern.
localization.item_desclightning_f8c_paint_bis2954: This purple and white 2954 Best in Show Livery celebrates the F8C Lightning winning the 2954 Ship Showdown.
localization.item_desclightning_f8c_paint_black_black: Turn heads and the tides of battle with the Shock Wave livery for the F8C Lightning. Featuring a striking green color with black highlights, the livery provides a dramatic and distinct look to a ship that's both a beauty and a beast.
localization.item_desclightning_f8c_paint_platinum: Cut a classic profile through any battlefield with the Stormfire livery for Anvil's new F8C Lightning. Featuring a triple-coat of Kalding paint rated for a variety of atmospheres and conditions, this sleek platinum look will keep you looking good for years to come.
localization.item_descloot_game_chess_1_a: This brass chess piece is a part of the classic Hyperion set that has been imitated multiple times since its 25th century debut.
localization.item_descloot_game_chess_1_b: This revenant wood chess piece is a part of the classic Hyperion set that has been imitated multiple times since its 25th century debut.

localization.item_desclynx_paint_purple_black_gold: The Nebula livery brings a striking metallic purple finish to the Lynx.
localization.item_desclynx_paint_silver_black_silver: A metallic grey body with black highlights makes the Moonrise a subtle yet stylish livery for the Lynx.
localization.item_desclynx_paint_white_blue_blue: Switch up the look of the Lynx with the Moonshadow livery, which is primarily white with blue highlights.

localization.item_descm50_paint_pirateweek_red_black_: Exude attitude with the Skullcrusher livery for the M50, which features a massive skull across the top.
localization.item_descm50_paint_racing_blue_yellow_ye: Slipstream into pole position with this sporty racing tint. Featuring a blue and yellow paint scheme accented by stylish chevrons, this Murray Cup themed livery highlights the sleek and piercing nature of the M50.
localization.item_descm80_paint_black_black_orange: Black envelopes most of the Afterglow livery for the M80 while orange accent lines provide a pop of color.
localization.item_descm80_paint_black_darkgrey_lightg: Customize your M80 ship with this gray camo livery.
localization.item_descm80_paint_red_black_blue: Featuring a brilliant red that produces a radiant shine, the Blaze livery transforms the M80's nose with an inky black, pale blue accents, and dark gray wings.

localization.item_descm80_paint_white_white_blue: Soar through the sky in style with the Dynasty livery, predominantly featuring a crisp white with soft accents of black and blue.

localization.item_descmedal_1_damaged_a: A campaign medal from the United Nations of Earth (UNE) military that commemorates meritorious service during the Unification Wars (2380-2384). Considered to be in poor condition due to the faded ribbons colors and broken, corroded metal.
localization.item_descmedal_1_damaged_b: A medal given to members of the UEE Marines 6th Platoon for distinguished service. The esteemed 6th Platoon 'Phantoms' have received this honor on numerous occasions, including for operations during the Second Tevarin War, on the Vanduul front and for rescuing a UEE survey team taken hostage by the Outsiders on Leir III. The discoloration of the ribbon and broken, corroded metal have left this medal in damaged condition.
localization.item_descmedal_1_damaged_c: A service marker awarded by the United Planets of Earth (UPE) to all members of the military who served during the First Tevarin War. Though many were produced in their time, those numbers have dwindled significantly and collectors are eager to pick up any found. This marker is considered in poor condition due to the broken and corroded state of the metal that's obscured the etchings.
localization.item_descmedal_1_damaged_d: This medal was awarded by United Planets of Earth (UPE) to members of the Government Cartography Agency who flew or supported missions involving the discovery, exploration, or scanning of new systems. It features a star woven with one large and three smaller interlocking circles that was the central symbol on the UPE flag. The tattered ribbon and broken and corroded metal has left this one in poor condition.
localization.item_descmedal_1_pristine_a: A campaign medal from the United Nations of Earth (UNE) military that commemorates meritorious service during the Unification Wars (2380-2384). Considered to be in pristine condition thanks to the bright colors still present in the ribbon and well-preserved etching on the medal itself.
localization.item_descmedal_1_pristine_b: A medal given to members of the UEE Marines 6th Platoon for distinguished service. The esteemed 6th Platoon 'Phantoms' have received this honor on numerous occasions, including for operations during the Second Tevarin War, on the Vanduul front and for rescuing a UEE survey team taken hostage by the Outsiders on Leir III. The excellent appearance of the ribbon and etchings on the observe have left this medal in pristine condition.
localization.item_descmedal_1_pristine_c: A service marker awarded by the United Planets of Earth (UPE) to all members of the military who served during the First Tevarin War. Though many were produced in their time, those numbers have dwindled significantly and collectors are eager to pick up any found. Well-preserved despite its age, this marker is considered in pristine condition and features clean etchings and minimal wear.
localization.item_descmedal_1_pristine_d: This medal was awarded by United Planets of Earth (UPE) to members of the Government Cartography Agency who flew or supported missions involving the discovery, exploration, or scanning of new systems. It features a star woven with one large and three smaller interlocking circles that was the central symbol on the UPE flag. The exquisite state of the ribbon and metal has left this one in pristine condition.
localization.item_descmedal_1_worn_a: A campaign medal from the United Nations of Earth (UNE) military that commemorates meritorious service during the Unification Wars (2380-2384). Considered to be in worn condition due to the faded ribbons colors and corroded metal.

The esteemed 6th Platoon 'Phantoms' have received this honor on numerous occasions, including for operations during the Second Tevarin War, on the Vanduul front and for rescuing a UEE survey team taken hostage by the Outsiders on Leir III. The discoloration of the ribbon and corroded metal have left this medal in worn condition.

This marker is considered in worn condition due to the corroded state of the metal and etchings.

localization.item_descmedical_fluid_storage_destructi: This Pancea canister from CureLife is used to refill the MedGel supply of medical beds.
localization.item_descmerlin_paint_luminalia_green_re: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.
localization.item_descmerlin_paint_luminalia_white_bl: Equip your P-52 Merlin with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.
localization.item_descmerlin_paint_p52: Standard livery for the P-52 Merlin.
localization.item_descmerlin_paint_stellafortuna2955_: Make luck your co-pilot. Boldly set your sights on the stars and adventure forth in style with the Fortuna livery. This Stella Fortuna themed paint scheme for the Archimedes and Merlin is primarily green with gray accents.
localization.item_descmerlin_paint_yellow_blue_white: Slipstream into pole position with this sporty racing tint. Featuring blue emboldened by stylish yellow chevrons, this Murray Cup themed livery highlights the sleek and piercing nature of the P-52 Merlin and P-72 Archimedes ships.
localization.item_descmeteor_paint_black_black_red_ca: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Meteor with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.
localization.item_descmeteor_paint_black_red_red: Make the Meteor a striking metallic red and black with the Bolide livery.
localization.item_descmeteor_paint_black_teal_black: The Skylark livery for the Meteor is primarily black and teal.
localization.item_descmeteor_paint_blue_black_red_met: Equip the ship livery used by ace pilot Disco in the classic children's cartoon Rory Nova. While it turns the Meteor metallic dark blue, black, and red, whether you turn into the 'dynamic, instinctive spacecraft operator' that inspired the livery's name is up to you.
localization.item_descmeteor_paint_vip_black_black_go: The eye-catching Shimmer livery brings a beautiful luster to the Meteor with a paint that shifts between gold and dark blue depending on the lighting and viewing angle.

localization.item_descmisc_freelancer_dur_shop:

Focus: Expedition

The Freelancer DUR variant specializes in exploration. Sacrificing 25% cargo capacity of the standard Freelancer for an enhanced jump drive, a more advanced scanner, and an expanded fuel tank may seem like a bad call to some, but those who value discovery over profit will find it to be their ship of choice.
localization.item_descmisc_freelancer_max_shop:
Manufacturer: MISC 
Focus: Medium Freight

Freelancer variant with additional cargo capacity at the expense of weapons. The Freelancer MAX variant sacrifices weaponry for an increased cargo capacity making it ideal for equipment or raw materials transport.
localization.item_descmisc_freelancer_shop:
Manufacturer: MISC
Focus: Medium Freight

localization.item_descmtc_paint_beige_grey_red_headhu: The Headhunters Reaper livery lets you proudly proclaim your allegiance to the gang. It features the gang's name and highlights in red on a beige and grey paint scheme. Compatible with all Greycat M-series vehicles.
localization.item_descmtc_paint_black_black_gold_soli: The Perdition livery envelops the MXC, and other Greycat M-Series vehicles, in dark black with gold highlights.
localization.item_descmtc_paint_black_grey_blue_solid: Crisp, metallic blue with grey and black highlights provide the Moonstone livery a spirited look for the MTC, which can also be applied to other Greycat M-Series vehicles.
localization.item_descmtc_paint_black_grey_red_camo: The Brushwood Camo livery for the MTC features a digital green and grey camo pattern with a red line cutting through each side. It's also compatible with other Greycat M-series vehicles.
localization.item_descmtc_paint_brown_brown_red_camo_: An ideal choice for cloaking the MXC in woodland environs, the Timberwolf Camo livery features a brown camo pattern and subtle red highlights. It's also compatible with other Greycat M-series vehicles.
localization.item_descmtc_paint_green_black_grey_cfp: Be a beacon of hope by equipping the Citizens for Prosperity Liberation livery, which features the group's name and symbol atop a green, black, and grey paint job. Compatible with all Greycat M-series vehicles.
localization.item_descmtc_paint_grey_black_red_solid: Bold red highlights add a bit of color and break up the black base paint of the MTC Baracus livery, which can also be applied to other Greycat M-Series vehicles.
localization.item_descmtc_paint_grey_black_yellow_sol: Equip the Filament livery to make the MTC grey with black and yellow highlights. It's also compatible with other Greycat M-series vehicles.
localization.item_descmtc_paint_grey_grey_red_camo_a: Disguise the silhouette of the MXC with the white and grey digital camo of the Icefront Camo livery, which is also compatible with other Greycat M-series vehicles.
localization.item_descmtc_paint_grey_lightgrey_orange: The Boreal livery brings a mix of metallic light grey, grey, and orange highlights to the MTC. It's also compatible with other Greycat M-series vehicles.
localization.item_descmtc_paint_lightgrey_lightgrey_r: Make the MXC light grey with red highlights by equipping the Cadet livery, which can also be applied to other Greycat M-Series vehicles.
localization.item_descmug_big_bennys_1_a: Grab Drink! \n\nThis playful Big Benny's mug features the brand's iconic mascot. Its unique dual layer design features a chip and fade proof ceramic that feels comfortable in the hand with special plastic coating on the lip and handle to ensure it's never too hot to touch.
localization.item_descmug_orison_2_a: Made from durable stoneware, the Finley the Stormwal mug features the mascot's iconic grin and inquisitive eyes. This fun mug will keep beverages warm and bring a smile to your face.
localization.item_descmug_star_kitten_1_a: The cuteness can't be contained but hot beverages can be with this Star Kitten mug. Personally designed by the character's legendary creator Genady Kuzo, it features an extra large handle that makes it easy to hold and is constructed with an ultra-durable ceramic so its adorableness won't chip or fade away.
localization.item_descmule_paint_bushwacker: When the job calls for crossing forests and grasslands, outfit your Drake Mule with the Bushwhacker livery, which mixes shades of green and grey.
localization.item_descmule_paint_green_black: Embrace Day of the Vara mischievousness and mayhem any time of the year with this custom Mule livery. It combines metallic green and black for a striking look that highlights the holiday's classic colors.
localization.item_descmule_paint_reburn: Who says you can't have a bit of fun while on the job? The Reburn livery for the Drake Mule brings a red tint to the cockpit glass and cargo cover.
localization.item_descmule_paint_silverback: The Silverback livery adds a white cargo cover and highlights to contrast the sleek grey frame of the Drake Mule.
localization.item_descmule_paint_smokestack: The Mule Smokestack livery features various shades of grey for a sleek and subtle look that's sure to impress while on cargo runs.
localization.item_descmustang_paint_beta: Standard livery for the C.O. Mustang Beta.
localization.item_descmustang_paint_citizencon2018: Standard livery for the C.O. Mustang Alpha Vindicator.
localization.item_descmustang_paint_delta: Standard livery for the C.O. Mustang Delta.
localization.item_descmustang_paint_gamma: Standard livery for the C.O. Mustang Gamma.
localization.item_descmustang_paint_iae2951_blue_blac: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Mustang livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.
localization.item_descmustang_paint_iae2951_grey_whit: Modify your Mustang with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.
localization.item_descmustang_paint_iae_2952_yellow: A unique ship deserves an equally bold look, so outfit your Mustang in yellow with the Guardian livery.
localization.item_descmustang_paint_luminalia_2021_wh: Equip your Mustang with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.
localization.item_descmustang_paint_omega: Standard livery for the C.O. Mustang Omega.
localization.item_descmustang_paint_stellafortuna2955: Make luck your co-pilot. Boldly set your sights on the stars and adventure forth in style with the Fortuna livery. This Stella Fortuna themed paint scheme is primarily green with gray accents.
localization.item_descmustang_paint_yellow_blue_white: With a deep blue base and a bright yellow finish with chevron accents, this lively Murray Cup livery shows spectators that you've got a true competitor's spirit.
localization.item_descmxox_emp_device:
Manufacturer: MaxOx
Item Type: Burst Generator
Size: 1
Damage Type: EMP

The TroMag from MaxOx is a well-designed and reliable EMP-focused burst generator. Its popularity has risen over the years as pilots look for alternatives to Behring’s REP-8. The TroMag boasts a faster charge time than their main competitor but has a smaller effective radius, leaving pilots to decide whether they prefer speed or size.
localization.item_descmxox_neutroncannon_s1:
Manufacturer: MaxOx
Item Type: Neutron Cannon
Size: 1

MaxOx’s NN-13 neutron cannon offers a massive energy payload at the expense of speed and energy efficiency. One could argue the virtues of speed, rate of fire and distance over damage, but the argument becomes irrelevant if you only need to hit them once.
localization.item_descmxox_neutroncannon_s2:
Manufacturer: MaxOx
Item Type: Neutron Cannon
Size: 2

Building on the technology of the NN-13, MaxOx’s NN-14 offers a significant increase in power for the neutron autocannon to give each shot a devastating punch. With that increased damage however, comes a heavier draw on your power plant.
localization.item_descmxox_neutroncannon_s3:
Manufacturer: MaxOx 
Item Type: Neutron Cannon 
Size: 3  

Building on the technology of the successful NN-series, MaxOx’s NN-15 offers a significant increase in power for the neutron autocannon to give each shot a devastating punch. With that increased damage however, comes a heavier draw on your power plant.
localization.item_descmxox_neutronrepeater_s1:
Manufacturer: MaxOx
Item Type: Neutron Repeater
Size: 1

The NDB-26 uses a twin barrel system to fire neutron projectiles at a rapid rate. Devastating at close range, this neutron repeater still packs enough of a wallop at medium range to persuade any attackers to reconsider their assault.
localization.item_descmxox_neutronrepeater_s2:
Manufacturer: MaxOx
Item Type: Neutron Repeater
Size: 2

Featuring a sleek, scientific design, the MaxOx NDB-28 is the next step in serious stopping power. Twin barrels overlap blasts for sustained neutron fire that remains effective at short to medium range.
localization.item_descmxox_neutronrepeater_s3:
Manufacturer: MaxOx
Item Type: Neutron Repeater
Size: 3

Decades of design work went into perfecting the NDB line of neutron repeaters. The S3 NDB-30 rapidly fires powerful and precise neutron projectiles that will quickly deter anyone foolish enough to get too close.
localization.item_descnomad_paint_2951redfestival_red: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the 2951 Auspicious Red Ram livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complimented by gold accents and a silhouette of a ram's head.

localization.item_descnomad_paint_lovestruck_pink_bla: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your Nomad.
localization.item_descnomad_paint_luminalia_green_red: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.
localization.item_descnomad_paint_luminalia_white_blu: Equip your Nomad with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.
localization.item_descnomad_paint_overdrive_white_bla: Upgrade your Nomad with the Cherry Blossom livery featuring a bold black and white styling with pink highlights.
localization.item_descnomad_paint_unity2952_metal_tea: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

localization.item_descnova_paint_badlands: Featuring a tan paint scheme ideal for desert environments, the Nova Badlands livery offers a devastating combination of weaponry to eliminate threats on the ground and in the air.
localization.item_descnova_paint_emberstorm: Featuring a tan, red and black camo paint scheme ideal for desert environments, the Nova Ember Storm livery offers a devastating combination of weaponry to eliminate threats on the ground and in the air.
localization.item_descnova_paint_fleetweek_level1_mil: Customize your Nova with the Timberline livery that's olive green with orange accents.
localization.item_descnova_paint_fw2955_grey_black_re: Discreetly traverse under the night sky in the Nova with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.
localization.item_descnova_paint_gunmetal: Featuring a metallic silver paint scheme, the Nova Gunmetal livery offers a devastating combination of weaponry to eliminate threats on the ground and in the air.
localization.item_descnova_paint_shiftingsands: Featuring a tan and white paint scheme for desert environments, the Nova Shifting Sands livery offers a devastating combination of weaponry to eliminate threats on the ground and in the air.
localization.item_descnova_paint_snowblind: Featuring a grey, black and white camo paint scheme ideal for arctic environments, the Nova Snowblind livery offers a devastating combination of weaponry to eliminate threats on the ground and in the air.
localization.item_descnox_paint_alienweek_green_red: The Ocellus livery adapts and updates the iconic colors and design used on some Tevarin ships to bring a striking new look to the Nox. The livery gives the top of the fuselage a prominent red ridge while shimmering green covers the rest of the ship. Thick grey lines swoop through both colors to provide a unique geometric element.
localization.item_descnox_paint_alienweek_platinum_si: The Wanderer livery features crisscrossing purple and grey lines over a platinum foundation. Inspired by the sacred Xi'an gardens of R.aip?uang, famous for its trails that wander in surprising ways and encourage a focus on the journey instead of the destination.
localization.item_descnox_paint_harmony: The Harmony livery is meant to showcase Humanity's peaceful relationship with alien species with a semi-pearlescent blue main coat marked with organic reflective red to suggest the coming together of disparate species and cultures. The Harmony livery has been designed and produced by the UEE's Diplomatic Corps and freely licensed to all spacecraft manufacturers. Now Aopoa Nox owners can celebrate the UEE's intentions of working toward a peaceful galaxy.
localization.item_descnox_paint_racing_blue_blue_blue: The Whirlwind livery mixes various shades of blue in a memorable animal stripe pattern to give the Nox a daring look.
localization.item_descnox_paint_racing_blue_white: The Slipstream livery will have your Nox ready and raring to race with this sleek blue and white paint scheme.
localization.item_descnox_paint_racing_purple_white: The Turbocharged is a distinct, purple racing livery for the Nox that will make you stand out from the rest of the field.
localization.item_descnox_paint_racing_red_silver: Blast past other racers in your Nox with the Overdrive livery, which features a stylish blend red and silver coloring.
localization.item_descnox_paint_racing_white_pink_blu: Embody Sally the Star Kitten's racing spirit with this custom Nox livery. Combining the bright pink, vibrant blue, and crisp white of the beloved cartoon mascot, this livery brings a playfulness your competitors are sure to enjoy.
localization.item_descnox_paint_racing_yellow_white_g: Give the Nox a classic racing design with the Finish Line livery. It features a yellow stripe across the front, a white one through the middle, and a grey one on the back.
localization.item_descnox_paint_thli_silver_black: Speed and style combine with the Nox Thli livery that artfully blends silver and black across this open-canopy racer.

localization.item_descnvy_bdu_trousers_01: Made to military specification, the Combat Readiness Uniform pants are made from tough nylon synthetics to make them durable and comfortable enough for any kind of field operations. localization.item_descokbv_fp_esci_s2_q1: OKB Voskhod has been in the thruster game for decades and recently unveiled the Energia IV at the thruster manufacturer trade show in Prime. Benchmarks show that this thruster mostly lives up to the marketing hype from the show floor: it has good fuel efficiency, and the extra shielding OKB Voskhod has added results in minimal heat signature. It lags a bit in the performance tests but the manufacturer maintains it not a marketed as a solution where maximum thrust is required.
localization.item_descokbv_silentiv_s3_q1: The Silent IV Advanced from OKB Voskhod is a field emission ion engine optimized to provide a decreased heat signature, making the ship more difficult to track via conventional scans.

localization.item_descpaladin_paint_blue_black_black: The Downstream livery features subtle shades of blue and black to help the Paladin discreetly reach drop zones.
localization.item_descpaladin_paint_clean_air_black_g: Showcase your dedication to helping Alliance Aid assist the people of Levski during their time of need with this grey camo livery.
localization.item_descpaladin_paint_cream_yellow_gree: Showcasing the Paladin's powerful design, the wild greens, beige, and yellow of the Solaris livery demonstrate that this is not a ship to be trifled with.
localization.item_descpaladin_paint_grey_black_green: Bring a grey base paint with green highlights to the Paladin with the Steadfast livery.
localization.item_descpaladin_paint_grey_black_red: Equip the Carmine livery with its bold red highlights atop a grey base paint to make the Paladin easier to spot amidst the fog the war.
localization.item_descpaladin_paint_white_black_grey: Blend into the clouds until ready to strike with the Galahad livery for the Paladin, which features a white base paint with black and grey highlights.
localization.item_descperseus_paint_beige_blue_red: The unique Repute livery divides the Perseus into distinct sections with a tan front half and a red and blue back half.
localization.item_descperseus_paint_black_black_red: Maintain your cover and an air of mystique with the Deadfire livery with its inky black base paint and red highlights.
localization.item_descperseus_paint_black_grey_white: Restyle your Perseus with a dazzle camouflage inspired paint scheme using various abstract patterns and shades of black, grey, and white.
localization.item_descperseus_paint_clean_air_black_g: Showcase your dedication to helping Alliance Aid assist the people of Levski during their time of need with this grey camo livery.
localization.item_descperseus_paint_gold_marble_gold: The Hieron livery bring classical beauty to the modern war machine with its marble-inspired base paint and gold highlights.
localization.item_descperseus_paint_grey_black_white: Accentuate the strong, angular design of the Perseus with the Flintlock livery. A distinct white section across the middle of the ship divides the pointed front half from the dark foreboding back.
localization.item_descperseus_paint_grey_blue_red: The Resilient livery for the Perseus elegantly mixes grey and blue with red highlights.
localization.item_descperseus_paint_red_grey_black: Proclaim the presence of the Perseus with the Incite livery, featuring a bold red front and grey and black rear.
localization.item_descpisces_paint_2953redfestival_re: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Rooster livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a rooster.
localization.item_descpisces_paint_bis2952_black_red: Metallic red and black makes the Red Alert livery a striking choice for the C8 Pisces.
localization.item_descpisces_paint_blue_white: Race to the rescue in style with the C8 Pisces Code Blue livery, featuring a vivid blue hue with white highlights and markings.
localization.item_descpisces_paint_red_black_stripe: A bright red base color and neon yellow highlights makes the Heartbeat livery for the C8 Pisces easy to identify from a distance during rescue operations.
localization.item_descpisces_paint_reward_faction_cfp: Join the Citizens for Prosperity in their mission to bring peace to the frontier with this dark grey and burgandy livery featuring the group's signature logo.
localization.item_descpisces_paint_reward_faction_fro: Be ready to battle in the untamed wilds with this green camo livery featuring the logo of the Frontier Fighters vigilante group.
localization.item_descpisces_paint_reward_faction_hea: Show your loyalty to the Headhunters gang with this livery featuring their logo emblazoned on a dark grey hull accented with a vibrant purple.
localization.item_descpisces_paint_reward_faction_xen: Let Humanity know you won't bow down to alien invaders with this XenoThreat livery featuring a muted teal with bright red accents.
localization.item_descpisces_paint_white_red: Outfit the C8 Pisces in pristine white with red highlights with the Responder livery.
localization.item_descpitbull_cream_silver_silver: The Wind Chill livery for the Pitbull features crisp white paint with black highlights and silver accents.
localization.item_descpitbull_metal_metal_yellow: The Aquamarine livery gives a metallic teal base with subtle yellow accents to make a statement, before you throw a punch.
localization.item_descpitbull_red_black_black: Dive into combat with this blood red livery for your Pitbull to show everyone on the battlefield exactly what you're out for.
localization.item_descpitbull_yellow_black_black: When you want them to see you coming, the Hardstrike livery is a bold explosion of yellow to make every fight even more vibrant.
localization.item_descplant_pot_1_luminalia_a: Bring a little life to your Luminalia decor with the Hello Sunshine Planter from Sakura Sun. Featuring a red and green pot with a Banu season greeting and a charming facial expression, this festive tree is decorated with ornaments and spinning stars.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_doublebed_flair_cora: With a luxurious bedspread featuring the iconic image of a spacesuit clad pilot that can be found on the Anvil Hornet Heartseeker, this opulent bed is framed by a red velvet, heart-shaped headboard that is sure to make every night a bit more pleasurable.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_flair_banu_instrumen: Inspired by Human-made instruments which were the Banu's first introduction to music, this ornately decorated Ochelo features four strings on a raised fret and a leather-skinned drum base. Some of the most popular practitioners of the instrument have risen to fame performing as buskers in markets and city squares.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_flair_bigbennyrank10: A replica of the original Big Benny's vending machine designed to bring a nostalgic touch to any environment.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_flair_cafemusain_sig: Show off your rebellious streak with this replica Café Musain bar sign. Originally a communal living area for the first settlers of Levski, over time this spot evolved into a performance space, an art gallery, and eventually a bar.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_flair_canister_anoma: Developed by ASD scientists, this experimental power core showed promise thanks to its exceptional output rates, but suffered from energy fluctuations and gravity anomalies that proved to be insurmountable issues which rendered it unusable. ASD has ceased all future development of this technology.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_flair_canister_worm_: Collected by the scientists at Associated Science & Development, this specimen tank holds a well-preserved juvenile valakkar. Once used in various research experiments, the valakkar inside is now ready to serve as biological curio and decorative conversation piece.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_flair_hanger_flag_ia: Though the 2954 Ship Showdown may be over, your memories of the F8C Lightning taking the top spot can last thanks to this large holographic standing flag honoring the winner.
Though the 2955 Ship Showdown may be over, your memories of the Polaris taking the top spot can last thanks to this large holographic standing flag honoring the winner.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_flair_heart_table_1_: Bring a touch of class to your bedside with this exquisitely designed table. Standing atop two curled legs resembling a heart, this luscious ruby tabletop is perfect for reminding you that love is always within reach.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_flair_light_rope_lum: This festive light display brings a bit of mirth to your holiday decorations with its charming depiction of a fierce kopion. Perfect for the wildlife appreciator in your life.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_flair_lunar_envelope: Showcase your Red Festival envelopes with this beautiful display. This three-level stand is made with sustainably sourced mahogany and features a red quilted backing with fringe detailing and a golden trim.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_flair_vanduullance_d: Mounted onto a standing case, this display shows the remains of a Vanduul lance recovered from the aftermath of the Battle of Vega.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_gunrack_4p_3r_lowtec: Made for the weapon enthusiast who values their guns for more than just the amount of damage they can do. Complete with numerous display shelves for your favorite arms, as well as storage space for spare ammo and accessories, all in a stylish package that shows off your top picks.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_it_couch_improvised_: Why risk your reputation as a serious outlaw by sitting on anything but the most hardcore of couches? Featuring hand-printed skulls and make-shift repairs, this couch will have your guests saying, “this person is definitely a criminal.”
localization.item_descplayerdeco_seat_armchair_headhu: Reign over your subjects from the haughty heights of your very own throne. Fabricated from a disused engine, animal bones, scavenged metal parts, and a swathe of vibrant red feathers, this chair's menacing presence is reinforced by a golden plated skull sculpted into the back.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_seat_barstool_col_1_: Popularized by famed furniture designer Aldean Baltazar, the iconic Baltazar Stool has seen little iteration in its design since its inception fifty years ago.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_seat_bench_2_seat_he: Snuggle up this Coramor on this luxurious heart-shaped couch. Featuring a captivating crimson covering, the nano-woven fibers of this settee guarantee you'll stay comfortable all night long.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_seat_chair_anvil_car: Styled after the seats aboard the Anvil Carrack, this grey and white accent chair is fantastic way to show your love of space travel even when staying at home.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_seat_chair_cargo_1_s: Ready to rest your weary legs after a long day of hauling dangerous materials? Look no further than this unique chair upcycled from a repurposed hazardous cargo box.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_seat_chair_crus_star: Styled after the seats aboard the Crusader Starlifter, this grey and white accent chair is fantastic way to show your love of space travel even when staying at home.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_seat_chair_drak_pira: Ripped out of a busted ship and ready for lounging, this former cockpit seat has been tagged with a vivid skull print to make for an aggressive seating addition to your hideout.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_seat_chair_rsi_phoen: Styled after the seats aboard the RSI Constellation Phoenix, this grey and white accent chair is fantastic way to show your love of space travel even when staying at home.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_seat_chair_rsi_polar: Salvaged from the wreckage of a UEE Polaris ship, this mostly intact captain's seat makes for a good talking point inside your hangar.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_static_diorama_cargo: Remember your part in resupplying the dangerous Pyro system with this commemorative display featuring artfully arrayed large cargo containers tagged with decorative graffiti.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_static_diorama_worm_: Face down the dangerous valakkar without risking your life with this exquisite statue. Irradiated by the toxic storms of Pyro I, this apex predator bursts forth from the ground ready to defend its young.
Artfully hewn from rock with resin accents, this fiercely realistic statue captures the indomitable spirit of the Yormandi as it faces down unsee prey.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_static_hologram_luna: Celebrate Red Festival in style with this eye-catching homage to traditional lanterns. Giving off a warm and inviting light, this beautiful lantern sits within a large, intricately carved circular frame adorned with a rat in honor of 2956.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_static_hologram_shat: Looted from one of the infamous smugglers' hideouts, this red holographic banner features the Shattered Blade's fearsome iconography that serves as warning to any who dare enter, Human and Vanduul alike.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_static_hologram_wike: Hello, human neighbor. I am Wikelo and now live in your human system of Stanton. Have many things if you would like to come visit. Can make too. If not, I understand. Enjoy this gift from me.\n\nBye.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_statue_stand_lifesiz: Based on the original model used as military propaganda after the UEE's first encounter with the Vanduul in 2681, this towering figure serves as a sombre reminder of the unrelenting destructive nature of the Vanduul species.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_statue_stand_navypil: Originally commissioned for the UEE Navy recruitment center in New York City on Earth, 'Spirit of the Starman' proudly displays an unnamed pilot, serving as a reminder of the solidarity and sacrifice the Empire's military demonstrate everyday as they serve as guardians of freedom and justice, and champions of honor and valor.
localization.item_descplayerdeco_table_improvised_pok: From planning your next heist to high-stakes card games, this salvaged table featuring a large skull marking is the perfect place for gathering with your last known associates.
localization.item_descplushy_carrack_1_a_uncarryable: Encourage an adventurous spirit with this soft and squeezable Carrack plushie modeled after Anvil's classic exploration ship.
localization.item_descplushy_cutlass_black: This soft plushie is modeled after Drake Interplanetary's widely popular multifunction ship the Cutlass Black. Even the most hardened spacefarer will appreciate its gentle squish.
localization.item_descplushy_cutlass_blue: This soft plushie is modeled after Drake Interplanetary's Cutlass Blue, a patrol ship variant designed to protect citizens and suppress dangerous outlaws.
localization.item_descplushy_cutlass_red: This soft plushie is modeled after Drake Interplanetary's Cutlass Red, a variant designed for emergency response. Whereas the real ship contains a med bay to help heal physical wounds, this plushie might just help heal emotional ones.
localization.item_descplushy_cutlass_steel: This soft plushie is modeled after Drake Interplanetary's Cutlass Steel, a troop transport variant intended to serve as both dropship and gunship.
localization.item_descplushy_hercules_1_a: Get your hands on Crusader's cargo hauling stalwart with this plushie version of the C2 Hercules Starlifter.
localization.item_descplushy_hercules_1_b: Get your hands on Crusader's devastating gunship and bomb delivery platform with this plushie version of the A2 Hercules Starlifter.
localization.item_descplushy_hercules_1_c: Get your hands on Crusader's premier tactical military transporter with this plushie version of the M2 Hercules Starlifter.
localization.item_descplushy_orison_whale_1_a_1h: Finley the Stormwal loves sailing through the clouds in Crusader's atmosphere. Much like Crusader's ships, Finley is big, graceful, and quite the sight to behold. Now this majestic creature can accompany you on a journey through the stars with this soft and squeezable plushie.
localization.item_descplushy_orison_whale_1_a_2h: Finley the Stormwal loves sailing through the clouds in Crusader's atmosphere. Much like Crusader's ships, Finley is big, graceful, and quite the sight to behold. Now this majestic blue stormwal can accompany you on a journey through the stars with this large, soft, and squeezable plushie.
localization.item_descplushy_orison_whale_1_b_1h: Francis the Stormwal loves sailing through the clouds in Crusader's atmosphere. Much like Crusader's ships, Francis is big, graceful, and quite the sight to behold. Now this majestic creature can accompany you on a journey through the stars with this soft and squeezable plushie.
localization.item_descplushy_orison_whale_1_b_2h: Francis the Stormwal loves sailing through the clouds in Crusader's atmosphere. Much like Crusader's ships, Francis is big, graceful, and quite the sight to behold. Now this majestic purple stormwal can accompany you on a journey through the stars with this large, soft, and squeezable plushie.
localization.item_descplushy_orison_whale_1_c_1h: Finley the Stormwal loves Luminalia so much they even gets dressed up for the occasion. This festive Finley plushie is decked out in red and green, making them an excellent guest for any Luminalia celebration.
localization.item_descplushy_orison_whale_1_c_2h: Finley the Stormwal loves Luminalia so much they even gets dressed up for the occasion. This festive and large Finley plushie is decked out in red and green, making them an excellent guest for any Luminalia celebration.
localization.item_descplushy_orison_whale_1_d_2h: There's only one thing Francis the Stormwal loves more than sailing through the clouds in Crusader's atmosphere and that's a good party. Make Francis the featured guest at your next event with this soft and squeezable plushie that's already wearing a hat fit for the occasion.
localization.item_descplushy_penguin_1: This adorable mascot of New Babbage loves nothing more than carving their way down the snow covered slopes of microTech.
localization.item_descplushy_penguin_1_b: No one can shred the slopes or celebrate quite like Pico the Penguin. This version of the charming microTech mascot makes any occasion more fun and festive by sporting a vibrant green jacket and playful party hat.
localization.item_descplushy_penguin_2_b: No one can shred the slopes or celebrate quite like Pico the Penguin. This version of the charming microTech mascot makes any occasion more fun and festive by sporting a vibrant orange jacket and playful party hat.
localization.item_descplushy_penguin_2_c: Even Pico the Penguin takes time away from shredding the slopes to celebrate Luminalia. This version of microTech's charming mascot features him in a red and green jacket and holding a Luminalia-themed snowboard.
localization.item_descplushy_penguin_3_b: No one can shred the slopes or celebrate quite like Pico the Penguin. This version of the charming microTech mascot makes any occasion more fun and festive by sporting a vibrant purple jacket and playful party hat.
localization.item_descplushy_vanduul_1_a: Not all Vanduul crave battle, some crave cuddles. Intricately crafted using a high-grade polyester, this plushie is ready to conquer your heart with its durable plastic armor, felt shoulder pads, and elegant gold detailing.
localization.item_descplushy_zeus_1_a: This soft plushie is a huggable bit of history celebrating the original 2140 RSI Zeus, the first civilian spaceship equipped with a quantum drive.
localization.item_descpolaris_paint_bis2955_orange_bl: Commemorate the Polaris taking the crown as the winner of the 2955 Ship Showdown with this striking metallic orange and black Best in Show livery.
localization.item_descpolaris_paint_black_grey_gold: Ribbons of gold set against a matte black base paint bring a restrained and elevated beauty to the Polaris Quasar livery.
localization.item_descpolaris_paint_blue_black_yellow: Patrol, protect, and impress with the Polaris by outfitting it with the Sirius livery, which masterfully mixes blue, grey, and tan.
localization.item_descpolaris_paint_fw2955_grey_black: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Polaris with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.
localization.item_descpolaris_paint_green_green_grey: Equip the Apex livery to give the mighty Polaris a distinct green and grey look.
localization.item_descpolaris_paint_halloween25_orang: The Black Magic livery for the Polaris mixes a macabre black with glowing orange highlights for a look inspired by the sinister spirit of Day of the Vara.

Manufacturer: ACOM 
Size: 1
Grade: B
Class: Competition

Four generations of racing knowledge and know-how are behind ACOM’s StarHeart power plant. Known for its rapid power distribution, the StarHeart has become a favorite among speedsters.

Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: ACOM
Size: 1
Grade: C
Class: Competition

Harness the power of a star with this high performance power plant from ACOM. Ideal for racers and those who seek speed.

Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: ACOM
Size: 2
Grade: A

Famous for performance that laps the competition, the LuxCore provides all the speed your ship needs. You'll leave other medium power plants in the dust with this first-class component from the racing experts at ACOM.
localization.item_descpowr_acom_s02_starburn_scitem:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: ACOM
Size: 2
Grade: B
Class: Competition 

The StarBurn power plant is another excellent addition to the ACOM line of components. This medium-sized component delivers solid performance without overheating, so you won't risk burning your hands while making important repairs on the fly.

Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics 
Size: 1
Grade: D
Class: Military

The Aegis Charger has powered military fighters for generations. Tried and tested in the most demanding of situations, the Charger can handle sudden or sustained power draws with ease.
localization.item_descpowr_aegs_s01_fierellcascade:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Size: 1
Grade: B
Class: Military

Rely on Aegis’ expertise to power your ship. The Fierell Cascade is a military-grade power plant that prioritizes performance over everything else.
localization.item_descpowr_aegs_s01_regulus:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Size: 1
Grade: C
Class: Military

The Regulus is the power plant you can count on when everyone is counting on you. Made to exceed exacting military standards, Aegis’ design team has made sure that you have the extra power you need, when you need it most.
localization.item_descpowr_aegs_s02_maelstrom:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Size: 2
Grade: C
Class: Military

This military-grade component has been put through the paces by the UEE Navy, so you know the Maelstrom can handle the havoc of battle.
localization.item_descpowr_aegs_s02_quadracellmt_scit:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Size: 2
Grade: A 
Class: Military

An Aegis intern crafted the initial design for the QuadraCell MT power plant, inspiring a phrase often heard around their office, “Fresh eyes bring fresh innovation.” This military-grade component still outperforms any other medium power plant they make.
localization.item_descpowr_aegs_s02_vortex:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics 
Size: 2
Grade: D
Class: Military

Turn the tide of battle with the Aegis Vortex. Counted on by the UEE Navy, this power plant can be found on ships defending every corner of the universe.
localization.item_descpowr_aegs_s03_drassik_scitem:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics 
Size: 3
Grade: D
Class: Military

The Drassik is a military-grade power plant from Aegis Dynamics. The large component is known for providing decent durability but unremarkable performance.
localization.item_descpowr_aegs_s03_quadracellmx_scit:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Size: 3
Grade: A 
Class: Military

Aegis engineers set out to create a power plant that could deliver the performance and durability needed during prolonged engagements. The QuadraCell MX was the result. This large power plant received years of strenuous field testing before finally becoming available to the public.
localization.item_descpowr_amrs_s01_hypergen:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. 
Size: 1
Grade: D
Class: Military

The HyperGen power plant is popular among both civilians and the military for its high quality. As a bonus, the manufacture, Amon & Reese, is famous for its stellar customer service.
localization.item_descpowr_amrs_s01_js300_scitem:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co.
Size: 1
Grade: A 
Class: Military

This high-end, military-grade component from A&R delivers excellent performance and solid durability at the expense of slightly increased emission levels. However with the JS-300 pedigree, it’s easy to see why this small power plant has many fans in the military.
localization.item_descpowr_amrs_s01_overdrive:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co.
Size: 1
Grade: C
Class: Military

Amon & Reese knows from years of experience just how hard the military can push their ships. Their OverDrive power plant was designed from the ground up to not only handle those tough conditions with less overheating, but to provide the same dependability and power to civilians as well.
localization.item_descpowr_amrs_s02_exogen:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. 
Size: 2
Grade: D
Class: Military

Simple and direct, the ExoGen generates power in traditional A&R style: no fuss, just solid craftsmanship.
localization.item_descpowr_amrs_s02_js400_scitem:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co.
Size: 2
Grade: A
Class: Military

As the UEE’s oldest energy weapon manufacturer, A&R expanded into power plants to interface more efficiently with their weapons. The JS-400 was their first attempt at a medium power plant, and it’s a testament to the quality of this military-grade component that it’s still around.
localization.item_descpowr_amrs_s02_ultraflux_scitem:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co.
Size: 2
Grade: B
Class: Military

Initially designed under a military contract, A&R's UltraFlux medium power plant decimated the required performance milestones and enjoyed a storied career as a dependable military asset. When the military’s exclusive rights to this high quality component lapsed, A&R eagerly released this to the commercial market.
localization.item_descpowr_amrs_s03_js500_scitem:
Item Type: Power Plant 
Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. 
Size: 3
Grade: A
Class: Military

The JS-500 is A&R’s best performing large power plant. This military-grade component receives consistent praise from users both in the military and civilian market.
localization.item_descpowr_amrs_s03_superdrive:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co.
Size: 3
Grade: C
Class: Military

A&R’s award winning customer service sets the SuperDrive apart from other military power plants in its class. Consumers love that they can depend on both the component and company when the going gets tough.

Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk
Size: 0

Class: Industrial

Juno Starwerk’s foray into vehicle power plants begins with the Jennet. While not as highly-rated as similar components, the company’s reputation for dependability and ease of maintenance still make it a favorite in some circles.

Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk
Size: 0
Grade: C
Class: Industrial

When the road ahead is long, Juno Starwerk’s Steadfast power plant is there to see you and your vehicle through to the end by providing on-demand power and durability.

Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk 
Size: 1
Grade: B
Class: Industrial

Juno Starwerk’s Endurance has been in service since the 26th century. This industrial strength, utilitarian power plant is a favorite of mechanics since spare parts are easily acquired.
localization.item_descpowr_just_s01_roughneck:
Item Type: Power Plant
Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk
Size: 1
Grade: D
Class: Industrial

For its class, the Roughneck power plant from Juno Starwerk is an ideal component for haulers looking for maximum performance.

Class: Industrial

According to Juno Starwerk, good industrial design is meant to go unnoticed, yet it’s hard not to marvel at the Genoa medium power plant, as its outstanding performance and noted durability make it a first-rate component.

Utilitarian to its core, the Trommel’s lack of frills has made the power plant a favorite of mechanics around the Empire.

Juno Starwerk’s Endurance has been in service since the 26th century. This industrial strength, utilitarian power plant is a favorite of mechanics since spare parts are easily acquired.

localization.item_descprospector_paint_aphorite_purpl: Decorate your Prospector with the Aphorite livery, which gets its name and color from the precious purple gemstone prized for its multi-hued tones.
localization.item_descprospector_paint_dolivine_green: Sharing the name with a gemstone prized for its beauty and industrial applications, the Dolivine livery blends shades of light green to give your Prospector a unique look.
localization.item_descprospector_paint_hadanite_pink: The Hadanite livery for your Prospector gives the ship a distinct pink hue that mirrors the look of the gemstone of the same name.
localization.item_descprospector_paint_iae2950_grey_b: This custom Prospector livery was created to celebrate the 2950 IAE on microTech. It blends black and electric blue to give the ship a cool new look.
localization.item_descprospector_paint_iae2950_grey_w: Modify your Prospector with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2950 IAE event on microTech.
localization.item_descprospector_paint_iae_2952_black: Balancing black and white, the Nebula livery for the Prospector lets you blast rocks in style.
localization.item_descprospector_paint_luminalia_gree: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.
localization.item_descprospector_paint_luminalia_whit: Equip your Prospector with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.
localization.item_descprospector_paint_scavengers_bla: This version of the livery has been modified from its original form with the addition of graffiti. Embrace chaos with the Outcast livery. It features rough splashes of neon green against black to give the Prospector an aggressively chaotic appearance.
localization.item_descprospector_paint_unity: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.
localization.item_descprospector_paint_workersweek_wh: Crisp white with blue accents, the Keystone livery celebrates the workers whose mining, refining, hauling, salvaging, and more have made the empire what it is today.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_alienweek_green_b: The Luminary livery gives the Prowler a glossy green base paint with brown highlights for a dazzlingly beautiful and complex design.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_alienweek_platinu: The Wanderer livery features crisscrossing purple and grey lines over a platinum foundation. Inspired by the sacred Xi'an gardens of R.aip?uang, famous for its trails that wander in surprising ways and encourage a focus on the journey instead of the destination.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_grey_grey_yellow_: Disguise the silhouette of the Prowler with the Deadlock Camo livery, featuring a grey camo pattern with yellow highlights.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_harmony: The Harmony livery is meant to showcase Humanity's peaceful relationship with aliens with a semi-pearlescent blue main coat marked with organic reflective red to suggest the coming together of disparate species and cultures. The Harmony livery has been designed and produced by the UEE's Diplomatic Corps and freely licensed to all spacecraft manufacturers. Now Esperia Prowler owners can celebrate the UEE's intentions of working toward a peaceful galaxy.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_iae2950_grey_blue: This custom Prowler livery was created to celebrate the 2950 IAE on microTech. It integrates black and electric blue accents to give the ship a cool new look.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_iae2950_grey_whit: Modify your Prowler with this white and grey camo livery specifically designed for the 2950 IAE event on microTech.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_icysilver_titaniu: Beautiful blues swirl together with the Elysian livery to bring a truly special look to the Prowler.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_ocellus_green_red: The Ocellus livery replicates the look of the Prowler during the Second Tevarin War. It features a bold red fuselage meant to draw attention and trick aggressors into shooting at the most heavily armored part of the ship.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_orange_gray_light: The Panthera livery brings bright orange and black highlights to the Prowler.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_orange_gray_orang: A special shimmering finish makes the Torchbearer livery either orange or red depending on the angle your viewing the Prowler.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_silver_steel_gunm: Slyly drift through darkened skies with the Darkrift livery, which tampers the luster of its metal finishes to make it less conspicuous.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_silver_titanium_g: Elevate the Prowler above the ordinary with the Silverado livery featuring striking silver with black and gold highlight.
localization.item_descprowler_paint_tan_brown_cream: The Hamada livery mixes tan and various shade of brown on the Prowler.
localization.item_descptv_paint_camo: ATC-F livery uses a non-reflective paint surface ideal for anyone looking to lower their profile in the wild. Perfect for military, sporting enthusiasts or naturalists.
localization.item_descptv_paint_cherry: Speed isn?t just about mechanics, it?s about perception. Your Greycat will look and feel faster without changing a thing. The Cherry livery topcoat system uses cutting-edge raw materials and composition coating technology to maintain its glossy finish.
localization.item_descptv_paint_double: One of the most popular liveries on the Greycat, Agate Gray is a two-toned paint scheme that brings the buggy?s interior colors as accents on the exterior, unifying the Greycat into a single cohesive aesthetic.
localization.item_descptv_paint_metal: Who says a buggy can?t be elegant? The Gunmetal livery is a medium gloss, two-component technology that maximizes gloss retention and durability.
localization.item_descptv_paint_stealth: The Tactical Stealth livery uses a near zero gloss paint that incorporates a catalyzed urethane process for unsurpassed durability making it highly resistant to UV rays, chemicals and chips.
localization.item_descptv_paint_willys: Rifle Green livery uses a premium two-component technology designed to endure harsher environments without fading or scratching.
localization.item_descpulse_paint_2956redfestival_red: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Rat livery. Outfit your Pulse with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a rat.
localization.item_descpulse_paint_black_gold_silver: Primarily black with sumptuous bronze highlights, the Dominion livery is a prestigious Pulse tint that displays a striking but understated elegance.
localization.item_descpulse_paint_grey_gold_camo: In honor of the soldiers who protect the Empire, Mirai crafted this limited-edition GCD-Army livery. The glints of gold against grey camo makes it a memorable choice for the Pulse.
localization.item_descpulse_paint_orange_blue_blue: Spotlight the incredible speed of the Pulse with Corona livery. Its dynamic stylings feature a two-tone blue with an angular orange across the front.
localization.item_descpulse_paint_red_red_red: The Crossfire livery is a rich red with black highlights, which includes lettering spelling Mirai across the bottom half.
localization.item_descpulse_paint_redfestival_red_gol: The Auspicious Red livery brings a bold red base paint and striking gold accents to the Pulse.
localization.item_descpulse_paint_silver_black_blue: Speed through the shadows with the Undertow livery and its subtle style mixing black and silver with blue highlights.
localization.item_descpulse_paint_silver_silver_silve: The Nightrider livery can easily blend into the blackness of space, but upon closer inspection reveals itself to be silver with lettering spelling Mirai across the bottom half.
localization.item_descpulse_paint_stellafortuna2955_g: Make luck your co-pilot. Boldly set your sights on the stars and adventure forth in style with the Fortuna livery. This Stella Fortuna themed paint scheme is primarily green with gray accents.
localization.item_descpulse_paint_white_pink_blue: Embody Sally the Star Kitten's racing spirit with this custom Mirai Pulse livery. Combining the bright pinks and pale blues of the beloved cartoon mascot, this livery's smiling decals bring a playfulness your competitors are sure to enjoy.
