localization.oso1_desc: This tidally locked planet features a lightside that is a churning sea of lava while its darkside is a cold, stark iron-rich landscape.
localization.oso2_desc: The planet has a lush biosphere and breathable atmosphere that would make it ideal for Human habitation if it weren't for the discovery of the Osonians. This multi-limbed, primitive creature is one of many unusual species found to inhabit the Fair Chance Act protected world.
localization.oso3_desc: This gas giant is believed to have been a rogue Jupiter that was pulled into orbit around Oso's star. It is slightly green and white in color due to silicate clouds.
localization.oso4_desc: A planet lacking both a core and an atmosphere. While initial scans showed its surface was rich in minerals, recent scans show those reserves much depleted causing speculation that miners have found their way past the UEE patrols in the system.
localization.oso5_desc: An ice giant with a highly lethal atmosphere of ammonia vapor.
localization.oso6_desc: A rocky dwarf planet completely lacking in resources.
localization.oso_desc: The most advanced primitive species ever discovered by the UEE lives in the Oso System and is a source of endless fascination for scientists. Because the native species is so advanced, the UEE has built Observation Base Chimera to monitor traffic in the system.  \n
localization.oso_jumppoint_castra_desc: This jump point connects Oso to the Castra system.
localization.oso_jumppoint_kallis_desc: This jump point connects Oso to the Kallis system which is protected by the Fair Chance Act.
localization.oso_jumppoint_pyro_desc: This jump point connects Oso to the unclaimed Pyro system.
localization.outlaw_laser_datapad_001_text: Florin we’ve been out here for days. You really think we can get this laser online again??? Have you seen how busted up this facility is?? Everything on the ground’s either sinking in the sand or got a huge hole in it.  And I don’t know about you, but I don’t have no degree in astrophysics or whatever you need to get this dish to work.\n\nDo us all a favor and tell Dent this ain’t happening.
localization.outlaw_laser_datapad_002_text:
To: Casey
From: Shik
Subject: RE: Have you seen Florin?

Okay. Thanks Casey.

-----
To: Shik
From: Casey
Subject: RE: Have you seen Florin?

Mate. Don’t be like that.

Tell you what, once we finish harvesting the materials for Dent, we’ll go for a drink together. My treat.

-----
To: Casey
From: Shik
Subject: RE: Have you seen Florin?

Oh okay. No I didn’t know that. Yeah you’re probably right. Never mind then.

-----
To: Shik
From: Casey
Subject: RE: Have you seen Florin?

Hey Shik

Remember what happened the last time you asked out someone in the gang? She tried to let you down gently and you got all weird about it and then you spent two weeks working that job together in Hurston and it was incredibly awkward. Or that’s how Roxie tells it at least.

Also, you do know that Florin’s sleeping with Angel, right?

C

-----
To: Casey
From: Shik
Subject: Have you seen Florin?

Hey Casey

Have you seen Florin around? I really need to talk to her. In person. There’s something I need to ask her.

Shik
localization.outlaw_laser_datapad_003_text:
To: Hamadi
From: Areon 
Subject: Re: Hold Hathor

Hold tight. Gonna see if my exploit can capture more comms. Don't let anyone run you off until we know exactly what’s going on. 

Areon 

-----
To: Areon 
From: Hamadi
Subject: Re: Hold Hathor

I think we'd have to coordinate stuff between a few of these old facilities.

Should we pull Karsen’s crew into this too?

- H 

-----
To: Hamadi
From: Areon 
Subject: Re: Hold Hathor

Not sure. But their chatter mentioned getting the laser up and running. That seem possible?

Areon

-----
To: Areon 
From: Hamadi
Subject: Re: Hold Hathor

We’re settled in, but this place is a shithole. What hell are we supposed to be looking for?

- H

-----
To: Hamadi
From: Areon
Subject: Hold Hathor

Hamadi - 

Get your crew over to that abandoned Hathor station on the double. Intercepted some comms talking about how there’s good creds to be made there. Let’s get in there before it gets too crowded.

Areon
localization.outlaw_laser_datapad_004_text:
To: Mac
From: Dyno
Subject: Re: Operation Free Fire

Classic Hathor... storing a vital component at a completely different location. Gramps always said the company was run by a bunch of imbeciles.

Let’s hope the other two PAFs have batteries that we can use too. If not, we’re shit outta luck. 

- Dyno

—---
To: Dyno
From: Mac
Subject: Re: Operation Free Fire

Hey, I found a battery.

Aligning the dish opened a storage room with one charging inside. It’s heavy as hell though. Getting it up to you ain’t gonna be easy. 

- Mac

—---
To: Mac
From: Dyno
Subject: Re: Operation Free Fire

Still short three batteries. We’ve searched the entire OLP twice now and haven’t found any more. Not even the charging stations they’d need to keep ‘em all juiced up.  

Have your crew keep their eyes peeled for them. Hathor must’ve stored them someplace special.  

- Dyno

—---
To: Dyno
From: Mac
Subject: Operation Free Fire

The instructions from your grandfather were dead on. Found everything we need here. Getting ready to align the first dish now. 

Any luck getting the laser powered up? 

- Mac
localization.outlaw_laser_datapad_005_text:
DW -

Need you to price check something for me. What’s the going rate for Saldynium?    

A source told us where we could find some but not sure it’s worth the effort. Just watched this worm absolutely pulverize one of my best fighters, and hearing there's stuff much worse out there. Don’t want to put my crew at further risk unless I know it’s worth it. 

- Mr. C
localization.outlaw_laser_datapad_006_text:
To: Ali, Buccio, Doyle, Toru
From: Mino
Subject: RE: quick question

Guys, can we stay focused maybe? Do you know how many credits we got riding here?

- Mino

-----
To: Ali, Doyle, Mino, Toru
From: Buccio
Subject: RE: quick question

Actually, because the gravity is so low up here, it would never reach the moon’s atmosphere…

- Buccio

-----
To: Ali, Buccio, Doyle, Mino,
From: Toru
Subject: RE: quick question

The freezing would happen instantly. There wouldn’t be enough time for it to disintegrate.

- Toru

-----
To: Buccio, Doyle, Mino, Toru
From: Ali
Subject: RE: quick question

No way that would happen, its mass is too small.

- Ali

-----
To: Ali, Buccio, Doyle, Mino,
From: Toru
Subject: RE: quick question

No. It would freeze when entering the atmosphere, becoming an incredibly tough shard of ice, and then hit the ground. So yes: it could kill someone.

- Toru

-----
To: Buccio, Doyle, Mino, Toru
From: Ali
Subject: RE: quick question

Wouldn't it would burn up when it enters the moon’s atmosphere and disintegrate?

- Ali

-----
To: Ali, Buccio, Mino, Toru 
From: Doyle
Subject: quick question

Do you guys think if I threw one of my bullets off the OLP it would gather enough speed and force to kill someone?

- Doyle
localization.outlaw_laser_datapad_007_text:
To: Aimee
From: Leo
Subject: RE: PAF Console Not Working

Never mind it’s working now.

-----
To: Leo
From: Aimee
Subject: RE: PAF Console Not Working

Leo, just out of curiosity, which way round are you putting them in? With the text facing up, or down?

Aimee

Leo

localization.outlawsweep_combatpay_0001: In addition to the standard contract payment, there will be a bonus issued for each combatant you successfully neutralize.
localization.outlawsweep_combatpay_0002: Unfortunately, we've been unable to determine the size of the force you'll be up against, but will issue you Hazard Pay for each hostile you manage to deal with successfully.
localization.outlawsweep_combatpay_0003: I've also been cleared to issue Hazard Pay that scales for each outlaw you take care of.
localization.outlawsweep_combatpay_0004: And to preemptively answer your question, yes, in addition to the normal flat fee there will be Hazard Pay issued for each hostile you clear from the site.
localization.outlawsweep_desc_0001:
Word has just arrived that a group associated with the notorious ~mission(Client) gang has been spotted at ~mission(Location). While their intentions remain uncertain, we can all agree that it is too dangerous to allow them to carry out whatever misdeeds they are hoping to accomplish. 

Crusader is forming a combat response team ASAP. Grab whatever gear you'll need and head over to ~mission(Location) on the double. ~mission(CombatPay)And please, try to be safe!

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K
localization.outlawsweep_desc_0002:
Outlaws identified as members of the ~mission(Client) have been seen infilitrating a ~mission(Location). We've been after these particular bad eggs for a while now, so as you can imagine ~mission(Contractor) is pretty eager to assemble a team to deal with them. ~mission(CombatPay)

If you're interested, grab whatever gear you'll need and get going. It'd be great if we could settle this whole thing as quickly and safely as possible.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K
localization.outlawsweep_desc_0003:
Armed members of a local criminal outfit, the ~mission(Client), were seen at ~mission(Location). We can only assume their intentions are hostile so a small team is being assembled to go and clear them out. ~mission(CombatPay) 

Now, since we don't want them to give us the slip, figured it would be wise to contact all operators in the area, regardless of skill or track record. If you're available — and I'm assuming you are — hurry up and grab your equipment. These ~mission(Client) are well overdue for their day of reckoning.


CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Gibbs
ID# 91G66BW0
localization.outlawsweep_desc_0004:
Moments ago, we received a tip that several members of the ~mission(Client) outlaw organization were reported at ~mission(Location). It's vital that we stop them before they can commit any more criminal acts.

To that end, we're assembling a squad of armed and trained operators to go in and secure the site. ~mission(CombatPay)Contractors are expected to provide their own transportation and weapons. I feel like shouldn't have to say that, but you'd be surprised how many so-called 'professionals' accept a contract thinking they can borrow some from us. Next thing you'll know they'll be asking us to squeeze the trigger for them too. 


CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Gibbs
ID# 91G66BW0

localization.outlawsweep_obj_long_03: Combat and eliminate hostiles to collect Hazard Pay.
localization.outpost_cleanup_desc: We've got an outpost on Daymar that is currently occupied by some rather unsavory characters. We need someone to... "clean up" there if you catch my drift.

localization.outpost_repair_desc_0001: Hey, we're having some power issues at one our outpost structures and could really use a qualified electrical technician to bring and install a replacement unit. ~mission(Timed)Thanks.
localization.outpost_repair_desc_0002: Not sure if it was the recent weather conditions or if it's simply normal wear and tear, but one of our buildings is having severe power issues. Looking to hire a tech to come assess the problem and perform any maintenance required. ~mission(Timed)You are expected to coordinate your own travel as well as bring any replacement parts needed.
localization.outpost_repair_desc_0003: A building at ~mission(Destination) requires maintenance due to power related issues and a technician is needed to execute the onsite repairs. Please make sure to bring any supplies or replacement parts needed with you, as we will not be able to provide any. ~mission(Timed)
localization.outpost_repair_desc_0004: Any experience with power conduits, outposts, or general electrical maintenance? If so, then you might be perfect to help us sort a problem we've been having at ~mission(Destination). Need a self-starter type to acquire any necessary replacement materials and then complete any and all repairs required. ~mission(Timed)Payment upon completion. You are expected to cover your own incidentals.
localization.outpost_repair_desc_0005: Okay, this is getting seriously frustrating. We've been trying to handle this electrical problem at ~mission(Destination) ourselves and nothing seems to fix it. Guess it's time to admit that the we may need outside help. We are hoping to find someone who can provide the replacement parts needed and help us figure this out once and for all. ~mission(Timed)
localization.outpost_repair_desc_0006: In search of a someone to bring and install a replacement battery at ~mission(Destination). ~mission(Timed)Prior experience with this sort of thing is a plus. Note that the moon where we are located may have different gravity conditions than you are accustomed to working in.
localization.outpost_repair_obj_long_01: Acquire replacement battery needed to repair the outpost.
localization.outpost_repair_obj_long_02: Go to the repair site at ~mission(Destination).
localization.outpost_repair_obj_long_03: Restore power to ~mission(Destination) with the replacement battery.
localization.outpost_repair_timed_0001: We are in a big hurry to get this sorted. Anything you could do to speed things along is appreciated.
localization.outpost_repair_timed_0002: This is a pretty urgent request as we can't work at full capacity until the problem is fixed.
localization.outpost_repair_timed_0003: The longer this problem goes unaddressed, the bigger of an issue it's becoming. Would be great to see this taken care of sooner than later.
localization.outpost_repair_timed_0004: We have a few pressing deadlines coming up, so we are looking at a pretty big headache if this isn't taken care of as soon as possible.
localization.outpost_repair_timed_0005: Now, we don't want you to rush or do sloppy work or anything, but if there is any way of speeding things along, that would help us out immensely.

localization.p_protectandresupply_desc:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, XenoThreat forces started to ambush Naval convoy ships transporting vital supplies while en route to Jericho station at the Pyro Gateway in the Stanton System. The Navy has requested CDF forces to help recover these supplies from the wreckage and safely deliver them to Jericho station. All available CDF volunteers are encouraged to provide support.

Please note that some of these supplies are highly volatile if not handled correctly. Use caution while transporting these materials:
* Zeta-Prolanide degrades over time until breaking down completely.
* AcryliPlex Composite becomes explosively unstable if damaged.
* Diluthermex releases a destructive energy pulse if exposed to quantum travel.
 
Additionally, while not as volatile, the supplies of DynaFlex lost during the attack are still urgently needed by the Navy to complete their repairs of the Javelin and should be a priority for recovery.    

Also, XenoThreat hostiles might still be in the area so be careful. CDF volunteers with combat experience are also urged to contribute by securing these areas from lingering XenoThreat forces.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

Attention, Naval forces have regrouped for a final assault on the XenoThreat outlaw pack that have been plaguing Stanton System. The Navy has officially requested for any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support in this final push to secure our system.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

localization.p_showdown_prexeno_desc:
Attention, Naval forces have regrouped for the final assault that XenoThreat have been planning. The Navy has officially requested any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support in this final push to secure our system. This will include volunteers outside of those who have participated in the Overdrive Initiative.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

If successful, this will complete this Overdrive Initiative series and you will receive temporary access to the F7A Hornets or a free upgrade if you currently own an F7C.

localization.prison_escapee_corpses_journal_001_body:
/**MOBICONNECT.RETRIEVALSYSTEM.FRP…DATAFOUND**/

Hey Duggy,

Know you’re going through with the "plan" tomorrow so I wanted to give you my lucky spoon. Left it under your pillow. This thing has seen me through a lot of shit. Hell, I was eating some soup with it the first time we met! 

And remember, it’s not yours. Totally expect you to return it to me once we meet up next month! 

First round of soup’s on you.

-Fil
localization.prison_escapee_corpses_journal_002_body:
/**MOBICONNECT.RETRIEVALSYSTEM.FRP…DATAFOUND**/

You had promised me that we would do this together. 
That we could do anything together. 

And now I’m alone. 

We could have just stayed. It would have been hard but at least you would still be here.

But you said this would be better and you lied. 

Now I just keep imagining your face when you fell, the sound when that branch pierced you.

I don’t know how to go on without you.
localization.prison_escapee_corpses_journal_003_body:
/**MOBICONNECT.RETRIEVALSYSTEM.FRP…DATAFOUND**/

I had to pay all my merits but Des came through! 
Made me memorize it -

Fan
Left
Drop
Jump
Right
Left
Jump x 3
Drop
Get the key
Stairs
localization.prison_escapee_corpses_journal_004_body:
/**MOBICONNECT.RETRIEVALSYSTEM.FRP…DATAFOUND**/

Trapped in a cage, diggin’ for rocks
Hope seems far, from behind these locks
Each day a grind, I’m wearing away
Serving my time, the light’s so far away

Got to break free
Can’t wait a moment more
Got to break freeeeee
Runnin’ fast, feet hit the floor

Got to break free
Freedom can’t ever die
Got to break freeeeee
Runnin’ fast, my chance to fly.

Then this next verse will be about how I start a new life once I get out.
localization.prison_escapee_corpses_journal_005_body:
/**MOBICONNECT.RETRIEVALSYSTEM.FRP…DATAFOUND**/

You have won a free all expense paid trip to Cassel!

This special offer expires in 24 SEH! Don’t miss your chance to travel in luxury!

You will receive 2 round-trip passes on Meridian Transit, a 3 night all-expense stay at  a Green Circle hotel. Also a day voucher that entitles you up to 300 credits to spend on delicious food, amazing cocktails, and exciting adventures.

To claim this special prize, comm FreeTripPrizeAmazingWin2045 right away and we will collect the information we need to transfer these incredible winnings to you.

This is a once in a lifetime opportunity! Don’t let this chance escape!

Best Travels,
Cawel Berborm
Marketing Manager
Dream Vacation Agency

localization.privatesecurity_repui_description: Contracted by various businesses and local authorities to protect their interests and stop criminal activity.
localization.protlife_blackbox_recover_desc_01: A vehicle claim has recently been filed by one of our clients and as the insurer, we at Olympus Principal need an investigator to check out ~mission(Location|Address), locate the black box and return it to ~mission(Destination) for analysis. \n\nNote that until we can determine the factors contributing to the craft's disappearance, extreme caution should be used in the area.
localization.protlife_blackbox_recover_desc_02: A vessel owned by one of our policy holders has been rendered inoperable and a contractor is needed to perform the investigation on behalf of Olympus Principal. To determine the specifics of what happened, the flight recorder needs to be recovered from ~mission(Location|Address) and delivered to ~mission(Destination). \n\nWhen approaching the incident site, please be on alert in case dangerous or hostile elements are still present.
localization.protlife_blackbox_recover_desc_03: Olympus Principal is seeking an investigator to locate the remains of recently lost vessel, extract its flight recorder from ~mission(Location|Address), and deliver the black box to ~mission(Destination). We can then review the data and properly process our client's claim of loss.\n\nAs we are currently unaware of all the pertinent details surrounding the vehicle's destruction, proceed to the incident site with caution.
localization.protlife_searchbody_cave_danger_0001: As we do not know what fate befell ~mission(TargetName|Last), we strongly encourage you to use all caution while exploring the site. There may be hostiles or unexpected hazards present.
localization.protlife_searchbody_cave_danger_0002: Please be aware that we cannot confirm nor deny the presence of hostiles or hazards at this site. All we know for certain is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) has not returned and we would hate for the same thing to happen to you. The important thing is that you use the utmost caution while exploring the site.
localization.protlife_searchbody_cave_desc_0001:
One of our long standing clients, ~mission(TargetName), was recently reported missing. Before we can determine the proper distribution of benefits, we need you to find confirmation of their current status. 

Our preliminary investigation team has learned that ~mission(TargetName|Last) had previously been conducting research at ~mission(Location|Address). It is our recommendation that you start your search there. ~mission(Location|CaveSize)

~mission(Contractor|Timed)~mission(Contractor|SearchBodyCaveDanger)
localization.protlife_searchbody_cave_desc_0002:
The family of ~mission(TargetName) has filed a benefits claim in response to security being unable to locate or contact them for over two weeks. Before we settle the matter, it is our hope that we can employ you to follow one last lead. 

It is our belief that ~mission(TargetName|Last) may have perished during a recreational visit to ~mission(Location|Address). We would like you to travel there and see if you can confirm what happened. ~mission(Location|CaveSize) 

~mission(Contractor|Timed)~mission(Contractor|SearchBodyCaveDanger)
localization.protlife_searchbody_cave_desc_0003:
We are seeking an investigator to locate and confirm the status of one, ~mission(TargetName), who was last reported to be heading to ~mission(Location|Address). ~mission(Location|CaveSize)

We cannot properly process their policy payout without this additional information. 

~mission(Contractor|Timed)~mission(Contractor|SearchBodyCaveDanger)
localization.protlife_searchbody_cave_desc_0004:
Olympus Principal is seeking the current location of our client, ~mission(TargetName), who has unfortunately been reported missing. We have recently been able to trace their movements to ~mission(Location|Address). ~mission(Location|CaveSize)

You are being contracted to conduct a thorough onsite investigation, so that we may hopefully find ~mission(TargetName|Last) and render assistance as needed.
  
~mission(Contractor|SearchBodyCaveDanger) ~mission(Contractor|Timed)
localization.protlife_timed_0001: Note that a certain amount urgency is warranted. The completion of this matter by the deadline would be appreciated.
localization.protlife_timed_0002: Note that this matter needs to be settled ASAP and before the set deadline expires.
localization.protlife_timesensitive_recover_desc_001:
A claim has been processed for a ~mission(Location) belonging to one of our policy holders after the vessel was recently rendered inoperable.

However, Olympus Principal has learned that there may still be valuable packages of zeta-prolanide onboard in a salvageable state. The successful salvage of these materials would go a long way in helping us recuperate our expenses, and as such, we are seeking a contractor to perform the retrieval operation on our behalf.

As you may know, zeta-prolanide is extremely volatile. If it is not kept in a powered stabilizer, it will grow dangerously unstable over time. We believe that salvage from ~mission(Location|Address) should still be stable for a little while longer, but be mindful as soon as they are removed you will only have a limited amount of time to deliver them to ~mission(Destination|Address). 

When approaching the incident site, please be on alert in case dangerous or hostile elements are still present.
localization.protlife_timesensitive_recover_desc_002:
Olympus Principal is seeking a salvage team to remove valuable packages of zeta-prolanide from a recently lost ~mission(Location). The hope is that the recovery of these materials will be able to offset any expenditures related to our client's claim of loss.

As you may know, if zeta-prolanide is not kept in a powered stabilizer it becomes extremely volatile over time. This will make any salvage attempt more complicated. 

Once the containers are removed from ~mission(Location|Address) you will only have a limited amount of time to deliver them to ~mission(Destination|Address) before they become dangerously unstable. 

There is a chance that word of this valuable salvage has gotten out to other interested parties and it is recommended that you proceed with caution in case there are hostiles present.
localization.protlife_timesensitive_recover_desc_003:
An inoperable vehicle claim has recently been filed by one of our clients for a ~mission(Location). The vessel was lost while transporting valuable packages of zeta-prolanide. It is our belief that those containers are still intact, and as the current property owner, Olympus Principal is eager to attempt to salvage them.

We are seeking professionals to handle this operation on our behalf owing to the dangerous nature of transporting zeta-prolanide once it is removed from a powered stabilizer. After you collect the containers from ~mission(Location|Address) you will only have a limited amount of time to deliver them to ~mission(Destination|Address) before they become dangerously unstable and lose all value to us. Please be very mindful of these time constraints.

Note that other interested parties (possibly hostile) may have gotten word of the valuables onboard the wreckage, and extreme caution should be used in the area.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_aa: Hey, this is Riegert with BlacJac. Glad to see you're back. Anyway, you know the deal. I sent the mission info, so you should have everything you need.
It's Riegert with BlacJac. Glad to see you're back. I've sent you all the details to knock out this contract. I'll keep you posted on any updates.
Hey, it's Lt. Riegert with BlacJac Security, just calling to follow up on the contract you accepted. I'm sending you all the mission data. You've worked with us before, so you know the deal.
BlacJac Security calling. This is Lt. Riegert. I'll be running this mission. Sending you the mission details now so you should be good to go. Good luck.
This is Lt. Riegert with BlacJac. I'll be your contact for this op. You should have everything you need on your mobi. Good luck out there.

Hey, this is Lt. Riegert calling from BlacJac Security about the contract you just accepted. Just wanted to reach out and say that I'll be running the op on this side. You should have everything you need in your mobi, so good luck.
This is BlacJac Security. I'll be your handler on this side. I've sent all the mission details to your mobi, so get to it.
My name's Riegert and I'll be your rep with BlacJac for this contract. Your mobi should be all loaded up with the mission details, so get out there and knock this out.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_dr: Hey, this is BlacJac Security calling. I?m Lieutenant Riegert, I'm handling this op. You should have already received the mission parameters, but here's a high-level. An automated production facility's gonna be kicking out contraband for a limited time. We need operators to get down there and destroy whatever's being produced. There are a lot of credits on the line here so prep for a fight.

This is Lieutenant Riegert with BlacJac Security. I've sent you details for the mission but here's the deal, a bunch of illegal contraband is going to start being produced at a facility, we need you to secure the site and destroy anything created. Make sure you're armed up as there'll probably be hostile elements there.

Hey, my name's Riegert, I'm with BlacJac Security. Your mobi should have the details on the mission you accepted, but here's a quick rundown. You need to head to an automated production facility and destroy any illegal contraband you find on site. Expect heavy combat. Good luck.

This is Lt. Riegert with BlacJac Security. I passed on the mission details to your mobi, but here's the gist, we got a tip that a facility's gonna start kicking out packages of contraband. We need you to head down there and seize as many of these packages as you can then deliver them to one of our security kiosks. I'd expect the AO to be pretty hot, so make sure you're tooled up.

BlacJac Security calling. This is Lt. Riegert and I'll be your contact on this op. Long story short, there's an automated facility that's going to be producing contraband for a limited time. We need you to get down there, secure whatever packages you can, and deliver them to a BlacJac kiosk. We'll take it from there. Good luck.

Hey. This is Riegert with BlacJac Security following up on the contract you just accepted. I sent the details, but in case you don't feel like reading, here's the deal. Production facility is going to be kicking out some illegal contraband for a limited time. I need you to get down there and seize as many packages as you can then take them to a BlacJac kiosk. Odds are, this is going to be brawl, so make sure you're armed up.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_announce_dropoff_aa: Riegert here. You're gonna need to take any confiscated contraband to a BlacJac Security kiosk. We'll take care of it from there. I've flagged your reg so you should clear any security stops without getting pinched for trafficking illegal goods. You're welcome.

This is Riegert with BlacJac. Remember to take any seized contraband to an authorized BlacJac kiosk for transfer. I've notified our people that you're on mission so you won't get tagged for trafficking illegal cargo while in transit.
This is Riegert calling. Just a reminder that any contraband needs to be dropped off at an authorized kiosk. Not just any kiosk. A BlacJac one. We'll cash you out when you make the drop.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_expired_mission_dru: Riegert here. Looks like the facility's stopped kicking out packages. Have a look and see if there's any remaining contraband that needs to be destroyed. But otherwise, you should be good.
This is Riegert with BlacJac. Local intel from the site says that the facility's stopped producing contraband. Be sure to destroy any packages that are still on the scene.
This is BlacJac calling. Word is that the production facility has stopped producing contraband. Do a sweep and see if there's any packages that need to be destroyed.
What's up, this is Riegert. Got a tip that the facility's finished its production run, so grab what you can and get it to the security kiosk for disposal.
Hey, Riegert here. Contact of mine said that the factory's shut down, so there won't be any more packages coming out of there. I'd take whatever you got and drop it off at the BlacJac kiosk.
This is Riegert with BlacJac, looks like that production facility has finished its run of contraband. Take what you got to the security kiosk and I can forward along your creds.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally: This is Riegert with BlacJac. We?re cutting you loose. You're just not up to snuff for what we need to get done.
Hey. Riegert here. Just wanted to call and say that we're cancelling our contract with you. Sorry.
Hey, this is BlacJac Security. You haven't been delivering the kind of quality that we expect from our operators, so I'm gonna have to cancel this contract.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badpe: This is BlacJac Security. We're gonna have to cut you loose. Maybe next time.
Hey. It's Riegert at BlacJac. Due to poor field performance, I gotta terminate your contract with the company.
This is Riegert. I hate to do this, but I have to cancel our contract with you. You just haven't been operating at the level we need our contractors to perform at. Sorry.
Riegert here with BlacJac. I'm pulling the job from you. You just aren't cutting it, performance-wise.
This is Riegert over at BlacJac. Sorry, but I'm gonna have to cut you loose. You're just not delivering at the level we expect.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_break: You there? It's Riegert with BlacJac. Just found out you pulled a CrimeStat. I know thing's get messy out there in the black, but we can't have wanted criminals working contracts with us, so I gotta cut you loose.

This is Riegert with BlacJac. You can't be going around committing crimes while you're working for us. Do you have any idea how terrible that looks? I gotta cut you from your contract until you sort this out.
This is BlacJac Security. We're gonna need to pull your current contract from you. Our contractors can't have active CrimeStats, so my hands are tied.
Riegert here with BlacJac. I just learned you got pinged with a CrimeStat. I can't have an active operator that's also a wanted criminal, so I'm pulling your contract. Get it sorted and we can talk.

Riegert from BlacJac calling. I don't know what the hell you think you're doing, but you can't be committing crimes while working for us. Go and sort this out and maybe we'll bring you back for another job.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_illeg: Hey, this is Riegert with BlacJac. What the hell are you doing? You can't offload that shit there. We hired you to bring the contraband to us, not put it back in the market.

This is BlacJac. Word is you just sold a bunch of seized contraband to a black market dealer. That was not part of the arrangement and now we gotta clean up your mess. You're off this contract. Effective immediately.
Yeah, this is Riegert from BlacJac. Have you lost your mind? You were supposed to transfer that contraband to one of our sites, not some rando scumbag. I'm cutting you out of the op.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_notpl: Hey, it's Riegert with BlacJac. Some idiot in charge screwed up some of the details of the mission you're on. Looks like we're gonna have to cancel the whole thing. Sorry for the screwup.
This is BlacJac Security. Due to some bullshit, we're gonna have to pull this job from you. Don't worry, it's not because of anything you did. Anyway, thanks and sorry.
This is Riegert over at BlacJac. Got some bad news for you. We're gonna have to pull your contract. It's not your fault. I'm told it's some kind of administrative error on our side. Sorry.

Hey, this is Riegert with BlacJac. I hate to do this, but I'm gonna have to pull your contract. It's not because of anything you did. Some crossed wires on our side. Or so I'm told. Anyway, sorry to jerk you around like that.
This is Riegert at BlacJac. There's been a problem with your current contract and we're gonna have to cancel it. You didn't do anything wrong, so we'll see you on the next one. Sorry for the trouble.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_inform_mission_stat: Riegert here. Just checking in, you're tracking really well on the contract. If we close this out quick enough, I can make happy hour, so keep it up.
Hey, it's Riegert over at BlacJac. Helluva job on the mission so far. Still got a bit to go, so don't get too cocky. There are plenty of chances for things to go to hell.
What's up, it's Riegert. I'm bored as hell over here, so I figured I'd check in. You seem to be doing good, so yeah? not much to discuss I guess. Keep it up.
This is Riegert with BlacJac. You're making good progress on the contract. Just wanted to give a shout and tell you to keep it up.
Hey, Riegert calling. Just checking in. Looking over your progress and we seem to be on track. So yeah, not really much to comment on. Just keep doing what you're doing.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_resp: What's up. It's Riegert with BlacJac. Heard you got tuned up a bit. Anyway, mission's still a go, so get back out there.
This is Riegert calling from BlacJac. Glad to hear you're back on your feet. Let's get back out there and finish this contract off. Sound good?
It's BlacJac calling. Welcome back to the land of the living. Once you finish getting patched up, let's get back out there. We still got a job to do.
Hey. It's Riegert over at BlacJac. Whenever you feel good enough to get back out there, we still got a job to do.
Hey, it's Riegert calling from BlacJac. That was a close one, huh? Anyway, once you're up for it, I need you to get back out there and finish the contract.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_dropoff_aal: This is BlacJac. Just heard you made a drop at the security kiosk. Great job. Should be worth a nice chunk of creds.
Hey, this is Riegert. Just got word of your drop. Shame it's slated for the incinerator. Anyway, sent your payment.
Riegert here. Saw you made a drop at the kiosk. Approving the payment now.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_aal: Riegert here. Did a good job on that mission. I'm completing your contract and sending your payment. Talk to you next time.
Hey, it's BlacJac Security. Congrats on completing that contract. Higher-ups over here are pretty pleased, so I'm sending along the credits.
It's Riegert over at BlacJac. Everything seems to be in order, so I'm sending over your payment. Great job on this contract.
What's going on. It's Riegert. Saw that you just closed out your contract. Great work. I'll see you get your creds. Thanks again.
BlacJac Security calling. Everything looks really solid on this last contract, so I think we're all good. I'll push your invoice through accounting and get you paid. Thanks for the hustle.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_dru: This is Riegert with BlacJac. Looks like all the contraband's been destroyed. Great job.
Hey. BlacJac Security calling. It's been confirmed that all the illegal packages have been destroyed. Thanks for your help.
Hey, it's Riegert. All the contraband's been destroyed. Looks like the situation's been resolved for now. Thanks.
localization.pu_acsecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_ab: Hey, BlacJac calling. What the hell are you doing? Get back on mission.
Hey, it's Riegert. Looks like you're diverting from the mission parameters. I'm gonna need you to get back on track.
This is BlacJac Security. I'm gonna need you to get back on mission.
This is Riegert with BlacJac, what are you doing? You know you're supposed to complete the contract in order to get paid, right? Do the job we hired you for.
Hey, it's BlacJac. Looks like you're breaking from the appropriate mission protocol. I'm gonna need you to get focused and get back on track, okay? Don't make me call you again.
This is Riegert with BlacJac. I'm not going to tell you again to get back on mission. Do it. Now.
Hey, this is Riegert again. I need you to get back on mission. Last chance.
All right, listen up. You need to finish the job we hired you to do. I'm not going to say it again.
This is your final warning. Get back on task and finish the mission as described. I'm running out of patience.
Hey. Stop screwing around and finish the job. This is your last chance.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_busy_ig_001_imalittle,p: I'm a little busy at the moment.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_busy_ig_002_itsnota,p: It's not a great time to talk.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_busy_ig_003_sorryikinda,p: Sorry, I kinda have to focus here.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_calmdown_ig_001_takeabreath: Take a breath and calm down.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_calmdown_ig_002_thinkfora,p: Think for a second. You don't want to do this.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_denyhelp_ig_003_youdhaveto,: You'd have to ask someone else.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_001_you: You should go check the cargo terminal.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_002_car: Cargo terminal should sort you out.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_directterm_cargo_ig_003_ify: If you need help with cargo, I'd suggest trying the terminal.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_001_a: All vehicle-related issues are handled by the terminal.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_002_i: If you need a vehicle, you should check out the ASOP terminal.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_directterm_vehicle_ig_003_s: Sorry, I can't help you. Have a look at the vehicle terminal.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_offerhelp_ig_002_somethingi: Something I can help you with?
localization.pu_admin1_sk_offerhelp_ig_003_whatcani,p: What can I do for you?
localization.pu_admin1_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_002_t: The funny thing is it looks a lot more boring than it is.
localization.pu_admin1_sk_randomworkcomments_ig_003_m: Might not look like much, but we've had some pretty interesting breakthroughs here. You might be hearing about them someday real soon...

I never would've thought anyone from the UEE would've stood with us like this. Thank you. I hope you find peace where you seek it. Take care.
localization.pu_amartel_civ_m_pmh_tsgphase7vanduuldat: Hey, it's Captain Martel again.  I've never seen someone take down one of those Maulers. Not outside of the Navy at least. What you're looking at there is one of their data stores. We've been trying to get a better sense of their numbers in Nyx and those can help. If you can pull the rest of the data, it'll give the Alliance a serious advantage.
localization.pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgdoyourpart_gp: Got a bit of spare time? Looking to make some credits? ArcCorp has the job for you. Thanks to recent government incentive programs, ArcCorp needs all available pilots for the urgent delivery of resources. Do you have what it takes? Yes, you do.
localization.pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsggenericmissio: Hey, this is El. You know, from ArcCorp. Saw that you canceled the contract. What the hell? Next time only take a contract you plan on doing, okay?
Hey, did you just quit the job? Do you have any idea how much extra work you just made for me? Whatever, I've wasted enough time dealing with you.
Hey, what happened? I thought you were gonna do that contract? You know what, it doesn't matter, I still need to find someone else to do the work. Enjoy your time off, I guess.
Ah, dang it. That's not good. I was really counting on this contract getting done. Guess, I'm working late tonight after all… again.
Oh wow. Wish that had gone differently. Just what I needed. [ Heavy Sigh ] I better get started on filling in the paperwork.
Wow. Wasn't expecting things to get botched like that. I'm gonna have to call in some overtime and try to salvage this mess. Oh well, not your fault you're not good at your job, right?
localization.pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsggivereward_gp: Hey, it's El. Guess what? ArcCorp's been so impressed with your hustle out there that they're sending you a little something as thanks. Pretty nice, right? Almost makes me wish I was a contractor… Anyway, enjoy and keep up the good work.

Hi, you ready for some good news? ArcCorp decided to send you a gift for helping them gather so many resources. Guess it's supposed to inspire dynamic motivational synergy, so that's uh… nice I guess. All right. Congrats and I'll see you on the next job.
localization.pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissionaccept: So, despite everything we've been doing, it's just not enough. But I think this contract could turn things around for ArcCorp. Just try your best, and whatever you do, get it done, okay? No matter what. We need this.

Hey, it's El again. I'm gonna level with you. Things aren't going great for ArcCorp in terms of getting the resources we need and this contract could change all that. So basically, lots of pressure riding on this one. Good luck!

Hey, wanted to chat about this contract real quick. Now, sure, all contracts are important. But this one is really, really important. ArcCorp needs to make up for lost ground and you doing this would make a big difference. Okay, pep talk over. Focus and get it done!
Hi. This is your first job with ArcCorp, right? Oh, wait. Sorry, that's the other contractor. I know you. You've done this before, so just keep it up. All right, later.
Okay! Back for another job. That's great. ArcCorp appreciates you and all that stuff. Just try to get it done ASAP, okay? Great. Thanks.
All right, look who's back for another contract. Guess you love working for ArcCorp. Well, you know the drill by now, so I'll just leave you to take care of everything. Thanks.
Hi, El Tieno with ArcCorp. Was just comming you to say… Sorry, totally blanked on why I comm'd. Too many things going on. Anyway, if I remember I'll comm you back. Sorry. Good luck with the contract.

Hey! It's ArcCorp's favorite contractor. Not to get ahead of ourselves, but as soon as you finish this contract, I've got like two more I could use you on. So, probably shouldn't be wasting time, right? We'll talk later.

No, I don't care why it went missing, just fix it… [Frustrated sigh] Sorry about that. Where were we? Oh, right! New contract. Good luck and you know, try to make sure everything gets where it's supposed to go.
Hey, it's El. Thanks for handling another job. I'm sure you'll do great.  ArcCorp needs all the competant people we can get right n- What? Yeah, I'm hanging up-

Great! You're going to help us out with getting resources. The market's going crazy thanks to Addision's big research push and ArcCorp's trying… hold on for one sec… Yeah? Just tell them to wait… Sorry, it's a bit crazy here today. Anyway! You're gonna be great. Oh, and I'm El Tieno by the way. Okay. Bye.
localization.pu_arep_tieno_arc_f_pmh_rsgmissioncomple: Hey, El here with an update. Thanks to you that cargo made it to ArcCorp safely. Thanks for the hard work.
Hey, looks like all that cargo was safely delivered to us. Wouldn't have made it without you, so thanks. Hopefully we can work together again soon.
Okay, wanted to let you know that the cargo made it safely to us. Wish I had a few more contractors like you. Hell, even just one more. Anyway, see you on the next job.
Perfect! Love to see a succesful delivery. You did such a good job you should probably take another contract as soon as possible, right? Talk soon!
Hey, El here. Seeing that you were able to complete the delivery. Thanks! And if you could do another, that'd be even better. All right, gotta go.
All right! ArcCorp appreciates you completing your delivery and- Oh crap. Sorry! I have to take this other comm.
Great! You brought the stuff. Nice to see someone actually doing their job for a change. Okay, I better get back to it. Have a good one.
Yes! Perfect timing on the delivery. Really, really needed this. ArcCorp thanks you. See you next time.
localization.pu_asdmerccaptain_civ_m_bna_audiolog1_gp: All teams. You should have all the specs on the op, but we're going to get in, do what needs to be done and get out. I want at least one, ideally two, shadowing the egghead at all times. Client's said the place has been decommisioned for years, but that don't mean it's empty, so make sure you don't take any chances. Stay focused and check those corners.
localization.pu_asdmerccaptain_civ_m_bna_audiolog2_gp: All teams. Fall back to my postion immediately. We've encountered unexpected resistance and need to regroup. Make your way here and seal any doors behind you. We need to contain this situation before it gets completely out of hand.
localization.pu_asdmerccaptain_civ_m_bna_audiolog3_gp: All surviving team members. You are ordered to exfil. Authorization Delta Delta Zebra. Forget the target and get out. I'm not having our team wiped out by radiation bursts, feral kopion, and god knows what else. It's not what any of you signed up for and it's not worth the credits. I'll see you all at the rendezvous.
localization.pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_2ndchanc: So, I've been thinking over the way we ended things and well, maybe I was a bit too harsh. I mean, we all make mistakes right? Look at me, I wound up buying the last Ellroy Cass album. Talk about unforgiveable. Anyway, if you come by, maybe we can try again.

Okay, I know we didn't exactly end things on the best note, but I figured it's worth giving us another try. Second time's the charm, right? Oh wait, it's third time's the charm, isn't it? Guess we get to look forward to doing this at least once more. But first things first. Come pay me a visit if you're interested.
Hey, listen, if you think you might be ready to really give it a go this time - like really, really try - then I might be willing to give you another shot. When you're ready, come and see me.
localization.pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_001_h: Hello. It's me. Tessa. Junior Cartographer. Stop by when you can. I have something for you.
localization.pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_002_h: Hi, it's Tessa. I was hoping you might have a second to swing by. Have something you might be interested in.
localization.pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_003_h: Hey there. Tessa here. Hope I'm not catching you at a bad time. Something popped up and I thought of you. Be great if you could come by.
localization.pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_004_h: Hey, it's Tessa. Have something I could use you for. Well, use is a bad word. Anyway, if you're free, stop by.
localization.pu_banister_mg_commmsg_joboffer_ig_005_h: Hey there. Guess who. Came across something that I think you'll be interested in. Come by when you can.
localization.pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_fa: Listen, I didn't want it to come to this, but there's a warrant on you for that property you stole. Sorry.
Well, you didn't return the property, and now we had to report it stolen. I think that technically makes you a thief, so you might want to take care of that.
localization.pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_ig: Hey, eh, you still have some property of mine. I'm gonna need you to return it.
Looks like you have still have some property of mine. Be great if you can bring it back.
localization.pu_banister_mg_commmsg_returnproperty_la: Hey, if you don't return the ICC's property, I'm gonna have to report you.
Just a word of warning. The ICC is going to report you if you don't return their property.
localization.pu_banister_mg_commmsg_underattack_ig_00: Hey. Eh, Long story short, I'm being attacked right now, and I really need some help. Please, hurry. And bring some weapons. A lot of weapons.
Mayday. This is Tessa Banister. I am under attack. Assistance is needed. Mayday. S.O.S. Emergency. Also, it's realy weird finally making one of these.
Hey. Eh, Hope you're not busy, because there's a bunch of ships shooting at me right now and it would great if you could stop them. Thanks! Hurry!
localization.pu_banister_mg_encouragedecision_ig_001_: Seems like a good fit for you. What do you think?
localization.pu_banister_mg_encouragedecision_ig_002_: You think it's something you want to do?
localization.pu_banister_mg_encouragedecision_ig_003_: If you don't want the job, you totally don't have to do it.
localization.pu_banister_mg_encouragedecision_ig_005_: So, you think you'll do it?
localization.pu_banister_mg_endrelationship_ig_001_ih: I hate to say it, but I don't think this is going to work.
localization.pu_banister_mg_endrelationship_ig_002_so: So as hard as this is, I think it might be for the best if we just called it quits.
localization.pu_banister_mg_endrelationship_ig_003_lo: Look, I tried to make this work, I really did, but sometimes you just have to accept that some things are a lost cause.
localization.pu_banister_mg_farewell_good_ig_001_alri: All right. Talk to you soon.
localization.pu_banister_mg_farewell_good_ig_004_hope: Hopefully I'll see you again soon.
localization.pu_banister_mg_friendlyfire_callsecurity: Oh, you bastard. The authorities are going to hear about this.
localization.pu_banister_mg_friendlyfire_ig_002_youre: You're not supposed to shoot that!
localization.pu_banister_mg_genericchatter_ig_001_you: You know what's strange? I had a fly in here the other day. No idea how it got in or where it came from. Maybe it was in one my foodpacks? Drove me nuts till I chased it into an airlock.
localization.pu_banister_mg_genericchatter_ig_002_ike: I keep running into these people who think stellar cartography is dull. Can you believe it? Cartography! I mean, if you think precisely scanning star systems and charting every single astronomical feature is dull, then I don't even know what to say to you.
localization.pu_banister_mg_genericchatter_ig_003_her: Here's something you may find interesting - my surname, Banister, came from the fact that my ancestors like forty or so generations back were master stair craftsmen. All the wealthiest people couldn't get enough of their stairs. My family crest actually looks like one of those 'in case of emergency' signs.
localization.pu_banister_mg_genericchatter_ig_004_let: Let me bounce something off you. I'm debating going to either Cassel or to Green for my vacation and you know what, nevermind. I just decided. Tangaroa it is.
localization.pu_banister_mg_genericchatter_ig_005_her: Here's a quick tidbit for you. Never eat toast with the gravity turned off. I have never seen so many crumbs in my life. Huge mistake.
localization.pu_banister_mg_greeting_1stx_ig_001_tess: Tessa to random ship. Come in random ship.
localization.pu_banister_mg_greeting_bad_ig_002_heylo: Hey, look who it is... you...
localization.pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_bad_ig_00: Well, since you're here, I guess you'll have to do.
Oh, it's you. I guess that's fine. It doesn't pay to be to choosy at times like this.
Hey, I'm in a bit of a bind here, so I'm hoping you can help.
Hey listen. There's something I need you do.
Hey, I'm running low on options, so maybe you can help. Any port in a storm, right?
localization.pu_banister_mg_greeting_beacon_good_ig_0: Yes! I am so happy to see you.
Perfect. Just the pilot I was hoping to see.
Finally! I was hoping you'd show.
localization.pu_banister_mg_greeting_goaway_ig_001_li: Listen, I thought I made myself clear, but I'd appreciate it if you didn't come around here anymore. It's just not working out.
localization.pu_banister_mg_greeting_goaway_ig_002_il: I'll be honest, I'm not sure what you think you're doing here. I definitely can't trust you to help, and if I'm being upfront with you, I really don't want to chat with someone I can't trust. It'd be better if you just go.
localization.pu_banister_mg_greeting_goaway_ig_003_lo: Look, I'm not saying it's going to be this way forever, but right now I think it'd be better for both of us if you stopped coming here. You go do your stuff. I'll do mine. And if anything changes, I'll let you know.
localization.pu_banister_mg_greeting_good_ig_004_woah: Woah. A repeat visit. I should probably be less impressed by that shouldn't I?
localization.pu_banister_mg_greeting_good_ig_005_nice: Nice to see a familiar face around.
localization.pu_banister_mg_greeting_good_ig_009_hope: Hope everything's been going all right out there.
localization.pu_banister_mg_intro_1stx_ig_001_hiwelco: Hi! Welcome to the neighborhood. 2nd Class Junior Cartographer Tessa Banister reporting in. I'm the eyes behind all the ICC scan probes in the\narea. What these little guys see, I see. Which, yes, means I can totally see you. Right. Now... <pause> Anyway, there was actually a reason to why I\ncomm'd. I'm sorta not allowed to leave my post, important jump point scanning and all, so I was hoping you might be able to help me with something.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_fail_i: Even though you weren't able to save that ship from before, it was pretty nice of you to try.
I heard what happened with that last distress call. Messed up stuff.
It was too bad about that ship you tried to help. I guess sometimes our best just isn't good enough.
I was sorry to hear about that last ship. Really sucks. At least you're okay.
Wanted to let you know that I appreciate you risking your life to help those people, even if it ended the way it did.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_failst: Another failed rescue, huh? You haven't crossed a shaman or something, have you? Not that I believe in curses, but in the face of overwhelming evidence it might not hurt to re-evaluate that stance.
We keep trying to help these people in these distress beacons, but what good is it when these outlaws are getting more and more ruthless. Maybe we have to accept that it's a lost cause.
How many is it that we've lost now? After that last distress beacon, I'm starting to wonder why we even try.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_failtu: Really a shame that about that last distress beacon, but you know, you can't win them all. Still sad though.
Listen, I know we lost that last pilot, but you can't focus on that. You've helped a lot of people out there.
On that last distress beacon, don't blame yourself for what happened. You were just trying to help.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_ignore: I was a little surprised you decided not to help that last pilot. Guess I was silly for thinking you were the kind of person who cared about people in trouble.
It was too bad you weren't able to make it to that last distress beacon in time. I'm thinking about sending the pilot's family a fruit basket. A nice one though, one that isn't all melon.

Oh, you remember that last distress beacon? The one you didn't check out? Yeah, so I've been trying to find out what happened to them, but it seems we might have been the last people to have been in contact with them. I guess we were their last hope.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_beacon_succes: It was nice of you to help that ship out.
Heard you got hit by some trouble out there. Glad you scraped through.
With that ship in trouble... I mean, space is dangerous, but it's good to know there's people like you out there too.
Appreciate that you put yourself on the line to help that ship out. I don't know if there's a lot of people who would have done that.
I saw that you saved that ship. Kind of amazing that you can change someone's whole life like that.
How many ships have you rescued at this point? Got to be some kind of record. You're like a one person Advocacy force.
I'm kinda blown away by the number of people you've helped out there. It's like you're some kind of insurance fairy, saving hulls before premiums can go up.
At the risk of giving you a big ego, it's pretty impressive how many ships you've helped rescue. Good job.
Way to actually rescue someone! I was starting to think they may be better off if you didn't answer the distress beacons. I'm glad to see I was wrong.
Congrats on that last successful rescue! That must feel pretty good after that string of bad luck you had.

Wanted to say nicely done on that last rescue. You heard someone needed help, you went and tried to help them, and in a surprise turn of events it actually worked. Hopefully this is the start of a trend.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_canceled_ig_0: Guess you weren't able to finish that last job. Bit embarrassing, when you think about it. Saying you're going to do something, then changing your mind.
I'm surprised you canceled on that last job. Must be that modern work ethic my nan was always complaining about.
Saw that you canceled the last job. That's too bad. I'm guessing you have your reasons but still... oh well.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_generic_fail_: Oh It was too bad to hear that last job didn't work out. I feel sort of responsible since I was the one who set you up with it. Oh well, guess these things happen.
Seems like things didn't go that smoothly on the last job. Live and learn as nan used to say. She also used to loved eating citrus. Always had an orange or a pomelo on her. I miss her a lot.
Looks like you didn't have a lot of luck on that last job. You'll get 'em next time.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_generic_succe: I heard that the last job went well.
I was very glad to hear that the last gig worked out all right.
Congrats on pulling off that last job. I'm sure that felt satisfying.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_fail_ig: No luck on that last probe, huh? Eh...I guess we'll just have to make do without for now.
It's too bad you're weren't able to deploy that last probe. It would have come in handy.
I didn't think deploying a probe would be that hard, but I guess it's just one of those things that depends on who's doing it.
Looks like you ran into some trouble placing that probe. I will admit, I'm a bit disappointed. I was really hoping to see the data it would've provided.
Shame that we couldn't get that last probe deployed. The ICC really counts on those scans.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_failstr: So, my boss has started asking me about where all the probes I've requisitioned keep ending up. I think I'm good for now, but we can't really afford to lose any more.
Lost another probe, huh? I guess what they say is true. More probes, more problems.
You're really not having any luck with these probes. Like none. It's almost impressive.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_probe_success: Quick update for you, that probe you deployed has been working out great so far.
In case you're interested, we've been pulling a ton of really useful data from the last probe you set up, so thanks again for your help on that.
You should see some of the scans coming in from the last probe you deployed. I mean, it would probably just look like a jumble of numbers to you, but take it from me, it's very exciting.
Wanted to let you know that we've gotten some really interesting data from the last probe, so thanks again for deploying it.
I've been spending a lot of my shift pouring over scans from that last probe. There's some really intriguing stuff coming through.
Those last few probes you helped me with, we've been getting some really fanastic data. Who knows, maybe at this rate I'll be a first class junior cartographer soon!
The more of those probes you deploy for us, the clearer picture we're getting of the system. It's been a huge help.
You're turning into quite the probe expert, aren't you.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_underattack_f: Decided to come back and see if I was still alive? Well, despite a certain someone, I luckily am.

I've been thinking about how that last attack went down and I have to say, it might be worth spending a few more hours training in a flight sim. You know, so you don't let down the next person who relies on you.
Just thought I'd tell you that I forgive you for what happened during the attack. You tried, and that's what matters.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_underattack_s: I just wanted to say again how much I appreciate your help with those outlaws. I don't what I would have done if you hadn't shown up when you did.
Thanks again for the help with that attack. I'm still a bit shaken up. I keep jumping at the smallest thing. There was a commercial for popcorn on last night and I nearly had a heart attack.
I keep thinking about the attack, imagining how many different ways it could have gone wrong... Kind of amazing how many things had to go right for both of us to get through that alive.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_fail_i: Guess you were too busy to check out that unknown reading for me. That's fine. Could have been a huge discovery and we'll never know, but I understand.
You know that thing I wanted you to scan for me? The one you didn't do? Well turns out someone else did. Their name's going to be in the Galactapedia now. Bet that feels nice for them, huh?
Didn't end up doing that scan, huh? That's too bad. Would have been interesting to see what was actually out there.
localization.pu_banister_mg_lastmission_unkown_succes: Thanks for looking into that for me. Really helpful.
Appreciate you looking into that scan for me. Between me and you I had been hoping we might discover a new lifeform, like a sentient rock or something, but what you found was pretty neat too.
Thanks again for checking into that unknown reading.
I gotta say, for just being someone who flew by one day, you've proven pretty useful so far.
Keep helping me out like that, and I just might make you an honorary Junior Cartographer.
localization.pu_banister_mg_midmission_probe_complete: Oh great! You placed the probe! Let me just try to sync with its signal and... there. Full connection. Oh, just look at all that data.

I hope you didn't run into too much trouble placing that probe. I'll connect to it now and make sure we're good. <beat> Hey, look at that. Synched on the first try. You are a natural at placing things.

Well, since the probe is in position, let me just bring it online. Oh, look at that. Data's just pouring in. Nicely done. Well probed. Which actually might be the first time anyone's used that as a compliment.
Looks like the probe is in place. All that's left is to sync my systems and we are up and running. Excellent.
Okay. Step one was deploy the probe. You took care of that. All that's left is step two, me remotely connecting to it. Finger's crossed. There we go. Step two complete! Don't we make quite the team.
localization.pu_banister_mg_midmission_probe_encourag: Just out of curiosity, I did ask you to place a probe for me, right? I'm pretty sure I did, but maybe I just thought about doing it, and.. oh wait, no, have it here in my notes. Probe. Awesome. As soon as you have it in position, let me know.
Not that I don't appreciate the visit, but I think you're supposed to be dropping a probe for me. Once you get it in place, come and let me know.
Any luck with that probe, yet? It'll be exciting to start scanning as soon as you have it set up.

Looks like you placed the probe! Let me just try to sync with my system and... oh, that's not good. The scan is off. I really hate to do this, but I think we might need to redeploy it in a slightly different position. Here, this should do it.

Great. Since the probe is in place, all that's left is to sync the signal and ... I don't understand. It should be sending - Ohhhh. I think I know what's wrong. It's the positioning. Looks like you're going to have to go back and deploy it somewhere else. Here, let me update the coordinates.

Okay, the probe is in position, so let me run a quick diagnostic. <pause> Crap. That's not gonna work. Looks like we might have to reposition the probe a bit. You mind going back and adjusting its positioning? I'm really sorry.
localization.pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_1stx: See, sometimes I accidentally pick up distress beacons that are outside of ECN range, but if I went chasing after all of them, I'd totally lose my job, not to mention get blown up by outlaws. But on the other hand, it's not like I can just sit here and do nothing, so I try to pass them along and get help when I can. And that's where you come in. If I give you the coordinates, I was hoping you could maybe see if there's anything you could do?
localization.pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_gene: Shooting you the location of a distress beacon. It is going off hard. You gotta help them. Code of space and all, right?
A distress beacon just went off. Here are the coordinates. Go. Save.

There's a DB blinking like crazy on my screen. Here. I sent you the location. If you take a look its a win-win. They get help and I get to stop hearing the damn thing go beep beep beep every freaking second. Oh, and DB stands for distress beacon by the way. Cause I realized I might be the only who calls them DB. Feel free to start using it.
Drop whatever your doing. Two words. Distress bacon. Beacon. Distress beacon. Sorry. I didn't have breakfast. Forget it. Just go help, okay?

I'm picking up a faint distress beacon on my scanners. I'll send you the coordiates. Might wanna be careful though, I was just reading about an outlaw pack that liked to use them to lure people into ambushes. Not that it should stop you from looking. Just, you know, don't get ambushed.
Picking up a distress beacon signal at these coordinates. If you check it out, be careful.
localization.pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_post: It does not sound good. Sending you the location of the signal. I think you should go try to help. I mean, you don't have to. You can do what you want, or whatever. But after hearing this - are you really not going to?
They're under attack. Here are the coordinates. You've gotta hurry!
Maybe you can go help? Sending location now.
Yeah, nightmares for a week. Please, these are the cords, if you think you can help them out, it would be pretty nice of you.
I'm sending you their location, though to be honest, by the time you get there, not sure how much good you'll be... And I just won the pessismist of the year award. Sorry. Good luck, okay?
It's coming from these coordinates. You should help if you can.
localization.pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_beacon_prem: (frantic) I just got a comm. Here -
Quick question for you. This sounds serious, right?
Ready for your unsettling comm of the day? And, yeah. Nightmares for a week.
Just when you start to forget that space can be pretty terrible you hear something like this-
localization.pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_: I picked up this job posting off the public spec and thought it might be your kinda thing. Sending it over.
Figured I'd pass this along in case your interested in some extra work.
I don't know if you're busy or just out coasting, but check this out.
Saw a job that you might be interested in. I'll send it over.
If you're on the hunt for some credits, and I mean, who doesn't need credits, there's a local posting that could be perfect for you. Here.
localization.pu_banister_mg_missionbriefs_noavailable: I'm sorry to say, but I don't really have anything exciting to tell you at the moment. Pretty boring here, actually. Well, other than the varied and exciting opportunties afforded me as an employee of the ICC, of course.
Guess what? There's absolutely nothing going on at the moment. To be honest, if you hadn't shown up when you did, I'd probably be taking a desk nap right now.

localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1emergen: It's me. I just got an emergency call from one of our ships, the Blinding Hope, who were on their way back from a dig. They got ambushed by the Moraine, one of the outlaw packs in the system, and need some help. You're the closest person I got. Please help them.

Good, you made it. I talked to Lucas, the captain of the Blinding Hope. They've locked themselves in the bridge but the Moraine are trying like hell to get in. Could you get over there and help out? I've passed along your comm info, he should be calling you now.

Hey, it's Recco. Welcome back. Just wanted to give you an update. Thanks to you, Lucas was able to repel the rest of the Moraine and get away. I'm sorry you had to regen, so I wanted to say, you can keep all those minerals you pulled. Thanks for trying to help Lucas and the others.

Recco here. Lucas said you were able to handle those Moraine. They've been hitting us a lot lately, so it's nice to finally turn one of these sad stories around. Tell you what, why don't you keep what you extracted. It's the least I can do for you for stepping up and helping out.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1findroc: Hey. Recco here. Looks like you're in the area. You'll have to scan to see where the minerals are.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1hook_gp: Hey, this is Recco Battaglia over at Levski. I organize some of the jobs coming in and out of the station. I popped a contract into your manager. Take a look and let me know if you're interested.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1miningc: That should do it. You're a natural at this. Come on home.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1rockcra: Great. Now that you've cracked the rock, you'll need to switch modes in order to extract it.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission1rockfou: There. That's what you're looking for. Now you just gotta harvest it.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2arrivea: Look at that… [long pause] Based on the damage, I don't think anyone in there's alive. I'm sorry to ask you to do this, but we should identify who we lost, so we can let the families know.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2blackbo: Black box says Isaac was on board when they launched, but if there's no body, I wonder where he went. I don't know why the Moraine would take him but they have taken people before... They have an old station near here that they've used as a hunting blind. I'll send you the location.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2body2fo: [pause] Yeah, that's Meg… Just last week she was talking about doing fewer of these runs.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2body3fo: Confirmed. That's TJ… sorry, this never gets easier, you know?
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2gettheb: Hey… I'm not seeing Kepler in there... Sorry, Isaac Kepler. Can you grab the ship's black box and we can see if he set out with them?
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2mission: Hey, it's me. I put everything I know in the contract, but I still haven't been able to contact the Blinding Hope. Lucas is always pretty on top of checking in, so I just need someone out there. You've been doing a lot of good work lately so I wanted to give this to someone I can trust. Thanks.
Hi there. It's Recco. Got a bit of situation here if you're able to help. Accept it through your mobi if you can.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission2moraine: Great. Bring that data back to me and I can see if there's any mention of what happened to Isaac.
That did it. You should be able to get inside now. Just be careful.
Alright, that's the Moraine base I told you about. It's probably a long shot that Isaac's here but we have to try. Be careful, the place may look empty, but you never know.
You should try to find their server room. Maybe we can find out what happened to Isaac there.
Right there. If you access that terminal. You can download any lingering Moraine data. Might take a little bit.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3intrans: Hey, it's me. I think this is going to work. Head over there now and bring Isaac back to Levski.

I'm sorry. Lucas shouldn't have done that. But you have to know that the Moraine are just using you. I've seen it before. Remember Callie Barnes? Moraine promised to take her in in exchange for the routes of our trading ships. They killed her. Lars Westerna? Same promise, same result. You may be frustrated with us, but I don't want you to get hurt. I owe that to your parents.
Of course you can. We've all made mistakes. Part of being family is looking past them.
Look, I've got someone heading to your position. They'll bring you back in and we'll just talk. Okay?
Sit tight, they'll be there soon.
Okay, here we go. Starting the comm.
We look after our own, Isaac. You know that. What's going on?

Look Isaac, I get it. I do. We're not perfect. I mean, your dad used to complain all the time about how indecisive the People's Alliance could be, but that doesn't mean that the dream isn't worthwhile. He knew that. I thought you believed that too. We need young people like you to help lead the movement forward. That's how this works.
I want to know what happened on the Blinding Hope.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3mission: Hey, it's Recco. I don't know if you're free, but I've had an idea about the situation with Isaac. Check your mobi.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mc_rbmmission3moraine: I'm sorry… I thought… I wanted to believe he was going to come back. [long pause]\nI've got to go. Next time you're on Levski, we can talk, but I have to go.
Okay, head back to the server room and we can get going.

Alright, we're connected. Give me a second to run a quick search... Got him. I'm going to trace his location, I'd like you to meet him and bring him in. I think word's gotten out that he was involved with the death of Lucas and I'm worried people might attack him if he comes in alone. Start heading to your ship now and I'll see if I can get him on a comm.

Anyway, I like to meet my people before sending them out. But what do you say? Want to hear about the gig?
