localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission1option2: All good, I'll just send the details to your mobi then.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission2busy_gp: Look, I might need a little time to process this.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission2playera: Hey, welcome back. Drop off the data and I can take a look.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission2reactio: Okay, let's see what we can see… Looks like some chatter between the Moraine talking about… No, this can't be right… Says here that Isaac tipped off the Moraine about the Blinding Hope. It's got to be some kind of trick, right? I need to look into this. I'll talk to you later, okay?
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission3beat1ac: Great. I've been trying to call him through my mobi, but he's not answering. I coded a relay into that data drive you took from the Moraine base. If you go plug it back in, I should appear as a Moraine so maybe he'll take the comm. Grab the drive whenever you're ready to head on out.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission3beat1en: Come on, let's get out there.
Don't have anything else to tell you. Drive's all ready to go.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission3beat1in: So here's the deal. I pored through all that Moraine data, and every recent ship attack by the Moraine had one thing in common: Isaac. I didn't want to believe it - I mean, his parents raised him up to believe in what we're trying to do here - but the evidence is all there. I know their deaths hit him hard, so maybe he's just fallen in with a bad crowd or something, which means there could be a way back from this. I just want to talk to him. If you can help me do that, I think I can get him to come home. Have a look.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission3beat1up: Hey, come on over so we can get started.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission3beat3in: First, I wanted to apologize to you. It wasn't fair to put you in danger like that. I wanted to believe Isaac could come back so badly that instead of listening to what he was saying, I just sent you in blind. And it almost got you killed too. So I'm sorry. [beat] \nBut I just had to do something, you know?
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission3beat3op: Yeah, I just still see him as that goofy little kid bombing around the Market. It's hard to believe that he could have all that hate. I know Lucas could be… difficult, but he loved that kid. We all did.

Yeah, I don't know... It is getting harder to believe in the best of people. Harder to not just hide those you love behind walls ringed with guns and shoot anyone that comes close. But even so, succumbing to that fear and giving up on the universe we want to live in doesn't feel like much of a future to me. Maybe People's Alliance does need to grow up a bit, but we have to do it in a way that doesn't change who we are.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission3beat3re: Don't worry. I'll be back to normal next time you come by. Just need to let this run its course.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission3beat3up: Hey, glad you could make it.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission3beat3wa: Sorry, yeah, I should get back to it too.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rbmmission3mission: Thanks for doing this. Come by when you can.
localization.pu_battaglia_peo_f_mg_rmbmission3beat3re: Anyway, thank you for helping me. I won't forget it. Sent you a little something. Come back and see me if you're looking for work.

localization.pu_boyd_civ_f_deh_huntpolarisplayerarriv: I'm sick and tired of you wanna-be starmen showing up and sticking your nose in where it doesn't belong. You need to step down and let us Frontier Fighters do what needs to be done. This is your only warning. You keep pushing, and anything that happens is your fault.

Look, I know a lot of you are upset about the whole Slicer thing, but that doesn't mean you have to get in the way of what the Frontier Fighters are doing now. All we want is the Polaris. No UEE civilians have to get hurt; but if you get in the way, I got no sympathy for you.

You're dedicated, which I can respect, but you're throwing your life away. For what? To protect some scum in a system that'd sooner see you dead as spit on you? You should want us to have this Polaris. We're going to use it to save the Empire.

I don't think I'll ever understand why you people fight as hard as you do for the dregs of Pyro. People like to call the Frontier Fighters murderers, but is it murder to kill to protect your home? That's all we want to do, and we ain't gonna let anything stop us.
localization.pu_boyd_civ_f_deh_huntpolarispolarisflee: Hell with it. Let's get the hell out of here.
You all deal with these CDF. Meet at the rendezvous.
localization.pu_boyd_civ_f_deh_missioncompletepolaris: Don't think that's the end of us. One Polaris doesn't change what needs doing, and the Frontier Fighters will see it through. You can count on that.
What a damn waste. We could have done a lot of good for the Empire with that ship. But don't worry, the Frontier Fighters will find another way. That you can be sure of.
localization.pu_boyd_civ_f_deh_missionfailspolarisesc: There. Now we can put that Polaris' combat abilities to some real use out in Pyro hunting down every last low-life that calls that system home. Seeing you fight out here today, you might want to think about doing the same yourself.

Now wouldn't it have saved everyone a load of hurt and effort if you had just let us take the Polaris in the first place? Well, what's done is done. Now, you and all of Pyro will get to see what the Frontier Fighters are really capable of.
localization.pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase1tauntmissionc: That wasn't some criminal you killed. That was someone who wanted the Empire to be a better place. They were also a friend.
I hope the pat on the head your handlers give you for doing their dirty work is worth what you've taken away. You killed a good person. Remember that.
Frontier Fighters are going to keep on fighting. Regardless of what you've done here. We remember our fallen. Who will remember you?
I hope you remember their name. I really do. I hope it haunts you until some scumbag puts a bullet in your brain.
Even after all this, you can't see the good we're trying to do. I can't make you see, but one day, when we've won, maybe you'll understand.
(long 2-3 pause) You just killed a friend. Someone who believed in a better Empire. You took them away. You did that.
They got exactly what will come to anyone who tries to stop what we're doing. Remember that.
I don't care what you think you accomplished today. You aren't going to stop us.
You're not going to find us. Even if you do, our message will not be silenced.
Don't think for a second you'll get anything from that traitor. We aren't going away that easy.
They tried blackmailing us with that intel before coming to you. They just wanted money. They had no cause. Nothing to believe in. You won't find us.
Shame you found them. I hoped my people would've done a better job disposing of that traitor. It won't matter. Even in death they won't give you anything to find us.
localization.pu_boyd_civ_f_pmh_fffphase2tauntmissionc: Why the hell won't you leave us alone? You're just a slave to the credits and corporations who hold your leash.
You should be fighting with us instead of against us, but you'd rather throw in with murderers and corrupt politicians.
How the hell do you think this is going to end? If we die, the outlaws of Pyro and the scum just like them will just keep on killing.
Where's all your moralizing now? You just ambushed and killed friends of mine who were just trying to make the universe safer.
I hope you're not still deluding yourself to think that you're doing the right thing here. Now you're just an assassin, killing good people.
You realize what you're doing? You're making it harder for the people who can still regen. Just stop.
How dare you say that you are just when you destroy medical beds. You make me sick.
This is low, even for you lot. Those medical beds are meant to help people and you assholes would rather kill good people than do something about the criminal cancer detroying our systems.
I never thought the UEE could sink as low as this. Stopping your fellow humans from being able to regen makes me think that the Empire isn't worth saving.
You're willing to put the murderers and scavengers of Pyro, people who would sooner kill you then land a hand, over the good people of the Empire. You're disgusting.

localization.pu_cscdr01_m_deh_accepted_mission_fleetb: Sending you the coordinates for the Nine Tails fleet generating the quantum blockade. We need to take them out if we want to restore regular travel to the area. Head there and be ready to engage the enemy.

Updating you with the Nine Tails fleet coordinates. I need you to head there and clear out the hostiles responsible for powering the quantum dampener. We take them out, and the blockade will be over.

Thanks for signing up. Every bit of help we get makes it that much more likely we can put a stop to the Nine Tails blockade. Here are the coordinates. This outlaw fleet is the one responsible for the quantum dampening. We take them out and the area should be clear again.

Glad you're with us on this. Not going to be easy facing down this Nine Tails fleet, but we take these ships out and we take the quantum dampener out with them. Then this damn blockade will finally be over. Head to the coordinates and let's get this done.

The plan is to use scan ships to help us locate whatever the Nine Tails are using to block quantum travel, but we can't do that until we clear a safe zone for the scanners to operate. You have the coordinates of the first scan site. Make your way there now.

Commander Herdsman here. Good to have you with us. Crusader Security needs to trace the current location of the main Nine Tails fleet, but can't get our scan ships into position until active hostiles have been cleared. Head to the coordinates now.

This is Commander Herdsman. Nice to see you will be joining Crusader Security for this operation. I have scan ships at the ready to help us locate the main Nine Tails fleet and put an end to this blockade, but we can't begin the scans until we can secure the location. Report to the provided coordinates.

This is Commander Herdsman of Crusader Security. I'm coordinating a protective detail to secure a scan site so we can locate the source of this Nine Tails blockade. Head to the location provided now. And be ready for a fight.

This is Commander Herdsman. I'm surprised to see you're volunteering again. Last time there was a Nine Tails blockade you left us high and dry. If you're serious about helping this time, we need to secure the first scan point so we can try and locate the main fleet. We'll see if you can do better this time around.

Commander Herdsman here. Thanks for volunteering. First we got to find their fleet, though. I'm sending you the coordinates for the first scan location. See you there.

localization.pu_cschief01_f_deh_succeed_event_aneutra: To all my fellow Crusaders, this is Director Rust. I am pleased to announce that the Nine Tails threat has been resolved and quantum travel can now resume. Thank you for your patience during these trying times and thank you to the brave individuals who assisted our security forces in defeating this scourge. Crusader Industries prides itself on providing safe travel for all.

People of Crusader, once again the Nine Tails have been pushed back and normal travel restored. I would like to personally thank Crusader Security and every civilian who contributed to this noble effort. You have my eternal gratitude.

Attention, please. On behalf of Crusader Security, this is Director Rust with some good news to share. The blockade is over, the Nine Tails have been dealt a decisive blow, and quantum travel can once again resume. I want to offer my sincerest thanks to everyone who contributed to this successful resolution. For all of us at Crusader, have a wonderful day.

This is a security update from Director Rust and I am pleased to share some good news. The latest Nine Tails blockade has been decisively concluded by our fearless security personnel and the brave private contractors who assisted the effort. We all owe them a debt of gratitude. Feel free to resume normal travel.

Attention. This is Security Director Rust. I am thrilled to announce that the Nine Tails outlaw group has once again been repelled and safe travel through Crusader space can resume thanks to the tireless efforts of our hardworking security forces and contractors. Whatever challenges arise in the future, I feel confident in our ability to meet them head on. Thank you all.

This is a security update on the recent quantum blockade of Crusader space. I am pleased to announce that our skilled security forces and contractors have successfully dealt with the perpetrators and regular travel can resume once again. Thank you all for your perseverance during these trying times. All of us here at Crusader wish you safe travels.
localization.pu_cschief01_f_deh_succeed_mission_tocdr: Excellent. I knew I could count on you. The people of Crusader will be very happy to hear the good news. Be sure that any civilians who assisted are rewarded for their hard work and I'll expect to be debriefed when you get back to Orison, Commander.

Well done, Commander. A hearty congratulations to you and the volunteer force. Rest assured that they will be provided due compensation for all their brave efforts. The board and I look forward to speaking with you in person when you return. Until then Commander, Director Rust, out.

Wonderful news. I only hope that we've put a stop to the Nine Tails once and for all. Make sure to compensate all the volunteers who assisted, and then report back to headquarters. See you soon, Commander.

That's a relief to hear. I know putting a stop to these Nine Tails was no easy feat. You should be proud. As should all the civilians who helped. See to it that they are duly rewarded for their efforts. Last thing before I let you go, the board's requested a personal debrief, so I'll need you to return to Orison as soon as you're able. Good work, Commander.
Fantastic, Commander. The board will be thrilled to hear. Reward the volunteers for their efforts and report back to headquarters. Director Rust, out.
I have good news, Commander. All your hard work has paid off. We have the location of the Nine Tails fleet. Head there now. We're putting an end to this once and for all.

I have an update, Commander. The scan information has paid off and we have the location of the main hostile fleet. I want you to engage the Nine Tails as soon as possible and end this. Good luck to you and all your forces.
Commander. We have finished analyzing the latest scans and determined the location of the Nine Tails' fleet. Head to their position ASAP. You have my permission to engage.

Commander. Just received word on the latest scan data. We found the bastards. Sending you the location of the main Nine Tails fleet now. Head to their position and put an end to this blockade once and for all.
Commander. The data team has successfully analyzed the scans and isolated the Nine Tails fleet location. I'm authorizing you to head there now and shut this blockade down immediately. Good luck.
localization.pu_cschief01_f_deh_succeed_mission_trade: Hello. I was just informed that the blockaded station has been resupplied thanks to you. Not an easy task. Please trust that they will be going towards a good cause. You have my and Crusader's gratitude. Safe flying.
Congratulations on a successful supply run. Your effort has done a lot of good for that station. On behalf of Crusader, thanks.
This is Director Rust. Wanted to let you know that the station resupply was successful and not a moment too soon. Your assistance in this matter was much appreciated.
Director Rust here. I have an update on the station resupply. Just got word that they have everything they need. Thanks for contributing to the effort.
This is Director Rust. I've got good news. The blockaded station has been completely resupplied. Should make quite a difference to our efforts there. Crusader appreciates your help with the matter.
This is Director Rust. The blockaded station has been resupplied so we wont be needing your assistance any longer. Crusader appreciates your offer to help. Safe flying.

This is Crusader Security Director Rust. Wanted to inform you that we no longer need your assistance in restocking the station. It's all been taken care of. We'll definitely let you know if we need any further assistance in the future.
Attention. The station has been successfully restocked. No further assistance with supplies is needed at this time. Thank you for your offer to help.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_aal: Hi there. Liaison Officer Vanzant. Happy to see you'll be helping Crusader Security out with this contract. With the work you've been doing so far, I'm sure you'll be able to take care of this one no problem. Updating you with all the details now.

Hey! Great to see your name pop up on this contract. Always appreciate having experienced and dependable operators handling things. Okay, I've updated all the info and you should be good to go. Good luck out there and I'll check in with you later.

Hi! Officer Vanzant here. You've been working with Crusader Security for a bit now, so I won't hold your hand too much. Check the details, use your best judgment, and I'll catch up with you later. Thanks.
Hi, this is Liaison Officer Vanzant with Crusader Security. I'll be managing your contract on this upcoming job. Sending you the important info now so you can get on your way.
Hi there. I'm the Crusader Security Liaison Officer overseeing your contract. You should have all the important details now, and I'll be monitoring you're progress as you go. Good luck out there.

Hey, I'm Officer Vanzant with Crusader Security. Thanks for taking this contract. I'm updating the details for you now but it should all be pretty clear. Just remember to keep your head down and be safe. Don't want to lose anybody on my watch. All right, get to it and I'll check in on you later.

Hey, comming you on behalf of Crusader Security. I'll be supervising your current contract with us. All the details have been forwarded so hopefully that covers everything you need to get started. I'll check in with you periodically, but until then, good luck and be safe.

Hey there, this is Crusader Security Liaison Officer Vanzant comming about the contract. I'll be your point of contact on this job but it should hopefully be straightforward. You have all details so feel free to get going right away. Just make sure to stock up on any supplies you'll need. Nothing worse than being caught unprepared. Good luck.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_accepted_mission_dru: Hey there. Liaison Officer Vanzant with Crusader Security. I'm the one managing your contract with us to - says here, "Destroy Illegal Contraband." Ah, right. Basically, criminals have been setting up these automated production facilities that can just keep turning out product like its nothing. We got coordinates on one of these sites, and we want you to go destroy all the contraband they make. We even got a nice little bonus scheme set up where we'll pay you based on how much product you manage to take off the market. You'll be doing good for the community, and getting a good salary to do it. Nothing wrong with that, right?

Hi, I'm your Crusader Security Liaison Officer for this contract. That means I'll be supervising while you deal with this automated facility. You should have the details, but the idea is that you'll infiltrate the compound and destroy the packages as they come off the production line, preventing them from getting out into the wild. While the manufacturing process takes care of itself, I wouldn't be surprised if you run into some outlaw resistance anyway. Go in prepared, and you should come out all right. Good luck.

Hey, Liaison Officer Vanzant here. Thanks for agreeing to help us deal with this illegal production facility. Crusader Security is very eager to make sure that whatever products are coming off the line don't make it onto market. Once you're on site, deal with whatever resistance there is, and destroy as much of the contraband as you can. Ideally all of it. I sent you the details so you should be all set to go. Safe flying.

Hi, this is Liaison Officer Vanzant with Crusader Security. I'll be overseeing your contract with us. Appreciate your help in dealing with this illegal production facility. As outlined, the hope is that you'll be able to secure the site and confiscate any contraband you find for delivery to our evidence hold. Now, these so-called criminal geniuses have managed to automate a lot of the production, so its unclear how long they'll be manufacturing product for or how many outlaws will be on site, but I'd go in ready to face some serious resistance. Could get pretty nasty... Sure you'll be fine though. I'll check in on you later.

Greetings. I'm a Liaison Officer with Crusader Security and I'll be supervising your work in helping us deal with this illegal production facility today. It's one of the newer automated style where it's pretty much hands free for the outlaws. Crazy how advanced these things are getting. We'd like you to go there and secure as many of the crates of contraband as you can and bring them to us for processing and disposal. And of course, if there any hostile forces present, you're expected to deal with them as appropriate. And remember, caution is the keyword all around.

Hey there. Crusader Security Officer Vanzant comming you about the contract work. Just wanted to make sure everything was clear. You're going to be headed to an automated production facility and grabbing all the contraband that comes off the line. Once you have it secured, you're to bring them to the appointed location so we can properly analyze and dispose of it. Not sure what exactly you can expect in terms of hostile resistance, but it usually pays to be ready for a fight. And just to say it, I'm really happy we hired you for this. Will be great to get all this contraband off the market before it does any damage.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_announce_dropoff_aal: Hey, it's Officer Vanzant again. Just wanted to pass along that the Crusader Security personnel on patrol in your sector have been notified that you're delivering some contraband to our evidence hold for us. You shouldn't run into any problem as you make your way there. At least from us. There's probably a few outlaws out there who'd like to get their product back. Actually, might be a good idea for you make the delivery as fast as you can. Won't be safe flying around too long with this stuff.

Hey there. Officer Vanzant. Wanted to let you know that I notified the local patrols that you'd be heading through the sector. Didn't want them to be surprised when a ship carting a bunch of contraband turned up. Also told them to keep an eye out for anybody who might be trying to get their hands on that stash you're hauling. Hopefully you won't have any trouble on your way to the drop off.

Hi, Liaison Officer Vanzant here. Didn't want you to run into any trouble on your way to the evidence hold, so I've gone ahead and alerted Crusader Security patrols in the area that you're authorized to be traveling with contraband aboard. Should make things easier for you. Now all you have to do is avoid any outlaws trying to take their drugs back and you'll be fine.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_expired_mission_drug: So, just got a tip hot off the wire. Seems these perps didn?t like us interfering and the site's been ordered offline. Since, they won't be producing any more contraband, destroy whatever's left before heading off.

Wanted to pass along an update. The production line's going to be shutting down. Guess these bastards decided to count their losses or lick their wounds or whatever. Go ahead and finish destroying whatever contraband is still on site and then we should be all set.

Hey, got a report from an informant that the production line's going dark. They probably figured there's no point in making more if we're just going to destroy all of it. Speaking of, finishing destroying whatever you can find left down there and then you're good to clear out.

Hey, one of our contacts just let us know that the people operating the site got word of our operation and ordered it to go dark. Collect whatever you can, and bring it to the evidence hold. It's not worth you hanging around there longer than you have to.

Hey, if this report I got is right, that production line should be shutting down any moment now. Finish collecting whatever contraband you can get your hands on and go ahead and bring it to the drop off.

So, looks like they're going to be deactivating the production line at the sight. Guess the criminals finally got word of what we were up to. Since their won't be any more contraband coming off the line, finish collecting whatever there is and bring it to the evidence hold. Thanks.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_aally_: Listen up. This is Security Officer Vanzant and it is my obligation to hereby notify you that due to breach of contract, your employment is hereby terminated.
Attention contractor. Having failed in your obligations to Crusader Security, I am hereby authorized to terminate your employment. Effective immediately.
Look, I don't want to do this but with the way you've been acting, you've given me no choice. I'm canceling your contract. Sorry.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_badper: Officer Vanzant here. I was rooting for you, but with your performance I have no choice but to unfortunately terminate your contract. Sorry, it didn't work out.

Look, I'm gonna give it to you straight. You just weren't up to snuff this time around. Nothing you can't overcome with a bit of a hard work and practice, but for now I'm going to have to terminate the contract. Hopefully things turn around for you soon.
Hey. So from what I'm seeing your performance isn't up to Crusader Security standards. Gonna go ahead and cancel your contract. Guess you just weren't the right person for this job, huh?
This is Officer Vanzant again. It's not good. Your performance has been sub-par and I'm canceling the contract. Nothing personal. Have a good one, okay.
All right, there's no easy way to say this, but I'm terminating your contract. Your performance just wasn't meeting our requirements for this job. That's it. Good luck out there.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_breaks: Geez, what are you thinking? That just because you're working for us you can break the law? That's not how it works, buddy. Contract's canceled, and you can forget about working with Crusader Security until you get your life sorted.

Am I reading this right? Did you actually get a crimestat while working as a security contractor? Talk about not knowing which way your feet are facing. It goes without saying, but we can't have an active criminal on the payroll, so you're fired. Good luck with your legal problems.
Hey, not sure what the hell happened, but an active crimestat means you can't work for Crusader Security. I gotta cut you loose. Contract's over.
Look, if we knew you were going to be out there breaking the law, Crusader Security never would have hired you in the first place. That crimestat means you're terminated. That's just how it is.

Did you seriously just get a crimestat? I know things can get tricky out there but I expected you to be more careful than this. Whatever happened, I'm gonna have to cut you loose. Crusader Security doesn't employ criminals. All right, contract's terminated.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_illega: Woah, you're going around selling this stuff? I can't believe you'd betray our trust like that. You can forget about the contract. Hell, you can forget about working for Crusader again for a very long time.

Hey! Did you actually think selling the illegal contraband we hired you to collect was a good idea? Unbelievable! You are so fired. I can't even comprehend what was going through your mind. You know what, I don't care. I'm done with you.

I didn't want to believe it at first, but I can't argue with the evidence. I can't believe you'd stab me in the back like this. Do you have any idea what kind of damage that contraband you sold will do to the community? Forget it. There's no point in talking to someone like you.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_fired_mission_notpla: Hey, hate to do this, but it seems that Crusader Security isn't going to need your help on this contract after all. Don't worry though. This won't reflect on you at all. Next contract, we'd be happy to have you back. Safe flying until then.

Hey, comming with a bit of bad news. I have to close out the contract. You didn't do anything wrong, it?s just the higher ups have decided our resources will be better spent elsewhere. Apologies. Hopefully this won't happen again.

Hey, it's Vanzant. Wanted to let you know that I have to cancel the contract. It's not your fault in the slightest, just one of those things. Crap luck really. Anyway, hopefully we'll have another job for you soon and we can make it up to you. All right. Have a good one.

Hey, really hate to do this to you, but I'm canceling the contract. The situation's changed and we won't be needing you after all. Hope you're not too mad. Would love to have you on another job in the future. Okay. Sorry again.

Okay, don't shoot the messenger here, but Crusader Security is terminating this contract. Nothing you did. It just happens sometimes and you unfortunately got the short straw. Hopefully, next time you work with us things will go smoother.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_inform_mission_statu: Hey, just checking in. Looks like you're making solid progress. Keep it up and we should have everything wrapped up soon.

Wanted to let you know how happy I am that you're making good progress on the contract. Seems like we got the right person for the job. Now you just need to do the rest. Shouldn't be a problem, right?

Hey, hope I'm not interrupting anything. Had gotten a status update on your progress and wanted to say that it seems you're more or less on target. Just keep doing what you've been doing and we'll be all set.

Hey there, it's Officer Vanzant. Just hopping on the comm to say good work so far. All the progress updates I've gotten have been pretty much on track, so that's great. Hopefully, we'll be able to close this thing out soon. Keep it up.

Hey, how's it going? Everything's pretty good on my end. Really liking these status reports I'm seeing on your progress. Crusader Security always appreciates contractors who can stay on task and get a job done. At this rate, the whole contract should be finished before too long. And then the best part, getting paid! Okay, I'll check in again later.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_remind_mission_respa: Welcome back. Hope the regen wasn't too rough on you. Now that you have some extra life experience under your belt, I'm sure you'll clear out this contract no problem. Good luck.
Hey, glad you're back on your feet. Contract is still open, so if you're up for it, could use your help in closing it out. I'm sure you'll do great this time.
Hey, look who's back in action! Was worried about you. Not to rush your recovery, but the contract's still waiting. Would be great if you can head back out and take care of it. Better luck this time.

I knew it! I knew you'd pull through. I tried to send you flowers, but there was a  whole thing, but anyway, I'm glad you?re feeling better now. The contract is still yours if you want it. And hopefully you can get it taken care of this time while staying in one piece! Just kidding. Be safe and good luck.

Hey, feeling better? This regen stuff's a real miracle isn't it? Anyway, now that you're moving about again, the contract is still waiting for you to finish. Figured you'd appreciate the chance to close it out. Just try and be a little more careful this time, okay?
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_dropoff_aall: Hey again. Officer Vanzant. Just saw the confirmation that you dropped off the contraband. Great work. Crusader Security thanks you for your effort.

Hey, wanted to say thanks for getting that contraband delivered to us. Your hard work is very appreciated. I'll make note of it on the final comments section of your contract when I close it out. Have a good rest of your day.
Hi, Officer Vanzant here. Looks like all the contraband you dropped off made it safely into the evidence hold. I'll make sure the higher ups know about how much you helped. Thanks again.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_aall: Look at that, contract's all done. Great job. Appreciate you making my life easier, and actually doing what we hired you for. You would not believe some of the people I have to deal with. Anyway, Crusader Security thanks you for your effort and you should receive your payment shortly.
Hey, congrats on wrapping up the contract. Good work. Crusader needs people we can count on. Hopefully we can do it again sometime soon.
Hi, this is Officer Vanzant. Just saw that the contract was all wrapped up and wanted to say on behalf of Crusader Security job well done. Safe flying out there.

Hey, wanted to let you know I received confirmation that you got the contract all taken care of. We should be all set now, and I'll make sure your payment gets processed. Oh, and feel free to hit up Crusader Security next time you're looking for work, okay? Be safe.

Hey! You pulled it off! Nice work out there. Between you and me, Crusader Security needs all the help we can get so this was great. Maybe we'll work together again soon. All right, I better get back to it. Later.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_succeed_mission_drug: Good news. Got reports that all the contraband on the site has been destroyed. Appreciate all your help in keeping Crusader safe.
Hey, looks like all the contraband at the site have been destroyed. That means your contract's complete. Thanks for your help on this. You should be proud of what we accomplished.

Hey, it's Vanzant. Just got word that the site has been completely cleared of all contraband so on behalf of Crusader Security, thanks for a job well done. Hopefully we'll get to work together again soon.
localization.pu_csecrrep01_m_deh_warn_missionarea_aba: Hey, Officer Vanzant here. Couldn't help but notice that you seem to be getting a bit off track. It'd be great if you could go ahead and focus on getting the contract done. Appreciate it.
Hey, it's Officer Vanzant. Looks like you might be getting a bit turned around. You should check the contract again and try to get back on track. Thanks.

Hi there. I was just checking on your status and it's looking like you might be a little lost or something? Not sure exactly, but it'd be good if you can check your bearings. Would love to get this contract closed out.
Hey are you okay? It looks like you?re a bit off course. Probably should get your headings sorted so you can finish off the contract. All right, I'll leave you to it. Thanks.

Hey, not sure if this is right, but from my end it looks like you're headed in the wrong direction. It's probably nothing, but figured it couldn't hurt to check. Okay, that was it. Talk to you again in a bit.
Okay, look. If you're going to keep messing around, I'm gonna have to give the contract to someone else. I think neither of us wants that. Get it together, and get it done.
I'm starting to run out of patience with you. Either get on task and take care of this job, or I'm gonna pull the contract. Your choice.
Did you get hit on the head or something? You're still way off course. Get yourself sorted, or I'm pulling you off the job. It's that simple.
I don't want to be the bad guy here, but if you're not going to take this job seriously, I'm not gonna waste my time dealing with you. Get on track, or you're gone. Understand me?

Listen, I'm trying to help you out but you're not making it easy on me with the way you're acting. I need you to get back on track with this contract, okay? If you can't do that for me, I'm afraid my hands are tied. I'll have to let you go.
localization.pu_customs1_sk_access_deny_ig_002_sorryy: Sorry, your access has been denied
localization.pu_customs4_sk_access_deny_ig_002_sorryy: Sorry, your access has been denied
localization.pu_darneely_mg_busy_ig_001_myapologiesto: My apologies, too much to do.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_busy_ig_003_weshallhave: We shall have to talk later. I am positively overwhelmed at the moment.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_chosen_playerdeclinemissi: I appreciate your honesty. Most would have taken the job and let it languish.
That, of course, is your prerogative.
Perhaps if your schedule clears you will reconsider.
Come back if you change your mind. Sadly, I will still be here.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_comms_forgivesplayer_ig_0: Hello, how are you? It's Clovus, by the way. I trust you're well. I know we didn't leave things under the best of circumstances, but I am in need of assistance and have exhausted my usual rogue's gallery.
Hello there. It's been a while. We both did things we regret, you and I. Maybe it's time to try and move on. It's Clovus by the way.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_comms_instructvisit_ig_00: Come see me in Lorville if you're free.
Please visit. Lorville is lovely this time of year. I kid. It's dreadful as always, but you should come by.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_comms_missioncomplete_ig_: Yes, this all seems to be in order. Thank you.
Wonderful, all i's dotted and t's crossed so to speak. Your efforts are appreciated.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_comms_newmission_ig_003_w: Why hello. I've just received word about some exciting employment opportunities.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_comms_newmission_ig_004_h: Hello there, it's your friend and benefactor, Clovus Darneely. Seems an opportunity has arisen that could profit both of us.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_002_: The credits you are owed have been issued.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_comms_paymentsent_ig_003_: I will send you your fee at once.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_failbou: This is notify you that I have officially placed a bounty for the return of the goods you absconded with. I have asked that they do not harm you, but that is ultimately for fate and yourself to decide.
Despite my attempts to be civil, you have forced my hand. A bounty has been placed for the retrieval of my stolen property.
Fair warning, there are now professionals hunting you down to collect what is mine.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_lastwar: You still have not returned my property. If that oversight is not rectified shortly, I will be forced to take action.
If you do not return my property at once, there will be consequences. You should know that I am not one to make idle threats.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_comms_returnitems_reminde: Of course, you will have to return any property that rightfully belongs to me.
Need I remind you that any property of mine that is currently in your possesion will need to be returned post haste.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_convorejoin_ig_003_ohyouv: Oh, you've returned. Splendid. As I was saying...
localization.pu_darneely_mg_decide_encouragelookandde: Please review at your convenience and let me know.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_decide_missiontimeout_ig_: I shall take your inaction as a no.
Your hesitancy speaks volumes. Say no more. Consider the offer null.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_intro_1sttime_ig_001_apol: Apologies, the air is especially dreadful today. There, still alive. I think?
localization.pu_darneely_mg_intro_1sttime_ig_002_hell: Hello and welcome to Reclamation & Disposal. My name is Clovus Darneely. Wonderful to meet you.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_g: Do not be too disheartened by the outcome of our last arrangement. Even the gods themselves stumble from time to time. Actually quite often, if the texts are to be believed.
Apologies on your last assignment. You were on the cusp of success, but I guess that's why the prevailing wisdom espouses that you can't win them all.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_fail_n: I hope we've learned from our mistakes on that last assignment.
Failure is something we all have to learn to cope with. More to the point, after your last assignment, failure is something you have to cope with specifically.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_failst: Like Sisyphus, you seem to be perpetually locked in an uphill struggle only to fail time and time again.
That last assignment marks yet another failure in what seems destined to inevitably be a very long line of failures. Dissappointing to say the least.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_lastch: To be quite frank with you, you have bumbled most heroically despite entrusting you with multiple opportunities, but my father said I was too generous, so I'm going to give you one more chance.
Despite my better judgment, I am inclinded to grant you one more chance to turn the tide of your misfortunes.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_nolong: There are no options left for us, I am afraid. This partnership, if it ever could be called such, is henceforth null and void. I wish you good day.

It would seem that I have no choice. Effective immediately and for all perpetuity, you and I will no longer work our special little jobs together. Use the salvage facilities if you must, but otherwise, consider our relationship dissolved.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_robbed: I am relieved to see you back on your feet after your misfortune during the last job.
It is fortuitous that you emerged, life intact, after being accosted by such scoundrels. The sooner we put the previous assignment behind us the better I say.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_succes: I was reflecting upon the completion of your most recent task. Fantastic work. Really.
If I may say so, you accomplished your task with Porthos' grace and Icarus' speed.
Full marks for that last bit of work you saw to.
I wanted to take a moment to congratulate you on your recent work. As my mother always canted, "A good job, deserves a good word."
I must say, it seems there is nary an egg that your touch cannot turn to gold.
Your efforts of late have not gone unnoticed. Truely, I could not be more ecstatic about our little arrangement.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_lastmissioncomment_tryhar: I implore you, reach deep into yourself and find new strength with which to pursue our fortunes.
You must try harder. You simply must. Otherwise, I must cast my employment services elsewhere.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_midmission_deactivate_ig_: This is embarassing, but I'm afraid I must cancel our arrangement. Apologies for the inconvenience.
Due to a cavalcade of unforseen circumstances, I must render our agreement null.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_midmission_fail_ig_001_im: I'm afraid you've thoroughly fumbled this opportunity.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_midmission_fail_ig_003_im: I'm not going to yell. I'm not. But this... is most disappointing.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_0: This is very exciting, but things have gotten a little more complicated. Have a look. Very exciting indeed.
New information pertaining to your current task has come to light.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_midmission_playerquit_ig_: I am most dismayed to hear that. When you agree to perform a service, one assumes that you will see it through to the end.
This is most unprofessional. Most unprofessional...
localization.pu_darneely_mg_midmission_receivedata_ig: I received your upload. Many thanks.
Thank you for the transfer, my friend.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_midmission_warningfail_ig: It may be that I am growing nervous with age, but ideally you should be getting close to wrapping up this job for me, correct?
You are nearing completion on your current assignment for me, are you not? Not that I'm checking in. I trust you. I'm sure everything is fine.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_mission_farewell_missiona: Excellent. Good luck on your charge and I will speak to you soon.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_mission_farewell_missiond: I will bid you a fond day then.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_good_ig: Ah, my old friend, it's been too long.
At last, someone interesting. This day has been absolutely dragging.
Welcome, welcome. My soul vaults to the heavens to see you again.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_nolonge: If you are here for reclamation services you may avail yourself at the terminal, otherwise, kindly leave me alone.
I haven't a single thing I wish to discuss with you. Good day.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_stillmi: Time is fleeting and unfortunately, so is your charge. Perhaps you should expedite things.
What are you doing here? Off you go. There's no time to waste.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_mission_greetings_wrongde: I believe you are mistaken. That doesn't come here.
I'm not quite sure what you expect me to do with that. I suggest you take it to a more suitable destination.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_generic_har: If you are up for a challenge, I may know of something that would fit the bill.
Would you describe yourself as high in confidence, but low on funds? If so, there is an assignment that I think you would be ideal for.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_generic_ig_: I have procured quite a little adventure for profit and gain.

localization.pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_nomission_i: I am loathe to dash your hopes, but the job well seems to have run dry for the moment.
An excellent question, with a dissapointing answer I'm afraid. I regrettably have nothing to offer.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_fin: Hurston Security was kind enough to notify me of several wreckage sites in the area and I find myself in need of a pilot to retrieve the detritus. Unfortunately, it might require some searching on your part.
I received another tip about some salvage. Sadly, they were not as forthcoming about exactly where it could be found.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_gen: I have received word that there is salvage to be had. Very exciting, I know.
I require the retrieval of some salvage. If you are willing, you shall go fetch it.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_inv: I have several confidants within Hurston Security who notify me when conflicts have been 'resolved' around the planet. They have no interest in salvaging the wreckage themselves, but pass along the location to me, for a nice cut of the sale.
Another day, another cluster of opportunity. I have received a list of potential salvage sites and if you agree, they shall be yours for the taking.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_salvage_pir: Security were just notified of a battle going on this very moment. They aren't going to intervene until the conflict is resolved, but I was thinking it might be beneficial to get up there before anyone else does. There might still be some aggressors in the area... but that shouldn't be a problem for someone like you, right?
I may know of some very fresh salvage. Unfortunately, you might have to battle your way to it. Thrilling, yes?
localization.pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_steal_gener: If you're not particularly concerned with shades of morality, I may have a lead on some... well, let's just call it questionable materials in need of forceful collection.

I often find people are too preoccupied with material concerns. I own this and you own that. Who is to say who owns what? I mean, if you were to bring me some salvage, woudn't that technically make it ours? Even if someone else said it was there's?
localization.pu_darneely_mg_missionbriefs_steal_retri: Feel free to say no, but a little bird gave me the location of some unfortunates who have been attacking convoys heading through the system. Now, should you eliminate them, it seems like that would produce some salvageable materials, no?
Truth be told, I have been in dire need of some very specific salvage. Dire enough to encourage you to go ahead and create the salvage yourself.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_multiplemissionoffer_ig_0: I am simply overwhelmed with the prospects of employment. Far too many to keep track of. Let me know if you may alleviate me.
Like Nisces herself, I have become a confluence of opportunity. See for yourself.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_playergoofsoff_ig_003_are: Are you feeling quite all right?
localization.pu_darneely_mg_prompt_missionorscrap_ig_: What can I do for you on this fine day?
And how may I help you?
localization.pu_darneely_mg_randomtonpc_locationcomme: Do you know I've met four generations of Hurstons? And just like my favourite cheeses they get softer and more repugnant with age.
It saddens me to see good people toil so hard and have so little to show for it. But that is our lot in life is it not?
Surrounded by such Human industry, I am both profoundly awed and deeply saddened.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_selectscrap_directtermina: Ah. Yes. More metal for the pile, I say. Well, the terminal will be able to sort you out.
Well then, access the terminal over there and we'll get you started.
Might I direct you to consult with my colleague over there. The terminal is most accommodating.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_sendingmissiondetails_ig_: Here are the particulars to this little excursion.
The devil's in the details, I believe. Read them well.
I have a list of the pertinent details for you to peruse.
localization.pu_darneely_mg_transition_commenttogivin: But I suppose that hearing an old man's opinions was not the real focus of your visit, correct?
But let us move on, shall we...

localization.pu_datascientist1_bna_datafacilitylog_gp: Test? Test? <pause> Okay, it's recording. <clears throat> Preliminary results look promising. Ibrahim spheres enhanced with irradiated pearl dust are showing better entanglement outcomes than what we're seeing in the normal ones. Dr. Jorrit's already given clinical the go-ahead to start in vivo testing, but I'm not confident we're at that stage yet. I want to replicate this a dozen or so times before we move onto development. We don't have enough data yet to say this is statistically significant. I wanted to get this on record in case Dr. Jorrit keeps pressuring us to rush things. Still, I'm feeling hopeful. Maybe we can solve the regen crisis. Not bad for a weapons company.

localization.pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_arresting_ig_002_u: Um, you're not allowed to be in here. I hate to narc you out, but rules are rules.
localization.pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_arresting_ig_003_w: What the hell are you doing? You really should have left when you had the chance. Sorry, but I've got to send security to pick you up. Do yourself a favor and go quietly.

localization.pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_last: Last chance to get out of here. We can't have any attendees in the halls, so you've gotta leave.

This is a final call. DefenseCon's gonna be closing very, very soon, so this is your last chance to head out of here. Unfortunately we gotta get the law involved if you stick around.
localization.pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_halls_closing_repe: Hey all, we're closing up soon so you'll have to head out.

localization.pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_trespassing_ig_001: All right, that's it. DefenseCon is closed. I hope everybody listened to my previous announcements and got out.
localization.pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_trespassing_ig_002: DefenseCon is now closed for the day. Really hope that nobody stuck around after they locked the doors.
localization.pu_dcann01_f_lpa_warn_trespassing_ig_003: All right, doors are locked. Great work everybody, and I really hope none of our attendees thought they'd be clever and hide out in here.

localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_datahackdiscovered: Are the Nine Tails stealing Crusader data? Could this be the reason for the whole assault? It doesn't matter. Shut it down if you can.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_datahackstopped_gp: Crusader will pleased to know we managed to protect their data from getting into the Nine Tails' hands. Who knows what they were after and why.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_elitedeadencourage: I ran that Nine Tail through our system and it seems they were one of the gang's more senior members. Might be worth taking a look to see if they had anything vital on them.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_elitedeadiktihint_: That's one problem sorted. It might be worth seeing if these Crusader ATLS could be repurposed to fit your needs. Seems a shame to waste such potentially useful hardware.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_elitedeadsearchbod: I think you found the access code holder.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_eliteweaponcacheke: Interesting. That's an access code, but sadly not for the inverter. There must be something else around here it opens up. Keep an eye out.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_findkeyheadinside_: Good. Now we can open the door and get to Mendo Ren.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_fullsecurityreset_: That should do it. This branch of the security network is back online and hopefully the elevator's working.
That was the last node needing to be reset. This security network branch has been fully restored and the elevator should be back online.
That was all of this branch's nodes. The security network should be reset. Head to the elevator and see if it's operational.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_genericmissionaban: This is Northrock. As a company, we need our contractors to fulfill on the promise of the contract. Leaving before it is complete is not that.
Adrienne from Northrock here. Just calling to confirm that we've received your request to terminate the contract early. I can accommodate you this time, but please avoid doing this in future.
Northrock here. In the future, please don't accept our contracts if you aren't able to see them through. It is the considerate thing to do.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_genericmissionacce: Adrienne from Northrock here. I have received confirmation that you are beginning one of our contracts. I will be serving as your Logisitics Officer as needed but all the details should be in the brief. Good luck.
This is Adrienne from Northrock. Thank you for taking on this contract. I am looking forward to working together and will be monitoring your progress. Feel free to proceed as you see fit.
Northrock here. I'll be managing your contract on the operations side. I don't foresee any complication at the moment so I am expecting a good outcome. Good luck.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_genericmissioncomp: This is Northrock. You have hereby completed all necessary requirements to close out that contract. I appreciate your diligence in this matter.
Adrienne again. Everything looks good on my end, so I'm going to conclude this contract. Thank you for your effort.

Hi, this is Adrienne calling. Looks like you've taken care of everything needed to close out this contract. Excellent. I'll forward this along to accounts and get you paid. Enjoy the rest of your day.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_genericmissionfail: Northrock calling. Apologies, but you have failed to meet the requirements outlined in the contract so we are terminating this operation. Thank you for your time.
Adrienne from Northrock here. I have to pull this contract from you since you failed to adhere to the parameters outlined. I recommend you adjust your mindset when working for us in the future.
Hello, this is Adrienne. After careful consideration, it is my opinion that this contract is currently untenable based on your actions, so we're going to cancel it. You understand how it is.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_goodwork_gp_001,p: Nicely done. That was expertly handled.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_goodwork_gp_002,p: Wonderful. Just the result we had been hoping for.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_goodwork_gp_003,p: Excellent. Fine work to be sure.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_hostilesobjectives: Got hostiles inbound to your position.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_hostilesreinforcem: I've identified a hostile capital ship.
Scans just flagged a hostile capital ship.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_iffidisablebarge_g: That's it. The inverter is now offline. Crusader Security have been notified and are sending units in now. They should be more than able to remove the last remnants of the Nine Tails and resecure the platforms.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_iffidisabledisland: I'm reading that Inverter unit is offline and that the signal has been weakened. Well done. There is a shuttle nearby that you can use to head to the next platform. The sooner we shut down the other units, the sooner Crusader Security can regain control.

Just received confirmation that this inverter unit is offline. The signal is barely hanging on but it's still enough to keep Crusader's ships at bay. There is a shuttle nearby that you that will take you to the next platform and the final inverter.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_island2secondsecti: The Nine Tails have built up their forces throughout this area. You'll need to find a way through to reach the inverter.
Prepare yourself. Reinforcements are closing in. Take care of them.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_kopioncallout_gp_0: Nine Tail trained kopions. Don't let them get close.
Kopion units. Keep your distance if you can.
A pack of Nine Tail kopion have your scent. Don't let them pin you down.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_leaveiktihint_gp_0: You'll have to leave the ATLS here. Sadly, there's no way to bring the units through there.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2confirm: There. The Lieutenant's finally joined the party. Engage and take them out.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2deadenc: Nicely done. Go ahead and search them for the inverter code.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2iffiacc: Just as we hoped. Now you can shut down this inverter unit.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2moredro: Be alert. There's another dropship headed your way.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenant2takeout: Heads up. They brought air support. Focus on taking them out.
Good news. Crusader has informed me that there should be some anti-air weapons stored nearby. See if you can find them.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenantappearsc: That is one of Mendo Ren's lieutenants. They must have the inverter code for this platform. You're cleared to engage.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenantdeadenco: Expertly handled. See if they have the inverter code on them.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lieutenantiffiacce: Excellent. Now you can use the inverter code to deactivate this platform's unit.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedelevator_gp_: This elevator will be offline until the security network is reset.
You won't be able to use the elevator while the security network is still under Nine Tails control.
Try resetting the security network to get the elevator online again.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedelevatorfirs: I have been in contact with a Crusader Security liaison and they've informed me that elevators on the platforms are designed to go into lockdown when the security network is compromised. If you perform a manual reset on all the nodes on this branch of the network, it should become operational again.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockediffiintereac: There's no way to shut the inverter down without the code.
Only Mendo or his commanders will have the codes needed to shut the inverters down.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_lockedweaponscache: Locked. A senior Nine Tails member might have access to it.
You'll need the access codes of a senior Nine Tails member if you want to open it.
It won't open without the code from a senior Nine Tails member.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_mendodeadsearchbod: Kill confirmed. Congratulations. Many have tried to eliminate Mendo Ren before you. Search his body and see if he's holding the last inverter code.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_mendoreniiffiacces: There. That's the final code we need to shut down this inverter signal once and for all.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missionacceptintro: Excellent. This is Adrienne Du-Buisson with Northrock and I will be your logistics officer. It is a pleasure to have you handling this operation for us. Unfortunately, the Nine Tails have blocked all air traffic so you will have to take a shuttle there. I've alerted Crusader Security that you and your support team are en route to the platforms now.  As you can imagine, they are eager to have this whole Nine Tails problem resolved as quickly as possible. Maybe next time, they will contact us sooner. For now, get your gear and make your way to the platform shuttle.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missionbrief_gp_00: Okay, now that you're en route to the first platform, here is what you need to know. Several hours ago, members of the Nine Tails gang took over several Crusader platforms and installed Identity Friend or Foe Inverters to control the airspace. Your main objective will be to disable these inverters allowing security forces to enter and resecure the islands. Crusader Security tried their best to retake the platforms themselves but experienced heavy casualties. That's when they finally contacted us, believing that one of our small, well-trained strikeforces will have success where they failed. We've managed to make contact with one of their teams still in place on the second platform.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missionbriefnoikti: Okay, now that you're en route to the first platform, here is what you need to know. Several hours ago, members of the Nine Tails gang took over several Crusader platforms and installed Identity Friend or Foe Inverters to control the airspace. Your main objective will be to disable these inverters allowing security forces to enter and resecure the islands. Crusader Security tried their best to retake the platforms themselves but experienced heavy casualties. That's when they finally contacted us, believing that one of our small, well-trained strikeforces will have success where they failed. You can expect heavy Nine Tails' resistance once you touch down. Best of luck, I will be checking your progress and updating you as needed.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missionbriefrespon: I have been trying to re-establish contact with the team on the first platform to no avail. They were under heavy Nine Tail mortar fire so until we hear otherwise, best to consider them a total loss. Those mortars will be your first obstacle to clear once you touch down. After you clear the Inverter on the first platform, you should rendezvous with any remaining Crusader personnel on the second. Best of luck to you all, I will be checking your progress and updating you as needed.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missioncomplete_gp: On behalf of Northrock, let me congratulate you on a succesful operation. Crusader is a very important client and I believe they will be more than satisfied by the results you've delivered. Perhaps even more importantly, Mendo Ren was dealt with and that will prove to be very welcome news to more than one interested party. You should feel pride in what you've accomplished here today. And with that, farewell until our next contract.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missionconclusioni: Perfect. Now that you're here, I'm going to do a bit of bookkeeping and close this current contract. Go ahead and take the elevator up to the shuttle. I've been in communication with Crusader reps and I should have more information and an updated contract for you soon.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missionstart_gp_00: Hello, Adrienne Du-Buisson with Northrock here. To catch you up, it seems Crusader Security's attempts to take back their platforms from the Nine Tails gang members have been impressively unsuccessful so far. I am still collating the finer details of the situation and will have a full debrief ready for you once you're under way. The shuttle that will take you to the platforms should be just ahead.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missionupdatebarge: Docked at the next platform is the cargo barge the Nine Tails used to sneak past Crusader security and where you will find Mendo Ren hiding. Deal with him and that will be the final inverter code.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_missionupdateislan: Now that we're underway to the next platform, I will patch Captain Reynolds in for a status update. Captain, are you there?
An increase in Nine Tails presence doesn't bode well. Let's rendezvous with Captain Reynolds and see if we cannot combine our efforts to get to the inverter.
As you make your way to the next platform, understand that by shutting down an inverter, the Nine Tails may be adjusting their offensive strategy. So be careful.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_partialsecurityres: That's one node reset. Just need to complete the rest to bring the system back online.
That security node has been reset. Do the same to the rest and we shall be in good shape.
That node is back online. Once you finish resetting the others, we can bring this whole branch of the security network back online.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_puzzledooropenconf: Interesting. Didn't even know this area was accessible. Check it out and then let's get back on track.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_reinforcementsarri: Prepare yourselves. Nine Tail reinforcements arriving. They don't seem to be happy about our progress so far.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_requireaniktitosol: Seems we are at an impasse. You might be able to use one of those Crusader ATLSes to proceed.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_respondstomendoren: No surprise that Mendo knows we are coming for him. Let's finish this.
Mendo Ren may be putting on a tough act, but I suspect your efforts are beginning to weaken his resolve. Let us see how bold he is after we shut down the next inverter.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_respondtoikitilead: Shit. Make your way into the Nine Tails ship and deal with this threat before it can become even more of an issue.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_respondtomendorenl: Vocal analysis identifed that as Mendo Ren, a high up commander in the Nine Tails. Northrock operatives have tried to apprehend him in the past with little success. His presence here explains why this was such a well-organized affair. If past experience is anything to go on, it is highly likely that he and his trusted lieutenants will be personally holding the access codes to the inverters. Taking them out will be a critical step to regaining control of the airspace around the platforms. Best keep your wits about you as you proceed.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_ridingelevatortoli: Satellite imagery confirmed that another of Mendo Ren's lieutenants is on the roof. They will be holding the inverter code for this platform and as such will be your next target.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_securityresetfirst: That's the first node reset. Get the rest of the nodes on this branch of the network back online and you'll be able to access the elevator.
That's all the nodes on this branch of the security network back online. The elevator should now be operational again.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_shuttleontheway_gp: There's a ship headed to your location now to take you back to the shuttle platform you embarked from. Apologies that they won't be able to take you all the way back, but they're needed for rescue operations.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_snipercallout_gp_0: Careful. There are snipers locked onto your position.
Be on alert. There are sniper nests nearby.
Word of warning. There may be snipers in the area. Use caution.
localization.pu_dubuisson_nor_f_mc_weaponcacheopenedf: So that's what the access code was for. Take a look inside and feel free to grab anything you deem useful.
localization.pu_dulli_uee_f_deh_huntpolarisresponseto: That was Amelia Boyd, leader of the Frontier Fighters. Don't let her faze you. Stay focused and let's get this done.
I don't know who she's trying to convince. If she honestly expects us to let them get away with stealing a Polaris, she's crazier than I thought.
Amelia talks a good game, but at the end of the day the Frontier Fighters are just glorified murderers. I'm counting on you to shut them down here and now.

localization.pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambusharrive_gp_001,p: Looks like we beat them here. Find a good place to post up and we'll wait.
localization.pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambusharrive_gp_002,p: No sign of 'em yet. Pick a spot and go dark. I'm sure they'll be here soon.
localization.pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambushobjectivehammer: Dammit, can't believe they took out that Navy ship. Got word from one of my contacts that they spotted some Frontier Fighters ships around a suspected transient jump point into Pyro. I think that's where the Polaris might be heading. Let's get over there and maybe we can turn the tables on them for once.

I'm scrambling Rescue teams to look for survivors from that Navy ship. We snatched a Frontier Fighter pilot and put the full burn on him. He didn't want to be tied to killing Navy so he flipped quick and gave up the location of a transient jump point the Polaris is gonna use to get out of the system. Get over there and set up an ambush.

Just got word from that Navy ship. They picked up some Frontier Fighter survivors and  squeezed them about where the Polaris rendezvous was. Turns out they've found a transient jump point into Pyro. Here's the location. Get over there and we can jump them before they escape the system.

Nice work. Just found one of the Frontier Fighter survivors gave up Boyd's rendezvous. They're looking at using a transient jump point to slip into Pyro undetected. If you move quick, you could get the drop on them before they escape.
localization.pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambushwait_gp_001,p: Go when you want to go, but I'd wait until you have eyes on the Polaris.
localization.pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_ambushwait_gp_002,p: Finally some luck. Hold until you're ready to go.

Those look like Frontier Fighters. No Polaris though. Take 'em out.
Contact. Frontier Fighter ships. Weapons free.
localization.pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_polarisescapes1_gp_00: Dammit, the Polaris quantumed away. Clean up these Frontier Fighters and we'll go after it.
Shit. The Polaris made a break for it. Secure the area and then we'll go after them.
localization.pu_dulli_uee_f_deo_polarisescapes2_gp_00: I'm getting a little sick of these Frontier Fighters hauling ass at the first sight of trouble. Clear these hostiles and keep after 'em.
Polaris is on the move. Amelia Boyd doesn't seem too concerned about abandoning her people. Take them out and we'll stay on her.

Contact. Frontier Fighter ships. Weapons free.
localization.pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_huntpolarismissionacc: Thanks for the assist. Hopefully you're up to speed with the mission specifics, but just in case you skimmed. Frontier Fighters stole a fully armed Polaris while in transit to the Invictus ceremony. Not sure what they've got planned for it, whether it's some future op or just to terrorize Stanton but bottom line, we can't let them get away with that ship. Navy's cleared us to take it out, so that's what we're gonna do. This thing's heavy, armed, and dangerous so I'd recommend bringing friends, breaking out the big ships, or both. Let's go hunting.
localization.pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_huntpolarismissioncom: The Polaris is down. Helluva job y'all.
Nice job taking out that Polaris before it could run again.
localization.pu_dulli_uee_f_pmh_huntpolarismissionfai: That Polaris got away. This isn't good people. God knows what Boyd and the rest of those lunatics are gonna do with it.
Shit… lost contact with the Polaris. I don't think we're gonna pick them up again. I gotta make some calls. You're dismissed.
