localization.pu_eckhart_mg_farewell_missionaccepted_i: Let me know when it's done.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_farewell_missiondeclined_i: Fine. Come back when you actually want to work.
Your loss. Talk to you later.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_acceptsmission_v_w: Great. Here's the tracking address for the ship. Let me know once you have the blackbox data.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_comm_v_wp_001_heyh: Hey, how are you? Miles Eckhart.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_comm_v_wp_002_afri: A friend over at Crusader Security said you've building quite a rep. I run a modest security outfit and I'm always on the lookout for capable people who don't rattle.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_comm_v_wp_003_ifyo: If you're interested in picking up some extra work, we should talk. I'll send my details.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_leavesmoon_v_wp_00: If you don't mind, I'll just have a look myself.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_playersits_v_wp_00: Sorry for the locale, don't look like much but the homemade stuff has some kick.

Anyway, a job came in late last night. Some idiot hauler cut through low-sec space, got his crew vented. Company needs to retrieve the ship's blackbox to claim insurance on the lost cargo. Should be a romper job: get in, get out, but all my people are tied up with bigger ops, so I figured I could use this as a chance to make a new friend.
I'll send the details. Let me know if you're interested.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_sentbbdata_v_wp_00: Got the blackbox data and verified it. I'll send it off. Great job.
You know... I'm just going to throw this out, but I ended up talking to a couple contacts of mine, turns out the pack that hit that ship are squatting in an old facility on that nearby moon.

I'm just talking here, but it's not crazy to think that they're keeping the cargo there. These outlaws are scum, so it's not like anyone'll miss 'em and the company is gonna claim the insurance, so it wouldn't technically be stealing if you happened to head on down and take it.
Again, I'm not saying anything here, I'm just gonna send along a location on that moon and... do what you want.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_gcintro_spotsplayer_v_wp_0: Glad you could make it, grab a seat.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_greetings_bad_ig_004_iaint: I ain't got time for your shit right now.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_idleconvo_v_003_welltellhi: Tell him if he doesn't like the prices, he doesn't have to pay them. I'm sure some other cut-rate outfit will run an escort for less, just don't come running back to me when they shit their pants at the first sight of outlaws. If he survives the attack, of course...
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_idleconvo_v_004_noimseriou: No, I'm serious, tell him that. I'll wait.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_idleconvo_v_005_yeahthough: Yeah, thought so. Do me a favor, next time your boss tries to grow some balls, remind him of this conversation or I'll come by his office and remind him how binding our contract is.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_intro_comm_v_wp_bad_001_he: Hey there. A couple associates of mine passed me your name. If you're looking for some strongarm stuff, I'm always looking for good soldiers. Here's my details.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_intro_playersits_v_wp_bad_: From time to time, jobs find their way to me that aren't "orthodox" requests.
There's a better way to say that... but let's just say they aren't the kind of ops you can give to just anyone. They require a very specific type of person.
Now, mutual friends have told me that you might be one of those precious few who are capable of completing a contract without question.
If I'm wrong, we can leave it at that. Enjoy a drink in my spectacular company for a few minutes then we'll part ways with the understanding that this meeting never happened.
But if I'm right, then I might just have a gig that I could use you for.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_intro_playersits_v_wp_good: Sorry for the locale, don't look like much but the homemade stuff has some kick. Anyway, I've been hearing good things about you. Real stand-up sort. Just the type of people I like to know. As I mentioned, I run a small security outfit, we handle all sorts of ops, so I'm always on the lookout for people who know how to handle themselves in a scrap.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_intro_takeseat_v_wp_good_0: Hey there, sport. Grab a seat.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objcomplete_ig_: You're making good progress. Keep it up.
Keep going, slick. I want this whole thing wrapped up soon.
Client will be glad to know we're making progress.
That part's done. Now you just got to handle the rest.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objfail_ig_001_: How the hell did you lose it?
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objfail_ig_003_: You lost the package! What the hell.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objfail_ig_004_: Seriously? You didn't get it? What is this? Amateur hour?
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objfail_ig_005_: How could you let it slip through your fingers?
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_objupdate_ig_00: Mission parameters have changed. Updating you now.
Got an update for you, slick. Things got a little more complicated.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_quit_ig_001_fin: Fine. You don't want the job, forget it.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_quit_ig_002_did: Didn't take you for a quitter. Guess I was wrong.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_midmission_quit_ig_003_you: You're just gonna walk away? Just like that? Real nice.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_hosta: We just received a bid for a forced extraction. Client's being held against their will and it's up to us to secure their freedom and make sure that the abductors are duly punished.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_ambush_kill_: Client's need to get someone gone. They've provided a detailed analysis of the target's movements and want you to set up an ambush.
Word is that a High Value Target has come out of hiding. Don't ask me how, but I got a line on their flight path, so we're gonna hit 'em. Well, you are.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_bounty_good_: I ever tell you that I started out as a bounty hunter? Yeah, after three tours, I guess I wasn't ready for the dogfighting to end. Couldn't stomach the thought of being a cop though. Too many bad run-ins as a kid, you know? I started hunting down criminals. Seemed like a decent compromise. Anyway, although we've moved mostly into security roles, I still keep tabs on open bounties.
If you're looking for some easy creds, got another bounty wasting away on the pile.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_breakout_pri: There's no easy way to say this so I'm just gonna come out and say it... I need you to knock over a prison. Yeah, yeah, it's kinda messed up, I know. We've got a client locked inside who's paying good money to get sprung. It's a whole lotta heat if this goes bad, so you gotta be sure you can pull this off.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_breakout_sec: Another client's gone and gotten pinched. They're currently being held at a security post. Would you mind retrieving them?
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_find: There's some cargo I'm looking to get ahold of. Only snag is that the owner is unwilling to part with it. I'm sure that won't stop someone like you.

I've got some clients who've lost some property. They're sparing no expense to get it back if it hasn't been destroyed. They've sent along a rough area where you can start your search. You're to find, retrieve and bring back this property intact.
Got another line on some cargo on the drift. I'll send the details if you're interested.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_inve: Here's the deal. There's a couple wrecks on the drift and you're going to go take for look for the client. See what you can find. Report back. Simple as can be.
We've been hired to check out some wrecks in the area. If you got some time, I'll send the details.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_collect_pira: Here's a retrieval opportunity for you. Outlaws hit a hauling convoy recently and they've been taking their time picking at the carcass. There is a piece that I'd like you to retrieve before they discover it.
Got a retrieval op for you. Word from the client is that enemy contacts are still in the area, so watch yourself.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_contractkill: Client just came through with a job. This is a straight-up ghosting. Find the target and eliminate. You'll be paid accordingly. And don't even think about getting caught.
Got another empty casket come over the comm. You busy?
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_defend_bad_i: I know you're pretty good at taking people down, but how are you with defense? I've got a gig that's pretty heavy on digging in and holding out against an assault.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_defend_good_: We've been hired to help bulk up defenses against a prospective assault. Take a look at the op specs, see if it's something you can help with.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_bad_: Hmm ... I've got some cargo that needs to move through the system without a lot of extra scrutiny, if you catch my meaning.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_bomb: Bit of an unusual request came in, clients want a problem taken care of in the noisiest way possible. I trust you're comfortable working with explosives? Pretty much just like dropping off a regular package if you think about it.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_good: Got a straight delivery run for you. Cargo needs to get there untouched and intact. Details will follow, but there's a possibility of enemy contact, so eyes open.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_pick: Got an exchange going down that needs a bagman. You give them something. They give you something back. Easy. Now these people aren't the most trustworthy sorts, so be ready if they get any bright ideas.
One of my usual guys fell through, you think you could do a run? They might have something for you to pick up as well.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_deliver_time: Need another runner job. You'd be on a clock, so don't mess around.
Got a rush delivery. You'll need to get the package to the location on time, no exceptions. Have a look at the route and see if it's feasible.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_atob_: Hey, I got a client who's looking for an escort. Standard deal: keep a low profile and make sure they arrive alive, okay?
Got a client that needs an escort. Way the universe's been going to shit, I figure this isn't going to be for show, so stay sharp.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_passe: I might need you to take on a passenger. Make sure they got a comfy seat and don't ask any questions. The less you know, the better.
You got a ship that can carry passengers, right? I got a client that's looking for a transport. Should be easy credits.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_sever: Got a comm from a client looking for a little extra protection while they make their rounds. Should be pretty straightforward: keep your mouth shut and follow their lead.
I've got a VIP who needs a bodyguard for a series of stops.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_escort_survi: Client needs a heavy-hitter to back them up. You're going to be muscle and escort, so tune up the target while keeping the client alive.
You busy? I need somebody who's willing to crack some heads. I'll send the details.
Local Law's been calling and need some more backup. I'll send the location and target.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_investigate_: To give you some backstory here, one of the many services Eckhart Security provides is as independent investigators. Sometimes that means extracting blackbox data, pulling datapads from wrecks or even looking for missing persons. Different day, different job. That's what my dad always said.
I have another snoop job if you're interested.

The advocacy ain't doing their job, so we get to pick up the slack. There's a wreck with some evidence on it that could get one of our clients off the hook. And since a client's worth more out of jail than in it, I need you to go fetch it.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_recover_good: Got a tip that some smugglers have set up a planetside dead drop. No telling what kind of stolen swag they got down there, but might be good for a reward or something.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionbriefs_steal_bad_ig: There's some cargo I need. I've made them some generous offers, but they don't seem interested in selling. I'd like you to get it for me.
There's talk that some valuable cargo got snatched. I've got a fence already lined up, so I need you to get it for me.
Got another boost job if you got the time.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_comm_ig_00: I think we're good. Transferring the funds.
Thanks for taking care of that. We're all set. Nice work.
I'll send your pay. Go buy something nice.
I'll let the client know... thanks.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_ig_002_ith: I think we're good. Transferring the funds.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_ig_003_tha: Thanks for taking care of that. We're all set. Nice work.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missioncomplete_ig_004_ill: I'll send your pay. Go buy something nice.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missiondeactivated_ig_001_: You win some, you lose some. I guess we weren't the only outfit the job got shopped too.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missiondeactivated_ig_002_: You should've moved a little faster.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missiondeactivated_ig_003_: Sorry, situation's gotten more complicated, so I gotta pull the plug on the op.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_001_whatthe: What the hell happened out there?
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_002_damnity: Damn it. You really screwed me on this. Not good, Slick. Not good.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_003_igaveyo: I gave you a simple job and you boned me.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_004_doyouha: Do you have any idea how many creds you just cost us?
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_missionfail_ig_005_itruste: I trusted you to handle this and you really dropped the ball.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_bad_ig_002_soit: So, it turns out, I might be in need of your services.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_bad_ig_003_anot: Another job's popped up. Thought you'd be a good fit.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_good_ig_001_got: Got a new job if you're interested.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_good_ig_002_don: Don't know what your sched is looking like, but I got a gig.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_goodforbad_ig_0: Got a new gig for you. This one's straight-up legit, so be on your best behavior.
I'm really shorthanded and I've got an op that needs handling that's outside your usual purview, but hey, credits are credits, right?
Got a bit of business that needs doing. Figured I'd toss it your way.
If you're looking to make a few creds, here's your chance.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_jobboard_ig_001: So here's the deal, business has been booming, which is great because I'm trying to snag this swank seaside property on Casell, but I've got more gigs than operators at the moment. Have a look and see if there's any you'd like to take off my plate.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_jobboard_ig_002: Kinda busy at the moment, slick, but I got jobs if you're looking, so tell me which you want. You know what to do.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_newmission_jobboard_ig_003: Tell me if there's an op you want to take.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_revisit_currentlyonmission: Let's get on the clock, come on.
You got the details, so get moving.
This shit ain't gonna sort itself out. Let's go.
I'm not paying you to stand around.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_revisit_failedlastchance_i: If I wasn't so short-handed, I wouldn't even be talking to you, but I'm in a bind, so this is your lucky day. You do whatever you gotta do to get your head right because if you fuck this up, I'll break your goddamn legs.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_revisit_failedlastmission_: I'll be honest with you. I'm hurt. More than a little annoyed, but mostly disappointed in myself for misjudging you. I'm gonna give you a shot to redeem yourself.
I take a lot of time setting up these missions, so don't take them if you can't deliver. You have no idea how much it pisses me off watching credits slip away.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_revisit_negmissionrep_ig_0: We ain't got nothing to talk about.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_revisit_nomission_ig_001_d: Don't have anything at the moment. Check back with me later.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_revisit_nomission_ig_002_i: I'm kicking some bushes, trying to scare up some gigs, but I'm a little light right now.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_revisit_nomission_ig_003_h: Hit me up some other time.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_revisit_succeededlastmissi: Before we get down to business, I gotta say, helluva job on that last run.
We're making quite a team here. Couple more of these and I might treat myself.
Great job on that last op.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_sendingdetails_ig_004_here: Here's a breakdown of the op.
localization.pu_eckhart_mg_wantstransitiontobad_v_wp_: I've been hearing some interesting things about you, slick. As a proud part of the UEE, Empire Health Services is here to provide equal and fair medical treatment to all.
localization.pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_announce_hospital_wel: For your convenience, there are sanitizing stations located throughout the facility. With your help, we can stop the spread of germs.
Please remember that regeneration doesn't fix everything. As advanced as current technology is, there's no substitute for caution and prevention. When in doubt, just stop. It's not worth the risk.
When it comes to addiction, you don't have to suffer alone. If you or someone you know is experiencing issues of addiction, contact the EHS Addiction Center and get the help you need.
Everyone deserves a chance at a better life. Sign up today to become a cybernetic donor and give someone less fortunate the greatest gift of all.
localization.pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_done_i: Attention. The emergency situation has been resolved. Repeat. The emergency has been resolved. You are free to go about your business.
localization.pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_inprog: Attention. We are currently working to resolve the emergency situation. Please continue to follow all instructions and obey staff. Thank you.
localization.pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_remain: Attention. This is an emergency alert. Please remain where you are until the situation is resolved. Repeat, please remain where you are.
localization.pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_warn_emergency_vacate: Attention. This is an emergency alert. Please vacate the premises in a calm manner. Repeat. Please vacate the premises.
localization.pu_ehshosp01_m_lpa_welcome_hospital_ehs_: Welcome to Empire Health Services. Dedicated to providing better care for all for over three centuries.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotarrives_gp: Watch yourself. Got an inbound ship that's already taken out some skilled CFP pilots.
Look out. I've heard stories about that ship. Better be ready.
Got a dangerous pilot heading your way. Watch out.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotcollectibl: Wonder if that pilot was carrying anything interesting. Might be worth checking out.
Just to say, pilots of that caliber tend to carry some interesting gear. Maybe have a look if you want.
By the way, anything you find in the wreckage of that ship is all yours.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotdestroyed_: Sorry it had to come to this, but glad you came out on top.
I wished we could've talked it through, but I'm glad to be rid of that ship.
I know CFP is hoping for more peaceful ways to ways to enact change, but that pilot wasn't helping.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_acepilotescapes_gp: Would've been great if you took out that ship, but I still consider that a win for CFP.
That pilot was smart enough to clock a losing battle. Guess we'll deal with them another day.
Good. They're gone. Maybe they'll twice before messing with CFP again.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambusharriveatloca: Great, you're there. Find a spot and lower your signature.
For this to work, you better hide and keep your sig as low as possible.
Okay. Now that you're there, find cover and go dark before they get here.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushhideinmarked: Our advance team recommended a good spot to hide. I'll share it with you.
Marked a location for you. Head there and it should help hide your sig.
Got a decent spot where you can go dark. Flagged it for you.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushtargetmissin: Heads up. Ships are inbound but not seeing the target.
You've got company... But I don't see the target yet...
Contacts heading your way. Don't see the target though.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushtargetspotte: Get ready. Here comes the target.
That's who we want. Target sighted.
Target confirmed. Go on your mark.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushwait_gp_001,: Hold tight. Targets should be inbound soon.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushwait_gp_002,: Go ahead and relax. I'll let you know when they're close.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_ambushwait_gp_003,: Stay in position. Shouldn't be long now.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipdestroy: Good work! No telling how many they would've brought back.
Nice, that ship would've been a problem if it got away.
Normally CFP doesn't advocate engaging fleeing ships, but they would've made this situation worse.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipescapes: Damn, that ship got away. Bet they'll be back with friends.
Uh oh. They got away. I'd expect them to get reinforcements soon.
Too bad you lost that ship. Hope you've got enough ammo to deal with what's coming back with it.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshipreinfor: That ship you couldn't take care of earlier is back. With friends too.
Scans are showing that you got more incoming. I knew that ship was gonna come back to haunt us.
Things are about to get intense. That runner is back and brought friends.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_chickenshiprun_gp_: We got a runner. Better stop it or it'll return with reinforcements.
That ship's running for it. Don't let it escape.
Watch out! That ship's running for reinforcements. Stop it if you can.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipdistress: Need you to step up. Our ship's in serious trouble.
Our ship needs your help. Not sure how long it'll last.
Let's go. You gotta protect that ship.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipobjectiv: That was close. Thanks for stepping up for us.
Glad you were available to help. Don't know what we would've done without you.
I'll check that off the list. Good work out there.
Damn. They're gone. I hate days like this.
We lost the ship... If working for CFP has taught me anything, it's that sometimes even when you do all you can, it's still not enough.
Thanks for trying. [Sigh] I better go let the team know the ship didn't make it.
If this job has taught me anything, it's that sometimes the bad guys win. But what's important is keeping up the good fight no matter what.
Gotta admit, I was really hoping you'd pull that off.
That didn't go to plan, but don't let that discourage you.
Bet our ship is happy to see you. Do everything you can to keep it safe.
Great, you made it. Now comes the hard part. Good luck protecting our ship.
No time to waste. Better start helping before it's too late.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_defendshipreminder: Remember, defending that ship is your primary objective.
Know there's a lot going on, but don't forget to protect our ship.
Please help that ship. It should be your top priority.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyfindsabandone: Interesting. Found a derelict nearby. Feel free to check it out, but I'd be careful if I were you.
Scans picked up a derelict ship not too far from you. You can have a look if you want.
Scans found a derelict ship in that sector. I'll leave it up to you whether you want to investigate it or not.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptyscanfalsenega: Think we can move on. Wait... hold tight. Might have something here.
One second… Ok, thought we were clear but there's definintely something out there.
Thanks for your patience. Let me just double check... Yup, I'm seeing something now.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_emptywaitscanlocat: Maintain position while I scan the area.
Do me a favor. Sit tight while I do a scan.
Want to do a scan before moving on.
Gonna run a scan to make sure we didn't miss anything.
Let me do a quick scan here.
Take a breather. Got to scan the area.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_friendlyreinforcem: I scrambled some CFP forces and sent them your way. Should be there soon.
Don't worry, CFP has your back. Sending you some help.
Shared your location with some other CFP members. They're flying in fast.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesdestroyede: That's it. You're doing a helluva job.
Yes! One less bad guy to worry about.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesobjectivec: You're clear. That was intense, huh?
Hostiles clear. Don't know about you, but my heart's almost beating outta my chest after that.
Not seeing any more hostiles. That was impressive.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesobjectives: I'm seeing hostiles in your area.
Here comes the heat. Hope you're ready.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_hostilesreinforcem: I'm seeing reinforcements flying in now.
Careful. Got a cap ship inbound.
Uh oh. I'm seeing a big ship heading your way.
Capital ship inbound. Here comes the big guns.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdfriendlysatellit: Just checking that this CFP satellite is functioning properly. Yup, good to go.
Looks like that satellite is ours. We're good go move on.
Cool. That's a CFP satellite. Nothing to worry about.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdmovetonextscan_g: How about we check the next one?
Head out to the next scan point.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdnothingfound_gp_: Scans look good on my side.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdobjectivecomplet: That should do it. Thanks for the help.
Appreciate the help sweeping through the sector.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_: Can you do a focused scan for us here? Thanks.
We need a better look here. Run a focused scan please.
Gonna need you to run a focused scan here.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdillegalsatellite: That satellite's definitely not ours. You're clear to eliminate it.
Ok, I've double-checked CFP records and not seeing anything about one of our satellites being there. Let's get rid of it.
Huh... that satellite wasn't there the last time we checked this sector. Better clear it away.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_deo_sdobjectivestart_g: Ok, got my list of areas you need to check for us. Go to each one and run a scan to see what's there.
Let's do a sweep through the sector. Head to each marker and ping your scanner.
Thanks for doing this sweep. Ping your scanner at the POIs I marked and let's see if there's anything out there.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_ambushmissionaccep: Hi, it's Lima. These ships have been terrorizing us for a while, so getting rid of them would be a big win. Good luck.
Lima here. Letting you know that I've triple confirmed all the ambush details. Head out and I'll advise when you're on site.
Everything's set on our side. CFP got this intel from one of our best sources, so let's make the most of it, ok? Good luck.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendmissionaccep: Lima here. Thanks for fighting the good fight. I've spent some time at that site and would hate to see CFP lose it.
Hey, it's Lima with CFP. Getting reports that the assault on that location is getting pretty intense. Better be prepared and bring plenty of gear.
Hey, thanks for stepping up to help protect our base. CFP needs more people like you to make this system safe.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_defendshipmissiona: Hey, it's Lima with CFP. Our crew on that ship are growing desperate. Grab what you need and get there as fast as you can.
Lima here with a quick update. I've commed the ship and let them know help is en route. Appreciate you stepping up for us.
It's Lima. Really glad you're available to help because it's essential that ship arrives at its destination. Good luck.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionaban: Hi, it's Lima with CFP. Thanks for letting us know you won't be finishing that job. Hopefully the next one will be more your speed.
Lima here. Saw you opted out of the contract you took. No problem I'll put it back into the system. Hope everything's ok out there.
Hey, it's Lima. Got flagged that you dropped that contract. I get it. Sometimes a gig just isn't the right fit. Sure you'll do better on the next one.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionacce: Hi, it's Lima with Citizens for Prosperity. Just wanted to thank you for coming on board. Good luck out there.
Thanks for lending a hand. Citizens for Prosperity truly appreciates your help and support.
Hey, it's Lima from CFP. Just wanted to thank you for picking up that contract. We can really use your help.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissioncomp: Hi, it's Lima. I'm just double-checking, but I think you knocked out everything we needed. I'll get your payment settled. Thanks again.
Hi there. I just saw you completed that last contract. I'm right in the middle of putting together a gift basket for a new outpost we're opening, but I'm sending your payment.
Hey, got a notice that you've closed out that contract. Appreciate you taking care of it for us. I'll process your payment now.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_genericmissionfail: Looks like you ran into some trouble with that last contract. Know it's rough out there, so don't be too tough on yourself about it.
Lima here. Sorry this contract didn't work out. Maybe grab another one and apply what you learned on this run to make the next one a success.
Hey, it's Lima. Sucks about that last contract, but hope it doesn't discourage you from doing another. CFP needs all the help it can get.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolmissionaccep: Thanks for grabbing that contract. Only way CFP can bring security to this system is if good folks like you are out there patrolling it.
Lima here with CFP. You should stock up before going out. Would hate for you to not be ready for anything that comes up. Good luck out there.
Thank you for picking up this patrol. We have to prove to the bad guys that we're here to stay.
localization.pu_endicott_cfp_f_pmh_patrolpointcleared: Sector is clear. Time to move on to the next one.
Thanks for checking that sector. Looks good on my side. Let's go to the next one.
Area is clear. Hope the next one is too.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatend_gp_00: You wasted some of my best fighters. I won't forget this.
You must think you've done something here. All you've done is put a mark on your head.
They deserved better than that. I'm gonna take out all their deaths on you. Mark my words.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatprogresst: Take out as many of us as you like. We’re gonna keep coming back, again, and again, and again. Nothing’s gonna put us down.
There's no way you're coming out of this alive. Give up now, and I promise my fighters will end you quick.
You enjoy being a lapdog for the UEE? You must to keep doing their dirty work for them.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxcombatstart_gp_: You're gonna die now so make it a good death.
Finally, my people have been itching for a fight.
All right, killer, show me what you’ve got.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxfirstallvanduul: Damn! You're pretty good at killing 'duul. Really saved our ass. To show our love… why don't you come land and the people you saved can give you a proper thanks.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxfirstambushcomp: You’re a tough one ain’t you? First the 'duul, now my people? I ain't gonna let you get the best of us again. We'll be ready next time. Trust me on that.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxfirstambushinit: Sorry, killer. Nothing personal, but you ain’t leaving this place alive.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxfirstdatadecryp: Well done, Killer. So now you know all about the Shattered Blade. Won't do you much good. We face down whole clans, so we aren't scared by the likes of you. Think real hard before picking this fight.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxfirstplayerarri: Hey! Can you hear me? My people need help! These 'duul are gonna wipe them all out if you don't do something. Please.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatdatadecry: Oh bravo, you decrypted the data. Don’t make a lick of difference to me. The Shattered can always get more buyers. We're survivors through and through, trust that.

You know, I’m not even angry. I’m actually impressed. If I hadn’t already decided that I’m gonna put a bullet in your brain when I finally get to meet you, I might have offered you a job. Until next time, killer.
You think you’re tough, taking out my gang and stealing our data? You wouldn’t last five minutes where I’m from. You’re nothing.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxrepeatplayerarr: If it isn’t the little rat that’s been scurrying around our storage sites. Come on in, we’ll be sure to give you a big, warm welcome.
Back for more? You just don’t know when to quit, do you? You were lucky to get away last time, but that luck’s about to run out.
If it isn’t our favorite killer! I was wondering when you’d show up. Well, what are you waiting for? Come say hello already!
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_prenyxtauntplayerdeat: Hope your regen's better at fighting than you are.
If you know what's good for you: stay down.
It was only gonna end this way.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2taunt_gp_001: You know, we had a really nice thing going. We were left alone doing our thing, but now we can't turn around without running into one of you UEE assholes.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2taunt_gp_002: You have any idea how long it took us to fortify this place?
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2taunt_gp_003: Here's an idea, can I hire you to just piss off? That's all you mercs care about anyway, right?
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase2tauntknown_g: Well shit. It's you again. Can't seem to be rid of you, can I? Oh well, maybe we'll have better luck this time and put you in the fucking ground.
Back again? I was hoping someone killed you by now. Well, guess we'll have to take care of that.
I'm gonna say it, I’m glad I ran into you again. You killed a lot of good people. Time for payback, asshole.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase3taunt_gp_001: How about this? We blast the shit out of that idris and you can leave. That sound good? You won't have any reason to stay then.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase3taunt_gp_002: People's Alliance could've just walked away. You could have too. But now they die. This should have been so much simpler.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase3taunt_gp_003: Fine. We're gonna go scorched earth, pure annihilation. It's the one thing the Vanduul do right.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase5taunt_gp_001: <crazy scrambled sound> You like that? Hell if I know what it means, but what I do know is that you blast that out on comms, some Vanduul are sure to come running. Have fun.
localization.pu_forge_sha_m_pmh_tsgphase5taunt_gp_002: <crazy scrambled sound> Have you seen what Vanduul do to Humans? It's ugly… raw… merciless. Don't worry if you haven't. You're about to.
localization.pu_fwdrakpa02_m_lpa_announce_drakehall_g: Welcome to DefenseCon. While we at Drake Interplanetary celebrate the brave men and women in the UEE Navy, I think we all know that while they're protecting our borders from Vanduul incursions, Drake is continuing to provide security at home with our affordable and reliable line of ships. Whether you need to haul cargo across the 'verse or protect your homestead from outlaw packs, Drake's got your back.

We've all been there. Some ships pop up on your scanner and they don't look friendly. Sure, you could try to call local law or the Navy, but who are you kidding, you'll be blown up and picked clean long before they show up. Stock up on any one of Drake's versatile, combat-tested ships, and it'll be the outlaws that'll be hollering for the law.

These are dangerous times. That's why Drake Interplanetary builds ships that not only provide function and power at a price that we can all afford, but provide peace of mind. For you. For your family.
DefenseCon's a great opportunity to take a look at the real ships that are out there every day, defending your freedom and moving the gears of this Empire.
localization.pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_announce_diorama_ig_0: While training at one of the Navy Forges on MacArthur, recruits will push themselves to their physical and mental limits, but the real lesson that our Divisional Officers will impart is that the Navy doesn't excel based on the individual, but as a team working together.
localization.pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_announce_generalinfo_: Although Invictus is a celebration of the men and woman who are about to ship off to begin their training, Launch Week not only provides an opportunity to celebrate our recent graduates, but also gives our active service members much needed recreational leave. Be sure to thank a starman today.
For centuries, Invictus has been a time for friends and family to come together and celebrate the pillars of duty, service, and civic pride.
For those with loved ones setting off today to begin their life in the Navy, stop by our Friends and Family booth to get a better understanding of what they have to look forward to in Naval service.
localization.pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_announce_shiphall_aeg: The UEE Navy and Roberts Space Industries have worked together since the earliest days of space expansion. Utilizing their timeless designs to push the boundaries of our universe with ships like to Carrack to defending Humanity with the majesty of the Bengal Carrier, we are proud to have RSI as partners and invite you to see the latest additions to the fleet from this innovative pioneer.

The UEE Navy has always tried to stay at the forefront of innovation. To that end, Consolidated Outland has started to create exciting new opportunities to the Naval fleet with their line of spacecraft.

The UEE Navy and Origin Jumpworks might not seem like the most obvious combination, but their dynamic innovation in pushing the limits of speed provides the backbone for many of the Naval interception and reconaissance units carrying out operations throughout the Empire and beyond.
localization.pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_announce_shiphall_anv: Aegis Dynamics is committed to improving the pilot experience. More so than any other manufacturer, Their reps and engineers are a common fixture at the academy and Naval bases to try and get first-hand accounts of what works and what doesn't in their ships.

Although the Navy is commonly known for the awe-inspiring Bengal and the dynamic Hornet, it's really the utility ships that allow the Navy to function day in and day out. ARGO Astronautics has been one of our valued partners for centuries and can be found on almost all of our capital ships, space stations, and even ground facilities.

Capitalizing on a relationship that's been cemented over centuries, Roberts Space Industries has been there since the very first Invictus and looks forward to working closely with the Navy to develop the next generation of protectors for the Empire.
localization.pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_announce_shiphall_arg: Invictus might be an odd place to reveal a new vehicle type, but Origin's new G12 impressed our test squadrons by operating in a variety of hostile atmospheres and environments. Our Pathfinder units are eager to get their hands on these new rovers.

Although Crusader Industries has been one of the leading manufacturers of commercial transports for a long time, but did you know that they are also responsible for creating military transports? Whether we're moving troops, vehicles or supplies, Crusader ships have been loyal members of the Navy fleet for years and will continue for years to come.

A common sight with our brothers and sisters in the UEE Army, Tumbril Land Systems were responsible for such dependable and versatile ground vehicles that even the Navy found it beneficial to add them to our fleet to secure landing zones in combat operations.

Some of the most valuable members of the UEE Navy never see a moment of combat. Logistics, Support, and Supply ships are the backbone of our fleet as they keep our frontline forces equipped to handle any threat that comes their way. The Navy is proud to count MISC ships as a valuable ally in maintaining combat readiness.
localization.pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_announce_shiphall_gen: Invictus Launch Week is a great opportunity to see your taxes at work. As members of the Empire, it's your right to inspect the latest acquisitions of the UEE Navy.

While fighters like the Hornet and Gladius have become synonymous with the UEE Navy. The truth is that with the variety of operations over the vastness of the Empire, the Navy utilize a variety of ships including some models made for the private sector.

The UEE Navy's small, but elite group of vehicle operators train for a variety of operations, but for their Combat Search & Rescue training, they are some of the few non-Marine military personnel who are invited to train with the Marines on the hostile environments of Corin.
localization.pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_announce_shiphall_rsi: Though not nearly at the numbers that our UEE Army brethren order, the Navy maintains an active, versatile fleet of ground vehicles as well, whether for logistics, transport, or even exploration operations.

The UEE Navy couldn't be prouder of our partnership with Anvil Aerospace. Their fighters, exploration ships, and transports are on the front-line every day keeping the Empire safe. We look forward to our continued relationship with them and invite you to take a look at their work up close.
Ever since Anvil Aerospace emerged with the Terrapin, pilots and politicians alike have cited their spacecraft and vehicles for hundreds of operations from combat to exploration to logistics.
localization.pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_announce_vehiclehall_: The UEE Navy is proud to announce that Anvil Aerospace has been invited to a joint engineering research facility that will be opening on MacArthur in the new year. Together Naval and Anvil engineers and scientists are looking to develop the next generation of ship technology.

The UEE Navy is proud to welcome Aegis Dynamics back to Invictus Launch Week. Though they have created some of the most iconic and decorated Naval ships in our history, their past was draped in shadow for decades. We are thrilled to see that they have truly committed themselves to building a brighter future.

The latest line of defenders from Aegis Dynamics have already been battle-tested throughout the Empire and beyond. With that kind of success, it's no wonder that the Navy expanded their roster of Aegis ships in their fleet.
localization.pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_welcome_conventionent: A time-honored tradition since 2541, Invictus Launch Week is an opportunity for the public and the UEE Navy to celebrate the next generation of men and women who are about to join our ranks to defend the Empire and give you an opportunity to see the latest additions to our fleet of defenders. Please enjoy your day.
localization.pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_welcome_shiphall_ig_0: Welcome to the Invictus Ship Hall. All of the vehicles you see on display are this year's additions to the fleet. With the expanding nature of operations throughout the systems, have a look to see how each of these ships will help defend the Empire.
localization.pu_fwmilpa02_m_lpa_welcome_tramstation_i: Duty. Tradition. Service. We salute those taking their first step to their new life in the UEE Navy. Welcome to Invictus Launch Week.
The UEE Navy would like to welcome you to the Invictus Expo Hall. Make your way inside for a look at the latest and greatest additions to the Navy fleet.
Hello and welcome to Invcictus Launch Week, a celebration of the men and women stepping forward to defend the Empire.
This is the Invictus Launch Week Expo Hall, an opportunity to celebrate the people and ships that are joining the UEE Navy in their ongoing mission to protect the Empire.

localization.pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgdoyourpa: Hurston Dynamics needs your assistance. The Empire has put out the call for resources and Hurston intends to answer. Consult your mobiGlas to see how you can help secure all of our futures in the pursuit of a solution for the regen crisis.
localization.pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggenericm: <bristling with anger> I can't believe you have the gall to take a job and then abandon it.
Don't ever do this again. I need people I can depend on.
Carmichael here. You have an obligation to Hurston and to me to finish a contract you accept.
This is Carmichael from Hurston. It is unacceptable for contractors to not deliver what was promised. Get your shit in order or find another line of work.
What the hell… that contract couldn't have been any easier.
I can't believe it. Hurston demands better from its contractors.
localization.pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsggiverewa: Hey, this is Hurston again. Just got word that the higher ups approved a bonus to help keep you motivated. We expect you to work even harder after this.
Hey, wanted to let you know that you should be receiving a bonus from us. To show your appreciation, Hurston assumes that you will deliver at a higher rate going forward.
localization.pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissiona: This is Carmichael. Hurston really needs to make up some ground. You have the contract parameters, so get this done.
Carmichael here. Grab what you need and get out there. Hurston needs this done to get back in this race.
Contractor Relations calling. Successfully completing this contract will help get Hurston back into this race. Be sure you give it your full attention.
This is Hurston Dynamics. I see you accepted this contract. Everything you need is in your mobi. Get it done.
Carmichael here. You have the details. Hurston appreciates your diligence.
This is Carmichael. Hurston's continuing greatness relies on you. Please complete the task as assigned and on time.
So you're our contractor... Fine. You know what needs to be done, so let's get to it. Hurston needs to win this thing.
Carmichael calling. Need this taken care fast and by the numbers. Can't have any losses on my watch.
Hurston needs this job done quickly. Make sure you have everything you need and take care of it.
This is Carmichael with Hurston. I will be supervising you. I don't want any excuses, just get this done.

Hello, my name's Aldus Carmichael. I'm with Hurston Dynamics' Contractor Relations department. Your assistance will assure Hurston rises to the Senate's challenge. You will be required to execute this contract in a timely fashion to avoid litigation. Get to it.
localization.pu_hrep_carmichael_hur_m_pmh_rsgmissionc: Hurston calling. Cargo should be arriving safely. My supervisor was pleased with our work on this.
Just got word that cargo got through. Well done. I'll put this down as a win.
Shipping just commed to say that the cargo is on its way. My supervisor was pleased to hear I resolved that situation.
Great, that's a win. I'll make sure this gets logged.
Just got word you turned in that contract. That should help Hurston gain some ground.
Checking your turn-in manifest. Looks good. I'll push this through payroll.
Saw your delivery come through. Could have been a little more efficient on your delivery, but a win's a win.
Carmichael here. Logged your contract delivery. I'll mark it down as a win for Hurston.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_aal: Hello again, contractor. I'm from Hurston Security with your latest mission details. They've been transferred to your mobi and should have everything you need to get started. It's great to be working with you again.

Welcome back, operator. I will be your liason with Hurston Security. Based on your file, you've performed admirably in previous contracts so I hope this will go as smoothly. The details for the current task have been sent to your mobi, so you may proceed.
This is Hurston Security calling about your latest contract. I've sent you all the mission details so you can get started. Hopefully this will go as well as your previous contracts. Good luck.
Hello, operator. I'm your outsource liason with Hurston Security. I'm forwarding all relevant mission details to you now, so please expedite it as quickly as possible. Thank you.
This is Hurston Security, I've just received the start paperwork for your new contract. Everything seems in order, so I will send along the salient mission data for you to execute the job. Good luck.
Hello, contractor. I will be your contact with Hurston Security throughout your current mission. The details have been sent to your mobi if you have any questions. Good luck.
Hello, this is your Hurston Security rep following up on your recent contract acquisition. You should have received all the information needed to properly execute this contract. Good luck.

Hello, contractor. I'll be your contact with Hurston Security for the duration of this mission. I've forwarded all the relevant mission data to your mobiGlas, so you're free to proceed as directed. Thank you.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_accepted_mission_dru: Attention, contractor. This is Hurston Security. You have been provided with the location of a production facility that will be producing illegal contraband on regular intervals for the near future. Secure the site and destroy all contraband you can. Compensation will be provided for each package you destroy.

Attention, this is Hurston Security. As an approved contractor, you are tasked with heading to the following location where an automated production facility will be producing illegal contraband. You will be responsible for the destruction of said contraband. Your compensation will be commensurate with the amount of contraband you destroy.

Hello, this is Hurston Security. I'll be your contact for the upcoming contract. An automated production facility will be producing illegal contraband for a limited time. You need to go to the site and destroy as many of these packages as possible. Local assets have indicated that there will be hostile elements present, so make sure you are prepared for a fight.

This is Hurston Security. As explained in the initial mission brief, an automated production facility will be producing illegal contraband for an undetermined amount of time. You are tasked with securing the site, confiscating as many of these packages as you can obtain, and delivering them to a Hurston Security facility for disposal. Good luck.

Hello, operator. I'll be your contact with Hurston Security. As we explained in your mission outline, you have been tasked with acquiring and delivering illegal contraband to an authorized security kiosk for destruction. The production facility will undoubtedly be a hotly contested zone, so bring appropriate weaponry.

Hello, this is your assigned liason with Hurston Security. You've been approved for this contract, so I wanted to give you some additional details. We've learned that a production facility is going to be producing illegal contraband for a limited time. We need you to secure the site and seize as many packages as possible then deliver them for immediate destruction. There will undoubtedly be competing elements on site, so be careful.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_announce_dropoff_aal: This is Hurston Security. You will need to take any contraband you've secured to the designated disposal areas. Local security forces have been notified of your contract, so they will not arrest you, but don't attempt to take the packages anywhere but authorized security areas.

Attention, operator. Now that you've secured some contraband, you will need to deliver them to an authorized security kiosk for immediate disposal. Local law enforcement have been notified of your cargo, so you will not be arrested for their transport, but make sure you deliver them for destruction promptly.

Hello, contractor. This is Hurston Security. I understand you've left the production facility with some seized contraband. Take these packages to one of our authorized security kiosks for immediate disposal. While under Hurston contract, you will not be charged with transporting illegal cargo, but make sure you deliver this contraband promptly.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_expired_mission_drug: This is Hurston Security. I've been notified that the production facility is no longer generating contraband. Make sure you destroy any packages that are still in the area.
Hurston Security here. Local assets have indicated that the production facility has stopped outputting packages of contraband. Make sure the site is completely clear of any packages.
This is Hurston Security with an update about your current mission. The production facility has stopped generating illegal contraband. Make sure you destroy any packages that are still in the area.
This is Hurston Security. We've received intelligence that the facility will no longer be producing contraband. Be sure to take whatever you've seized to an authorized security kiosk for destruction.

Attention, this is your rep at Hurston Security. Latest intel suggests that the production facility has stopped producing contraband. If you were able to seize any contraband, deliver it to an authorized station.
Hurston Security here. We've learned that the facility has completed its production. Take any seized contraband to one of the authorized disposal sites. Thank you.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_aally_: This is Hurston Security. We are hereby terminating your services, effective immediately.
Attention, operator. This is Hurston Security. Your services will no longer be required.
This is your liason with Hurston Security. I'm calling to notify you that due to recent behavior, we are terminating your employment status.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_badper: Attention, operator. This is your Hurston Security representative. Based on your performance, we are severing our employment contract with you effective immediately.
This is Hurston Security calling. We are terminating our current contract with you. We hope that you make efforts to rectify this type of behavior for future contract opportunities.
This is your rep with Hurston Security. Due to your recent performance, we have decided that you are unfit to continue your current employment with the company.
Hurston Security here. After numerous violations of the terms of your agreement, we're terminating your contract.
This is your rep with Hurston Security. Your recent job performance has forced us to reconsider your employment status. You are hereby discharged from your current contract.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_breaks: This is Hurston Security. If you had read your contract, you would know that contractors are forbidden from committing any kind of offense while in the employ of Hurston Dynamics. As such, you are hereby terminated from employment.
Attention, operator. Due to your recent crime stat, Hurston Dynamics is forced to cancel their contract with you.

This is Hurston Security calling. Your recent crime stat is a violation of the employment guidelines described in your contract. As such, we cannot keep you as an active employee until this is resolved.
This is Hurston Security, your recent criminal activities are a violation of your terms of employment, so we are obligated to sever all connection with you on this contract.

Hurston Security calling to notify you that because of your CrimeStat, you are in violation of your work contract with Hurston Dynamics. If you reconcile these charges, we can reconsider your employment status.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_illega: Attention. This is Hurston Security. We have been notified that you sold contraband to an unauthorized kiosk. This is a direct violation of the terms of your contract. Therefore, we are terminating your employment with us. Effective immediately.
This is Hurston Security. You have violated the terms of your contract by delivering illegal contraband to an unauthorized kiosk. We are hereby terminating your contract.

This is your Hurston Security rep. We have learned that you sold illegal contraband to an unauthorized vendor which is in direct violation of your contract and Hurston law. Therefore, your employment status has been terminated.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_fired_mission_notpla: Hello, this is your Hurston Security rep. Due to extenuating circumstances, you will no longer be required to fulfill your contract. We are invoking subclause seven and releasing you of any further responsibility. Thank you for your time.
Hello, contractor. This is Hurston Security. We regret to inform you that we need to pull your active contract. We hope that this does not reflect poorly on your experience with Hurston Dynamics.

This is Hurston Security with an update to your current contract. Unfortunately, due to unforseen events, the situation around your contract has changed and we no longer need your assistance. Thank you for your efforts.

This is Hurston Security calling. It seems that the situation around your current contract has changed, eliminating the need for your services. You should consider yourself freed from further obligations on this mission. Thank you.

Greetings, operator. This is your rep with Hurston Security and I have an update to your current mission. Unfortunately, a decision from the executive board has eliminated the need for this contract to be fulfilled. We thank you for your service.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_inform_mission_statu: This is Hurston Security calling. I've been receiving updates on your progress. Ideally, we like to track a higher efficiency, but this seems to be at the lower edge of acceptable.
Hello, operator. This is your rep with Hurston Security. I've been running your current progress against our projections and you are working within acceptable parameters. That is all.
This is your Hurston Security rep. You have been operating at an acceptable work efficiency level. Maintain this progress through the completion of the mission.

Hello, this is Hurston Security calling with a status update. We've received reports on your current progress. You are currently on track to complete your contract with a satisfactory performance. Thank you.

Hurston Security calling. Your current mission progress seems to be within acceptable parameters. I can see potential ways to increase your efficiency for future contracts, but make sure you complete the task at hand.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_remind_mission_respa: This is Hurston Security calling. Glad to hear that you're back on your feet. Your contract is still active, so try to get back out there as soon as possible and finish it. Thank you.
Hurston Security here. Now that you've been patched up, you should get back to completing your active contract. Thank you.
Hello, contractor. This is Hurston Security. Now that you have received adequate medical attention, it is time to complete your current contract.
This is Hurston Security. We've heard you're back on your feet, so you have no reason to not complete your active contract.
Hello, operator. Glad to hear you managed to survive your recent encounter. Your contract is still active, so we look forward to closing it out as soon as possible.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_succeed_dropoff_aall: Hello, this is Hurston Security. Thank you for contributing to the destruction of illegal contraband. Your efforts help Hurston Dynamics keep their planet safe for everyone.

Hello, contractor. This is your contact with Hurston Security. With the successful destruction of that contraband, you have fulfilled the requirements of your temporary contract. Thank you for your service.
This is your Hurston Security Rep. Thank you for promptly delivering the contraband and doing your part to eliminate criminality in Hurston.
localization.pu_hsecrrep01_f_deh_succeed_mission_aall: Hello, operator. This is Hurston Security. We wanted to thank you for completing your current contract. Payment has been issued and we hope to work with you again in the future.
This is Hurston Security calling to confirm that you have adequately satisfied the requirements of your current contract. Payment has been issued. Hurston Dynamics thanks you for your service.

This is your Hurston Security liason, calling to say that you have satisfied all the requirements for your active contract. We thank you for your service and have transferred the agreed upon payment to your account.

localization.pu_iaeann02_f_lpa_announce_generalinfo_i: Whether its innovative specialty craft, reliable workhorses or tried and true defenders, the Intergalactic Aerospace Expo is where spaceship enthusiasts come to take flight.
Whether it's stepping into an unknown system or coasting the well traveled routes of your home sector, how you get there is half the fun. Find your next craft of choice at the 2951 IAE. Dare to fly.

Did you discover the craft of your dreams at this year's IAE? Then why not experience it first hand with a test flight? Many of the vehicles on display at this year's IAE are available to rent from one of our local providers.

Ready to learn more about the manufacturers and ships on display? The all new 2951 IAE immersive audio experience is the perfect way to get more info about why adventurous pilots across the universe "Dare to Fly."
localization.pu_iaeann02_f_lpa_announce_locationinfo_: This is a friendly reminder that the Tobin Expo Center is a shared space. Please be mindful of other guests during your visit so that we can all enjoy this day together.

Due to heightened security measures in the Stanton System, microTech Protection Services are asking all guests to be extra vigilant when it comes to safety. If you see anything of concern, please alert a member of staff as soon as possible. Thank you.

Attention visitors to the Intergalactic Aerospace Expo - Please remember to stay hydrated while exploring the exhibits on display. For your convenience, a selection of beverages and tasty snacks are available for purchase in the lobby.

Tobin Expo Center would like to invite everyone to join in and help keep our halls looking their best, for every guest. Please be sure to keep track of all your belongings and deposit any waste in the appropriate receptacles. Thanks.
localization.pu_iaeann02_f_lpa_announce_pilotportrait: To commemorate this year's theme of "Dare to Fly," the IAE wanted to celebrate those who wear the mantle of 'pilot' each and every day. This unique portrait series features pilots from around the universe, captured through the eye of famed portrait artist, Aruto Divani.
localization.pu_iaeann02_f_lpa_warn_expo_closing_ig_0: Attention guests, this Expo hall is about to close for maintenance. Please make your way to the exit and be sure to visit us again soon.
localization.pu_iaeann02_f_lpa_welcome_entrance_ig_00: Welcome to the 2951 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo, where we're celebrating those who "Dare to Fly."
Thank you for visiting New Babbage's Tobin Expo Center, Stanton's preeminent destination for live events and exhibitions.
localization.pu_iaeatnarr01_m_lpa_announce_tour_besti: Selected by popular vote, the IAE Best in Show line up is a chance for your favorite ships to take center stage at the expo. At least most of the time. At the 2938 Expo, that year's winners were all ships too large to actually fit inside the show hall!
localization.pu_iaeatnarr01_m_lpa_announce_tour_pilot: While it may be commonplace to sail through the stars, we should never lose sight of the wonders of space flight from discovering new jump points, unearthing lost ruins, or setting new speed records. Famed artist, Aruto Divani, created this unique portrait series as a tribute to the diverse array of people who eagerly climb aboard their ships and 'Dare to Fly.'
localization.pu_iaeatnarr01_m_lpa_announce_tour_ship_: MISC's latest addition to their already impressive line of ships perfectly encapsulates the spirit of this year's IAE. Push the boundaries of the known universe with their new multi-crew wayfarer ship, the Odyssey. Get a sneak peek in the holoviewer room. Only at the IAE.
localization.pu_iaeatnarr01_m_lpa_announce_tour_specm: Few companies have had as tumultuous a history as Aegis Dynamics. From its earliest days manufacturing iconic warships of the First Tevarin War through the darkest days of the Messer regime, Aegis ships have found a resurgence in the public eye for their versatility and robust construction.

No ship manufacturer personifies this year's theme better than Aegis Dynamics. Whether you're running cargo in a Retaliator or providing security in a Gladius, Aegis ships are putting in work in every corner of the 'verse. Regardless of the controversies that have plagued them over the centuries, pilots continue to trust their lives and livelihood to their tried and true designs.

Anvil Aerospace may have made a name for itself along the frontlines with its masterfully built fleet of military craft, but more and more of the company's civilian craft have captured the imagination of the Empire. Look no further than the Anvil Carrack to see a ship that has transitioned easily from its Naval origins to the very edges of space as pilots use the ship to chart new territory.

As the war against the Vanduul continues, many pilots find themselves seeking a way to protect their home and loved ones during these uncertain times. Anvil Aerospace has been a strong ally in this endeavor, creating civilian versions of their popular military craft, like the Hornet F7-C, to protect you and the ones you care about.

Contrary to popular belief, Argo Astronautics name doesn't come from the ancient water craft of Earth mythology, but rather is derived from the initials of the company's founder Alana Redmond and is attributed to her mother.

It's not uncommon for Human manufacturers to offer unique features and designs to make their ships stand out from the crowd, but the Banu take a slightly different approach when it comes to crafting their vehicles. Heavily and freely borrowing from each other and even other species, Banu ships are made by combining the best features and best technology that they can get their hands on.

One of the newer ship manufacturers to debut at the IAE, Consolidated Outlands has already made its mark on the Expo when it introduced the first ever mobile construction yard in 2947. The Pioneer opened up exciting opportunities for planetary settlement by allowing settlers to create their own modular structures, and forever changing the idea of what a spacecraft could do.

Crusader Industries continues to surprise ship enthusiasts around the empire. Initially known for their commercial transports like the Genesis Starliner and the Hercules StarLifter, Crusader has been expanding into the civilian market with the introduction of their Ares Star Fighter and Mercury Star Runner. Needless to say, the future is bright for this titan of astro-engineering.

Unlike many of their competitors, Crusader Industries dedicates as much effort on their employees as they do on their products. Recognized as one of the UEE's best employers in 2943 and 2946, Crusader not only offers competitive pay and benefit programs to all employees, but also houses extensive in-house  training and education programs to foster talent and take their workers to the next level of their career.

Mention the name Drake Interplanetary in a room and you're sure to kick off some debate. To some, they're villains, arming the most dangerous elements in the 'verse with the tools to wreak havoc. But did you know that this criminal connection was only made possible because Drake ships were so common? In the infamous Kesselring Heist of 2903, a Drake caterpillar was used specifically because it was easy to blend in with the masses in flight.

No one brings the thunder to IAE quite like Drake Interplanetary. Love 'em or hate 'em, their ships have become versatile and affordable options for everyone from security and militia forces to haulers trying to scrape a living out in the black. The Drake Red medic ship was recently recognized for the 'most lives saved' thanks to the ship's usage in medstations and hospitals around the UEE.

Though the Expo attracts the latest innovations and technological wonders, Esperia is constantly paving the way forward with their reverence of the past. Preserving important historical craft and xeno-vehicles, Esperia defines spaceflight in entirely new ways by providing unique experiences that would otherwise be unavailable to modern pilots.

Greycat Industrial holds the distinction of having the most ever vehicles at a single IAE when in 2926 a thousand buggy parade was driven through the streets of Severus. The highlight was when all of the buggy's sounded their horns together to play a rendition of the Imperial anthem.

It's common knowledge that MISC builds some of the hardest working ships around, but to get that tough a lot of thought and careful consideration had to go into even the smallest of details. To find the best panel adhesive, MISC ran over a million thermocycle shock tests at their R&D center. The winner alone was able to survive tens of thousands of cycles without failing. Talk about being built to last.

Represented in almost every industry, MISC continues to create reliable, durable, and versatile ships at a variety of pricepoints. One of their toughest tests is known affectionately as the "Meat Grinder." Though the specifics of the test are a proprietary secret, insiders claim that the test aims to inundate the prototype ship with nearly three dozen adverse conditions, sometimes attacking with three to four at the same time in an effort to prove that their ship can survive the harshest of the harsh conditions.

Luxury. Elegance. Performance. These are only a handful of the terms that are regularly associated with Origin Jumpworks ships. Since the 28th century, Origin has consistently pushed the boundaries of speed and sophistication, but did you know that their controversial decision to uproot their headquarters from Earth to Terra in 2913 nearly sank the company?

Perpetually expanding what's possible when it comes to high-end performance vehicles, Origin Jumpworks is a fan favorite at the IAE and this year's lineup is sure to impress. When attempting to design a new addition to their roster, Origin engineers have looked for inspiration from a variety of sources. For example, when initially brainstorming designs that would ultimately become the X1, Engineering Director Alberto Vara looked to musical notes to dictate the potential shape language of the open-canopy racer.

Some historians credit Roberts Space Industries with the invention of modern spaceflight. For founder Chris Roberts, the prospect of making space travel more accessible was a lifelong dream and when his company unveiled their prototype Quantum Core Engine in 2075, suddenly, space travel didn?t seem that fantastical anymore.

It's pretty amazing to think that RSI makes one of the smallest ships on the market and one of the biggest. It would take about 50 Auroras laid end to end to equal the length of one mighty Bengal carrier.

Xi'an ships are becoming a more common sight across the UEE, but it wasn't too long ago that their sale was completely forbidden by the Xi'an Emperor. Now, thanks to growing trade between our two species, Xi'an manufacturers like Gatac and Aopoa are producing vehicles specifically for Humans to pilot. Even more promising, some new ships have been designed for Human and Xi'an crew to serve along side each other.
localization.pu_iaeatnarr01_m_lpa_announce_tour_specs: Establishing fire superiority can be the key to victory. Aegis designers consulted with both active and former members of the UEE military as well as security forces to find out what was and wasn't currently represented in the latest generation of combat gunships. The result? The Aegis Redeemer. Originally debuted years ago, Aegis made the somewhat controversial decision to delay the release of this battlefield equalizer to redesign the interior.

Despite the Aerospace in it's name, Anvil has hardly been limited to the skies. For example, the tough and rugged Atlas vehicle platform was developed to help conquer the unforgiving landscape found on moons and planets alike. Both the Ballista and the Spartan were both built from this design foundation, proving its adaptability.

If you're looking to crack into the cargo hauling market, look no further than Argo's new RAFT. This small multi-crew ship utilizes Argo's experience in the industrial ship market and a versatile design to create an affordable entry-level ship that's ready for the long haul.

Although Crusader Industries might be best known for their transports, their recent introduction of the Ares Star Fighter shows that the charity-minded manufacturer is taking a new approach to helping citizens across the Empire, and more specifically those who live on Crusader itself. With recent attacks by well outfitted groups like XenoThreat and the Nine Tails becoming all too common, its easy to see why a powerhouse like the Ares was added to their line-up.

Introduced in 2887, Drake's Buccaneer almost begs its pilots to pick a fight. While it doesn't have the versatility of something like the Hornet, the Bucc's got heart... and enough firepower to make it a serious threat in any engagement. Though it's been associated with multiple crimes throughout the Empire, it's also become a mainstay for local security forces and militias looking to keep the peace.

Initially concepted to be a competitor for RSI's classic Constellation line, Origin's 400i quickly developed  its own singular identity. Utilizing Origin's usual high standards of performance and comfort, the 400i evolved into a ship for explorers who didn't feel the need to 'rough it' while pushing the boundaries of the known.

Since its introduction in 2712, the RSI Constellation has been reimagined countless times, proving itself as varied and long-lived as Roberts Space Industries itself. It has been a cargo hauler, an explorer, a luxury liner, and more. When asked what's next for the Constellation, RSI Designer Deshondra Lewin said "Whatever it is, we will always strive to balance innovation with the tested features that pilots have come to rely upon."
localization.pu_iaeatnarr01_m_lpa_announce_tour_theme: The theme of this year's expo is "Dare to Fly" which celebrates the courage of pilots everywhere who boldly take flight to discover new thrills, to seek adventure, and to push boundaries farther than ever imagined. With the right ship and the right frame of mind, anything is possible.
localization.pu_iaeatnarr01_m_lpa_announce_tour_weapo: You may be wondering why an Expo focused on vehicles and spacecraft would want to highlight personal armor and weapons. While its true that getting there is half the fun, what you do when you arrive is just as important. Having the perfect gear on board will help ensure that a landed pilot will be ready to take off again soon.
localization.pu_iaeatnarr01_m_lpa_welcome_tour_ig_001: Hello and welcome to the 2951 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. This special audio presentation will be your guide to the ins and outs of the various halls and provide unique insight about the vehicles and manufacturers on display. Thanks for listening and we hope you enjoy your time with us here at this year's IAE.

A Nine Tail ship just arrived with reinforcements. We're going to cut our way closer to see what's going on. I'll get back in touch once you arrive.
localization.pu_invictushg01_m_lgr_announce_invictus_: Celebrated since 2541, Invictus gives the public an opportunity to see the latest and greatest additions to the UEE Navy fleet.
Remember, Invictus is an opportunity to celebrate those who are about to embark on their journey in the UEE Navy. Be sure to congratulate any new recruits you see.
Duty. Tradition. Service. A life in the UEE Navy is about building a better universe for your loved ones.
Get an inside look at some of your favorite manufacturers' ships. Check the daily schedule for directions.
The Navy would like to thank our private and corporate partners for making this year's Invictus the best yet.
Ever want to see what life is like aboard a capital ship? This year's Invictus is offering a rare opportunity to explore an active duty Javelin destroyer.
While at Invictus, take a moment to honor all Naval starmen, past, present and future, for faithfully defending the Empire.
The UEE Navy. United in Purpose.

Invictus Launch Week not only marks the graduation of the latest class of starmen and pilots entering service into the UEE Navy, but signifies the date that new recruits all over the Empire report to start their service.
