localization.pu_nbhosp01_m_lpa_welcome_hospital_newba: Welcome to Brentworth Care Center, where getting better has never been better.
localization.pu_npcvp10_bdc_genericreact_ig_002_thats: That's the way it goes, I guess.
localization.pu_npcvp10_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_iu: I used to think all those old timers were spoutin' nonsense. But I swear, this old scar of mine itches something fierce whenever a storm's about to hit.
localization.pu_npcvp10_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_ih: I heard two greenhorns arguing over whether ballistic or energy weapons are better. You wanna know which is better? Whichever bloody gun you can reach in time.
localization.pu_npcvp10_bdc_genericresponse_ig_003_ik: I keep thinking I'm gonna quit drinking for good, but then before I know it, I look down and there's a bottle in my hand. Not sure what's making my life worse at this point: the drink or constantly fighting against it.
localization.pu_npcvp10_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_001_hardt: Hard to believe the Council's gotten in so deep in Pyro. I remember the days when the whole point of coming to the system was you got to run free. Seems to me, there's hardly any places left these days where that's true, and that's a real shame.
localization.pu_npcvp10_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_iwass: I was shacking up with this small outpost a little while back, providing them protection in exchange for supplies. When it was time for me to move on, I tried to warn them they needed to shore things up or they were gonna get hit. Guess they didn't listen.
localization.pu_npcvp10_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_heard: Heard some fool yammering that the UEE was gonna finally claim Pyro. Ain't no way. Not when they get to keep using the system as their dumpin' ground. Who they gonna blame for all their problems if ain't us?
localization.pu_npcvp10_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_twent: Twenty years ago, I swore I was never gonna eat an aloprat. But here I am, craving the damn things whenever I leave Pyro. Tried them other places too. Just don't taste the same.
localization.pu_npcvp10_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_001_im: I miss the days when outlaws tried to stay low key. I ran into a few of those Nine Tails last week and one of them had a big ol' nine painted on their helmet. It's like, yeah, we get it, son.
localization.pu_npcvp10_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_002_ig: I got stuck in one of ArcCorp's infamous traffic jams this weekend. I was waiting for six hours to get a landing assignment just because some idiot got into a shipwreck.
localization.pu_npcvp10_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_th: There's a rumor going around that Crusader might be looking to sell their planet. I guess owning an entire world might not be everything it's cracked up to be.
localization.pu_npcvp10_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_se: Security in this system is such a mess. Between all the planets having their own forces, all of the merc guild contractors, plus the Advocacy stickin' their noses in... it's no wonder crime's been skyrocketing.
localization.pu_npcvp11_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_si: Sitting on a couple things right now. I don't know though. Still testing the waters, but if they line up right? Could be big.
localization.pu_npcvp11_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_la: Last little thing I had didn't quite work out, but you gotta keep at it. Can't lose all the time, right? But I got a good feeling about the next one.
localization.pu_npcvp11_bdc_genericresponse_ig_003_gu: Guy I was supposed to be working with ended up perished. Hell if I know why, somebody with a big grudge and a long memory, I guess. Anyway, been looking for a replacement.
localization.pu_npcvp11_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_001_yeahy: Yeah, you know, I'm just out there doing my thing. It's crazy though, lotta people look around this system and just see the fighting. I see opportunities. Just gotta figure out what they are.
localization.pu_npcvp11_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_might: Might've gotten a line into one of the rooks in the Rough & Ready. That's like a mid-level lieutenant or something. I don’t know where they get these names, but anyway, could be big.
localization.pu_npcvp11_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_hadar: Had a run take me down into the bowels of Ruin Station. There's a special kind of crazy that wants to live down there. I couldn't get out of there fast enough.
localization.pu_npcvp11_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_gotju: Got jumped by XenoThreat the other day. Managed to get away without taking too much of a hit, but I don't know why the other gangs haven't stomped those assholes out.
localization.pu_npcvp11_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_001_lo: Lotta eyes around this place. Can't tell if people are curious, trying to make a cred, or if they have it out for me, but I get a lot of questions. Too many if you ask me.
localization.pu_npcvp11_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_002_im: I'm all right, but I'll be honest. I may occasionally dip my toe, but you look at the shit some of these corps are doin'? That's real criminal.
localization.pu_npcvp11_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_to: Took some time, but I think I finally got my finger on the pulse of this system. Between the four worlds, they all seem to want something from each other. Yeah… there's opportunity here.
localization.pu_npcvp11_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_we: Went on one of those whale tours on Orison. Didn't see shit. You ask me, if you pay for a tour and don't see one, you get your money back.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_ivehe: I've heard stranger, if you can believe that.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_allth: All the fun stuff happens to you.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_bu: Business has been improving. There have been some logistical issues that have mitigated some of our expansion, but I'm resolving them.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_im: I'm trying a new adaptive solution to project future growth opportunities. I'm currently trying to figure out how to simulate wildcard factors to trigger new thought avenues. It's fascinating work.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_genericresponse_ig_003_iv: I've been working with the Interstellar Transport Guild to study their hauling paths around the Empire. I'm hoping to find some gaps and see if there are any opportunities there.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_001_thecr: The criminal presence here certainly presents an interesting challenge. Routing through Pyro certainly cuts down on transit time, but obviously the risk is higher. It's a fascinating equation to balance.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_forbe: For being a lawless warzone, I do find some of the local cuisine quite good. I mean, the people here may be dregs, but they're creative dregs.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_shado: Shadowing one of my new contractors through the system. They're good, so far at least. Keeping a good pace, but didn't drop my cargo at the first sign of trouble.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_eager: Eager to get out of here. It's almost sad though, if the people around here got their act together and built something rather than slitting each other's throats for scraps, Pyro could actually be quite a system.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_001_cu: Currently meeting with representatives of Hurston, ArcCorp, and microTech to try and incorporate them into my delivery cycle. I'm still waiting on a response from Crusader.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_002_id: I don't know why people are complaining about the workers on Hurston. I mean sure, the contract is rigid and brutal, but it's honest. If they read the thing rather than snatching the signing bonus, they'd know what they were in for.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_on: One of my ships got clipped coming out of Area18. I don't know if their ATC is stupid or people are just insane pilots… probably both, actually.
localization.pu_npcvp12_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_iv: I've just been visiting Orison. I've grown quite fond of that place. I've actually been thinking about basing my company out of there.
localization.pu_npcvp13_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_002,p: Yeah, I don't know. Sounds stressful.
localization.pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_: These Frontier Fighters might have the right idea. If people don't want to be treated like outlaws, then they shouldn't live in Pyro.

So a friend of a friend is actually in a band called the Frontier Fighters. They been around for years, playing speed thrash clubs in Prime. Now, they keep getting all these angry comms and people are protesting them. I think they're going to have change names, which sucks for them.
This whole Frontier Fighter thing is awful. How can Humans even be fighting each other when we're in the middle of a war with the Vanduul?
localization.pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p: Good, I think? (more certain) Yeah, I'm good. Trying to be more positive, you know? Sometimes it works.
localization.pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p: Been trying to get away from cities lately. Just been feeling overwhelmed way too often. It's good to take a break.
localization.pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_003,p: Things have been busy, weirdly enough. Almost to the point where I have to turn down work. I can't do it, though. Spent too long in those lean years to ever say no to a paying gig. Downside is I haven't had a day off in two months.
localization.pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0: Been trying to volunteer some time to help CFP out whenever I'm in Pyro. There's so much to like about this system. Making it safer seems like a pretty good idea.
Things are getting nuts out here. I've just been trying to keep my head down and not get it shot off.
I can't wait to get home. Every time I pass through here, I'm so on edge I can't ever get a decent night's sleep.
localization.pu_npcvp13_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_: I want to know what's going on. I want somebody to check my imprint and make sure it's working. They said this shit was supposed to be safe.
You can tell me who the hell's gonna fix this. I splashed out god knows how many credits to get a "platinum level" regen package and now I’m hearing that this shit won't even work?

Let me ask you something. Do you have any idea how dangerous it is for us scrappers right now? Regen was supposed to bring me peace of mind, but now it's feeling like nothing but a scheme to get a piece of my paycheck.
localization.pu_npcvp13_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00: I'm freaking out. I can barely leave my hab because I'm terrified I'm gonna get hit by a ship or something and that's gonna be that.
Kicking myself for ever believing in regen. Can't believe I let some corp make a copy of my consciousness. Can only image what the hell they're gonna do with that.
I wonder if Addison is going to get impeached over this whole Regen crisis? It's pretty much her fault that broken alien tech was rushed out to the whole empire before it was ready.
localization.pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsestanton_ig_001,p: I've been reading up on the companies that run this place. Even the best of them have done some shady shit in their past. Sends a pretty bleak message about the price of success.
localization.pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsestanton_ig_002,p: Been wondering if the UEE's ever gonna reconsider giving all this power to the corporations here. Feels like the system's enough of a profit machine to make it worth their while. Don't know if I'd like it more or less.
localization.pu_npcvp13_bdc_responsestanton_ig_003,p: I found this service that tracks commercial ships in and out of spaceports. It's hypnotic as hell to watch. Been using it to help fall asleep.
localization.pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_greetinggeneric_ig_: Fill me in on what's going on with you.
localization.pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_: Sometimes you just gotta go with the flow.
localization.pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsefrontierfig: Was just arguing with a friend about the Frontier Fighters. He got pissed when I said they have a point. Pyro ain't gonna fix itself. Doesn't mean I support 'em, you know?
Still can't believe the Frontier Fighters are the ones who attacked Stanton. I talked 'em up to so many people. Sure making me eat my words now.
Was really hoping the Frontier Fighters would make Pyro safer for us working folks. But that sure as shit ain't happening.
localization.pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_: Oh, you know, focused on keeping thing simple. Going where the work takes me, and trying to stay a step ahead of trouble.
Been better, but old enough to know there's no use in chewing your ear off about it.

Can't complain. Started doing this thing where I take a few moments each day to just stop and appreciate the world around me. Today I spent a good ten minutes staring at clouds moving across microTech.
localization.pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie: Salvaged a '27 Cryo-Star cooler the other day. Thought I'd hit the jackpot but the solar flares fried it good. Can't catch a break.
Spent the day running diagnostic checks and calibrating components. Always good to know everything's in tip-top shape before working Pyro.
Wondering why I'm even here. Can't tell you how many friends I've lost to this damn system.
localization.pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responseregenhospit: So let me get this straight. After I spent all those creds on an imprint, you can no longer guarantee it'll work. Is that what's happening here? Well, that ain't gonna fly with me.
Look, I've already wasted hours on spectrum chatting with one of your damn reply bots, and surprise, surprise they were no help. That's why I came down here to talk to a real person about my imprint.

I seen you people out there on the spectrum talking about 'solutions are coming' and 'scientists are optimistic' but it all sounds like a bunch of bullshit. All that knowledge and learning and you still can't give me a goddamn straight answer.
localization.pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responseregenpublic: Not feeling too good right now. Don't know what's going on, but I haven't felt right since my last regen.

Was talking to a buddy of mine who said this was the Vanduul plan all along. Let us think we swipe the tech from them and then they pull the rug out right when we get comfortable. Who knows if it's true, but it's comforting thinking it might be an answer.
You ever catch the Parker Terrell rant about regen being some grand Xi'an conspiracy against us? Doesn't seem so crazy now, does it?
localization.pu_npcvp14_civ_m_bdc_responsestanton_ig_: Deciding whether I want to stick around here. Worked Stanton for decades and never seen things this bad. System security has really gone down hill since Nine Tails took control of Grim HEX.
Ran into an old friend in Area18. We sure had fun together before life pulled us in different directions. Let me tell ya', thirty years can go by in the blink of an eye.
Not sure if it's just me, but every time I visit Orison I get this weird taste in my mouth. Wonder if there's some gas in the air there that I'm sensitive to.
localization.pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_greetinggeneric_ig_: So anyway, what's going on with you?
localization.pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_: I sure hope that works out for you.
localization.pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responsefrontierfig: I'll tell you what I'm doing - I'm staying the hell away from these Frontier Fighter thugs. I've heard their leader Effie has a couple of screws loose if you know what I mean.
I'm glad people finally figured out that these Frontier Fighters are a bunch of assholes. Always had a bad feeling about them.
I just don't know what these Frontier Fighters were thinking. Killing innocent people just to prove a point? It doesn't make sense to me.
localization.pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_: I dunno, it's just one thing after another these days. First I get my cargo stolen by some juiced up kids, then my ship gets busted and my insurance won't pay out…I feel like the universe's out to get me.

Hmm? Oh. Yeah. Sorry, I'm just feeling a little…I dunno. I'm starting to wonder if maybe the trader's life isn't for me. Getting kinda sick of living one job to the next. But then again, what else am I gonna do? It's all I know.

I think there's something loose in my cockpit, because everytime I take off I hear this "ting ting ting" and it is driving me crazy. I took my ship to the dealer and they said they'll have to take the whole thing apart just to get to the bottom of it.
localization.pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responsepyrofrontie: Got a guy from the Rough & Ready who wants to buy six kilos of weavil eggs from me - six! Pulled every string I had to get them. Says he wants to meet at Orbituary, alone, which makes sense, considering… you know.
Seems like there's a lot of work in Pyro if you don't ask questions. The other day some guy paid me to dispose of a box for him. Easiest creds I've ever made.
So get this, I'm standing in customs and I feel something jab me in the back, then this voice says "hand over all your creds." Turns out to be my brother-in-law. What are the chances.
localization.pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responseregenhospit: Hey hey hey - don't ignore me. I'm talking to you. When are you gonna fix this? "We're doing the best we can" isn't good enough! I need to know what's going on!
Are you morons even doing anything to fix this? This is a service, a service that I pay a lot of money for, and you're telling me it doesn't even work? This is freaking unbelievable!
So you're telling me there's a chance I might not regen? Well what kind of chance? Are we talking fifty-fifty? One in a hundred? One in a thousand? Come on god damnit, I need to know.
localization.pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responseregenpublic: I'm not doing good, not good at all. You heard that regens aren't working anymore? I heard someone say one in twenty people aren't coming back. Others are saying one in five. Nobody seems to know. Isn't that crazy?

You not heard the news? Regen's failing. My buddy Ricky got crushed by a stack of crates in the cargo bay - complete freak accident - and now he's just gone. Regen was supposed to stop this kind of stuff from happening.
This whole regen thing's got my head in a spin. What happens if I get blasted by some thug, or I crash my ship, o-or I'm stepping out the shower and I slip on some soap? I could be done. Permanently.
localization.pu_npcvp15_civ_f_bdc_responsestanton_ig_: Just got back from Orison recently and oh man, let me tell you - now that is living! Everyone says the people there are really snooty, but I only got kicked out of two, maybe three bars, when I was there.

I'm just trying to make a few creds, as per usual. I kinda made a bad investment recently, really thought people would be more interested in these knock off toys. Now I've got a cargo bay full of one-eyed pico the penguins I can't seem to shift.

You won't believe this, the other day I was in New Babbage, and I tried setting up my stall, and this woman walks up to me and says I need to get all my junk out of here or she'll call security. Don't know why she cared so much.
localization.pu_npcvp16_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_003,p: I have never heard anything like that.
localization.pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_: The Frontier Fighters being responsible for the attacks on Stanton is completely unsurprising to me. Just another group of power obsessed vigilantes. I wouldn't be surprised if the CFP were in league with them too.
I had a couple of jobs lined up with the Frontier Fighters which I can't do anymore. Apparently it'll make me an enemy of the UEE or something. So annoying.
The attacks the Frontier Fighters were doing were so unbelievably basic. Everyone knows that you focus on targeting communications and other key infrastructures first. Amateurs.
localization.pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p: Urgh, don't even ask. I just got a new mobiGlas and the default volume was set to 100%. Almost burst an eardrum when I got my first notification.
localization.pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p: I am so sick of these software updates. I just bought this AR lens and every day it seems like I get another update popping up. Freaks me out.
localization.pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_003,p: Apparently, VidPro are working on a new piece of software that allows you to rate your social interactions with people and assign them an overall score. About time, I say; I'm sick of wasting time talking to boring people.
localization.pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0: The CFP tried to contract me recently to help them set up a computer network at one of their outposts. When I told them my rates, they asked if I'd do it "out of the goodness of my heart". I said, "That's the funniest thing I've heard all week."
The tech here in Pyro is so outdated. I swear I've used toilets more sophisticated than these ship terminals.
I got a comm the other day from some sketchy organization that wanted me to help them hack into Checkmate's shipping database. If the job wasn't so trivial, I might have considered it.
localization.pu_npcvp16_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_: This is a joke, right? There's no way your company would release this technology if it wasn't guaranteed to work. Right?
I've read your terms and conditions inside and out, and I know that legally, if your service no longer works, then I have a right to a full refund, and I want that refund now.
I've been on Spectrum, I know what people are saying. I'm not leaving until you can guarantee that 'A': my imprint is intact and viable, and 'B': that I will regenerate upon death.
localization.pu_npcvp16_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00: I've always been skeptical about this regen technology. Immortality? Ibrahim spheres? There's just no way for it to be sustainable. I can't wait for advanced neural interfacing to take off so I can just digitize my consciousness.
Everyone's freaking out about the regen crisis, but honestly I'm not worried. When I had my imprint done, they said my IVS score was one of the highest they've ever seen.
This regen crisis is all anyone talks about these days. It's so boring. The advancements in technology that Saga DataSystems have made with their new drones are far more interesting.
localization.pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsestanton_ig_001,p: Can you believe they're talking about increasing the safety measures in the Murray Cup again? If I wanted to be bored senseless by racing, I'd go watch Star Kitten with my nephews.
localization.pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsestanton_ig_002,p: The other day someone asked me who I thought the best computer processor manufacturer was, and I actually had to say to them: "Is that a serious question? It's obviously microTech." Some people are so uneducated.
localization.pu_npcvp16_bdc_responsestanton_ig_003,p: Someone was complaining to me the other day about how 'unfair' the Hurston employment contracts are. Honestly if you're dumb enough to sign a contract like that you deserve to be indentured for as long as humanly possible.
localization.pu_npcvp17_bdc_greeting_ig_001,p: You're not doing too bad, I hope?
localization.pu_npcvp17_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_001,p: That's the way it goes sometimes.
localization.pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_: Someone just told me that whole Slicers thing was actually fake or something? Like we don't have enough going on without having to deal with made-up outlaws attacking us.

I gotta say, some of what these Frontier Fighters are saying is making a lot of sense. Sure, I don't agree with all their methods, but I've always thought we ought to be doing something about Pyro. Heaven knows the Imperator hasn't done anything.
These Frontier Fighters aren't doing themselves any favors going around attacking the wrong people. Kill all the bad guys you want, just leave the rest of us alone.
localization.pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p: Oh, can't complain. Got stuck in an elevator yesterday for a few hours, but it's fine.
localization.pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p: I'm getting by. My son was supposed to come visit me but had to cancel last minute, so that was hard. But otherwise I'm fine.
localization.pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_003,p: You know how life is. It has its ups and downs. My hab's life-support is on the fritz, but it could be worse. At least I have somewhere to live, right?
localization.pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0: I haven't heard from my son in over a week and I'm starting to get worried. He's so busy all the time so it's probably nothing, but you never know with Pyro.

I got two different job offers from two different gangs. The credits would set me up for the rest of the year, but the problem is, if either one finds out I'm working for the other, they'll be really mad. Eh, I'll probably risk it.
It's gotten so bad out here I'm debating starting up my own gang. Maybe that way I could finally make some decent credits.
localization.pu_npcvp17_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_: Look. I know this situation's tough on you. But you can't imagine how tough it is for me. I spent my life savings on this regen thing, and if it 'isn't guaranteed to work,' then it was all for nothing.

I've been standing around here all day trying to get answers. My feet hurt. My back hurts. My knees hurt. I'm exhausted. But I'm not planning on leaving until you tell me the truth: is my regen going to work or isn't it?
I just want some certainty here. They've been saying on the news that this thing isn't happening to everyone. I need you to tell me that it's not gonna happen to me. Why is that so hard?
localization.pu_npcvp17_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00: I don't believe for one second that regen only works for "some people." This is just another example of the government trying to control us. I bet you anything that most of those people it works for are citizens. Just wait and see.

Everybody is acting all surprised that regens are failing, but I knew better than to put my faith in some alien technology. Bringing people back from the dead just isn't what Humans are supposed to do.
I heard the reason why the government is restricting regen is that some people are coming back as monsters. Like attacking people, eating flesh, the whole thing. It's all just one big cover-up.
localization.pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsestanton_ig_001,p: It's a shame, really. Stanton used to be such a nice system with so much promise, but these days, with all the outlaws and prices getting so high, won't be long before all the decent folk are forced to live somewhere else.
localization.pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsestanton_ig_002,p: Did you hear the rumor that Crusader might be selling Orison to Shubin Interstellar? If they do, they better not be planning on changing the planet name. It's Crusader and it always will be, as far as I'm concerned.
localization.pu_npcvp17_bdc_responsestanton_ig_003,p: I was flying to visit my son last week, and the transport got stopped by Crusader Security, Hurston Security, and BlacJak Security. It's just ridiculous. All that security, and they're harrassing innocent people instead of dealing with outlaws.
localization.pu_npcvp19_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_001,p: Yup, it's some bullshit, ain't it.
localization.pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_: Honestly, I've been nonstop pissed off at the Frontier Fighters. I'm all for shocking people out of their stupor, but you don't kill innocent people to do it. That shit's out of line.
Been thinking about arming up and hunting down some Frontier Fighters. I'm not a violent person, but those assholes got to go.
Had to pick up a couple runs for a buddy of mine that got killed by the Frontier Fighters. God, I hope they get stomped out soon.
localization.pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p: Same ol' bullshit. Different day. Trying to make ends meet like a good little consumer.
localization.pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p: Stayed up all night last night and just thought. No music, no spectrum, no lights even. Just sat by the window and thought. It was powerful.
localization.pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_003,p: Been reading this really interesting book that's been teaching me to identify my "anchors," basically materialistic things that I think I need but really don’t. You'd be surprised how many things that covers.
localization.pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0: People out here don't even appreciate the freedom they have. To them, it's just an opportunity to exploit and hurt each other. It's a shame, really.
Pulled some jobs for the CFP. I like what they're trying to do out here, but I'm worried that if they get their way, they'll set up a Whammer's on every corner. System deserves better than that.
I might actually move out here. I know people say Pyro's a warzone, but I don't know. I kinda just vibe with the people I feel like they're living right.
localization.pu_npcvp19_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_: We trusted you with our lives -- our literal lives! And now you're all, "Oh, well, there's a chance it could fail, but don't worry about it." Bullshit! You know why the Imprints are failing and you refuse to tell us 'cause it would ruin your bottom line!
You've always been happy to take my creds in the past, but now that I need answers, suddenly you can't do anything for me? Typical.
You know what? This is a waste of time. Pull up my account. I want you to erase my imprint and I want you to give me a full refund. Now.
localization.pu_npcvp19_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00: Watching this whole regen thing unfold's been a trip. You ask me, I'm sure all the corporations realized how dangerous it was to let people have the tech. I can't prove it yet, but I'm working on it.
I'm actually kinda glad this regen thing's falling apart. Life's not really life if it doesn't end…. So yeah, that's where my head's been at.
I scrapped my imprint. To be honest, I don't think it's even worth having if I'm not sure it'll work.
localization.pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsestanton_ig_001,p: Just spending my time watching all the drones of this system scurry around trying to do Master's bidding. It's pretty pathetic; they just need to wake up.
localization.pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsestanton_ig_002,p: I really want to do something, you know? Something that grabs everybody in Stanton and says, "Hey! Don't live under the boot of these corporations. You're a person." But I don't know if they'd know what to do with themselves.
localization.pu_npcvp19_bdc_responsestanton_ig_003,p: I think I'm gonna stop working for Hurston all together. I just can't justify a paycheck from those people. I'll have to figure out some way to make up the difference, though.
localization.pu_npcvp1_bdc_genericreact_ig_002_thatsh: That's how it goes, I guess.
localization.pu_npcvp1_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_bee: Been looking to put together another haul, but credits are a bit tight at the moment, so, pulling some hustles on the side.
localization.pu_npcvp1_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_ifi: If it ain't one thing, it's another. But hey, that's just how this big ol' 'verse works, right? For better or worse, things just keeps on turning.
localization.pu_npcvp1_bdc_genericresponse_ig_003_got: Got another contract snaked from me by Trevor. We stay on this path and I swear we'll have words. I never begrudge anyone for making a living, but this feels personal.
localization.pu_npcvp1_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_001_ohyoul: Oh, you'll love this. Some dipshit actually tried to stick me up. Said that they were "the new power in Pyro." Weren't powerful enough to take two to the chest, I'll tell you.
localization.pu_npcvp1_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_caught: Caught a stowaway the other day. Hell if I know where he slipped aboard. Scared the hell out of me when I found him, but honestly it was nice to have someone to chat to.
localization.pu_npcvp1_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_imnots: I'm not sure it's worth doing runs through here anymore. With all the lunatics out there, nine times out of ten I spend more on repairs than I get on the run.
localization.pu_npcvp1_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_shitsb: Shit's been a little crazy. Normally I don't like to work for the gangs, but out here, Rough & Ready actually seem to be the only ones who'll actually pay. Hell, they pay quicker than a lot of companies do.
localization.pu_npcvp1_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_001_ill: I'll tell ya, crime in this system has gone way out of control. If the cops and Advos don't step it up, I'm not gonna roll through here with anything less than size sixes if you know what I mean.
localization.pu_npcvp1_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_002_igo: I got stuck in a Customs jam outside Lorville. Sat there for hours while they sifted through every single ship. If those cops were wound any tighter, you could play them like a guitar.
localization.pu_npcvp1_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_iha: I had a run take me out of New Babbage over the weekend. Totally lost track of time, you know, getting everything loaded. Finally take off at night. Some asshole who was probably drunk, high, or both nearly rams me out of the sky.
localization.pu_npcvp1_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_ohy: Oh, you know, got my irons in the fire. Just out there grinding for credits to keep the man's foot off my back. It helps to have that dream though. Keeps me going through a lotta crap.
localization.pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsefrontierfig: Been trying to understand the Frontier Fighter's logic. Like, I get that they believe in fighting fire with fire, but doesn't that only help burn everything down? Not seeing how that mentality really helps anything.
Guess this kid I went to school with dropped everything and everyone in his life to join the Frontier Fighters. No one's heard from him since.
I was in Stanton when the attacks by the Slicers went down. It was wild. Frontier Fighters sure have a whole lotta bad karma coming their way.
localization.pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_: Heard someone humming a song, and now it's stuck in my head. Swear I've heard it before, but I can't for the life of me figure out what it is. It's driving me crazy.

Been busy charting potential routes for the next leg of my trip. Definitely want to spend some time in Castra. Maybe Oya after that. The dream is to visit a real, Xi'an city, but not sure if I'm ready for that.
Going a little stir-crazy. Been laying around the past few days battling this nasty cold. Think I've taken every med on the market and still can't kick it.
localization.pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsepyrofrontie: I met this old timer who's lived here for almost a century. Kept asking her for tips about how to survive, and all she would say is "keep ya' trap shut".
Got another comm from my dad. Sweet of him to care about how I'm doing, but not sure how to respond. He'll lose his mind if he finds out I'm in Pyro.
Did I tell you I swung by a CFP settlement? Things felt normal there. Like almost boring enough to make me think I was back home.
localization.pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responseregenhospit: I'd be better if you could guarantee that my imprint would work. I was only able to strike out here all by myself, because having one gave my dad peace of mind. Now that's out the window.
I need to know if something is wrong with me. I regened about six months ago, and I feel fine, but all this talk about imprints being messed up has me worried.
I want to get my imprinted deleted. Now that this tech is all messed up, I honestly don't feel comfortable with some company having a copy of me taking up space in some data center.
localization.pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responseregenpublic: I'm freakin' out a bit, right now. Saw someone on Spectrum saying their uncle regenned and came back half Human and half horseshoe crab. Like, I'm pretty sure that's not true, but I really don't know who to trust anymore.
Thinking back on this whole regen debacle, it's wild how the goverment was like "we solved death," and everyone just believed them.
Well, guess my days of being reckless are over. Now that there's no guarantee I'll regen, I might have to think twice before actually doing something fun.
localization.pu_npcvp20_civ_m_bdc_responsestanton_ig_: Can I admit something potentially controversial to you? I think ArcCorp is way more impressive than Orison. Planet-wide city versus a few floating platforms? Come on. No contest at all.

Had my first run in with Hurston Security. Went down this alley in Lorville and saw them beating the everliving shit outta someone. Guessing it was an activist, but didn't stick around to find out. Hope they're ok.

Was at Wally's Bar the other night and think someone slipped something in my drink. One moment I'm taking shots with some folks, and the next thing I remember is waking up in the Oasis room missing my mobi and one shoe.
localization.pu_npcvp21_bdc_greeting_ig_003,p: So, come on, talk to me.
localization.pu_npcvp21_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_001,p: Well, do what you gotta do.
localization.pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_: I knew the Frontier Fighters were a bunch of assholes. They were just way too gung-ho about busting into Pyro.

I'm about go get a piece of those Frontier Fighters myself. Maybe they had a leg to stand on a month ago, but they knocked out a buddy of mine claiming he was a "sympathizer," so they can just fuck right off.
I hope the Headhunters get ahold of the Frontier Fighters. I'd kill them myself, but I got too much work keeping me busy.
localization.pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p: You know, dealing with assholes. Got this guy who backed out on what he owed me for his haul. I'm giving him another day to cough up the creds or I'm gonna kick it out of him.
localization.pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p: Somebody almost scratched my ship the other day. Guy was wasted and weaving with a bunch of metal boxes a little too close. Grabbed him by the collar and put the fear of God in him.
localization.pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_003,p: Things are getting kinda desperate in the UEE. I’m one bad quarter away from joining an outlaw pack. Hell with doing the right thing when you got mouths to feed.
localization.pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_0: Still trying to make some moves. Caught wind of a couple opportunities that I'm looking into. We'll see.
Haven't gotten my head blown off yet. Way Pyro's headed, we'll see how long I can keep saying that.

I saw someone cross the Rough & Ready yesterday. Don't know if they opened fire on a station or stole from them or what, but they got dragged to an airlock and vented. Pretty messed up… but that's what you get.
localization.pu_npcvp21_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_: You're gonna get my imprint fixed. I don't care what you gotta do, who you gotta comm, you do it. If you think I'm gonna shell out all the credits I shelled out for an imprint that doesn't work, you're out of your mind.
I've called you assholes twenty times in the past two days and nobody's gotten back to me. I want answers, now. I don't care about my imprint, but my mom is terrified. She won't even leave the house.
What am I supposed to do with my imprint now? Nobody's saying nothing, but you all still got all the money I paid to have it stored here. If that shit's useless, I want my money back.
localization.pu_npcvp21_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_00: These doctors don't know shit. I'm telling you, everybody from the Imperator on down is just as confused as we are. You ask me, we should just bin the whole tech.
Everybody's freaking out about their imprints failing, but I couldn't care less. I miss that rush you get when you're taking a risk. I've been boring as hell since I got imprinted.
I'll be glad if this whole regen thing totally collapses. Made my life a lot easier when people were scared of dying. Made them less eager to mess with this.
localization.pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsestanton_ig_001,p: You really wanna know? The more I hang out in Stanton, the more I'm convinced the people around here are soft as hell. <derisive snort> It's pathetic.
localization.pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsestanton_ig_002,p: I need a break. Every time I come to Stanton, people come out of the woodwork trying to hire me to do shit. It's exhausting.
localization.pu_npcvp21_bdc_responsestanton_ig_003,p: I don't know what's going on. Been waiting for my ship to get replaced for three days now. ASOP's telling me it's en route, but when I called the landing services at Orison, they say they haven't gotten the request. It's so annoying.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_001_sot: So, tell me a bit about what's going on with you?
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_wellth: Well, that's the way it goes, right?
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_wouldn: Wouldn't have put it like that myself, but I get what you mean.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_wel: Well, it was my niece Tilly's equivalency ceremony last week, and it was just lovely. Did her parents spend too much on it? Sure. But I guess when your kid's nearly dropped out to join a gang, you got to celebrate any wins you can get.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_its: It's been a bit of a week waiting for this shipment to arrive. They don't know if it was stolen or what, but it might as well have grown legs and walked out of the hangar for as much as they know. Downright frustrating is what it is.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_genericresponse_ig_003_can: Can't complain really. Tell you the truth: Give me a bowl of porridge in the morning and I'm right as rain. I hear Admiral Bishop eats a bowl every morning too, if you can believe it. No wonder those 'duul don't stand a chance.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_001_ijustw: I just wish people would learn to mind their manners. Hell, if everyone would just take a moment and throw out their own trash, maybe we wouldn't all have to live in such an absolute pigsty, you know?
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_ivebee: I've been debating if I want to get an imprint made. On one hand, it'd be real nice not to die; but on the other, I've heard that the government implants coding so they can turn you into a loyal soldier when Ivar Messer becomes imperator again, and I'm not sure I'm willing to risk it.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_imthin: I'm thinking about getting a new helmet. Ever since I got stuck in that storm last week, the visor's been telling me I'm dehydrated. Can't tell you how much water I drank before I eventually realized it was a glitch.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_iwasju: I was just thinking about what my gang would be called if I was going to run one of my own. See, it needs to be something tough but also memorable, like the "Shoot Firsts" or maybe "the Killer Killers," but better than that. Though, I guess most gang names sound pretty dumb until one of them tries to shoot you.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_i: Getting a little tired of these Frontier Fighters. I would've been on their side if they didn't go and start attacking innocent people to prove their point. Now they're just another bunch of assholes.
Ran into some Frontier Fighters last week. Bunch of douchebags tried to explain why I was "helping the cause" while they were robbing me.
Been in a bit of a tailspin honestly. With everything popping off in Pyro and Frontier Fighters attacking Stanton, it's been hard to leave my hab.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_0: What do you mean my imprint isn't working? I got a hull full of radioactive cargo, and now you're telling me that it might kill me? Do you know how many credits I got sunk in this?
I don't care why it's not working. It's your job to do Regens, so fix the imprint scanner already.
Are you sure I can't do an Imprint today? I have a really important memory that I just made and I don’t want to lose it.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_001: All this regen failing business couldn't have come at a worst time. I just dropped a bunch of credits on a ship-racing class.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_002: This whole regen thing's got me paranoid as hell. All I know is the government better do something to fix it. Fast. Can't drop this kind of tech on us and then say it doesn't work.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_003: I was regen'd one time last year. I'd be lying if I say it didn't mess me up a bit. I'm still having nightmares. Maybe it's for the best if we can't use it anymore.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_001_ima: I'm all right. My allergies have been acting up a bit, though. I blame the Hosanna trees. No matter where I am in the system, their pollen seems to just follow me from Orison.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_002_you: You know what I just learned? That the Grim in Grim HEX actually stands for "Green Imperial." Crazy, right? It's a lot less intimidating when you say it that way.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_imr: I'm really looking forward to Invictus this year. The capital ships, the fireworks, all those gorgeous starmen in uniform. It's probably one of my favorite times of year.
localization.pu_npcvp2_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_isw: I swear, Whammer's has totally started making their burgers smaller. I used to be able to eat one whamburger and be full, but nowadays I need at least two. You know what? I should totally bring a scale with me the next time I go and catch them in the act.
localization.pu_npcvp3_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_ive: I've been on a bad streak lately, but my luck's due to turn any day now. Some side gigs finally coughed up which'll help me clear out my debts and keep me with a little left over, so yeah, I feel like things are looking up.
localization.pu_npcvp3_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_ine: I need to spend some time on my gear. Been too long since I've done a proper clean of my armor and weapons. That's the one thing I miss about the Army, kept me disciplined enough to keep everything tip top.
localization.pu_npcvp3_bdc_genericresponse_ig_003_bee: Been looking into getting one of those sight adjusters that automatically compensate bullet drop based off the atmosphere sampling. No idea how the hell it works but it's pretty insane tech.
localization.pu_npcvp3_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_001_ilikei: I like it out here. There's something quite calming about that whole law of the jungle thing. Some skag accused me of cheating at Trigger and stood up. After I cleaned the blood off, we just dealt another hand and that was that.
localization.pu_npcvp3_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_ivebee: I've been doing some sightseeing actually. I grew up hearing about what a hellhole Pyro is, but I gotta say, there are some pretty places around here.
localization.pu_npcvp3_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_pickin: Picking up some work here and there. Nice thing about all these gangs at each other's throats is that there's always someone who could use an extra gun or two.
localization.pu_npcvp3_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_gotjum: Got jumped heading out my hab earlier. Guy acted like I'd killed his family or something… maybe I had. I don't know. I can't even tell 'em apart anymore.
localization.pu_npcvp3_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_001_bus: Business is booming. I can't turn down the gigs fast enough. Gotten to the point where hearing about another crime spree gives me a warm and tingly feeling. Hell, if it dries up, I might just go pull some crimes to kick it back up again.
localization.pu_npcvp3_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_002_bud: Buddy of mine just reached out and tried to get me to join BlacJac. I don't know, not sure I could stand getting stuck walking a beat in Area18. I'd probably kill everybody there after day two.
localization.pu_npcvp3_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_ike: I keep hearing word of this militia the corps are looking to build. You ask me, the UEE should probably step in. If they don't, I'm totally down. I'm sure we'll be able to charge those accountants a mint.
localization.pu_npcvp3_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_imi: I might clear out of this system soon. It's been good for business, but I don't know, dealing with all these corpo assholes just grates on me. Most of the time, I just want to waste 'em all.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_guesst: Guess that's the way it is sometimes.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_ihopee: I hope everything works out for you.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_fee: Feeling a bit out of it. My sister just enlisted in the Navy. We were supposed to go start up our own settlement but I guess she changed her mind. Wish she would have told me. Not sure what I'm going to do now.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_one: One of my friends just told me about this huge deposit they spotted while out scanning. If everything goes according to plan, the two of us are going to go half in on an extractor and should make some decent profit.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_genericresponse_ig_003_ive: I've been thinking about packing up everything and heading out somewhere new for a fresh start. Figure all I need is a few resources and I can just fabricate anything else I need. Feel like I'd do my soul some good to get back to basics.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_001_imnots: I'm not sure what to make of these Citizens for Prosperity people. Do they actually think they can make a difference? Just keep wondering what's in it for them.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_hearda: Heard about this settlement that got wiped out by raiders last week. Thinking about heading out there and see if there's enough left to get it going again. I mean, it's gotta be pretty safe, right? No way the raiders would come back to hit the same settlement twice.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_iwasou: I was out on the drift last week, all by myself, and that big flare hits. So there I am, sitting in the powered-down ship when I start hearing something. Not sure what the hell it was, but maybe these Fire Rats are on to something.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_feelsg: Feels good to have a few credits to my name. Finally can buy myself a decent meal. Not sure how many more carafi cubes I was gonna be able to choke down.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_001_ive: I've been hearing rumors that Hurston might be mandating a curfew. Guess they're unhappy about workers showing up to shifts tired, and want to make sure everyone gets enough sleep. It sure does suck when your government's also your boss.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_002_myf: My family and I are thinking about taking a trip this Luminalia. Might go somewhere extra snowy on microTech to really get into the spirit of things. Nothing like watching the lamp light flicker while all bundled up in a warm sweater and sipping on cocoa.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_ihe: I heard about a new settlement trying to start up on Yela. Guess they found a few resources and think it might be enough to have a go at it. Not sure if I'm going, but I figure it's worth sending them a comm.
localization.pu_npcvp4_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_ido: I don't know how people can live in Orison full time. I need solid ground under my feet, and some floating platform doesn't cut it.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_greeting_ig_001,p: Life been good to you recently?
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_greeting_ig_003,p: What's been going on with you?
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_001,p: As my Pops says, you can't control life, just gotta live it the best you can.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_002,p: Gotta take things a day at a time, right?
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_reactiongeneric_ig_003,p: Some things just boggle the mind.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsefrontierfighters_i: I heard about Amelia Boyd's past and it was really sad. It doesn't excuse what the Frontier Fighters have done, but still. I feel bad for her.
I've been feeling really bad for all those families of the Frontier Fighter victims. It's such a shame.
I wish the government would have at least listened to the Frontier Fighters. They probably could have stopped all of this if they just paid attention.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_001,p: Decided to take a few days for myself. I'm not setting an alarm or planning anything. Just gonna let the day take me where it takes me. Feels like I've been going non-stop recently and it's starting to wear on me.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_002,p: I've been better. Had a terrible dream last night. Something woke me up in the middle of it too, and now I can't shake this weird feeling. Like, I know the dream is just my mind processing stuff, but it felt so damn real.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsegeneric_ig_003,p: Days like today remind me why I left Terra. I got this comm from my mom and she is... look, she means well but isn't the best at expressing it. She just comes off as very self-righteous and dismissive of anything that's not simpatico with her world view.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsepyrofrontier_ig_00: Think I'm getting a little too used to being in Pyro. Saw someone get gunned down in the middle of a marketplace and didn't think anything of it. Just assumed they had it coming.
I stopped by a Citizens for Prosperity outpost yesterday. This system could use a few more places like that. Might look into doing some more work for them.

My pops just commed saying he wants to come visit. Thing is he still thinks I'm doing odd jobs around Stanton. He'd shit a brick if he knew I was in Pyro, so I'm trying to think up a solid excuse for why he can't come.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_responseregenhospital_ig_0: I want to know what's going on. I want somebody to check my imprint and make sure it's working. They said this shit was supposed to be safe.
You can tell me who the hell's gonna fix this. I splashed out god knows how many credits to get a "platinum level" regen package and now I’m hearing that this shit won't even work?

I want to talk to a doctor or a scientist or someone who knows what the hell is going on. How am I supposed to know if some other weird side effect suddenly pops up? Like everyone with an imprint suddenly drops dead.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_001: I'm scared. I'll admit it. It was really wonderful to know that if tragedy struck, people weren't really gone. But now… it's back to the way it was before.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_002: Been frustrated with the UEE's response to this regen thing. Feel like they had to have known it was an issue before they announced it. Who knows how many people were flying around not knowing they were at risk of really dying.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_responseregenpublic_ig_003: Being a lot more careful, I'll tell you that. Ever since this regen thing blew up, I'll admit I've been a lot more cautious on the drift.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsestanton_ig_001,p: Met someone at the Teasa spaceport who offered me decent creds to courier her backpack to a friend in Lorville. Guess she was short on time and really needed to patch up the hull of her ship. Turned her down 'cause she was giving off this weird vibe, but now I'm wondering if I just missed out on some easy money.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsestanton_ig_002,p: I'm not feeling great right now. Got a burrito from one of those stalls in Area18 yesterday and it did not agree with me. Had to abandon a gig today because I just wasn't up to it. That'll teach me to stray away from the ol' reliable Torpedo Burrito.
localization.pu_npcvp5_bdc_responsestanton_ig_003,p: Was in Orison the other day and ran into an old friend from Terra. Gotta say, kinda weird when someone from your old life is suddenly smack dab in the middle of your new one. Honestly didn't know what to say to him.
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_001_soh: So how you been? You good?
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_002_fee: Feels like I ain't seen you for ages. What you been doing?
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_003_you: You're looking good. Been up to much?
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericreact_ig_002_yeahye: Yeah. Yeah, yeah, I feel that.
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_priceo: Price of doing business, I guess.
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_let: Let me tell you. I got things happening. Big things. Kinda things that turn a regular guy into a legend. You know what I mean?
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_you: You know, just been out there. Living that life. Ear to the grindstone.  Looking for opportunities. That's what you gotta do these days. You gotta make your own magic because let me tell you, ain't no one gonna help you with your future. You gotta do that.
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_genericresponse_ig_003_ith: I think my Guild membership is gonna lapse soon. I haven't needed to mine anything in years, so I just kinda let it slip. It's weird though. Growing up, that seemed like the coolest, but I just been busy with other opportunities, you know? Can't keep your head in a tunnel as my dad used to say.
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_001_everyb: Everybody's so pissed at each other out here. Fire Rats hate Horizon. Headhunters hate CFP. XenoThreat hates everybody. Shit's stressful. I kinda wish everyone would just calm down.
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_imina,: I'm in a lotta trouble actually. Or maybe. I'm not actually sure. Word is that Jimmy Dengo's been telling people he's gonna plug me the next time he sees me. Thing is, I don't know a Jimmy Dengo, so maybe it's all talk. I don't know.
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_beenwi: Been wild lately. I thought Rough & Ready operated all the stations in the system. I flew up to this one last week, bunch of assholes just opened fire. Barely got out of there alive. But otherwise, can't complain.
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_gotapp: Got approached by a Fire Rat the other day. There I was, just minding my own business, eating some chuan, when I notice this weirdo just standing next to me, staring at me. He asks me if I heard the Prophet whisper. I said no, but I can hear my Dominator shout. Guy left me alone.
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_001_bee: Been trying to drum up investors over on microTech, but I gotta tell you. I can't keep up with those kids. I mean, I like a good night out, sure and even back in the day known to chase down a party or two, but Jesus, all the booze and drugs these kids do is nuts.
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_002_bee: Been hanging out at my cousin's place. Don't know if you ever met her. Good egg that one. Anyway, she's out on some business thing in Terra for the next month or two, so I'm staying at her place. You know, water the pets, feed the plants, that kinda thing. It's cool... place is loud though.
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_imk: I'm kinda done with this system. Everybody's got their own regs on what they will and won't accept, it's impossible to keep track anymore. I just wanna bounce to somewhere in the UEE that's much simpler.
localization.pu_npcvp6_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_had: Had a run take me to an executive center on Hurston. Let me tell you, they may be the biggest assholes in the 'verse, but they know how to live.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_003_how: How are things in your neck of the woods?
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_youcan: You can only do what you can, right?
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericreact_ig_002_weallh: We all have our crosses to bear.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericreact_ig_003_wellev: Well, everything happens for a reason I guess.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_its: It's been an adventure, you know? Seen some things that I never thought I'd see and others, I honestly wish I hadn't. But that's the journey, I guess.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_spe: Spent the last couple of nights plotting where I'm going to head next. I genuinely don't know where I want to go and that's not even factoring in Banu or Xi'an systems. It's pretty exciting though.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_genericresponse_ig_003_aft: After all this time, I'm actually surprised at how much I don't miss having a place to call home. I would've thought I'd miss it: having that familiarity. But I really don't.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_001_pyrosb: Pyro's been eye-opening. You hear the rumors and think this place is just going to be a war, but it's not. I mean, I wouldn’t exactly call it safe, but there are people here just trying to live their lives, just like in a so-called 'secure' system.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_imetan: I met an interesting guide the other day who showed me around Pyro III, which I guess they call Bloom. She didn't know why. Anyway, it was really pretty.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_things: Things got a little tense recently. My group attracted the attention of some... let's just say less desirable people who tried to relieve us of our stuff. I imagine their lives must have been really rough, but we didn't let them take anything.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_ireall: I really tried not to bring my judgements into this system, but seeing the general disregard for life in Pyro is really overwhelming. I don't know. It's just sad to see.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_001_div: Dividing my time between the four planets has been interesting. It's like seeing four different approaches to capitalism manifested. My old econ professor would've loved it.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_002_ido: I don't really like what I'm seeing on Hurston. The people there… it's just not fair how they're being treated. I know they signed contracts and all, but that doesn't give Hurston the right to exploit them.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_spe: Spent three days sitting in Orison. I didn't even have a room rented out. Just spent my nights sitting on the edge of one of the platforms and just watching that beautiful world turn.
localization.pu_npcvp7_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_ive: I've been thinking lately. I thought Area18 would be more impressive. Sure, it's crazy to think how much Arccorp built in a relatively small amount of time, but to me, a city's a city. Doesn't matter if it's Prime or an entire planet.
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_genericgreeting_ig_002_bee: Been a while, how have you been?
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_allill: All I'll say is appreciate any day where you don't gotta deal with the 'duul.
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_genericresponse_ig_001_you: You'll never guess what happened to me today. Almost cracked my dang head open coming out of the shower. Glad I caught myself.  'Wet floor' has gotta be one of the top ten most embarrassing reasons to regen.
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_genericresponse_ig_002_get: Get this, a Tev I know hired me to help 'em assess the potential of a mining site in Branaugh. First time I'd ever been there. I can't get into the specifics, but I'll just say there's good creds to be made there.
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_genericresponse_ig_003_rew: Rewatched part of Lost Squad last night. Not sure why I do it to myself. I mean, it's a great series, but every time I put it on it reminds me of Vega. Still haven't been back since the attack. Kinda been avoiding it.
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_001_alittl: A little worried. Got it on good authority that a pack of 'duul were spotted in Nyx. Was just about to make the jump when I heard. Might have to add Nyx to my 'no-go' list if this keeps happening.
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_002_gottas: Gotta say, this is one beautiful system. Seen a bunch of sites that would be primo locations to build a home. Just not sure I'm ready to put down roots again, especially in a system with so many outlaws. Feels like I'd just be askin' for trouble.
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_003_little: Little pissed with myself. Haven't worked Pyro in a bit and let my ship get hit hard by a coronal mass ejection. My scanner system's been all messed up since. Been trying to fix it myself but worried I might have to replace it.
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_pyroresponse_ig_004_iverea: I've really come around on Pyro. Used to avoid it like the plague, but now that Stanton's also crawling with outlaws, it almost feels just as dangerous.
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_001_fou: Found a little spot in the Aaron Halo that's been more productive than expected. Growin' a little concerned though.  I'm seeing more and more pirates in that part of the belt. Gotta wrap things up before they clock me.
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_002_had: Had an old friend passing through the system recently who really wanted to see what a city-wide planet looks like. I mean ArcCorp's a sight, for sure, but every time I'm there, all I'm wondering is how much valuable ore is still buried under all those buildings.
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_003_jus: Just finished a biography on Gal Dougan. Been listening to her non-stop while mining too. It inspired me to spend more time wandering around Grim HEX. Think I found the spot where she wrote "The Day Ahead."
localization.pu_npcvp8_bdc_stantonresponse_ig_004_sot: So the other day someone at New Babbage ran up to me and asked me to pick between Pico and Finley. Didn't know what the hell was going on and gave them a pretty salty response. Guess it was part of some hidden cam, and the clip's all over Spectrum. Been a little weird having old friends comm me outta the blue over it.
localization.pu_npcvp9_bdc_genericreact_ig_001_everyd: Every day's a gift, isn't it?

localization.pu_ntguide01_m_ntg_announce_tour_messhal: Hello everyone, my name's Lt. Horrigan and as you can probably tell, this is the War Hammer's mess hall. Definitely one of the more popular spaces on the ship, the mess has a fully automated dispensary since we operate on rotating shifts. We have a standard crew complement of sixty-five to seventy and meals need to be available at all times, so we have a culinary team always on duty, ready to lend support. The famous pilot Aria Reilly was once quoted as saying "If you ever want to take the temperature of a ship's crew, spend twenty minutes in their mess." This is one of the main social areas of the ships where crew members from different departments can catch up in their downtime. We also use the mess for social events like birthdays, holidays, and promotions since it's able to hold so many people. Our skipper, Captain Medcalf, is a big believer in casual gatherings in an effort to entrench kamaraderie, so we're in here pretty often. Now you've probably noticed our games in the corner so I'll just address the question that everyone asks: yes, it's pretty competitive. The XO currently has the score to beat. Anyway, I'd like to invite you to have a look around.

localization.pu_ntguide02_m_ntg_announce_tour_barrack:
Hi folks. Welcome to the War Hammer. I'm Leading Starman Detmer and this, as you've probably guessed, is one of the two barracks on the ship. I know, I know, you must be thrilled to see where Navy personnel sleep and let me be the first to tell you, it's every bit as exciting as promised. Javelins are pretty great when it comes to the sleeping arrangements as they have enough bunks for the full crew which is amazing because it avoids situations known as 'hot bunking' where you swap out bunks with somebody on the opposite shift. That, is horrible. This one time on my old ship I had to share with this guy who had just the worst smelling socks. I'm talking 'the military could've weaponized it' kind of bad. And I had to try and fall asleep with that stench every, day. So, after that, these bunks are a dream. Actually, I don't think my CO would like me talking about how bad hot bunking is. Maybe just forget I said anything.

Anyway, each one has special slots for personal effects and is capable of sealing up to give you a little privacy as people are always moving around the barracks. Sleeping schedules shift slightly too and they can activate the full crew at a moment's notice if the ship enters heavy combat, so you're always sleeping with one eye open anyway. I mean, we get shorter sleep schedules if we're patrolling in dangerous space, so you're already grabbing sleep when you can. Sorry, I'm rambling. Otherwise... yeah, I'm not sure what else to tell you. This is where we sleep. Not a whole lot of mystery to it. 

I hope this has been enlightening. Have a look around if you want, but please don't touch anything in the bunks. This is an active ship and everything in here is the property of the crew, so be cool.

localization.pu_ntguide03_f_ntg_announce_tour_turret_:
All right, let's settle down. My name's Lt. Commander Aldeman, I run the turret complement aboard the War Hammer. That means I'm in charge of coordinating fire between our various gunners during a combat engagement in order to maximize combat effectiveness. But, when we aren't in combat, I strive to keep my team sharp by running through engagement drills and simulated encounters. Now the Javelin comes standard with fifteen turrets, thirteen of which have embedded operators. There are six turrets like the one you see here that run along the side of the ship. Each of which is equipped with a pair of Size 7 cannons for larger targets and a pair of Size 4 gatlings for smaller targets like fighters and even incoming missiles and torpedoes. We've got four more turrets on the bow of the ship, armed with Size 7 energy cannons and three gunners on the underside with the same. All this firepower is coupled with a heavy payload of ordnance to make the War Hammer a real problem for all sizes of ship, hence why we can be tasked to operate independently on patrols without support from the rest of the battle group.

During the XenoThreat incursion, our gunners were responsible for the destruction of over seventy hostile elements and several capital ships as well as protecting the ship from incoming ordnance.

As a special treat, we've safetied this turret so you can get a taste of what it feels like to be a gunner. All the weapons have been deactivated so don't worry about accidental discharge, but I'll remind you this is an active military vessel, so be respectful all the same. Thank you and have a great Invictus.
