I'll give you one chance to get back on that shuttle, otherwise you're fair game.

Why the hell do the CDF have to come in and wreck some good old-fashioned chaos? I mean, we're not messing with you, so why the hell do you wanna risk your life for those chickenshits at Crusader who don't even have the sack to defend their own territory? Take a second and think it over, we can blast any ship that comes near us out of the sky. I've got heavy-hitters locking down each of the platforms. You don't stand a chance, so just take my advice; get back on the shuttle, go home, and pop a Pips. You'll live longer.

Crusader's even more pathetic than we thought to rely on civvies to save their ass. We control the skies around all these platforms so there ain't nobody getting close that ain't a friend of Nine Tails and each island is controlled by someone you really don't want to be messing with, so best thing you can do is get back on that shuttle. It ain't your problem.
You probably think you're making good progress so far. And yeah, maybe we started off underestimating you, but don't worry, that'll change.
Yeah, great. You survived this far. But if you think it's gonna get any easier you're in for a world of hurt.
All right, you made it this far, sure. You got lucky. It's not gonna last. Trust me.
Why the hell won't you just die already? No bloody way am I'm losing to you CDF shitheads.
Why won't you all just walk away? You're acting like Crusader is someone worth protecting. Hell with it, we got something special cooked up for you.
Goddammit! You volunteers couldn't just keep out of our business, could you? I got better things to do than deal with your stupid ass.
You don't really think you're going to make a difference here, do you? Trust me, we're still in control here.
I gotta tell ya, I'm getting pretty sick and tired of you interfering with Nine Tails business. Gloves are coming off.
So you managed to slightly interupt our plans here, you want an award or something? Whatever, I'm getting tired of dealing with you. This ends now.
localization.pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_approach_missionbo: Just you and me now. Let's see what you've got.
Where the hell you at?! Let's do this.
Come on, asshole. Time to settle this shit.
localization.pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_deaththroe_mission: You didn't win here. (pained laugh) You didn't stop shit?
Don't you worry. We'll do this again real soon?
Yeah, all right. That was a good scrap?
localization.pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_failed_mission_ig_: I told you the CDF wouldn't stand a chance against the Nine Tails. To anybody who survived, remember this and don't ever cross us again.
Sorry we had to kill some of you, but maybe in the future, you all should think twice before fighting some company's battles for them.
Thanks for keeping us entertained while we did our work, CDF. You certainly kept things lively.
localization.pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionboss_: Well, shit. Guess I'm all out of people. Then fine, you all want a fight? Head to the barge and let's fight.
You bastards got all of them? even Stax. All right then. Come to the barge and I'm gonna give you CDF shitheads a personal demonstration of what the Nine Tails are really capable of.
So this is it, eh? Just me against an army of some over-eager volunteering do-gooders. Fine. It's time I got my hands bloody. I'll be waiting for you on the barge. Better bring your A-game.
localization.pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_intro_missionobj_t: You hear that, Remy? You got some company. If they cause a problem, you show them what Nine Tails can do.
Remy, you copy? You got another CDF sucker heading your way.
Remy, look alive. CDF's en route to your island. If they don't get back on that shuttle, you make 'em regret it.
Hey Acker, you there? You got some trouble coming in. Make it hurt.
Acker, look alive. CDF's making their way to you.
Get your game face on, Acker. You got some company.
Now you gotta deal with Scorch. You all right with that, Scorch?
Hey Scorch. Got some more kindling for you to burn.
Scorch, I'm trusting you to handle this. You got me?
Stax, you got some trouble headed your way. Watch yourself.
It's up to you, Stax. You got this?
You're on deck, Stax. Watch out for this one, okay?
localization.pu_ntsiegecdr01_m_deo_succeed_missionobj: Solanki was Remy's first real assignment and to be honest, I hoped he'd at least be able to hold his own against some pissant volunteers, but I'll bitch him out about that when he regens. The CDF won't get that lucky again.
You may have taken out Remy, but he was a newby compared to what's coming, so don?t think it's gonna get any easier from here.
Not surprised you lot got the better of Remy. Kid talks too much. Probably could've lasted longer if he wasn't shooting his mouth off.
Goddammit? I'll admit, I wasn't expecting Acker to get punched out like that. You CDF just won't quit, will you?

Gotta say, I'm a little surprised you all managed to take out Acker. I mean, the guy was a certifiable lunatic. He made Vanduul seem tame, so it's probably better for all of us that he's out of the picture.
Shit. Taking out Acker ain't nothing to sneeze at. But, who knows, maybe you just caught him having a bad day.
I'll be damned. Some nobody CDF volunteers took out Scorch... Must've gotten lucky.
Getting kinda sick of the CDF taking out my people, but I guess that's life, huh.
Shit? guess you put Scorch out of his misery, huh. You know, you CDF are really starting to piss me off.
How the hell did you get to Stax so fast? He didn't deserve to go out like that.
I can't believe you got to him so quick. Stax and I came up together. The CDF's gonna pay for taking him out like some scag.
Eight years? Stax and I ran together for eight years? pulled more jobs and got outta more scrapes than you can imagine. And just like that, he's gone. You're gonna pay for that.
Stax didn't deserve to go out like that, you scag shit. You all better get ready because there's no way I'm letting of you CDF bastards walk away from this.

You know, it's damn near impossible to find people you can trust in this game. And you all just killed him. The one person I knew would have my back no matter what. Guess I'm gonna have to handle this myself afterall.
I'm gonna hurt you bastards real bad for what you did to Stax. Any of you step foot on this barge and I'll show you how serious I am.
I can't believe you all did Stax like that? You're all dead. You hear me? That was my friend.
That was my friend. I'm gonna make you CDF bastards pay for what you did. And don't think for a second that you're gonna get a quick death.
You killed my friend. Big mistake. I'm gonna find each and every one of you and torture you so bad, your regen's gonna be screamin' in pain.
localization.pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_approach_missionobj: You know what? I'm sick of watching inept dipshits try and take you out.
Did you know that every time you regen you get stronger? Win or lose, I'll be back stronger than ever before.
Come on, you and me, let's do this! Whooo!
localization.pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono: You think this is over? I'll be back?
localization.pu_ntsiegelt01_m_deo_respond_missionobj_: Oh yeah, boss. Don't you worry. I got 'em. I'll beat them so bad, their regen's gonna wake up in pain.
I'm going by Phoenix now, but yeah, we got this place on lock.
Oh, hell yeah. I'll smoke 'em so fast, they'll regen before they know what hit them.
localization.pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_approach_missionobj: You think you can just look into fire and walk away? Nobody walks away. It gets us all.
It's time. Are you ready? Are you ready to face what comes next?
The fire couldn't kill me. What makes you think you'll do any better?
localization.pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono: I lost the fire. Where did it go? Where did it go?
localization.pu_ntsiegelt02_m_deo_respond_missionobj_: Yeah, they'll burn. They'll burn like all the rest.
Sure, we got a special welcome planned.
localization.pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_approach_missionobj: Hell with it, I'll kill you myself.
I'm gonna send you to a deep dark place and I'm gonna have fun doing it.
Time to go to sleep, shithead.
localization.pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono: Screw you? you ain't gonna be the last of?
localization.pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_react_poi_openconta: You know, you'd think people would do what the heavily armed criminals order them to do. Pretty surprising how many didn't, huh?
Oh, them? Yeah, I wasn't quite sure if my guns were working right. As you can see, they're working fine.
Ren told me to control the hostages. They looked pretty controlled to me.
localization.pu_ntsiegelt03_m_deo_respond_missionobj_: No problemo. I'll make 'em feel real welcome.
Oh no. Are they here to save everybody? (laugh) Good luck with that.
Bring 'em on, I've been getting bored over here.
localization.pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_approach_missionobj: All right, you asked for it. I'm not gonna go easy on you.
Where you at? Come on, let's do this!
Where you at? Come on, let's do this!
Where you at? Come on, let's do this!
You ready to do this? Let's go then.
localization.pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_deaththroe_missiono: I'll be damned? that really hurts?
localization.pu_ntsiegelt04_m_deo_respond_missionobj_: You got it, boss. We'll be ready.
Yeah, all right. This whole thing's starting to remind me of that raid we did back in '46.
I got your back, boss. We'll handle 'em.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxcrimi: Another mining group got raided. It's like they know exactly where we're going to be. Jak suggested that we round up everyone suspicious and push them out of the vent. But, that's a bit too extreme, right? Anyway, what about you? Did you have any bad run-ins as well?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxgener: Hey, you look like you have something on your mind. Alright, spill it. I'm here for you, buddy.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxueeen: I heard rumors about some UEE ships in Nyx. To be honest, I don't really mind UEE protection, but based on what my pop told me about his life as a Hurston's miner. It was like 2-hour shifts, 8 days a week. That's horrible, right? I don't want that for me or my future kids. Anyway, do you know anything?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxvandu: I feel like it's a one-way trip every time we head out mining. I mean, at least with the gangs, you can try to make a deal with them, but the 'duul, they just attack without saying anything. Shit, I'm sorry, I don't want to scare you off or anything. How about you? Do you have any news regarding the 'duul as well?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxcrimi: Yeah, I get you. I think everyone is just trying to survive in Nyx. We just need to find a better option that suits everyone.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxgener: I feel ya. Life in Nyx is strange but it's still better than Stanton, am I right?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxueeen: I heard stories from my granpa about what happened to Tanaka. I just hope that the Alliance is strong enough to stand against the Empire. Maybe we can try to make a deal with them to leave us alone.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxvandu: I just don't understand what they want from us. I think we should try to capture one and learn from it. Maybe then we can have a conversation with them, you know? I mean, decades of fighting them haven't changed anything at all.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_responsenyxgener: Just visited my pop in the hospital. I wanted to tell him about what happened to Rebecca. But he kept going on and on about the time he spent with that ship. Shit, man, when he sees it being all jacked up... he might have to regen again.

This new kid mentioned a "secret" ore repository in the ice belt. I followed his coordinates and then I ended up crashing straight into an asteroid. Now my family's mining ship is a wreck. I want to report him to the chief but I don't want to cause a scenen within the mining group?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_responsenyxueeen: I noticed some ships floating about the ice belts. They're definitely not from around here. To be honest, I think they looked like those UEE patrol ships. Dealing with criminals is one thing, but I don't think we stand a chance against the Empire. Maybe we can make a deal with them to leave us alone? I don't know.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_bdc_responsenyxvandu: My mining ship got raided by some 'duul scouts. Luckily, an Alliance patrol group was nearby to intercept them. Me and my crew made it somehow, but I heard only one guy from that group managed to return. I think I'll drop by Mercy to visit him. With all the losses, I think he deserves at least a thank you from us.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerapprecia: Thank you very much. I'm sure to come back here again.
Thanks, I'm glad that supplies are good around here.
With outlaws and shady merchants hiding among us, I'm glad that I can find someone I  can trust.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customergiveorde: You know what, I want this. My mining crew is going to be jealous the next time we head out.
Alright, I'll have this. Carl is going to be happy when he sees this.
Give me this. This will be a morale boost for everyone.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerreactser: What do you mean by that? It must have been a mistake.
Hmm, What? That can't be true. I've been waiting all evening.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerrequests: Hey my mining shift is coming up, and I would really appreciate it if you would help me out.
The chief wants me to check in with you before heading out to make sure the task he requested is done.
Carl's mining ship got bust up really bad. Can you work things out for him before the next shift?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customerservicec: Look, I don't have time for this. My next mining run is coming up. My crews are already calling me. What is taking so long?
Shit, I'm late to my mining shift. Hey, can you let me know what's going on here? I really need this to be ready.
I think this is taking longer than it's supposed to be. Is there a reason for that?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_customershopping: There is no way stocks can be this bad. Did all the good shits get smuggled to the Moraine?
I feel like I'm looking at nothing but leftover scraps. Did the outlaws from the Ring got first dip on the hauls again!?
We can't mine if we can't resupply. I know you need to make a profit but my Dad told me "We residents need to look out for each other."
The prices here seem fair. I'm glad we still have some decent vendors around.
You're wares are a lifesaver to us miners around here. Hey, my crew and me appreciate you're hard work.
It's been a long time since I saw so many good shit around. You're haulers are doing good work.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde: Right away, I'm glad our supplies can help you out even a little bit. You can consider it already in your inventory, friend.
Sure thing. Sending it to your inventory. If you know anyone else who might be interested in my wares, do direct them here.
Alright, I got you. It should be in your inventory in a minute.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendordirectcons: Maybe you should try the terminal over there. We merchants sometimes share our stock around here, so you might find what you need in it instead.
Have you tried checking the terminal over there? That market has limited space, so I only show popular items. Who knows, I may have what you need in stock instead.
If the items on the shelf are not to your liking, you should check with the terminal over there. It updates my stock live whenever the haulers bring in the goods.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorofferhelp_: I'll do my best so you can head out there in the best condition possible. So, let me know what you need.
I heard another mining group got raided near the Ice belt. It's shit, but if you're heading out there mining, let me know if there's anything I can help you to survive.
Anything here caught your eye yet? If not, you can count on me.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco: Please understand, with all the outlaws out there, our haulers and miners are having a tough time doing their work.
How about we just keep it cool? Nyx's outlaws are messing with all of us, let's not fight among ourselves.
Just take a deep breath. I know it's rough in around here, but we need to stay strong together. Whatever you need, I will try get it in the next haul.
Take your time and browse through my wares. They are from our latest haul.
Trust me. Not even a vanduul fleet can stop you if you have one of these.
Just to let you know, these items are really popular with our miners around here.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp01_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig: Welcome. I have supplies to keep our community strong. Have a look.
Hey friend, you'll find that I have just the supplies you need. Our haulers travel tirelessly across the verse to get these to Nyx.
Hey there, fresh new haul from Castra. These don't come in very often.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_questionnyxcrimi: This is probably gonna sound contrary to the Rules of Life, but I think we should just kick out anyone who's a criminal. It's harsh but I think you gotta prove your loyalties lie with the Alliance, because honestly, we're just being played for suckers and I'm sick of it. What do you think?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_questionnyxgener: Just to say, I'm don't know if you heard the racket coming from the temporary habs last night, but I feel like we gotta screen the people who can stay here. Anyway, sorry, what's going on with you?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_questionnyxueeen: With everything going on, I'm getting worried how I'm often I'm hearing people seriously discussing incorporating into the UEE. Having grown up in the Empire, I just can't see everything that's special about Levski surviving that. Not sure how you feel…
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_questionnyxvandu: Buddy of mine said he was actually going to try and communicate with the Vanduul. I tried to talk him out of it, but he was on that whole 'enemy of my enemy' thing. I hope he reconsiders. Have you run into them yet?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxcrimi: I'm just tired of being taken advantage of. We're trying to build something here and these assholes come in to screw it all up.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxgener: Guess that's life on the fringe, huh.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxueeen: Screw 'em. UEE won't bring nothing but problems here.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxvandu: Yeah, plus if they keep hanging around here. I feel like the UEE's just gonna come in and try to 'secure the system.' Then we're all screwed.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_responsenyxcrimi: I think the Executives are staying too soft about the criminals. Still welcome people in, sure, but if we find out you're running with a pack, you're out. No explanation, nothing. Just good bye.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_responsenyxgener: I've been pulling a lot of shifts lately, some work in the stores, admin, and even some security patrols. It's been just been good to take my mind off things, you know?
I don't think I can go to Musain's any more. I've just been so on edge lately that getting wasted isn't doing me any favors. I wake up feeling worse than when I crashed.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_responsenyxueeen: Honestly, I don't know if the UEE will be able to help themselves. Yeah, they're not the Messers any more, but a corrupt system is a corrupt system.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_bdc_responsenyxvandu: I've just been trying to keep track of where they've been congregating. Right now it seems like they're in the ass end of the system. I just hope it stays that way.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerapprecia: Thanks for coming in. Have a good one.
You're all set. Til next time I guess.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customergiveorde: Screw it. It's pricey but I'll go for it.
Yeah, I think I'll give it a shot.
I'll take it. You only live once, right?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerreactser: <heavy sigh> This is stupid. This is so stupid…
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerrequests: Hey, sorry, I sent along a request and was told to come by to see if you could help.
I've been having a bunch of issues lately and heard you could help me.
I got sent your way. Things have been getting a little crazy out there and could use some help.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customerservicec: Look, I'm tired of coming here. I need to get this resolved today.
You people have been giving me the runaround for days. Is there any chance I can get this taken care of now?
I need this handled now. No more comm calls or sitting on hold. Now.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_customershopping: I bought something from you last week and it's already busted so I want to know what the hell you're gonna do about it.
Why am I back here again? Every thing I buy from you turns out to be a piece of shit, so what's up. What's going on?
I don't know where you get this shit, but you can't expect people to pay real credits for this stuff.
Oh nice. I've heard about these. They're supposed to be pretty good.
Is this thing new? Looks nice.
I don't remember seeing this here before.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendoracceptorde: Great. I'll have it sent to your hangar.
Oh, you want it? Cool. I'll have it sent over.
That's great. I think you'll really like this.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendordirectcons: Check out the console. It knows a lot more than I do.
Have a look at the terminal too. There are some things in there that aren't on the shelves.
Yeah, maybe check the terminal if you have questions.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorofferhelp_: Give a shout if you need a hand with anything.
I'm still trying to get up to speed on what we sell here, but I'll answer what I can.
Let me know if I can help.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorshoppingco: I don't know what you want me to do, I'm just filling in here.
You'll have to take it up with the owner when they're back.
I'm sorry, but there's nothing I can do.
Feel free to try it out. They've been really popular lately.
Been moving a lot of these from what I'm told, so yeah, act quick, I guess.
I've heard good things about that.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp02_civ_f_soc_vendorwelcome_ig: Hey, thanks for coming in. Have a look around.
You good? Feel free to see if there's anything you want.
Hey, how's it going? I think we got some new merch, check it out.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxcrimi: Heard some scuttle that the Moraine have a mole in the People's Alliance. Need you to keep your eyes and ear open about this. Folks talk more freely around you. Any security concerns you wanted to flag?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxgener: Something's wrong with my hab's ventilation system. It got hot as hell in there last night and I couldn't get any sleep. Got me feeling all outta sorts today. How you doing?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxueeen: Why's everyone's suddenly concerned about the UEE coming in and taking control of the system? If there was anything in Nyx they really wanted, they would've claimed this system centuries ago. Do you think it's anything to be concerned about?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxvandu: Look, I know most folks don't agree with me on this, but we need to increase our stock of munitions 'round here. Even though it goes against every bit of my being, violence is the only language the Vanduul speak. And if we don't respond in kind, they'll wipe us off the damn StarMap. Where do you fall on this? How worried are you of the 'duul?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxcrimi: Not sure if you ever meet my grandma, but she used to say, "acknowledge the evil you see, but don't let it change you." Always have that in the back of my mind when thinking 'bout how the Alliance should handle this stuff.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxgener: Appreciate your input. You always put an interesting spin on things.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxueeen: My family helped found Levski, and there's always been rumors the UEE was about to storm to system. Not sure why they'd do it now after leaving us alone for so long.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxvandu: This Vanduul situation isn't good. If even a small sized clan targeted Levski, we'd be in real trouble.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_responsenyxcrimi: Thinking Levski will ever be crime-free is a damn pipe dream. Criminals have always tried to take advantage of our situation here and always will. Best thing we can do is focus on how to minimize their footprint.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_responsenyxgener: Got up early today to walk around and clear my head, and guess who I ran into? Ludwig. Of course, he talked at me non-stop the entire time we were together. Feel bad saying this 'cause he's a nice enough guy and clearly dedicated to the cause, but my head hurts more after our walk.

Feeling a bit frazzled right now. Just spent a few hours wandering around the municipal works checking the water filtration system. It's not producing as much clean water as expected, so either the system's broken or someone's siphoning off water from us. Really need to figure out what's going on before it becomes a real problem.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_responsenyxueeen: Not sure why everyone's so worked up about the UEE. Guess the lifers here that've never really spent time in the empire don't realize how little they think about of us.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_bdc_responsenyxvandu: I'll come right out and say it. The Alliance needs to be proactive against this Vanduul threat.  Because here's my concern, if we all sit around debating what to do, by the time we around to doing it, it'll be too late.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerreactser: Y'all are pros at wasting my damn time.
Why the hell did someone say to come down here for help when you can't help?
Great. Now I have a migraine because of all this bullshit.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerrequests: Been trying to get this issue resolved for over a week. Really need this figured out today.
Send y'all a comm yesterday about the problem I'm having, and was told I had to come talk to someone in person. So, yeah, now I'm here.
So... I'm not exactly sure what happened here, but really hoping you can help.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customerservicec: Look, I'm not mad at you personally, but this entire process has done nothing but piss me off.
Not sure why the hell it's so hard for y'all to get this resolved. It seems like a simple clerical error on your side.
Don't know what to tell you, but that's all the info the last Admin gave me. She said it was all I needed to take care of this.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_customershopping: Not sure why you're expecting me to pay Terra prices when we're not in Terra.
You really should take better care of this place. Never a good sign for customers when there's a layer of dust covering everything.
This place makes me miss Gene's old shop.
Just wanted to say that you've got a nice selection of stuff here.
I don't know how you do it, but you always have exactly what I need.
Lookin' around, I was surprised by a few things you got for sale. In a good way, I mean.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_denyentrancegene: No one's allowed through here right now.
Can't let anyone in this way.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_denyentrancepeop: Sorry, buddy, People's Alliance members only.
This area's restricted to members of the People's Alliance.
No can do. Only Alliance members past this point.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_directtrafficgen: Let's go. Gotta keep this area clear.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_loitergeneric_ig: Time to find someplace else to rest.
Ok, let's go. You've been here long enough.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_loiterpeoplesall: Gonna need you to clear this area for me. Thanks.
Hate to do this, my friend, but I've gotta ask you to move.
I'd appreciate it if you found somewhere else to rest.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde: One second while I ring it up, and you'll be good to go.
You picked a good one. I'll have it sent to you shortly.
Perfect. Let me confirm your preferred destination here... ok, I'll have it sent to your hangar now.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendordirectcons: Probably easier to see everything we have at the console.
You could use the shopping terminal too for all purchases.
Might be more convenient for you to use the terminal.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorofferhelp_: I'm here to help if you've got any questions.
If you're looking for anything in particular, just let me know.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco: Complaining ain't gonna get you a discount.
My family's had this shop for generations. We'll be just fine if you wanna take your business elsewhere.
Know this place ain't perfect, but we're doing the best we can 'round here.
By the way, I'm low on backstock. If you see anything you like, better grab it before it's gone.
Well, if you're looking for something special, that right over there comes highly recommended.
Everything here comes with my personal guarantee. If you have any issues, just bring it back and we'll figure something out.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp03_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig: Some good stuff came in today. Better check out it before it's gone.
If you're looking for a good deal, you've come to the right place.
Hey there, perfect timing. Just finished restocking everything.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_questionnyxcrimi: I was having a drink in Musain the other night and I overheard some people planning to attack a transport ship. They weren’t even trying to be quiet. Can you believe it?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_questionnyxgener: I’m helping out with “public sanitation” this week, so I get the pleasure of waking up at the crack of dawn and cleaning out the latrines for everyone. Wasn’t a problem when there was only a few of us, but now...anyway, what's new with you?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_questionnyxueeen: People are going on and on about seeing the UEE here, but so what? They’ve always been keeping tabs on us. And you know why? Because we have it better than them. They could learn a thing or two from us. Don’t you think?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_questionnyxvandu: It’s always one thing after another these days. First the outlaws, now the Vanduul... I've heard folks talking about how we should be having a "parley" with them. But they’re not like us, you can’t just sit them down and have a conversation. I just don't know what we are supposed to do against a bunch of bloodthirsty, murderous aliens.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxcrimi: Sure as hell can’t go on like this. Something needs to be done.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxgener: Things are just getting harder and harder around here, aren’t they?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxueeen: No point even thinking about it. I’d sooner cut off my own arm than deal with a member of the UEE. You can quote me on that.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_reactionnyxvandu: If the ‘duul wanna wipe us out, I wish they’d go ahead and do it already. I’m sick of just sitting around and waiting for it to happen.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_responsenyxcrimi: I hear you. Buddy of mine was on his way home after work and some low-life tried to shake him down. He wasn’t having any of it. Clocked him right between the eyes, sent the guy running just like that. Now I’m not saying violence is the answer, but that thug might think twice before messing with anybody anytime soon.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_responsenyxgener: Been trying to teach some new arrivals how to weld a pipe back together and I'll tell you: if this is the best the next generation has to offer, we are all screwed. Useless. Absolutely useless. These kids couldn’t tell a multi-tool from a multi-wrench.

Apparently Kris has been trading with some Banu and managed to get ahold of a bottle of Radegast ’47. Can you believe it? I don’t mind folks stopping through here if they’re gonna bring goods like that with them.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_responsenyxueeen: These rumors about the UEE are a load of bull. When you’ve been around as long as I have, you’ll realize that these kind of conversations come and go.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_bdc_responsenyxvandu: All this talk about the Vanduul…if you ask me, sounds like they’re running from something. But that doesn’t mean there’s room for them here. Got enough freeloaders as it is.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_customerapprecia: You keep out of trouble now.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_customergiveorde: Been looking for something like this.
You know what? I'll take it.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_customerreactser: Are you kidding me? <deep breath> Remember the rules...remember the rules...
Thanks for wasting my time. Asshole.
Don't say there's nothing you can do. Take some damn responsibility.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_customerrequests: I got about ten minutes before I need to get back to work so let's get this sorted quick, okay?
Tenneson. T-E-N-N. Look, it's all in the comm I sent over, are you really gonna make me go through this again?
Yeah, just following up on the comms I sent you. You hadn't replied to the last couple so thought I'd come down in person.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_customerservicec: What more do you want from me? I'm here, aren't I? So get it sorted for me.
Listen. I'm a reasonable person. I do my part around here, so that's why I expect you to do yours. You understand that? I'm just asking you to do your job.
If this is the way you usually operate I'm surprised anyone comes here at all.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_customershopping: You sure a couple of those "zeroes" aren't typos? These prices can't be right.
I swear everytime I come here this place just gets more and more depressing.
Do you honestly expect people to buy this crap?
My expectations were pretty low, but you actually have some half-decent stuff in here.
You got some good things in stock today, glad I made the journey.
I'm happy this place hasn't gone out of business. Not yet, at least.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_denyentrancegene: This place is off limits, understood?
This area ain't for you, buddy.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_denyentrancepeop: People's Alliance only. Now, move along.
This area ain't for you. Only People's Alliance allowed.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_directtrafficgen: What are you stopping for? Move along buddy.
If you've got time to talk, you've got time to walk.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_directtrafficpeo: Can't you read the sign? No stopping. Wait, where'd that sign go?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_loitergeneric_ig: Come on, time to move along.
You just gonna stand there, or...?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_loiterpeoplesall: Ain't trying to be the bad guy, but you gotta move.
There's plenty of places you can stand still, but this ain't one of them.
Hey buddy? You need to move along.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_vendoracceptorde: Give me a second, I'll get that sorted for you.
Yep, just putting it through for you now...
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_vendordirectcons: The console over there will tell you everything you need to know.
You're probably better off using the console rather than talking to me.
Honestly? The console's got more information than I do.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_vendorofferhelp_: You need a hand? You look kinda lost.
I know this stock like the back of my hand, just shout if you need something.
So you gonna buy something, or...?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_vendorshoppingco: I don't know what you expect me to do about that.
Complain all you want, don't make a lick of difference to me.
Life ain't fair. Better you learn that sooner rather than later.
Thanks. Nice to see people appreciate our hard work for a change.
Some of this stuff tends to go pretty fast, I'd get it while you can.
We've picked up some interesting stuff recently with all the new traders coming through.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp04_civ_f_soc_vendorwelcome_ig: Take your time looking around, not like I got anything better to do.
Come take a look at what I got, just make sure you buy something.
You won't find this stuff anywhere else. Probably.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxcrimi: Not sure if you heard, but Kelso got hit in a raid. Sela, their sister, is moving back Castra after the funeral. That's two more Alliance members lost to outlaws. It's like what's next, you know?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxgener: Just finished a shift volunteering with the wellness check crew. Some of these old-timer's have been living out here for decades. In the UEE they'd be left to fend for themselves, but thats why the People's Alliance is so great, you know? We really try to make sure no one's forgotten. Anyway, how's your day been so far?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxueeen: So, this is probably just a rumor, but Jeff said that Allard is having secret talks with the UEE about them starting to do patrols in Levski? That can't be true, right? No way the Alliance is gonna let the UEE into Nyx.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_bdc_questionnyxvandu: Man, I'm exhausted. Was out late yesterday doing my first patrol. Fenric organized a few people with combat experience to keep an eye out for Vanduul since there were so many raids this week. Didn't end up running into any, but it was intense. It's crazy how many Vanduul seem to be in the system all of a sudden, right?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxcrimi: We've all had tough times, but I don't think I'll ever understand how someone could turn to crime. Not when there's so many other options.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxgener: Well, I'd choose a meaningful life over an easy life every time.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxueeen: You figured the UEE would have enough to deal with already, without needing Nyx, but I guess there's no accounting for greed.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_bdc_reactionnyxvandu: It's gotta make you wonder what Humanity ever did to make the 'duul hate us so much.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_bdc_responsenyxcrimi: I just don't get these outlaws. I was supposed to do a run out to the supply depot over in G7 and the entire thing was ransacked. If they just came to the Alliance for help, it'd be one thing, but to steal from us? It makes me so mad.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_bdc_responsenyxgener: So, you know Daniels? She asked me to crew a run out to an old QV station in the belt. Guess she figured out a way to bring the fracker back online. If we can get one asteroid split, that could be enough money to help fix the water filter issue the lower habs have been dealing with.

My team's been low on headcount now that both Tilfer and Bobcat decided to move back to the UEE. I don't understand how people can put that much time into building the dream and then just give up on it.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_bdc_responsenyxueeen: Get this. Axel accused me of being a UEE spy. Says it's the only the reason someone like me would move out to Nyx. What does that even mean? Hell, if Axel had their way, the Alliance would never have new members.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_bdc_responsenyxvandu: You know the reason we're dealing with Vanduul is because of the UEE's idiotic war. If they had just left them alone and maybe focused on solving real problems, but no, the only way they stay in control is by distracting people with a big war. Now the we're the ones paying the price.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_customergiveorde: I think I'm gonna go with this.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_customerreactser: Really? That's it? You can't do anything else to help me?
Unbelievable. What a waste of time.
Why I am not surprised at this point.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_customerrequests: Look, I'm sure you got a million things to deal with, but if you could help me sorting this out before the end of my shift, it'd mean the world to me.
Hey, I was hoping you might be able to help me get some answers. My reference code is JKG5T6RL9.
Just the person I was hoping to speak to. Do you think you can check and see if there's any update?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_customerservicec: I'd love to know on what world this kind of treatment is acceptable, because this is just ridiculous.
This is just ridiculous. I've already been here six times this week and I am sick and tired of being given the run around.
I've really had it up to here with you people and your nonsense. It's like its your job to piss me off.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_customershopping: You're missing half the things I needed to get and now I'm gonna have to go hunting around who knows how many other places. It's pretty frustrating.
You can run your business how you want, but I find it hard to believe anybody's willing to pay these ridiculous prices.
Not sure if you've noticed, but there's a really strong smell over there.
You got such good stuff here, I always have such a hard time deciding.
Gotta say, I'm impressed by these prices. Appreciate you keepin' things reasonable.
Looks like you got more in stock. Glad things are going well.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_denyentrancegene: Sorry, you can't come through here.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_denyentrancepeop: This area's for members of the People Alliance only.
I can only let People's Alliance through.
If you're not People's Alliance, you can't come in.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_directtrafficgen: All right, let's move along people.
This way. Let's keep going. Don't stop.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_loitergeneric_ig: Hey, find somewhere else to be, okay.
Hey, I need you to clear out, all right.
You, let's get a move on.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_loiterpeoplesall: Hey, do you think maybe you could find a different spot to wait?
Sorry to bother you, but I'd really appreciate you waiting somewhere else. Thanks.
Hi, you look pretty comfortable so I hate to ask, but do you think you might be able to find a different spot? We need to keep this area clear.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendoracceptorde: Sounds good. It'll be waiting for you in your hangar.
Good choice. I'll have it sent to you as soon as its ready.
That's one of my favorites. I'll have it sent over.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendordirectcons: There's a console right there you can use.
You might want to try the shopping terminal.
Take a look at the terminal if you're not seeing what you want.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorofferhelp_: You look a bit lost. What can I do you for?
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorshoppingco: Hey, you don't like it, my friend, you don't have to buy anything.
Ha. Good luck finding a shop around here that's better.
Don't complain to me. It's my Uncle's shop.
If you're having a hard time deciding, you can always get something today, and if you're not happy, just come back and let me know.
I only carry stuff I think my customers are gonna like. You really can't go too wrong with anything here.
I've got a lot of people asking after that one over there. Really popular this week.
localization.pu_nyxnpcvp05_civ_m_soc_vendorwelcome_ig: Hey, feel free to take a look at what I got.
You all right? Got plenty on offer, so see what suits you.
Come on. Don't be shy. Take a look.
localization.pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_001_sinc: Since 2399, Hathor Group has built its name as an industry leader in extracting value. Together we can reshape the empire.
localization.pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_002_itse: It's every employee's responsibility to avoid costly accidents. Safety starts and ends with you.
localization.pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_003_reme: Remember, Hathor trusts you to help keep our business private. Do not discuss work with non-employees.
localization.pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_004_lets: Let's all work together to avoid distractions in the workplace. Time is a valuable resource. Stay focused or pay the price.
localization.pu_orbgentan_dpa_hathorgenpa_gp_005_unsu: Unsure of the proper procedure or regulation? Check your manual. Know the rules and stay alive.
localization.pu_orbolptan_dpa_laserinitiated_gp_002_a: Attention! Laser firing protocol initiated. Stand by.
localization.pu_orbolptan_dpa_lasersetupcomplete_gp_0: Firing authorization granted. Laser ready for activation.
localization.pu_orbolpterm_cantactivatelaser_gp_002_r: Request denied. Cooldown cycle in progress.
localization.pu_orbpaftan_dpa_bladeinserted_gp_003_se: Sending coordinates to Orbital Laser Platform.
localization.pu_orbpaftan_dpa_phase2complete_gp_006_a: Adjustment complete. Standing by for transmission.
localization.pu_orbpaftan_dpa_phase3complete_gp_007_p: Power battery charged and ready for Orbital Platfom deployment.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_a: The next shuttle is approaching the station.
Shuttle now arriving. Please make way for disembarking passengers.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_c: Orison Skyway Shuttle Service is expanding! This station will be opening soon with even more connecting flights.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_d: Attention. We're experiencing a slight delay in service. Please stand by.
Last call for passengers. The shuttle is preparing to depart.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_o: Attention. This station is currently out of service. Apologies for the inconvenience.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_platform_s: Attention. Shuttle service has now resumed. Thank you for your patience.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_skyway_gen: At Orison Skyway Shuttle Service, we aim to make getting there half the fun. Please enjoy your flight.
Enjoying the view? Our recently redesigned Crusader Industries shuttle craft feature expanded vista opportunities with their signature crystal canopies.
Providing connections to all major platforms, Crusader Industries is happy to offer free and convenient transit to all visitors aboard the Orison Skyway Shuttle Service. Have a pleasant stay.
A friendly reminder to check for your personal belongings before and after all shuttle flights and to dispose of any trash at appropriate receptacles. No stress, no mess.
Miss your shuttle? Not a problem. Another shuttle will be along shortly. At Orison Skyway Shuttle Service, more flights means less worries.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_spaceport_: Welcome to the August Dunlow Spaceport, Crusader's gateway to the stars.
Thank you for visiting Orison, the heart and headquarters of Crusader Industries. Where dreams take flight.
Be sure to explore and discover all Orison has to offer. With so much to see and do, Crusader is a journey worth making.

Safety is a top priority for all of us at Crusader and we want your help. Keep track of all personal effects, follow all safety announcements, and report any concerns to Crusader Security. Together we can set your visit on the right course.

2955 marks the centennial anniversary of the first orbital platform built on Crusader. Join us in celebrating a 100 years of incredible engineering and the tireless efforts of those who work everyday to keep Orison afloat.

This is a reminder that flight status and hangar information may change. Be sure to double check flight information on your mobiGlas or one of the conveniently located information signs throughout the terminal.

Looking for your next stop after visiting Crusader? Consider the lunar siblings Cellin, Daymar, and Yela. These beautifully preserved moons offer adventure and stunning natural vistas just waiting to be discovered.

New visitors to Orison may sometimes find that they are experiencing a mild sense of vertigo as they acclimate to the elevation. Remember to breathe freely, stay hydrated, and take plenty of rest breaks. If symptoms persist, please contact a medical professional for additional assistance.

Did you enjoy the stunning wonder of Crusader's very own gentle giants, the stormwals? Then why not take one of your very own home with a soft and loveable Finley the Stormwal plush. Available throughout the terminal.

As part of our ongoing "Crusader Cares" program to improve the lives of everyone in the empire, Crusader Industries will be donating 10% of all spaceport food sales to help stamp out hunger. Together, we're making a difference.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_delay: We are currently experiencing an unexpected delay. Please remain where you are while we work to correct the situation.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_doors: Please clear the hatch. Shuttle will be departing.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_malfu: This shuttle is experiencing technical issues. Please remain where you are while we work to correct the situation.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nexts: Next stop - August Dunlow Spaceport, Crusader's gateway to the stars.
Next stop - Cloudview Center, where visitors can enjoy stunning views, memorable art, delicious dining and drinks, and Empire-class accommodations.
Next stop, Solanki Platform, home to temporary residences for VIPs like you. Passengers who have reservations at the Hoshki center or the Abe towers should disembark at this stop.

Next stop, Hartmoore Platform, home to the next generation of combat ships and military transports from Crusader Industries. This platform is only accessible to valid clients who have already been prescreened. Due to security protocols, passengers should not disembark unless they have an active appointment with a Crusader representative.
Approaching next station. If this is your stop, please prepare to disembark.
Next stop, the Valet Station. We at Crusader Industries would like to thank you for visiting us today and hope that we'll be doing business with you in the future.

Next stop, Brushwood Platform. Any passengers representing business or other private sector buyers are invited to disembark upon arrival and take a look at the exciting new lineup of commercial transports from Crusader Industries.
Next stop - Providence Industrial Platform, home to the famous Crusader Industries' shipyards.
Next stop, the Vision Center. Your gateway to world-class events and entertainment.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_announce_tram_nowar: Now Arriving at August Dunlow Spaceport.
Now arriving at Hartmoore Platform. Only authorized passengers are invited to disembark.
Now arriving at the Valet Station.
Now arriving at Providence Industrial Platform.
Now arriving at the Vision Center.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_envirohazard_d: Attention. The environmental hazard has been contained. You are now free to proceed as normal. Thank you and have a great day.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_envirohazard_i: Warning. The environmental hazard is still in progress. We are working to resolve the issue. Please remain calm and thank you for your patience.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_envirohazard_r: Warning. An environmental hazard has been detected. Please remain where you are until notified otherwise. Repeat. Please remain where you are.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_envirohazard_v: Warning. An environmental hazard has been detected. Please vacate the immediate area in a calm and orderly fashion. Repeat. Please safely vacate the area.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_platformcorrec: Platform Elevation Correction is now complete. You are now free to proceed as normal. Thank you and have a great day.
Attention, this platform is currently suffering a critical thruster failure. We advise all occupants to calmly evacuate the platform until further notice.

Attention. This platform will be undergoing routine elevation correction momentarily. You may notice some slight movement and vibration during this maintenance operation. Please use caution while the platform is in motion, secure any belongings, and keep a safe distance from the edge. Thank you.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_restrictedarea: Warning. The restricted area around this platform will activate in a few moments. All unauthorized pilots are advised to leave the area immediately.
Attention, the restricted area will actively momentarily. This is your final warning to clear the area or be flagged as a trespasser.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_securitythreat: Attention. Crusader Security has given the all clear. You are now free to proceed as normal. Thank you and have a great day.
Attention. This is an update on the ongoing Crusader Security alert. A resolution to the situation is actively being worked on. Please remain calm and thank you for your patience.
Attention. This is a Crusader Security alert. For your safety, please remain where you are until notified otherwise. Repeat. Please remain where you are. Thank you.
Attention. This is a Crusader Security alert. Please safely and calmly vacate the area. Repeat. Please safely vacate the area.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_tram_collision: Warning. Collision detected. Brace for impact.
localization.pu_orisonann01_f_lpa_warn_tram_emergency: Attention. This is an emergency. Please safely and quickly exit the shuttle.
localization.pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_approved_departure_: All right. You are cleared to go.
Looks like you are all set to leave.
You are cleared to head out.
localization.pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_assigned_storage_an: Okay, looks like we have a space for you.
There we go. One spot for you.
Ah, perfect. This space should do nicely.
localization.pu_orisonatc01_m_atc_farewell_aneutral_t: Thank you so much for visiting Orison. We hope that you visit us again real soon.
On behalf of Crusader Industries, I'd like to thank you for visiting Orison. Safe travels.
I hope you enjoyed your time here at Orison and you have a pleasant rest of your journey.
Let me say that it has been a real pleasure to assist you during your visit to Orison and I look forward to seeing you again real soon. Have a great day.
Thanks for visiting Crusader. I hope you had a chance to enjoy our beautiful shipyards and breathtaking sky gardens during your stay. Hopefully we'll see you again soon.

Thanks for visiting Orison, official home of Crusader Industries, the Empire's industry leading manufacturer of quality starliners. This whole week's been great at the plant. They signed up a new shipload of recruits and they've been taking up a lot of the slack. Plus, I love watching as they realize what exactly they've been signed up for. Never gets old.
localization.pu_patron1_m_cp_chat_hurston_procconvo_g: Did you hear about Ardell Hurston? Gave birth to a son. Named him Reyes. Reyes Finley Hurston. Yeah, tell me about it, if it ain't one thing it's another.
That's great. Let's hope tomorrow is even better.
You wouldn't believe it. Two people comm'd in sick. Had to do all their work plus my regular stuff. Maybe I should comm in sick tomorrow.

Not really in the mood to talk about work.
localization.pu_patron1_m_cv_chat_farewell_pos_ig_002: Okay, it was great seein' ya.
localization.pu_patron1_m_cv_chat_procconvo_gencivili: I had the best hand of Trigger I've ever had last week. Could not believe it. One card after the other. It was beautiful.

Bit of exciting news. Larry got his arm caught in the injector so they promoted me. A few more accidents and maybe I'll get promoted all the way to Hurston tower.

Today was the worst. Boss completely blindsided me. Gave me a huge load of extra work to do. Might even have to do some unpaid OT to get it all done.
Work-wise, today hasn't been that bad. Played some good music on my glas, and just dug in. Even managed to finish a bit ahead.
Honestly, work is not my favorite subject right now.

You know what I'm sick of? All these new arrivals whining about how they're getting the short end. How the hell's it fair if some fresh pulls up and starts earning the same take as me? It's just not the way it's done. What the hell do they expect? It's not like Hurston's gonna pay us all more money. You know what happens when everyone earns the same? Someone's sure as hell gettin' paid less.
You know what I love most about working for Hurston? They took all the guess work out of life. Day in and day out I know what I'm gonna be doing. It may not be great, but at least it's steady.
localization.pu_patron3_m_cp_chat_hurston_procconvo_g: You ever wonder what they're doing up in that tower? I bet it's some crazy ass shit. Like naked drug parties, or Banu fighting pits. I tell you what though, one of these days, I'm gonna get myself invited.
localization.pu_patron3_m_cp_chat_procconvo_bluecolla: You know what, I'm tired of complaining about work all the time. Ain't nothing gonna change, system's designed to keep us in our place and that's that. Might as well not even think about it.
The next thing will be seeing if my manager is willing to start listening to some of my suggestions. I'm telling you, I've got some real ideas.
Well, like my grandma used to say, 'the wheel keeps turning for everyone.'
Nice. Glad things are going pretty good for you.

How's this for some BS? I was leaving my shift to head home, when I got called into the boss' office. Said I had a performance review coming up and said I might consider putting in a bit more effort. Can you believe that? Like I'm not working my ass off already.

So, check this out, I happen to get to work 10 minutes early. Right as I walk in, the boss comes joggin' up and tells me that the shift supervisor is out sick. Asks if I can cover. I spent the whole day riding a desk, bossing people around. It was glorious.

I wish people would just stop bothering me today.
We can get to me later. Tell me how you've been.

localization.pu_patron4_m_bs_general_busy_pos_ig_001_: Hate to do this, but I'm really tied up right now.
localization.pu_patron4_m_cp_acquiredrink_orderdrink_: Can I get something to drink.
localization.pu_patron4_m_cp_chat_hurston_procconvo_b: But you know, at the end of the day, Hurston is giving us a great opportunity by letting us work here.

You ever stop to think about some of the weapons we're building for Hurston? Like what that cannon I helped weld last week is blowing up right now? I wonder how many people I've helped kill just so I could get my threes and a bed. It's enough to make you wanna drink.

So today, I got to go in the Tower for the first time. The stiffs needed some files delivered and my manager chose me to go for whatever reason. It's like a whole other world in there. Fancy as hell. And let me tell you, it felt so good just walking past security like that. Plus, the guy at the desk even gave me a bottle of water to take back with me.
localization.pu_patron4_m_cp_chat_hurston_procconvo_g: So, my mum comms me. She wants to come for a visit. Now, I have to figure out a nice way to say there's no way that I'm letting her come to a place like Lorville but not have her all worried that I'm living here. Maybe I'll tell her that dad lives here now. That'll keep her away.
localization.pu_patron4_m_cp_chat_procconvo_bluecolla: Yeah, of course, finding another job's pretty much out of the question. Well, at least not till I can pay off a few more loans. Then we'll see.
Yeah... I'll be honest, when things are good there, they're pretty good. I always try to keep that in mind when things aren't so good.
You know what? Screw that place.

Man, I do not even want to think about the day I just had. Steam cap burst off the auxilary line centimeters from my head. Not sure if even my hard hat would have stopped that. And to top it off, the floor manager had the gall to tell me to be more careful.

Had a pretty good day today. They let the entire third shift crew go because one of them had been skimming, so now I'm getting a bunch of extra work coming my way. Kinda sucks in the meantime, but it'll be nice to have some extra scratch in my account come payday.
Pick another topic. It's bad enough having to think about work when I'm there.
localization.pu_patron4_m_cv_chat_greeting_remember_n: What do you want this time?
localization.pu_patron4_m_cv_chat_procconvo_gencivili: So, I've been meaning to clear out this locker I don't use any more, and I find my old mobi sitting in the bottom. Looking over the thing, I cannot believe how much bulkier they used to be.
localization.pu_patron4_m_cv_chat_procconvo_murraycup: What really gets me is just how many people care about Murray Cup. To think of the amount credits that gets dumped into something so stupid is stunning.
What I'm wondering is if this is the year MISC pilots start really holding their own. Guess we'll just have to see.
Wanted to ask if you saw the race?
Yeah. I keep hoping this season's gonna get better, but not sure how much longer I can wait.
Defineitly was a good race. Not embarassed to say I spilled my drink a few times cheering.
I have officially given up on the Murray Cup. The only ones who ever win it have boatloads of credits backing them. I liked it better back when regular people had a shot at winning.
All right, so check this: I blocked out my whole afternoon, grabbed a case of brew, shut off my mobi.  Five hours of racing, no distractions.
I feel like I might have, but for the life of me I can't remember.
localization.pu_patron4_m_cv_general_backdown_ig_001_: Like I'm gonna waste any more time on you.
localization.pu_patron4_m_cv_general_calmdown_ig_001_: It'd be better if you just calmed down.
localization.pu_patron4_m_cv_general_insult_neg_ig_00: It's hard to believe that anything short of a trashdump can smell as bad as you do.
localization.pu_patron4_m_cv_general_notappropriate_p: I'm not sure if doing that sort of thing is really a good idea.
localization.pu_patron4_m_cv_general_offended_pos_ig_: Hey now. There's no need for that.
localization.pu_patron4_m_cv_general_strangebehavior_: I'm starting to think you might be a couple beers short of a six-pack.
