localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_acepilotarrives_gp_0: Heads up, that pilot's track record is no joke. Engage them with caution.
Got a ship inbound that's knocked out some skilled contractors. Neutralize it if you can, but it won't be easy.
Scans just picked up a ship we've tagged as "extremely dangerous." If you engage, be careful.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_acepilotcollectibler: You know what? They seemed the type to be carrying something of value on them. It's up to you if you want to take a look.
If I were you, I'd check that debris for anything of value.
Heard a rumor that pilot liked expensive gear. Wouldn't be surprised if there was some interesting stuff in the wreckage.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_acepilotdestroyed_gp: Nicely done. They were tough, but you were tougher.
Kill confirmed. That was super cool.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_acepilotescapes_gp_0: Dang it. That pilot got away. Guess they're someone else's problem now.
Shit, they got away! Thought we had 'em this time.
Jeez, look at 'em run. Too bad you couldn't land that killshot.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_ambusharriveatlocati: Alright, head to cover and power down your ship.
Find a spot to hide and power down.
Next step is finding your ship some cover and powering it down.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_ambushhideinmarkedlo: Okay, we're here. I've tagged a place that should hide your signature while you wait.
Good. You're on site. I went ahead and marked a good place to post up. Should keep you pretty well hidden.
This looks like the spot. Went ahead and flagged a place for you to wait. Should keep you pretty well hidden.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_ambushwait_gp_001,p: Good. Now all we have to do is wait for them to show up.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_ambushwait_gp_002,p: Preparatory checklist complete. Time to wait...
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_ambushwait_gp_003,p: You're all set. Settle in and keep chilly until they arrive.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_chickenshipdestroyed: Great work. Probably dodged a bullet there.
Smart kill. They definitely would've brought help.
Hell yeah, gotta roast those runners.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_chickenshipescapesuc: Uh oh, they got away. I hope they stay gone.
That's gonna be trouble. Better expect some reinforcements.
I really hope they don't come back with friends.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_chickenshipreinforce: Uh oh. That runner from before brought some reinforcements.
Here comes the reinforcements. Hope you've got enough ammo to handle 'em.
Time to get locked in. Looks like the runner is back with some friends.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_chickenshiprun_gp_00: Hey, I think that ship's trying to make a run for it. If they get away, there's no telling how many reinforcements they could bring back.
Don't let that ship get away. A whole lotta reinforcements will be crawling up your ass if it does.
That ship's running for reinforcements. Get 'em. Get 'em.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipdistress_g: Looks like they could use some help. Weapons on and get in there.
Got a ship in distress. Time to be a hero.
Oh jeez. Got a contact that looks like they're in trouble.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectivec: Good. I think they're in the clear now.
Not seeing anything on the scans. Think you're good.
Scans are clean. Job well done.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectivef: We lost them. Dammit, we need to do better.
Oh, come on. Was expecting better from you.
Gonna be honest, Foxwell expects more from our contractors.
Damn it! I'm gonna get some angry comms about this.
That was not good. Not good at all.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipobjectives: Okay, that's who you're here to protect. Make sure they stay safe.
That's the client. Do whatever you have to do to keep 'em safe.
Ok, good, you found them. Operation Security Blanket is a go.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_defendshipreminder_g: Focus. That ship is in serious trouble.
If you don't do something, that ship is toast.
Quick! Save that ship before it's too late.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyfindsabandoneds: Almost missed it, but there's an derelict vessel near your position. It's not Foxwell's concern, so it's up to you if you want to investigate any further.
Heads up, my scans spotted a dead ship not too far for you. Your call on whether you want to check it out or not.
Picked up something in your sector. Okay, yeah, looks like a derelict ship. Feel free to investigate it if you want.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptyscanfalsenegati: Scans all came back clear so I think - Wait… Just got something.
Huh... Hold tight for second. Yeah, that's not right. Something's definitely there.
Before I give you the all clear, let me just check... Damn it, found something.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_emptywaitscanlocatio: Hey, not seeing anything yet. I'm gonna do a deeper scan. Stand by.
Hold tight while I scan the sector.
Running a scan. Maintain your position.
Stand by. Going to do a quick scan.
Hold up a sec. Need to check something.
I need to run a scan. Give me a second.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_friendlyreinforcemen: Good news. Looks like we got some backup to help you out.
Called in some support. They should be there soon.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesdestroyedenc: Hey, you're doing good. Keep it up.
You're doing a hell of a job. Don't back down now.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivecle: Alright, not seeing any more hostiles. Think you're in the clear.
Looks like you're clear. Scans are clear of targets.
Not picking up any hostile activity. Giving you the all clear.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesobjectivesta: Heads up, got hostiles at your location.
Oh no, get ready. There's company coming your way.
Watch out. Enemies heading your way.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesreinforcemen: Look alive. There's hostile reinforcements coming in hot.
They're not messing around. Here comes the backup.
Got some bad news: a big ship's bearing down on your location and it's not friendly. Get ready.
Big ship coming in. You must've really pissed them off.
Heads up. You've got some serious firepower heading your way.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_hostilesthreatcallou: Looks like we're in business. No sign of the target yet though.
Got eyes on some baddies. Don't see the target…
Got contacts. Stay chilly. I don't see the target yet.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdfriendlysatellitef: Looks like a monitoring satellite. Seems functional so we can let it be.
Let me confirm. Yup, that satellite is friendly and functional. Let's move on.
Okay, that satellite is good. You're clear to proceed.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdobjectivecomplete_: Alright, that was the last scan point.
That was the last scan we needed. Thanks for the help.
And with that, our work here is done.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_sdrunfocusscan_gp_00: You should do a focused scan and see what's what.
All right, run a focused scan to get some more intel.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_targetthreatcallout_: That's them. Go when you're ready.
That's the target. Weapons on and good hunting.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deh_targetthreatdestroye: That's a kill on the target.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdillegalsatellitefo: Uh oh. Getting some strange readings from that satellite. Just to be safe, go ahead and neutralize it.
Hold tight... Yeah, that satellite isn't registered. You're cleared to take it out.
Damn, whoever set up that satellite knew what they were doing. It almost fooled me. Get rid of it.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_deo_sdobjectivestart_gp_: Okay, now that you're here, we need you to check the area. Fly to the designated points and ping your scanner.
Let's make sure the sector's secure. Head to the marked locations and run a scan.
Looks like you're ready for a security sweep. You should be seeing waypoints. Make your way to each one and ping your scanner.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_ambushmissionaccept_: Hey, Walton with Foxwell here. Saw you nabbed the contract. Good to have your help. These lowlifes have been a menace, so I'm hoping you'll be able to shut them down once and for all. Head to the ambush site when you're ready and keep it cool out there.
This is Walton with Foxwell. We got a hot tip on where these outlaws are gonna be traveling so this is a great chance to do some good. Bring your A-game and plenty of ammo. I'm counting on you.

Hey. Walton from Foxwell calling. Heard you're gonna be our hands out there in the field. I've confirmed all the specifics with Foxwell's intel team. All that's left is for you to get into place and drop the hammer.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_defendmissionaccept_: It's Walton. I'll be handling things on this end for Foxwell. Good to have you onboard. Head out to the contract site as soon as you can. Need you to provide them protection before it can be overrun. Weapons free.
Hey, it's Walton with Foxwell. Need you to deploy and defend that site on the double. Not sure how much longer they'll be able to hold out.
Walton from Foxwell here. Looks like things are about to get real bad on that contract. Grab your gear and get to that site immediately.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_defendshipmissionacc: Hey, this is Walton with Foxwell. One of Foxwell's clients has a ship in trouble and they need security support. I'm hoping you'll be able to keep them safe. Good luck.
Walton here. Sorry for keeping this short, but Foxwell needs you to provide security for this ship on the double. Good luck out there.
Thanks for grabbing this. Just spoke with the pilot and they're anxiously awaiting your arrival. Don't let us down.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionabando: Hey, yeah, not sure why you aren't completing the contract. I don't really have anyone else to handle it, but okay, I'll see what I can do.
I can't believe you're just walking away from a job like that. Foxwell needs people we can count on.
Getting some angry comms about this contract not being completed. If you work for Foxwell, we expect you to finish it.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionaccept: Walton from Foxwell here. Glad that you're coming on board to lend us a hand. You should have everything you need to get going.
Hey, I'm Walton with Foxwell. Let's get you to work. We're swamped with contracts so it'd be good to get this one cleared out.
Welcome onboard. I'm Walton, your Foxwell point of contact. Everything looks good on my side, so you may proceed with your contract.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissioncomple: Hey, nice work. Foxwell appreciates it. I'll get your money sent.
Contract complete. Initiating your payment now.
Sending creds your way. Thanks for clearing out that contract.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_genericmissionfail_g: Sorry, gonna have to pull this contract from you. You might not be ready for security work yet.
I'm gonna reassign the contract. I just don't think you're a right fit for this.
I'm sorry but I need to revoke this contract. Foxwell needs its field operatives to uphold our corporate standard.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_patrolmissionaccept_: Foxwell here. Thanks for taking the contract. Make sure to gear up before you head out on patrol. Always pays to be prepared when you're not sure what you'll run into out there.
Hey, it's Walton with Foxwell. Courtesy reminder to not head out on patrol without getting geared up. Things have been wild out there lately.
Foxwell appreicates you covering that patrol, but don't go out low on ammo and other essentials. You might need 'em.
localization.pu_walton_fox_m_pmh_patrolpointcleared_g: Okay, looks like we're ready to Oscar Mickey. Head to the next patrol point.
Good, good. Area secured. Let's get you deployed to the next one.
We're clear here. You can head to the next sector.

localization.pyro_nyx_jpstation_desc: Situated at a strategic location near the Pyro-Nyx jump point, the Gateway station provides shops and services to those traveling to and from the system. Visitors to the station can find a wide variety of amenities and stores including: Refueling, Restocking, Cargo Transfers, Supplies, Habs, and more.
localization.pyro_ruinstation_desc: A Gold Horizon platform orbiting Pyro VI. It was owned and operated by Pyrotechnic Amalgamated until it was abandoned and then overrun by outlaws. Feuds between factions have lead to frequent and deadly battles; making this location extremely dangerous for civilians and outlaws alike.
localization.pyro_stanton_jpstation_desc: Situated at a strategic location near the Pyro-Stanton jump point, and considered by many to be the last bastion of civilization in the system, the Stanton Gateway provides shops and services to those traveling to and from the system. Visitors to the station can find a wide variety of amenities and stores including: Refueling, Restocking, Cargo Transfers, Supplies, Habs, and more.
localization.pyrostar_desc: A K-type main sequence flare star.
localization.pyrosystem_desc: With an unpredictable star creating a less than hospitable environment, the Pyro system was left unclaimed by the Empire, leaving unscrupulous mining consortiums, like Pyrotechnic Amalgamated, looking to harvest as much ore as they could. With the system now depleted, it is currently inhabited by down-on-their-luck settlers and fierce outlaws vying endlessly for control of the system's remaining resources.

localization.racingrep_guild_description: Wildstar Racing started as a small Spectrum channel where racing enthusiasts would share vids of themselves racing on their favorite local tracks. Since then, they have grown into a sanctioned racing organization specializing in rally tracks and are widely recognized as an affordable proving ground for amateur racers to work towards competing in higher-profile leagues.
localization.rain_collectresources_irradiatedpearls_d:
To all available contractors,

Our researchers are on the cusp of a breakthrough relating to the biological application of rare, irradiated materials, but are being hindered by the lack of publicly available resources.

As a result, we are in need of people to acquire <EM4>irradiated valakkar pearls</EM4> and deliver them to us immediately. While rare, these pearls can be acquired from adult valakkar that have received prolonged and sustained exposure to high amounts of radiation. Former contractors have reported that ASD's now inoperative <EM4>Lazarus Complex located on Pyro IV</EM4> is home to such valakkar.

Because of the extreme risk associated with this contract, multiple contractors are advised to complete this.

After obtaining the required materials, please deliver them to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
localization.rain_collectresources_multiple_gen_desc_:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
localization.rain_collectresources_multiple_olp_desc_:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of three resources essential for their experiments: <EM4>saldynium, jaclium, and carinite</EM4>.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

Though we haven’t been able to do thorough scans, there’s a strong belief among our teams that Hathor’s defunct Orbital Laser Platforms were built above areas with a high concentration of these resources. Reactivating these OLP could be your best hope of acquiring what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
localization.rain_collectresources_single_olp_desc_01:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments. 

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.      

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
localization.rain_collectresources_storm_desc_001:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but for our scientists to continue their efforts they need resources that the company's suppliers have been unable to deliver. 

There is a sizeable population of kopions that have been exposed to radiation near <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4>. Rayari is seeking an contractor to collect <EM4>irradiated kopion horns</EM4> and deliver them to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Due to the scarcity of this resource, we are prepared to pay a high service fee. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
localization.rain_collectresources_storm_desc_002:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are stopping at nothing to halt the ongoing regeneration crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need a rare resource that the company's suppliers cannot obtain. 

Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather <EM4>irradiated valakkar pearls</EM4>, which can be extracted from apex valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have found a qualifying population inside the storm near <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4>. Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is prepared to generously compensate anyone who can assist with gathering the pearls. 

Once attained, please take these valuable resources to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
localization.rain_collectresources_storm_desc_003:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but to continue their efforts our scientists need materials that the company's suppliers cannot obtain. 

Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather <EM4>irradiated valakkar fangs</EM4>, which can be extracted from adult valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have uncovered the existence of a qualifying population inside the storm near <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4>. 

Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is offering premium pay to anyone who can assist with collecting the fangs.  

Once attained, please take these valuable resources to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
localization.rain_collectresources_storm_desc_004:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are working day and night to solve the current regen crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need rare resources that the company's suppliers cannot deliver. 

We are therefore seeking a contractor to secure an <EM4>irradiated valakkar egg</EM4>. Our scans have confirmed several radioactive storms with known a valakkar presence on Pyro I, you can find a shuttle near <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4> that will take you inside the storm. One more thing, analysis indicates that these eggs will decay over time, the state of the egg shouldn't affect our research but sooner would be better.

Due to the health risks associated with radiation exposure that will be needed to deliver a viable sample, Rayari is ready to pay well for anyone who can safely secure and deliver this item.

Once attained, please take this valuable resource to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
localization.rain_collectresources_yormandieyes_desc_:
To all available contractors,

One of our teams has been studying the medicinal application of rare fauna-extracted materials and believe this line of research is crucial to the advancement of Humanity. As such, they are worth the extreme risk that is often associated with acquiring them.

To that end, we require <EM4>multiple samples of yormandi eyes</EM4>. Researchers have identified that these creatures can be found in ASD's <EM4>Onyx Facilities located in the Stanton System<EM4>.

Access to these dangerous facilities seems to be difficult to say the least. Bringing additional support in the form of other contractors is advised.

Once acquired, please deliver to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> for processing.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
localization.rain_intro_desc_01:
To all available contractors,

Rayari Incorporated is looking for independent contractors to provide additional support in our efforts to push the boundaries of science, agriculture, and medicine in the Empire and beyond. 

A research initiative at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> is in desperate need of resources, so we are looking for a reliable contractor to obtain and deliver these crucial components.

For more information on the materials in question, refer to "A Forager's Guide" in your Journal.

Rayari offers competitive wages along with the knowledge that you're building a better universe.

Let’s grow together,

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
localization.rain_intro_name_01: Interested in Building a Better Future?
localization.rain_killcollectcreatures_multitype_desc:
To all available contractors,

Rayari has been continuing our efforts into the next generation of scientific research, but recently, we’ve had to halt an invaluable research project due to a lack of biological materials critical to our efforts and are eager to have our stock restored.

As such, we are seeking people who can track down multiple species in the wild, acquire the requisite biological components from the different specimens, and deliver them to ~mission(destination|address).

For more information on the animals in question, refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal.

Let’s grow together,

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
localization.rain_killcollectcreatures_onetype_desc_0:
To all available contractors,

As part of an active research project here at Rayari, we are in need of freshly harvested ~mission(items).

As such, we are seeking people who can track down ~mission(creature) in the wild, acquire the requisite biological components and deliver them to ~mission(destination|address).

For more information on the animals in question, refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal.

Let’s grow together,

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
localization.rayari_repui_description: Rayari Incorporated is a Human research company that specializes in agriculture and bio-engineering. Founded in 2803, it first came to prominence when the founders recreated a complete line of plants from the genetic code of ones indigenous to the then recently-massacred planet Garron II. In 2863, the company expanded into social engineering, creating large arcologies such as Reza's Landing designed for planets with hostile environments. The company maintains many labs throughout the United Empire of Earth (UEE).
localization.reccobattaglia_repui_biography: Recco Battaglia, the latest in a long line of miners, had continued the family tradition until an accident at a dig site left her unable to work. Frustrated with her post-accident treatment under the bureaucracy of the UEE and United Resource Workers, Recco moved out to Nyx where she now coordinates contractor operations for the People's Alliance.

localization.recoverstash_pickup_obj_long_00: Find all of the stash at ~mission(Location|Address).
localization.recoverstash_pickup_obj_long_01: Find the first part of the stash.
localization.recoverstash_pickup_obj_long_02: Find the second part of the stash.
localization.recoverstash_pickup_obj_long_03: Find the third part of the stash.
localization.recoverstolen_danger_0001: We expect things should go relatively smoothly, but be ready just in case they don't.
localization.recoverstolen_danger_0002: We've got our hands full right now, so if things go south out there we won't be able to provide you with any back up. Go in expecting to handle any surprises on your own.
localization.recoverstolen_danger_0003: We did some preliminary scouting of the site and it should be clear, but experienced operators know better than to rely on that to keep them safe.
localization.recoverstolen_danger_0004: The thieves responsible might still be lurking around, so use caution.
localization.recoverstolen_desc_0001: We have been fortunate enough to track down a ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) that recently was reported stolen. It is being held in ~mission(Location). We need an operator to go in, reclaim their property and return it to ~mission(Destination). ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryTimed) ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryDanger)
localization.recoverstolen_desc_0002: An informant of ours has given us word that a ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) taken from ~mission(Destination) is being held at ~mission(Location). We are seeking a independent operator to handle the retrieval of said ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) on our behalf and return it to its rightful owners. ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryTimed) ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryDanger)
localization.recoverstolen_desc_0003: This rarely happens, but believe it or not some missing property that's been our radar just surfaced at ~mission(Location). Intact too! Now all we need is someone to give the whole thing a happy ending and return the ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) to our clients at ~mission(Destination). ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryTimed) ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryDanger)
localization.recoverstolen_desc_0004: After contacting us about a recent theft at ~mission(Destination), we were able to apply our tradecraft and trace their stolen ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) to ~mission(Location). All the hard work is done, all that's left is the actually physical retrieval. Think you're up for it? ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryTimed) ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryDanger)
localization.recoverstolen_desc_0005: Every time you think criminals can't get any dumber, they surprise you again. These geniuses stole some~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) from ~mission(Destination) but we were able to trace it right back to their ~mission(Location). Should be a simple matter for an operator to head in, retrieve the item, and return it to its proper owners.~mission(Contractor|RecoveryTimed) ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryDanger) Though if I'm being honest, I wouldn't be surprised if these draggers thought it was magic or something once they notice the ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) is missing.
localization.recoverstolen_desc_0006: Good news. After a client of ours suffered a theft, we were able to trace their ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) to where the criminals were holding it at ~mission(Location). We are looking for someone to finish the op, and return the property to ~mission(Destination). ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryTimed) ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryDanger)
localization.recoverstolen_obj_long_01: Go to ~mission(Location) to retrieve the stolen goods.
localization.recoverstolen_space_danger_0001: It would be prudent to go into this contract expecting the thief to be armed and extremely hostile.
localization.recoverstolen_space_danger_0002: Unfortunately, if things go south out there, ~mission(contractor) cannot commit combat support at this time. Take this contract at your own risk.
localization.recoverstolen_space_danger_0003: Use caution approaching this perp. No telling how they might react when you get them cornered.
localization.recoverstolen_space_danger_0004: And since this dragger is well-connected, don't be surprised if some of their ~mission(client) friends show up.
localization.recoverstolen_space_desc_0001: An independent investigation has resulted in the location of a recently stolen ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) being tracked down. We believe it to currently be in the possession of one ~mission(TargetName), an affiliate of the ~mission(client) with a known record. ~mission(contractor) is looking for a skilled individual to track down ~mission(TargetName)'s ship, recover the lost property, and return it to ~mission(destination). ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryTimed) ~mission(Danger)
localization.recoverstolen_space_desc_0002: ~mission(contractor) is seeking an experienced operator to handle the retrieval of a stolen ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) which our investagtion team has learned to be aboard the ship of known ~mission(location) affiliate; ~mission(TargetName). Once recovered, the ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) will need to be taken to its rightful owners at ~mission(destination). ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryTimed) ~mission(Danger)
localization.recoverstolen_space_desc_0003: Small miracle. Some good folks over at ~mission(destination) had a ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) stolen from them, but we've actually been able to track it down. Turns out some scag by the name of ~mission(TargetName) has the stolen ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) aboard their ship right now. However, a skilled operator should be able to hunt their ship down and return the property to where it belongs. ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryTimed) ~mission(Danger)
localization.recoverstolen_space_desc_0004: A ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) was reported stolen by one of the workers over at ~mission(destination). As a nice change of pace, we actually got a solid lead on the ~mission(client) member that pulled the job who's currently going by the handle: ~mission(TargetName). Now all we need is a suitable contractor to handle the recovery operation on our behalf. ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryTimed) ~mission(Danger) Serious applicants only. EDIT: ** THIS IS NOT A GUILD JOB **
localization.recoverstolen_space_desc_0005: We have it on good authority that a stolen ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) is currently aboard the ship of ~mission(TargetName). ~mission(contractor) needs a pilot, preferably with combat experience, to retrieve the stolen property and return it to its proper owners at ~mission(destination). ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryTimed) ~mission(Danger)\n\n*This contract agreement is considered at-will, and may be terminated at any time by either party.
localization.recoverstolen_space_desc_0006: Got a break today. After a client of ours over at ~mission(destination) got robbed, we were able to trace their stolen ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryItem) to the ship of one ~mission(TargetName). With your help, we are hopeful that we will be able to locate the perpatrator and recover the property intact. ~mission(Contractor|RecoveryTimed) ~mission(Danger)
localization.recoverstolen_space_obj_long_02: Neutralize ~mission(TargetName) before they can escape with the stolen ~mission(Item).
localization.recoverstolen_space_obj_long_03: Recover the stolen ~mission(Item) from the wreckage.
localization.recoverstolen_space_timed_0001: Timing's going to be tight on this. We need to recover the property before it can be sold off or moved out of system.
localization.recoverstolen_space_timed_0002: Our intel indicates that a sale might be happening sooner than later, which means we're going to need you to move swiftly on this.
localization.recoverstolen_space_timed_0003: Not a lot of time to waste on this since ~mission(TargetName) is a definite flight risk.
localization.recoverstolen_space_timed_0004: To help limit any additional complications from springing up, we need this contract completed ASAP.
localization.recoverstolen_space_timed_0005: As far as timing goes on this, afraid there's not a lot of wiggle room. Every second that passes, the chances of success only get worse.
localization.recoverstolen_timed_0001: Time is unfortunately of the essence here. We need to recover the property before it can be moved to a different location.
localization.recoverstolen_timed_0002: Our reconnaissance showed that if we want this operation to succeed, the retrieval must be handled swiftly.
localization.recoverstolen_timed_0005: This is a priority task, so it will need to be resolved quickly.
localization.recoverstolen_timed_0006: This package needs to be retrieved as soon as possible in order to limit any additional complications.
localization.recoverstolen_timed_0007: This job's got a narrow window of opportunity. See that you don't miss it.
localization.redwind_courier_fromdc_med_desc_001:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got a request in from ~mission(Pickup1|Address) that they have a fair number of packages waiting in the ~mission(Pickup1) that they need delivered. 

Before you take the contract, just make sure you got a ship with enough room. Tractor beam wouldn’t hurt either.

PACKAGES FOR PICK UP 
     · All Packages in the <EM4>~mission(Pickup1)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Pickup1|Address)</EM4>

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

I know you've done some solid work for us in the past, so I figured I'd see if you were interested in handling a bit of a special run for us that's a bit farther out in the system than what you've been doing so far.

In a nutshell, we need a pilot who's willing to keep their head down, focus on getting the packages delivered, and most importantly, not ask a lot of questions.

See, for a smaller company like us, staying ahead of competition means that we need to offer our clients something they can't get elsewhere - discretion. At Red Wind, as long as you got the credits we'll take whatever to wherever. Understand?

If that sounds good to you, let's see how you do on this run -

Got a shipment waiting to be hauled from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. 

I’ll be up front with you though, this spot doesn’t have the cleanest of reputations. That being said, they still need packages delivered and they got credits, so that’s all square. But if you go in there, there’s a good chance you might run into some trouble.

Don’t take the job if you can’t handle that.



TO ALL VETS - Red Wind appreciates your service to our Empire! Your struggles mean our freedom!

localization.refinery_ui_processingtype_fastcareful_d: This higher-than-average priced refinement process uses a series of very precisely controlled heating chambers to slowly extract the wanted material over the course of the thermal cycle and remove insoluble impurities through chromalysis to result in an above average yield.
High Yield // High Cost // Slightly Fast
localization.refinery_ui_processingtype_fastnormal_de: This process exposes raw material to quick bursts of Gaskin solvents to break down and remove impurities through inductive filtration. This fast but expensive process results in an average final yield.
localization.refinery_ui_processingtype_fastwasteful_: This process employs an array of highly corrosive reaction agents to rapidly dissolve unwanted materials. Developed by the Navy to expedite wartime material production, this costly refinement method makes up for its lower than average yield with its high rate of turnover.
localization.refinery_ui_processingtype_normalcareful: This recently developed process returns a high yield of refined product at a slightly below-average rate for a nominal cost. By using a resonant distillation process inside a flux-retort, the desired materials can be separated from the raw slag while minimizing waste.
High Yield // Moderate Cost // Very Slow
localization.refinery_ui_processingtype_normalnormal_: This moderately priced electrochemical process uses a pure sample of the desired final material as an anode to attract and bond the chemically dissolved raw material resulting in an average yield percentage and processing time.
Moderate Yield // Moderate Cost // Moderate Speed\n
localization.refinery_ui_processingtype_normalwastefu: This readily available and relatively quick process, invented by Art Cormack in 2321, injects the molten material with a stream of reactive gas that bonds with common impurities. The resulting insoluble byproduct can then be filtered from the refined molten slurry producing a relatively low final yield.
Low Yield // Moderate Cost // Very Fast
localization.refinery_ui_processingtype_slowcareful_d: This process slowly sublimates raw materials in a pressurized Dinyx chamber and then over time recrystallizes the vaporization in zero gravity to remove impurities as off-cast and produce a high yield of refined product.
localization.refinery_ui_processingtype_slownormal_de: Through slow application of repeated heating and cooling cycles, the raw materials can be separated according to their specific thermonatic properties and produce a moderate refined yield.
localization.refinery_ui_processingtype_slowwasteful_: Despite its moderate processing rate and relatively low yield, Kazen Winnowing, first developed in the 22nd century, is still frequently used thanks to its relatively simple set-up and lower price point. Once the raw material reaches its liquidis temperature, high pressure gas is introduced and used to winnow any remaining impurities.
Low Yield // Low Cost // Slightly Slow

Hello Guests,

We have recently been alerted that one of our Oxygen Dispensers has suffered a technical error. As you know these kiosks are vital to ensure that you have plenty of oxygen handy while participating in our Work Release Program.

We are looking for any available guest to reset the kiosk. That should reconnect the kiosk to the network and resolve the issue. The first guest who's able to complete this task will not only be compensated with merits, but also with the satisfaction that they're making the workplace safer for other guests.

Thank you.

localization.retrievedatapad_captain_journal:
Sorry about the last minute price hike, but that's just the cost of doing business these days isn’t it? 

I recommend that you try to focus on the fact that at the end of the day you're still getting what you want. What's the harm if I'm getting what I want too? That's called a win-win in my book.

Looking forward to working with you again in the future,
Arliss

localization.retrievedatapad_civilian_journal:
To: Tim Oishi
From: Barry Norris
Subject: Bye

Hey Love,

I know I said I'd be home next week, but it's looking like I'm gonna have to break another promise. 

We got hit and I took some fire. Managed to get away and hide, but I'm bleeding bad and if the rest of the crew are down, it's not going to be good. Doc said I didn't have any more regens in me, so this might be it. At least I managed to leave a little surprise for the bastards if they come after me.

I'm sorry for everything I put you through, and I'm sorry I never got the chance to make it right. You were the best thing that ever happened to me and I should have treated you like it.

If I don't come back, you don't have to worry about doing a ceremony or anything for me. Never been my style. I just hope the next person you love is better than I was.

Love,
B
localization.retrievedatapad_crew_journal_01:
To: Marcel Brickley
From: Tania Adlett
Subject: What Goes Around Comes Around

Look, I love credits as much as the next person, but I got a feeling what the Captain's been doing isn't going to fly for very long. All this double-crossing and blackmailing is going to catch up to him, and we're gonna be left holding the bag.  

I think we should say something to him. I'd do it myself, but I know he listens to you. I'm not saying we need to go clean or anything, just be a little more careful with our dealings is all. I mean, you and I both know what the Nine Tails are capable of. Did we really need to get on their bad side?

Let me know what you want to do,
Tania
localization.retrievedatapad_crew_journal_01_title: [SENT MESSAGE] What Goes Around Comes Around
localization.retrievedatapad_crew_journal_02:
To: Tania Adlett
From Marcel Brickley
Subject: Chill Out

Tan,

You need to calm down. So, we screwed over the Nine Tails? Who cares? How are they going to find us? It's not like they can magically track their cargo. 

And anyway, when you think about it, it's really their own fault. People should learn to be more careful.  Like this last job with the data, why would they tell us how valuable it was if they didn't want to get screwed over? Far as I'm concerned, we're schooling them on how to behave for their next crew.

My suggestion? Worry about how you're going to spend all these credits were going to make. 

-Marcel
localization.retrievedatapad_desc:
Ran into a bit of crap luck that I'm hoping you can help me right.

A few days ago, I hired the crew of the 'Pride of Arliss' to obtain some important data for me. They pulled off the job no problem, but the bastard of a captain comm'd me demanding more credits. Turns out it wasn't the first time he's tried to pull this trick either because in middle of "negotiating" with me, his ship was attacked by some very pissed off individuals looking to teach him a lesson.

Our comm got cut off when the shooting started and that was the last I heard from him. I'm guessing he's as good as ghosted, but I want you to head to the Pride of Arliss and try to get my data off the captain's personal datapad.

Once you have it, I set up a secure transmission channel at the ARC-L1 rest stop. Travel there and when you're in range, submit the data to me through this contract to get paid.
  
Don’t try to screw me over either. Karma can be a real asshole.
localization.retrievedatapad_engineer_journal:
To: Captain Arliss Knox
From: Judy Ramirez
Subject: Grav Gen Issues

Hey Cap,

Bad news. That last little scuffle did more damage than I thought. The gravity generator's going to need a complete overhaul to get it working again, and that means we need to park up in a garage for a few days. 

Since I know we’re not going to do that until this job's done, and there’s a good chance the gravity's going to keep fritzing out on us which is less than ideal, so in the meanwhile, I went ahead and rigged the engineering console to allow anybody to do a hard reset of the system if they need to.

Figure at least this way if I'm gunked up patching another part of the ship you all don't have to wait for me.

-Judy

localization.roughandready_repui_description: In a play off of the popular Rest & Relax stations found throughout the UEE, this gang has established itself by running the largest fuel operations in Pyro. While their prices may not be fair, you can at least count on them having fuel and services on offer. Individuals who cross them often find life in Pyro much harder than it already was.
localization.roughready_bounty_cargoship_desc_001:
Rough & Ready recently provided fueling services for a hauler named ~mission(TargetName), who agreed to deliver their next load of supplies to us as compensation. Well, we just found out that the lying skag sold their latest shipment to a rival gang instead. 

We’re looking for someone to track down and eliminate ~mission(TargetName|Last) for the double cross. 

An old friend of mine just spotted the skag at ~mission(Location|Address). Looks like they're loaded with more cargo that’s not coming our way, and traveling with an escort. We’re only paying you to take out the ship, so anything you find aboard is yours to keep.

- Smokey
localization.roughready_bounty_cargoship_desc_002:
My associates and I brokered a deal with a hauler named ~mission(TargetName) to deliver supplies to us. Funny thing is the shipment never showed up. They claimed pirates raided their ship and took our supplies, but it turns out that story’s 100% ranta dung.

Lying to back out of our deal can’t go unanswered and you’re going to make that message abundantly clear. ~mission(TargetName|Last) was recently seen with an escort at ~mission(Location|Address). As long as you kill ~mission(TargetName|Last), we don’t care what happens to the cargo they’re hauling. 

- Smokey
localization.roughready_bounty_cargoship_desc_003:
Some asshole going by the name ~mission(TargetName) has been running a scheme where their cargo ship requests refueling services only to ambush our ships when they get there. Even loaded the damn thing up with real cargo to make sure it passes scans. We’ve spread the word so nobody in Rough & Ready will fall for the trap again, but I want this skag punished. 

I think ~mission(TargetName|Last) knows a lot of our people on sight, so I’m guessing it’ll be better to pay you to take care of it. Heard that they were spotted around ~mission(Location|Address). Head there now and take care of that cargo ship and anyone protecting it once and for all. 

- Smokey
localization.roughready_bounty_desc_001:
Interested in doing a little hunting? 

~mission(TargetName) sabotaged one of our fuel shipments and cost us a ton of creds, so I’m looking for someone to make ‘em pay for what they did. Just got word ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted at ~mission(Location|Address). If you head there now, there’s a good chance you can pick up their trail and take ‘em out for good. 

~mission(TargetName|Last) didn’t work alone, so don’t be surprised if they’re traveling with extra protection.

- Smokey
localization.roughready_bounty_desc_002:
Rough & Ready have been in business with ~mission(TargetName) for years but that relationship has taken a turn for the worse. For a while, we were supplying them with fuel on credit but when it came time to collect the coward went into hiding. If ~mission(TargetName|Last) can’t pay with creds, guess they’re gonna pay with their life.

An associate just clocked ~mission(TargetName|Last) at ~mission(Location|Address). I’d love for you to head there now to make the stingy bastard pay.

By the way, it looks like ~mission(TargetName|Last) isn’t traveling alone, so I’d make sure you’re fully stocked before going after ‘em. 

- Smokey
localization.roughready_bounty_desc_003:
I have a delicate situation that needs handling. After years of being a loyal member of Rough & Ready, ~mission(TargetName) defected from the gang and is out there shopping secrets to our rivals. We need ~mission(TargetName|Last) ghosted immediately. 

With stuff like this, I’ve found it’s always better to pay someone unassociated with us to do the deed. Scans picked up ~mission(TargetName|Last) near ~mission(Location|Address) not too long ago. We’ll pay you well to head there now and take care ‘em for us. 

~mission(TargetName|Last) isn’t an idiot and knows we’ll be coming after ‘em. Be prepared for a helluva fight and don’t expect ‘em to be alone.

- Smokey
localization.roughready_claimsweep_desc_easy:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for someone to handle a delicate situation. We’ve discovered a ship and orbital sentries at ~mission(location|address) spyin’ on us. We’re in a bit of a bind because we don’t want to start a larger fight with whoever’s behind this. That’s why we’re looking for some hired help who can quickly and discreetly take care of it for us. Interested?

Last thing, once you’re out there, make sure to keep an eye on that ship. Bet as soon as you start blowin’ up their sentries they’re gonna try to bring in some help to stop you.
 
- Smokey
localization.roughready_claimsweep_desc_hard:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for an independent merc interested in something heavy. We’ve been keeping an eye on a developing situation at ~mission(location|address) where ships are guarding several orbital sentries spying on our operations.      

Now, I might’ve been born at night, but it wasn’t last night. Considering the blatant way they’re set up, whoever’s responsible had to know we’d eventually discover it. Almost feels like they’re baiting R&R into attacking it, and I don’t want us falling for it. 

Instead, you’re gonna do it for us and get paid a damn good amount of creds for your effort. The ships stationed there will be less suspicious of an unaffiliated ship approaching and make it harder to pin the attack on us. 

Just be sure to plan accordingly before heading in. Maybe bring your own reinforcements in case any of their ships escape and call in some of their own.     

- Smokey
localization.roughready_claimsweep_desc_intro:
My associates and I have found ourselves in a little predicament and could use some help. There’s an orbital sentry at ~mission(location|address) that’s spying on us. We don’t know who put it there, but it sure as hell can’t stay. 

Thing is we’re business minded folks first and foremost and worry that if we blow it up ourselves it’ll start shit. That’s why it’s better if someone like you does it. Should be a quick and easy gig for someone interested in earning some creds.   

- Smokey
localization.roughready_claimsweep_desc_medium:
Recently made an interesting discovery that someone set up a handful of orbital sentries at ~mission(location|address). Guess they’re trying to grab some info about our operations there. They even have a few ships guarding to make sure nothing happens to them. 

Of course, we want these bastards gone, but I’m worried that getting rid of it ourselves would be bad for business. That’s why we’re looking for a little ‘plausible deniability’. Someone from outside of R&R to eliminate the problem, so whoever is behind it can’t directly tie the attack back to us. I know this won’t be a walk in the park, especially with those guards lurking. Who knows how many reinforcements they have at the ready? But if you manage to get it done, we’re prepared to see you paid right. 

Think you’ve got the skills to pull this off? 

- Smokey
localization.roughready_claimsweep_desc_rand:
Interested in getting your hands dirty? Turns out someone set up a little operation at ~mission(location|address) to spy on Rough & Ready’s business dealings. They’ve got several orbital sentries and guard ships posted there. We don’t know who’s behind it, what kind of reinforcements they have waiting, or why they’re targeting us, but it’s definitely not for something good.  

Now, we could take care of it ourselves but have business interests to consider. Sometimes the best way to protect those interests is to hire mercs to do our dirty work. If you’re interested in making good creds and gaining a little good will with the R&R, now’s your chance. Interested? 

- Smokey
localization.roughready_delivery_station_desc_001:
Any chance you’re at ~mission(Destination)?

Need a box hustled from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Get it there on time and unbroken and it’ll be the easiest creds you’ll ever earn.   

-Smokey
localization.roughready_destroyitems_fuel_desc_01:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that ~mission(location|address) is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high. 

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey
localization.roughready_eliminateall_hangar_desc_01:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in ~mission(location|address). We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey
localization.roughready_eliminateall_maintenance_desc:
Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over ~mission(location|address).

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

- Smokey

Comm’s come in from one of our Rook’s that a gang’s been secretly operating out of ~mission(location|address).

Can’t have that on our turf. We’d handle it ourselves, but the whole situation’s embarrassing enough as is, so rather than have our people draw any more attention to it, I want you to handle the problem for us. 

Of course, you’ll be paid well for your services.

- Smokey
localization.roughready_missingperson_inv_e_station_d: Find missing RR member who was last seen near ~mission(Location|Address).
localization.roughready_replaceparts_desc_001:
Anybody out there got a multitool and some fuses? Need some patch ups done around ~mission(Location) station . I’ll give you the details if you pick it up.

Now we’ll throw you some creds for doing this, but honestly it shouldn’t be too much to ask for some help when we give you all the run of our stations. But hey, that’s just me.

Grizz
localization.roughready_salvage_e_desc_001:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to ~mission(Location|Address). They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

- Smokey
localization.roughready_salvage_m_desc_001:
Got word there’s a few ships near ~mission(Location|Address) just floating all by their lonesome. It’s good salvage, but none of our crews have the time right now. We figured to give you first snap at it.

If you want the coords, we’ll sell them to you for a price. Then you’re free to pick the wreck as clean as you like and sell it all for a tidy profit. Now, you might run into some trouble out there from rival scavs, but I’m sure it won’t be anything you can’t handle.

- Smokey
localization.roughready_salvage_m_title_001: Salvage Wrecked Ships on the Drift
localization.roughready_salvage_xt_vh_desc_001:
Been given some primo info that could be a boon for both of us. Someone took out a XenoThreat hauler near ~mission(Location|Address). It must have some sweet, sweet salvage because a Xeno recovery team was there and working that site almost immediately. Would be a real shame if someone else showed up, knocked out the other Xeno ships, and then claimed all that salvage for their own. 

I’ve got a few colleagues interested in the action themselves, but Rough & Ready members getting caught there would only look like we’re taking sides. Would be much better if an unaffiliated force stepped in to deliver the surprise strike. 

Figure we can all win here. I’ll sell you the coordinates to the wreck, and you can clear out the XenoThreat forces and then pick it all apart. Pretty sure they’ll put up a fight for it, but just come in prepared and consider all that collateral damage as more profit off salvage. 

- Smokey
localization.roughready_searchbody_danger_station_des:
After hearing rumors that we might’ve gotten a bad case of squatters over at ~mission(Location|Address), I had sent one of my more trusted people to investigate. 

Bad news is that I haven’t heard from them since. 

I’d like for you to head over and see if you can find ~mission(TargetName)’s current whereabouts.  I’ll leave it up to you how you want to deal with any scum you come across. 

Confirm where ~mission(TargetName|Last) is, and there’ll be a reward in it for you.

- Smokey
localization.roughready_searchbody_nodanger_station_d:
I’ve got people left and right askin’ me if I know what happened to ~mission(TargetName). Now personally, I’d be more than happy to see ‘em gone for good, but for whatever reason they got friends in high places demanding answers.

I can’t spare any of my people to go on a wild goose chase, so I'm looking for the perfect candidate to go over to ~mission(Location|Address) and find out what happened to ~mission(TargetName|Last). You’ll get paid if you find where they are.

10 credits says they got way too high and passed out in a dark corner somewhere.

-Smokey

localization.ruto_assassin_sync_e_desc:
Here's the deal. ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2) need to die at the same time. Unfortunately, they aren't gonna be in the same place.

A double hit can sound complicated, but if you hire some additional guns it shouldn't be all that hard to do two hits simultaneously.

Make sure you find folks who have skills as I have it on good authority that each'll be flying with some escorts for "protection."
localization.ruto_assassin_sync_h_desc:
Have another pair that needs simultaneous deathing. Seems to be getting more and more popular as a murder option. 

This time it's ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2). Both are supposed to be pretty skilled operators and they won't be flying alone. 

I'd make sure whoever you get to help you on this one can handle a fight.
localization.ruto_assassin_sync_intro_desc:
Guess what ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2) have in common? 

You're gonna kill 'em both!

Difficult part is that I need you to kill them at the same time so that one doesn't have a chance to escape, or worse, kill the person trying to kill them. 

So put together a team to track one target while you handle the other. Divide and conquer!

And despite the fact they made a mess big enough to get themselves killed, my understanding is that they are relative lightweights. Don't expect you to meet too much resistance.
localization.ruto_assassin_sync_m_desc:
I really hope that you're not buddies with ~mission(TargetName) or ~mission(TargetName2) because I need you to ghost the pair of them... at the same time...

Of course they wouldn't make this easy on us and travel in the same ship or something obvious like that. No. You're going to have to put together a crew so that you can down both targets simultaneously. 

As soon as one of them is dead, be ready to drop the other one too. Can't risk either of them getting away.

And I figure I should mention that not only are both pretty good pilots, but that they'll be traveling with backup too. Nothing you can't handle I'm sure.
localization.ruto_assassin_sync_s_desc:
If you had asked me, I would've said ~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2) would have wound up eventually killing each other. But instead you're going to get the honor of killing them both at the same time.

You're going to have to work for it, though.

Each one is trouble. Serious records, highly trained, and too smart to fly without backup.

Gather the best crew you can on this one. You'll need it. And don't be stingy. You can't spend credits if you're dead.
localization.ruto_assassin_sync_ve_desc:
It's pretty touching when you run across a pair that's willing to die for one another. Stupid but touching.

~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2) chose to stand by each other and now its gone and got them dead.

Find a friend of your own and hunt each of these two down. Make sure you kill them at the same time. Call it poetic justice.

They should die pretty easy. Maybe they'll have a ship or two with them but I don't think it'll be anything to worry about.
localization.ruto_assassin_sync_vh_desc:
~mission(TargetName) and ~mission(TargetName2). I think they may be related? Or dating? Doesn't really matter, someone wants them killed. 

I've arranged it so that you can hit them when they're not flying together. Safer for you this way. They are both serious business and fly with equally serious backup.

Make sure you and your crew time your attacks. I don't want one of them left alive or it's going to be a real headache.
localization.ruto_assassin_sync_vh_title: two for the price of two

localization.sc_lz_shops_abernathyinteriors_abernathy: Welcome to Abernathy Interiors. How may I help you?

localization.sc_lz_shops_advocacyfieldoffice_advocacy: Welcome to the Advocacy Office, citizien.\n\nDo you have something to report?
Please fill out this crime report.
Please fill out this crime report.
I want to report a crime.
What crime would you like to report?
I want to pay my bounty.
If you have something to report,\n\nplease see the officer at the main desk.
localization.sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_barte: Welcome to ArcCorp Bar! What can I serve you?
We have everything from pure water to the highest-quality space alcool.
Any big news I might have missed?
I don't think so. Things have been pretty quiet lately.
I'm always there if you change your mind.
localization.sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_lev_c:
I used to be in the army. 


I was a Hornet pilot, fighting the Vanduul in Tiber.
I'm sure I could teach you a thing or two about dogfighting.

I served in the Navy too, fighting the Vanduul.


I guess war never changes.

Well, one day you're risking your life protecting all of mankind,


the next you're alone drinking in a lousy bar in the middle of nowhere!
All right, come back later and we'll have a drink.
localization.sc_lz_shops_arccorpbar_arccorp_bar_waite: Welcome to ArcCorp Bar! What can I serve you?
We have everything from pure water to the highest-quality space alcohol.
Just give me a sign if you need anything.
localization.sc_lz_shops_arccorpdistrojobwell_arccorp: Welcome to ArcCorp Distro and Job Well.\n\nHow may I be of service?
ArcCorp is always looking for raw materials to use in its factories.\n\nWe have lots of industrial good for sale.
Anything else I can help you with?
We have a few contracts available. Please have a look at the board.
localization.sc_lz_shops_arccorpstore_arccorp_store_s: Welcome to ArcCorp Store. We have all the latest technologies from ArcCorp available at the lowest price.
I'd like to see what you have for sale.
Sure thing. Let me show you our newest fusion engine. It's a true marvel of engineering.
We'll give you the best price for your original ArcCorp parts.
localization.sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_insu: Hi! What can I do for you?
I'd like to know about your insurance packages.
I'm sure we have the perfect package to suit your needs.\n\nIt all depends on the level of coverage you want.
localization.sc_lz_shops_astroarmada_astroarmada_sale: Welcome to Astro-Armada! How can I help you today?
Let me check with our insurance representative. He should be with you in just a minute.
Our insurance representative is ready. You can meet him in his office.
I'd like to sell my ship.
You've come to the right place.\n\nWe'll give you the most credits for you ship.
I'd like to buy a ship.
We have our most popular model right here on the show floor, and many more in our hangar.
Let me know if you have any questions.
I'd like to get insurance for my ship.
localization.sc_lz_shops_barclaysestate_barclays_esta: How may I help you today?
I want to write my will.
Sure. We have this easy form you can fill out.
Anything else I can help you with?
I'm here to collect my inheritance.
We are sorry for your loss, but we'll do our best to make this process easy for you.
I'm sorry, I changed my mind.
Welcome to Barclay's Estate. How may we help?
I'd like to talk with a lawyer please.
One of our qualified lawyers will be available in just a minute, please have a seat.
Our lawyer is ready to meet with you. Please go through this door, his office is the first on the right.
I'm sorry, I have to go
Don't forget, Barclay's Estate is always there for you.
localization.sc_lz_shops_casabaoutlet_casaba_outlet_s: Welcome to Casaba Outlet. How may I help you?
We have a great selection of clothes for every occasion.
I'd like to try out these clothes.
Sure. Just go into any of the unoccupied changing room.
Come see me if you need to try anything.
localization.sc_lz_shops_centermass_centermass_salesp: Welcome to Centermass. How may I be of service?
What do you have for sale?
We have the latest weapons and defensive countermeasures from ASD, Klaus & Werner, MaxOx, and many others.
Can I help you in some other way?
I have some parts I'd like to sell.
We're always looking for quality parts.
Remember, when you fire, you can't go wrong with Centermass.
localization.sc_lz_shops_corporatesecurity_corporate_: BlackJack Securities is keeping ArcCorp safe.\n\nDon't start any trouble.
You look like you can defend yourself.\n\nAre you looking for work?
Let me know if you change your mind.\n\nThere's good money to be made for both of us
I can always use some extra credits.
I have some important work to get done,\n\nbut you need to keep a low profile.
I don't want any unwanted attention. Are you up for it?
I might have misjudged you then.
I'm just the man for the task.
All right. I'll contact you when everything is ready.
This isn't the kind of work I'm looking for.
localization.sc_lz_shops_cubbyblast_cubby_blast_clor_: Welcome to Cubby Blast. I'm Clor Vee, offering you the best in personal weapons in this part of the galaxy.
I only stock the finest weapons and I test them all myself.\n\nThat's Cubby Blast's commitment to quality.
I have some weapons to sell
Let me see what you have and I'll give you a price.

Good, cause that's all we're selling.\n\nEverything we have is on the shelves behind you.
I have some extra parts I'd like to sell.
All right, I can always take a look at what you have and give you a price.
I'm pretty busy right now.\n\nGo see the manager at the counter.

localization.scramblerace_desc_regular_01:
You fast? You deadly? You looking to make some serious creds? Then I got the race for you.

I'm talking a weapons free, old school scramble. Pilot a ~mission(RaceType|Short), collect checkpoints, steal points from the leader, and win big. Whoever gets enough points first is declared champion and gets a fat payout. 2nd and 3rd place even get prizes too.  

Let me know if you're interested, and I'll send you the starting coordinates once the race is set up. In the meanwhile, feel free to get your ~mission(RaceType) ready to go. ~mission(RaceType|ScrambleRaceASOP)
localization.scramblerace_desc_suicide_01:
You've proven that you can handle yourself, so now's the time to take your racing to the next level!

SUICIDE SCRAMBLE!!!!

That's right - Winner takes all.

Whichever ~mission(RaceType|Short) gets enough checkpoints first walks away with all the credits.

Tell me you're in, and I'll send you the starting coordinates once we're all set up. Till then, start prepping your ~mission(RaceType). ~mission(RaceType|ScrambleRaceASOP)

localization.searchbody_danger_0001: We would be remiss if we did not remind you that venturing into the wreck site will potentially be hazardous, and all caution should be used.
localization.searchbody_danger_0002: It goes without saying, but be careful out there. We would hate for whatever or whoever happened to the ~mission(Ship) to happen to you.
localization.searchbody_danger_0003: It's possible that the ~mission(Ship) was the victim of foul play, so make sure to take your time and don't get sloppy. Caution is the keyword.
localization.searchbody_desc_0001: The family of ~mission(TargetName) is hoping to find some closure. While there is confirmation that the ~mission(Ship) ~mission(TargetName|First)were serving aboard did not survive its journey, the family wants to know for sure what happened. ~mission(Contractor) is looking for someone with tact and discretion to investigate ~mission(Location) and see if they can learn ~mission(TargetName|First)'s fate. ~mission(Timed)~mission(Danger)Your assistance in the matter is appreciated.
localization.searchbody_desc_0002: Recently, a ~mission(Ship) ran into some unfortunate luck and was destroyed. Since around that same time, no one has heard or seen ~mission(TargetName) and it is our current belief that they may have been aboard when the ~mission(Ship) met its fate. We are looking for a contractor to complete a survey onsite at ~mission(Location) and ascertain if ~mission(TargetName|Last) is there. ~mission(Timed)~mission(Danger)
localization.searchbody_desc_0003: We are in need of a contractor to locate one, ~mission(TargetName), who was last seen working aboard a ~mission(Ship) that was recently reported as destroyed. ~mission(Timed)~mission(Danger)Payment will be issued upon receiving confirmation of ~mission(TargetName|Last)'s whereabouts.
localization.searchbody_desc_0004: ~mission(Contractor) is currently seeking a contractor to help confirm the status of ~mission(TargetName). According to our initial research, it is believed that ~mission(TargetName|First) was serving aboard a ~mission(Ship) that befell a tragic accident. We would require you to travel to ~mission(Location) and conduct an onsite search, so that we may determine if ~mission(TargetName|First) did indeed perish aboard and inform the parents. ~mission(Timed)~mission(Danger)
localization.searchbody_desc_0005: Not expecting a happy outcome on this one. ~mission(TargetName) was last heard from when they boarded a ~mission(Ship). That same ship was reported destroyed. Now, the family wants to confirm what happened one way or the other. That's where you come in. Go, search ~mission(Location), locate ~mission(TargetName|Last) and we can hopefully give them a little peace of mind. ~mission(Timed)~mission(Danger)
localization.searchbody_timed_0001: We would all like to see this matter closed as quickly as possible, and as such, a certain amount urgency is warranted.
localization.searchbody_timed_0002: We've been asked to expedite matters, and are looking to settle this ASAP.
localization.searchbody_timed_0003: ~mission(TargetName|First) has been missing for some time, so anything you could do to settle this as quickly as possible would be great.
localization.searchcrew_danger_0001: We would be remiss if we did not remind you that venturing into the wreck site will potentially be hazardous, and all caution should be used.
localization.searchcrew_danger_0002: It goes without saying, but be careful out there. We would hate for whatever or whoever happened to the ~mission(Ship) to happen to you.
localization.searchcrew_danger_0003: It's possible that the ~mission(Ship) was the victim of foul play, so make sure to take your time and don't get sloppy. Caution is the keyword.
localization.searchcrew_desc_0001: The family members of the crew serving aboard a ~mission(Ship) that was recently reported as destroyed are hoping to find some closure. ~mission(Contractor) is looking for contractors to investigate ~mission(Location) and see if they can learn the crew's fate. ~mission(Timed)~mission(Danger)Your assistance in the matter is much appreciated.
localization.searchcrew_desc_0002: Recently, a ~mission(Ship) ran into some unfortunate luck and was destroyed. Since that unfortunate incident, no one has heard or seen any of the crew since and it is our current belief that none may have survived. We are looking for contractors to complete a survey onsite at ~mission(Location) and positively identify all the missing crewmembers. ~mission(Timed)~mission(Danger)
localization.searchcrew_desc_0003: We are in need of contractors to locate the missing crew of a ~mission(Ship) that was recently reported as destroyed. ~mission(Timed)~mission(Danger)Payment will be issued upon receiving confirmation of the full complement's whereabouts.
localization.searchcrew_desc_0004: ~mission(Contractor) is currently seeking contractors to help confirm the status of the crew aboard a ~mission(Ship) that befell a tragic accident. We would require you to travel to ~mission(Location) and conduct an onsite search on our behalf so that we may determine what happened to the missing crew and inform the relatives. ~mission(Timed)~mission(Danger)
localization.searchcrew_desc_0005: Not expecting a happy outcome on this one. A ~mission(Ship) was reported destroyed and now the family of the crew wants to confirm what happened one way or the other. We need contractors to search ~mission(Location), locate all the missing people, so we can give their relatives a little peace of mind. ~mission(Timed)~mission(Danger)
localization.searchcrew_obj_long_01: Go to ~mission(Location) to search for missing crew.
localization.searchcrew_timed_0001: We would all like to see this matter closed as quickly as possible, and as such, a certain amount urgency is warranted.
localization.searchcrew_timed_0002: We've been asked to expedite matters, and are looking to settle this ASAP.
localization.searchcrew_timed_0003: The crew has been missing for a while now and anything you could do to settle this as quickly as possible would be great.
localization.sectorsweep_danger_001: Do not underestimate the ~mission(Client)' flying skills. They have proven themselves more than capable so far.
localization.sectorsweep_danger_002: Make sure to use extreme caution with your approach. It's been a real mess out there.
localization.sectorsweep_danger_003: And so we're perfectly clear, this is a potentially dangerous contract, so you are undertaking this at your own risk.
localization.sectorsweep_danger_004: It's not going to be an easy task. The ~mission(Client) have some serious fighters in their ranks.
localization.sectorsweep_desc_0001: The ~mission(Client) have been aggressively operating in ~mission(Location) and after their most recent attack, the local authorities have decided enough is enough. ~mission(Contractor) are looking for operators to head out immediately to the rendezvous and begin sweeping through the entire sector, clearing out any ~mission(Client) they come across. ~mission(Jingo)~mission(Danger)
localization.sectorsweep_desc_0002: The death toll has been on the rise in ~mission(Location) as the ~mission(Client) have increased hostile actions in the sector. In order to stem this unfortunate trend, we are seeking mercenaries to head out ASAP and launch an immediate counter action, removing any and all threats from the area before there is any further loss of life. ~mission(Danger)
localization.sectorsweep_desc_0003: Mercenaries are needed to eliminate a hostile group that have been attacking ships near ~mission(Location). Initial intelligence reports indicate that the group is comprised of members from the ~mission(Client), a local gang known to operate in the sector. We are not sure how long this intel will be good for, so operators need to be ready to move fast. ~mission(Danger)~mission(Jingo)
localization.sectorsweep_desc_0004: Trouble in ~mission(Location) is about to boil over and we want it stopped before that happens. ~mission(Jingo)Operators are needed to assist in clearing the ~mission(Client) out of the designated sectors. Be ready to roll out as soon as you are able. ~mission(Danger)
localization.sectorsweep_desc_0005: We've been having growing problems with the ~mission(Client) out near ~mission(Location). ~mission(Jingo)As such, and owing to the urgency of the situation, financial incentives have been allocated in order to hire mercenaries to assist with clearing their hunting grounds as soon as possible. ~mission(Danger)
localization.sectorsweep_jingo_0001: It's time that we show these bastards that they can't do whatever they want without paying the consequences.
localization.sectorsweep_jingo_0002: This can't be allowed to go on any longer. It's time we took a stand.
localization.sectorsweep_jingo_0003: These outlaws have been running roughshod over the people of Crusader for too long. It's time for a change.
localization.sectorsweep_jingo_0004: It will be a relief to see these cutthroats put down once and for all.
