localization.ui_pregame_hangar_aeroview_desc: Equally capable of holding a client meeting as well as a ship, Aeroview Hangars have become the definitive choice for the discerning executive. Built with a proprietary modular system, an Aeroview Hangar can be customized around your needs, even accommodating larger ships than most other civilian hangar providers on the market. With an overlooking office space, you won’t ever be far from your business, wherever it may take you.
localization.ui_pregame_hangar_aeroview_history: Aeroview proudly claims to be the oldest established hangar manufacturer in Human space. Their design and construction of hangars goes back more than 300 years. In the 27th century, Arthur Nassir formed the company around a rigid code of business ethics focusing largely on design quality, a dedication to ergonomics, and an extreme respect for client confidentiality. Aeroview also famously reserves the right to refuse service to any non-Citizens. While hangar design and housing is tangential, at best, to piracy, Nassir’s outspoken contempt for those who fly outside the law led to the company’s code. When Aeroview was purchased by Shubin Interstellar, the conditions of the sale insisted that the code be adhered to in perpetuity. /n/nWhile the code remains intact, Aeroview’s original business model does not. The Aeroview hangars of the 28th century were palatial affairs built on a case-by-case basis to the specifications of the social elite capable of owning their own spacecraft. In recent years, Aeroview has adapted their tactics to follow in SELF-LAND’s footsteps (although they would never admit it). Instead of custom-building high-class hangars on an individual basis, they now produce a line of modular “business hangars” priced to sell to successful businessmen and other executive-level clients. Unlike other modular hangar companies, Aeroview does not lease the property on which their hangars are established. This is left up to the individual consumer to determine; the Aeroview hangar can be erected at any point in the UEE given 48-hours notification (24 hours, for a steep rush construction fee). Of special note, Aeroview has found particular success in developing hangars for larger scale craft or craft that require additional space for support equipment. Pilots of ships like Freelancers, with multiple crew housings, or Hornets, with weapons racks and a need for more intensive hull repair facilities, generally find it more cost effective to purchase a single Aeroview hangar rather than multiple SELF-LANDs.
localization.ui_pregame_hangar_revelyork_desc: Excellence. Refinement. Function. These are the pillars that the architects at Revel & York hold dear when building a hangar facility. They understand that your hangar is not just a space. That it is an extension, a manifestation of its owner. Featuring handcrafted wood paneling, botanical gardens and dynamic wallscreens, Revel & York hangars will feel more like home than home.
localization.ui_pregame_hangar_revelyork_history: When the Revel & York engineering corporation set about designing its first hangar some thirty years ago, the reaction was laughter. The company, known best for excessively expensive and visibly uncomfortable furniture, was entering a field dominated by aerospace giants. The laughter ceased quickly as the Revel & York “deluxe” line of hangars became the de-facto spacecraft garage of the rich and powerful. The company’s cavernous hangars, established on ideal landing spaces in top-dollar land agreements, earned their standing reputation for excellence and quality. /n/nRevel & York designers work directly with pilots to develop a hangar experience like no other. R&Y is the only company currently constructing modular hangars designed to support merchantman-class spacecraft like the Constellation and Caterpillar, locking them into a valuable if small segment of the population. Their hangar designs have earned their reputation: between interlocking catwalks (with motorized lifts!) to allow pilots to supervise their spacecraft from overhead, to specially designed Greycat PV buggies for transporting ship crews from module to module, everything is designed for not just the elite pilots’ usability but also their overall enjoyment. SELF-LAND and competitors make a place to put your ship; Revel & York makes a place for you to take it in.
localization.ui_pregame_hangar_selfland_desc: Affordable and utilitarian hangars available in every system of the Empire. Self-Land prides themselves on providing a safe and secure landing experience whether you’re in Terra or Fora. Their modular design and use of prefabricated materials means that Self-Land hangars can be constructed in almost any existing structure, leading to their extensive presence around the UEE.
localization.ui_pregame_hangar_selfland_history: Incorporated by Peter Weathermen, a wealthy guild licensed shipper who made his living on the active spacelanes, SELF-LAND hangars have become an ever-present reminder of just how easy it is for Humans to travel the stars. The corporation was founded on the philosophy that the temporary hangars available to transiting pilots were inaccessible, unaffordable and most importantly unsafe. (Weathermen began developing the company after he was jumped by a gang of dock-thugs who stripped his Starfarer to the hull plating.) /n/nStarting in the mid-29th century, SELF-LAND began a franchising-based expansion across the Human-inhabited galaxy. The first SELF-LAND was established by Weathermen on Vann in the Croshaw System. Seemingly overnight, the company had expanded to a dozen worlds … and then a hundred. Today, the SELF-LAND corporation boasts that they maintain at least one facility on every world in the UEE, with some planets (Terra chief among them) having as many as sixty different complexes. SELF-LAND hangars are fully modular and environmentally controlled. Prefabricated out of the most available common metals, they aren’t necessarily attractive to look at … but they are comfortable and familiar. The SELF-LAND experience on a colony world near Vanduul space is exactly the same as that available to a pilot berthing on Earth. The SELF-LAND corporation takes care of everything, from structure design to land titles. Because of their design, the same hangar type can be used in configurations ranging from skyscraping heights, to the breadth of a plain, to stacked underground, or to honeycombed deep within asteroids.
localization.ui_pregame_hangar_vfgindustrial_desc: For commercial and industrial needs, why not consider a hangar from VFG Industrial? Inspired by military design principles, their effective and durable structures are capable of sustaining inhospitable conditions. With a VFG hangar, there’s no such thing as off limits.
localization.ui_pregame_hangar_vfgindustrial_history: Tom Vivien, Walter Fink and Ulla Gandil were members of the UEE Army Corp of Engineers who specialized in quickly building pressurized landing zones in combat zones during their service. They founded VFG Industrial shortly after being discharged and attempted to bring their expertise to the civilian market. With so many mining groups and terraformers out there, they believed there was a demand for functional and well-crafted hangars in 'non-ideal' conditions. They were correct, clients came in droves, until the Army attempted to sue them for patent theft. The lawsuit claimed that VFG's entire business was built upon proprietary design briefs written for and owned by the Army. VFG tried to settle in for a long fight, but soon began to run out of resources. With a freeze on their business, no more money was coming in, but the three refused to back down./n/nWhen things seemed bleakest, they received a reprieve, of sorts. ArcCorp was very interested in their hangar building methods, specifically for their mining and terraforming subsidiaries, but also to mass-market to the public. The members of VFG were divided. Fink utterly refused to sell to the MegaCorp, but the other two knew they had no choice. The three finally agreed to sell. ArcCorp's lawyers took over their defense and within a matter of weeks managed to work some backroom black magic to hamstring the Army's case. Fink took a substantial buyout and left the firm. Tom Vivien and Ulla Gandil are technically still on the board, but control of the company has shifted to ArcCorp.
localization.ui_pregame_hangars_desc: Hangars provide a private area to view and modify your ship loadouts.
localization.ui_pregame_nyx_desc: Discovered in 2582, the Nyx System was left unclaimed by the UEE after deciding its three planets were not terraforming candidates. Private concerns like QV Planet Services attempted to mine the system's resource but were soon forced to abandon their attempts. In 2655, a group of political activists and refugees fleeing the Messer regime, the People's Alliance, moved into a vacated asteroid mining facility to found the egalitarian society of Levski. To this day, the group continues to struggle to build a better life in the face of growing challenges from outlaws, the encroaching Vanduul, and the UEE expressing a renewed interest in the system's potential.
localization.ui_pregame_persistentuniverse_desc: Experience the Star Citizen Alpha universe. Join your friends, visit space stations, execute contracts, all in a persistent expanding universe.
localization.ui_pregame_port_area18_callout1: Cubby Blast, Casaba Outlet, Dumper's Depot, Astro Armada, Traveler Rentals
localization.ui_pregame_port_area18_callout2: Riker Memorial Spaceport, G-Loc Bar, TDD, ArcCorp Distro, Adira Falls, Bevic Convention Center
localization.ui_pregame_port_area18_desc,p: Area18 is one of the main commercial ports for interplanetary traffic in the surrounding region of ArcCorp. Travelers can find a variety of goods from trusted names as well as local providers, if they’re not overwhelmed by the sights and sounds of this landing zone.
localization.ui_pregame_port_area18_history,p: PLACEHOLDER  TO BE FILLED IN..... Area18 History
localization.ui_pregame_port_checkmate_desc: Located at the L4 Lagrange point of Pyro II, this dilapidated station was originally established by Pyrotechnic Amalgamated to supply their workers with fuel and other resources. Today, the fierce Rough & Ready gang uses the station to offer outlaws traveling the system a place to stop for fuel, supplies, and a bit of entertainment. Just be sure to mind your manners.
localization.ui_pregame_port_grimhex_callout2: Old '38 Bar, Trade Terminals, None of Your Business
localization.ui_pregame_port_grimhex_desc: A cheap Housing Exchange (also known as a HEX) built into a hollowed out asteroid to provide affordable living. As mining opportunities dried up, the station declined and slowly transformed into a market for drugs and petty crime. Locals now refer to the station as Grim HEX.
localization.ui_pregame_port_levski_callout1: Conscientious Objects, Cordy's, Dumper's Depot, Teach's Ship Shop, Grand Barter
localization.ui_pregame_port_levski_callout2: Café Musain, Miners Amalgamated Loc. 163, Trade Terminals, Liberty Maintenance
localization.ui_pregame_port_levski_desc: This mining facility was abandoned for years before UEE refugees took up residence. Dedicated to the creation of an egalitarian society, Levski has evolved into a self-sustaining port of political activists and those wishing to escape the eye of the Empire.
localization.ui_pregame_port_lorville_callout1: Tammany & Sons, Hurston Dynamics Showcase, New Deal Ship Market
localization.ui_pregame_port_lorville_callout2: Reclamation & Disposal, Transfers Market, M&V Bar, L19 Residences, Desmond Memorial Convention Center
localization.ui_pregame_port_lorville_desc: The capital of Hurston and the corporate headquarters for the eponymous weapons manufacturer, Lorville is a company town with a population predominately comprised of Hurston Dynamics employees and the security forces that supervise their labors.
localization.ui_pregame_port_milemillionhighclub_desc: Designed by famed architectural firm Ido, this executive lounge features polished hardwood floors, a fully-stocked bar and two floor-to-ceiling aquariums. Whether hosting work associates, friends to watch the latest SataBall match or pulling out the stops for an all-night affair, the Million Mile High Club is the perfect venue for any kind of occasion.
localization.ui_pregame_port_newbabbage_callout1: CenterMass, Omega Pro, Aparelli, Regal Luxury Rentals, The Factory Line
localization.ui_pregame_port_newbabbage_callout2: NBIS, The Nest, MT Planetary Services, TDD, Wally's Bar, FTL, Shubin Interstellar Services
localization.ui_pregame_port_newbabbage_desc: Built to keep the world's freezing temperatures at bay, New Babbage is a luxurious city with top-class amenities and domed open spaces designed to inspire the creativity and productivity of the cutting edge companies and tech firms drawn here by microTech's innovative spirit.
localization.ui_pregame_port_olisar_callout1: LiveFire Weapons, Garrity Defense, Casaba Outlet, Dumper's Depot
localization.ui_pregame_port_olisar_callout2: EZ Habs, Trade Terminals, Vending Machines
localization.ui_pregame_port_olisar_desc: Located in the trade lanes above Crusader, Port Olisar offers a breathtaking view of the planet below. Owned and operated by Crusader Industries, Port Olisar acts as a gateway to the company’s vast planetary holdings and orbital shipyards.
localization.ui_pregame_port_olisar_history,p: PLACEHOLDER  TO BE FILLED IN..... Port Olisar History
localization.ui_pregame_port_orison_callout1: Crusader Showroom, Cousin Crow's Custom Craft, Kel-To ConStore
localization.ui_pregame_port_orison_callout2: August Dunlow Spaceport, TDD, Covalex, FTL, Green Circle, Voyager Bar
localization.ui_pregame_port_orison_desc: Located high above the clouds, Orison is built upon a military-constructed latticework of inhabitable floating platforms which Crusader Industries uses to manufacture their large-scale ships. The shipyards themselves are famously beautiful and have made Orison a prime tourist destination in the Stanton system.
localization.ui_pregame_pyro_desc: With violent and unpredictable solar flares creating a less than hospitable environment, the Pyro system was left unclaimed by the Empire, leaving unscrupulous mining consortiums, like Pyrotechnic Amalgamated, looking to harvest as much ore as they could. With the system now depleted, it is currently inhabited by down-on-their luck settlers trying their best to survive and fierce outlaw gangs vying endlessly for control of what sparse resources are left.
localization.ui_pregame_spaceports_desc: Explore some of the unique locations of the Star Citizen Universe.
localization.ui_pregame_stanton_callout1: Shopping and trade opportunities available throughout the system.
localization.ui_pregame_stanton_callout2: Port Olisar, Lorville, Area18, Rest & Relax Stations, Levski, Green Imperial HEX (CLOSED)
localization.ui_pregame_stanton_callout3: ECN monitored space patrolled by local corporate security.
localization.ui_pregame_stanton_desc: While the UEE still controls the rights to the system overall, the four planets that reside here were sold by the government to four separate megacorporations – Hurston (Stanton I), Crusader (Stanton II), ArcCorp (Stanton III), and microTech (Stanton IV). These worlds became the first privately-owned planets in the Empire. Developed quickly, Stanton has grown into an economic powerhouse with large amounts of businesses and manufacturers flocking to the commercially-focused system. Of course, such rapid growth is not without problems - crime has become an increasing concern as the corporate governments and security forces strive to maintain the law and uphold peace.
localization.ui_pregame_starmarine_desc: Itching for some intense FPS action? Pick a loadout and join in on some multiplayer mayhem!

localization.uwc_refueling_easy_desc_001:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one. 

A beacon has just gone live at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, from a client whose <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> is in need of ~mission(FuelType), so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
localization.uwc_refueling_easy_desc_002:
Hey, 

I've got a Club member at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> that needs ~mission(FuelType). 

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

If you're interested, it should be a simple gig. The beacon puts it a long way from any recent trouble spots, but it's never a bad idea to keep one eye on your scanners, right?

They've got places they want to be, so let's get them on their way.

Take it easy, out there.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
localization.uwc_refueling_high_desc_001:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> looking to be topped up with ~mission(FuelType) at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
localization.uwc_refueling_intro_desc_001:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: <EM4>make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out</EM4>.

A Club member has run out of ~mission(FuelType) at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest). As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a <EM4>journal entry</EM4> on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates. 

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
localization.uwc_refueling_moderate_desc_001:
Hey, you!

I've got a beacon at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. They say their tanks are running dry and they could use ~mission(FuelType). If you're interested, I get the feeling they'll be really pleased to see you.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

They're stuck out in an area with a bad reputation, though things have been a bit more quiet recently. Still worth staying alert I'd say, just in case there's still trouble lurking out there. 

Either way, the sooner everyone's able to get flying again - and that includes you - the better.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
localization.uwc_refueling_multiple_hard_desc_001:
Heyo,

Over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need ~mission(FuelType). Talk about when it rains it pours!

The client will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run. 

It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
localization.uwc_refueling_multiple_med_desc_001,p:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting ~mission(FuelType). Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
localization.uwc_refuelling_bespokecapital_desc:
DD here - I've got something special for you,

I just received a ping from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. A strike force led by a ~mission(Ship) just dropped into the system and are looking for a fast refuel before heading back out. 

They  need ~mission(FuelType) asap and will pay ~mission(RefuelRequest) for it. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I won't lie - I'm more than a little jealous. Getting up close and personal to a ship that big? Should be one to tell the grandkids about.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
localization.uwc_refuelling_bespokecombat_desc:
Hey,

Before you say yes to this contract, there's something you should know: this job comes with a serious health warning. 

We got an urgent call for a mid-flight refuel at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. It's a small fleet that's hot out of combat and all together need ~mission(FuelType). From what little they've said, it sounds like they're expecting trouble so anyone heading that way should be ready for a hostile reception.

The rate for the job is ~mission(RefuelRequest), plus the UWC service fee listed above upon completion. But believe me, if you accept this, you'll be earning every credit of your fee on this one. 

Fly safe. Don't get dead.

Good luck,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
localization.uwc_repairship_desc_001:
Attention Wayfarers,

We’ve received a call from a pilot that’s suffered some mechanical failure and is in need of assistance. Any available contractors will need to head to (token|location) as soon as possible to get them back on their feet.

According to the pilot, they’ve been having an issue with their (token|component) and it finally broke down. You’ll need to obtain an equivalent size and model, transport it to their location, and install it. 

You don’t need to break the bank on a replacement, this is just to get them back on their feet again, but feel free to spend big if you want. A little kindness goes a long way.

Sincerely,

(token|NameFirst) (token|NameLast)
Contractor Relations
United Wayfarers Club
We’ve got your back

localization.vanillacheesecake_cfp_a_desc,p:
SETTLEMENT RESUPPLY NEEDED

Citizens For Prosperity are a peaceful organization who are spearheading a campaign to support law-abiding settlements in Pyro in an effort to promote the growth of good and change the entire moral landscape of the system.

We’re looking for pilots to procure the following supplies and take them to ~mission(Destination|address). Since Pyro is so dangerous, we’ll have a CFP member on standby to take goods from the drop off and make the jump into Pyro themselves to distribute them.

You’re welcome to acquire the following materials wherever you can, but here’s a list of a few suggested locations where you can find what we currently need:

*Agricultural Supplies - Can be bought at numerous research and mining facilities, including Hickes Research Outpost on Cellin and HDMS-Woodruff on Ita. 
*Aluminum - Mine and process your own, or purchase from mining facilities, like Shubin Mining Facility SMO-22 on microTech.  
*Nitrogen - Can be bought from Beautiful Glen Station.

You'll also get a complete list of the required amounts upon acceptance, but they should range between 2-4 SCU per item.


Fly Safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
localization.vanillacheesecake_cfp_b_desc,p:
ADDITIONAL ITEMS NEEDED

Citizens For Prosperity are a peaceful organization who are spearheading a campaign to support law-abiding settlements in Pyro in an effort to promote the growth of good and change the entire moral landscape of the system.

We’re looking for pilots to procure the following supplies and take them to ~mission(Destination). Since Pyro is so dangerous, we’ll have a CFP member ready to take the delivery into Pyro for distribution.

You’re welcome to acquire the following materials wherever you see fit, but here’s a list of a few suggested locations where you can find what we currently need: 

*Agricium - Mine it and process it if you can, or otherwise buy it from Shubin Mining Facility SAL-2 on Lyria.  
*Medical Supplies - Purchasable from several research outposts, like Rayari Anvik on Calliope. 
*Processed Food - You’ve got two choices really, Terra Gateway or Bajini Point.  

Upon accepting the mission, we will provide exact amounts based on current needs, but we tend to be looking for 6-20 SCU per item.

Fly Safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
localization.vanillacheesecake_cfp_title,p: Op. Save Stanton Phase 4: Supply Run
localization.vanillacheesecake_journalallcompleted,p:
Citizens for Prosperity Supply Run
Frontier Fighters Supply Haul

localization.vanillacheesecake_journalbody: Owing to the recent attacks by the Slicers outlaw gang, resources are in short supply and urgently needed by two organizations looking to make a difference in Pyro. Successfully complete six supply hauls, and meet requirements from the previous phases, to receive a special reward.
localization.vanillacheesecake_journalcompleted: Citizens for Prosperity Supply Run\nFrontier Fighters Supply Haul
localization.vanillacheesecake_v_a_desc,p:
YOUR CONTRIBUTION MATTERS

Are you furious with the UEE for refusing to do anything about the outlaw problem plaguing us from Pyro? You’re not alone.

We’re the Frontier Fighters. A group of Stanton residents who refuse to sit back while scum like the Slicers constantly wreak havoc on our system. We got things in motion to launch into Pyro proper, but we need help gathering and hauling crucial supplies to our staging areas.

We’re looking for someone to acquire the following supplies themselves and deliver them to ~mission(Destination). Don’t have the time to list out everywhere you can get this stuff, but we're gonna need the following items:

*Helium - Can be bought from stations such as Seraphim Station above Crusader.
*Bexalite- You can mine and process this resource yourself or you can buy it at the Magnus Gateway.
*Hydrogen - Mining facilities or at the Terra Gateway.

I'll send exact amounts if you accept, but it'll be around 2-4 SCU per item.

You ready to step up and bring an end to the gangs controlling Pyro?


Corbin Cassady
Communication Specialist
Frontier Fighters
localization.vanillacheesecake_v_b_desc:
FURTHER CONTRIBUTIONS NEEDED

Are you furious with the UEE for refusing to do anything about the outlaw problem plaguing us from Pyro? You’re not alone!

We’re the Frontier Fighters. A group of Stanton residents who refuse to sit back while scum like the Slicers constantly wreak havoc on our system. We got things in motion to launch into Pyro proper, but we need someone to acquire some urgently needed supplies and haul them to our staging areas.

We’re looking for someone to acquire some urgently needed supplies and then deliver them to ~mission(Destination). We need:

*Tungsten – You can mine this yourself, or get it from HDMS-Bezdek on Arial. 
*Titanium – Same as tungsten. 
*Copper – Mine it if you can, or otherwise buy it from Seraphim Station above Crusader.

I'll send you the exact amount we'll need if you sign on, but it'll be around 6-20 SCU per item, so make sure you got the room.

You ready to take a stand and bring an end to the gangs controlling Pyro?


Corbin Cassady
Communication Specialist
Frontier Fighters
localization.vanillacheesecake_v_title,p: Op. Save Stanton Phase 4: Re-Supply Haul
localization.vaughn_assassination_e_desc_001:
~mission(TargetName) needs to be eliminated. My contacts tell me they will have one or two escorts, but nothing you can't handle. Find them near ~mission(Location|Address).

Most Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_e_desc_002:
Another assignment for you. ~mission(TargetName). Current location is suspected to be ~mission(Location|Address).

I trust you to eliminate them and handily deal with whatever escort they have manage to drag up.

Most Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_e_desc_003:
I need an associate to put down ~mission(TargetName).

However, I do not expect them to go quietly as they have obtained an escort or two to serve as protection.

Travel to ~mission(Location|Address), deal with the lot, and eliminate ~mission(TargetName).

Most Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_e_desc_intro:
You have been doing such a fine job as of late, that I have decided to see if you are not capable of more.

This mark will be slightly more difficult that what you have undertaken so far, but I still expect it to be a rather straightforward affair.

Your target is ~mission(TargetName). They will most likely be traveling with an escort or two near ~mission(Location|Address), and with their connections there is a good chance they will be more skilled than your average pilot. 

Let us see what you can do with the odds stacked against your favor.

Most Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_desc_001:
I want you to focus your efforts on one ~mission(TargetName). You should be able to find them and at ~mission(Location|Address). My sources indicate that they might not be alone. ~mission(Location|CaveSize)

At the very least kill ~mission(TargetName). The others are none of my concern.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_desc_002:
It appears that one ~mission(TargetName) has been making quite the impression. I received multiple commissions to see them killed. Lucky for them since the individual offers were not high enough, but pooled together are more than sufficient.

Find them at ~mission(Location|Address). I was made to understand that they will not be alone so caution is the key. ~mission(Location|CaveSize)

Earnestly,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_desc_003:
The time has come for one ~mission(TargetName) to bid adieu to this cruel world. 

You will find them and some faithful companions sequestered at ~mission(Location|Address). ~mission(Location|CaveSize)

They think that teamwork will be enough to overcome your considerable skills. I would wager my credits on you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_desc_intro:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself, or more precisely, my vocation. I am sought out when someone is in need of elimination, and I, in return, find the one who shall execute it. 

This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may have a proclivity for killing and if true, why should we both not profit from these much needed skills? As such, I offer an opportunity - 
 
Seek out and kill ~mission(TargetName) over at ~mission(Location|Address). What you do with the others who may also be residing there is up to you. ~mission(Location|CaveSize) 

Successfully complete this task, and I have a suspicion it shall be the start of something quite grand.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_desc_rehire:
While it is true that you have acquitted yourself quite poorly the last time you attempted an assassination on my behalf, let it not be said that I cannot find it within my heart to forgive.

I'm going to offer you a chance to prove yourself capable once more. 

Seek out ~mission(TargetName) who is hiding at ~mission(Location|Address) and kill them and whoever else attempts to interfere. ~mission(Location|CaveSize)

Do this and you can consider yourself forgiven.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_title_intro: A Chance to Prove Your Mettle
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_title_rehire: Another Chance to Prove Your Mettle
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_ugf_illegal_bos:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with ~mission(Location|Address), but ~mission(TargetName) is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_ugf_illegal_des:
They say there is no honor among thieves. Today, it seems, you're targeting one of your own. 

Please head to ~mission(Location|Address) and kill ~mission(TargetName). What you do with the others there is entirely up to you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_ugf_illegal_tit: All Things Come To An End
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_ugf_legal_boss_:
A senior security official by the name of ~mission(TargetName) is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at ~mission(Location|Address), they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn

A senior security official by the name of ~mission(TargetName) has been marked for termination. While they can be found at ~mission(Location|Address), they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

Normally, I would recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. However, in this instance a more delicate touch is required. While you should feel free to eliminate any and all of the security forces on site, you must ensure the safety of all the civilian workers there.

Tiresome for sure, but a requirement none the less. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_ugf_legal_desc_:
A security officer by the name of ~mission(TargetName) is in desperate need of an early retirement. They are currently stationed at ~mission(Location|Address) along with a host of other eager types in uniforms. 

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of ~mission(TargetName) which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_fps_ugf_targetonly_:
Normally I give you free reign to indulge your darker impulses, but in this instance, restraint is the key. 

While ~mission(Location|Address) is sure to be teeming with all sorts of life, you are charged with killing ~mission(TargetName) and only them. 

No other deaths will be tolerated. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_h_desc_001:
Killing ~mission(TargetName) may end up being quite the challenge. They are aboard a well-protected ship near ~mission(Location|Address) and are most likely in the company of skilled escorts.

A cautious approach may be wise.

Warmest Regards,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_h_desc_002:
I am eager to see how you will handle this next assignment.

~mission(TargetName) will be traveling near ~mission(Location) with trained escorts aboard a heavily defended ship. Killing them will be no mean feat.

But I am starting to suspect that you may enjoy the challenge.

Warmest Regards,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_h_desc_003:
We have been hired to end the life of ~mission(TargetName). However, they have all the earmarks of a challenging assignment - a well fortified vessel with skilled escorts.

Of course, you have proven yourself most adroit and handling the difficult tasks. You will find the target near ~mission(Location|Address).

Warmest Regards,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_h_desc_intro:
I have always been forthright with you, so I will say that this next contract will be extremely difficult.

~mission(TargetName) is notorious for not only their own deadly skills in the cockpit, but they travel with equally deadly compatriots as well. The client neglected to mention to me that several other contractors have failed in the past.

It will be up to you to track ~mission(TargetName) to ~mission(Location|Address) and kill them. I am afraid it will not be easy. However, you have always risen to the challenge thus far and I'm hopeful that you can do so once more.

Warmest Regards,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_m_desc_001:
The latest name for our list is ~mission(TargetName).

They will be traveling around ~mission(Location|Address) in a better class of ship and with a better class of escort. Approach with caution, and try to make this a clean kill.

Regards,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_m_desc_002:
Good news. Received the name of our next victim.

I believe you will find ~mission(TargetName) to be piloting a fairly well-armed vessel while in the company of a few skilled pilots somewhere near ~mission(Location|Address).

I can't say it will be an easy assignment, but it should at least be interesting.

Regards,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_m_desc_003:
Our next target, one ~mission(TargetName), might have received word that there is a price on their head. 

They have upgraded their protection detail and are traveling near ~mission(Location|Address) on a better defended ship than usual.

Inconvenient, but not insurmountable.

Regards,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_m_desc_intro:
I have a special assignment for you near ~mission(Location|Address). 

The name is ~mission(TargetName).

Normally, I would task this to one of my more experienced associates, but the timetable on the life of ~mission(TargetName|Last) has moved up, so the responsibility falls unto you.

Know that this may be your most difficult assignment to date. Do not be surprised if you encounter several well-trained pilots serving as escorts to the target, who themselves are known to be quite the pilot. 

I suspect making a clean kill may prove a bit tricky, but I have the utmost faith in your ability.

Regards,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_pa_e_desc:
I can’t imagine you’ll have much trouble with this, even if it is marginally more challenging than your previous contract. Head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and take care of People’s Alliance member by the name <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4>. My informants tell me they may have an escort or two with them. Nothing you can’t handle, of course.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_pa_h_desc:
<EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> of the People’s Alliance, certainly seems to have a reputation about them, based on the importance our client has placed on this being handled in a timely and exacting manner.

But we’ll spare you the details. All you need to do is travel to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and put an end to their life. Expect a well-armed ship and highly competent backup to boot. They seem to take themselves quite seriously.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_pa_m_desc:
It seems the People’s Alliance have been ruffling some feathers recently. A client of ours would be most thrilled if you can prevent ~mission(TargetName) from meddling in their affairs ever again.

You’ll find them around <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, and from what our client has told us, it’s unlikely that they’re alone. These aren’t your run-of-the-mill pilots, they might even pose a slight threat to your safety.

Do try your best to keep it as clean as possible.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_pa_s_desc:
I am thrilled to inform you that we have a particularly ambitious assignment for you.

<EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> has been marked for termination. You may know them already: a particularly high-profile member of the People’s Alliance who is notorious for having thwarted numerous attempts against their life. We initially considered it too troublesome until our client offered an even more outrageous amount of credits to see this to completion.

The target’s last known location was at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Expect a top-of-the-line ship and a skilled escort.

We look forward to hearing about their untimely demise.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_pa_ve_desc:
I have a relatively straightforward task for you.

<EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> has outstayed their welcome and needs disposing of. They can be found at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.

I assume you have no moral quandary regarding killing a member of the People’s Alliance?

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_pa_vh_desc:
We hope you enjoy a challenge, because this one is looking to be far from a walk in the park.

For reasons our client was unwilling to disclose, a rather prominent member of the People’s Alliance needs disposing of. The target, <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4>, was last seen at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> piloting a high-class ship accompanied by several skilled allies.

Do make the most of this opportunity.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_s_desc_001:
I fear this is another one of those assignments that will take your full skillset to see to completion.

~mission(TargetName) is aboard a very heavily armed vessel protected by at least two equally armed escorts. They are traveling near ~mission(Location|Address).

Not for the faint of heart.

Fondly,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_s_desc_002:
If you hadn't already proven yourself time and again, I would say that this next kill would most definitely cement my esteem of your abilities.

Aboard a heavily defended and well escorted ship traveling near ~mission(Location|Address) is one ~mission(TargetName). Please kill them.

Fondly Yours,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_s_desc_003:
Powerful people make powerful enemies as is evident in this next assignment. 

Despite ~mission(TargetName)'s well-appointed vessel and extremely qualified escort ships, it is up to you to see them dead. You should be able to find them near ~mission(Location|Address).

You have my full faith.

Fondly,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_s_desc_intro:
When I received the name ~mission(TargetName), I knew that you were the one for the assignment.

They and their wingmen will most likely be your equal in terms of combat skill, but I am wagering they will not have your instincts. 

Normally, I wouldn't even take such a difficult contract but you have proven yourself such an asset that I feel confident the outcome will be favorable.

You should be able to find ~mission(TargetName|Last) near ~mission(Location|Address).

I eagerly await the good news.

Fondly Yours,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_ve_desc_001:
I have a new assignment for you.

Dispatch ~mission(TargetName). You should be able to find them at ~mission(Location|Address). 

I do not expect them to put up much of a struggle. At least not a formidable one.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_ve_desc_002:
It has been requested that ~mission(TargetName) be killed. I suspect they will not be too difficult to deal with once you find them near ~mission(Location|Address).

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_ve_desc_003:
The next name on my list is one ~mission(TargetName). 

From what I gather, they can be found near ~mission(Location|Address) and you should be able to put them down rather easily.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_ve_desc_intro:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill ~mission(TargetName) over at ~mission(Location|Address).

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_ve_desc_rehire:
It is not often in life that we get another chance to make a first impression, but I am going to provide to you with just that.

To say I was disappointed in how things last transpired on your last assassination attempt would be a severe understatement. However, here is your chance to prove yourself capable of more. 

Kill ~mission(TargetName) over at ~mission(Location|Address) and I will consider the slate wiped clean. 

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_vh_desc_001:
An tricky assignment has just arrived that I think you will be ideally suited for.

Expect to encounter ~mission(TargetName) aboard a heavily armed vessel near ~mission(Location|Address) and accompanied by some of the most highly-seasoned pilots that can be hired. 

Deal with the escorts as you wish. As long as you kill ~mission(TargetName), I will be more than satisfied.

Respectfully,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_vh_desc_002:
I just got off of a comm with a client who felt obligated to monologue about why he needed a target dead.  

I will spare you the details, but know that the assignment's name is ~mission(TargetName). They are a relatively high profile individual and will be traveling near ~mission(Location|Address) in a heavily guarded ship with highly qualified escorts.

I suspect there will most likely be a full defensive reaction to any hostile actions so be prepared.

Respectfully,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_vh_desc_003:
Believe it or not, but this assignment's name is near identical to one of my earliest contracts. I can't tell if that's because it's a popular name or if it reflects on my having been in the business a very long time.

That said, this ~mission(TargetName) is very different than the earlier one I dealt with. This one is traveling near ~mission(Location|Address) in a heavily fortified ship with well armed guards escorting them. 

If I am not mistaken, they are going to put up quite the resistance, but hopefully this ~mission(TargetName) will soon be as dead as the first.

Respectfully,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_assassination_vh_desc_intro:
I will not skirt the truth of it. This will be my second attempt at dispatching ~mission(TargetName). The first time cost me a very talented asset.

It turns out that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is not only a skilled combatant themselves, but they travel with several highly skilled companions making them most difficult to kill. I have traced their current whereabouts to ~mission(Location|Address).

While I would hate to see the same unfortunate fate befall you, I believe that you shall triumph where others failed.

I sincerely hope you prove me right.

Respectfully,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_eliminateboss_fps_rockcracker_war:
One of the leaders of the mysterious Claw Salamanders gang, a ~mission(TargetName), has worn out their welcome and has now become our problem to deal with. It's hardly a surprise figuring no one except their friends could understand what they're saying. 

Unfortunately, it won't be as easy as heading to ~mission(Location|Address) and dealing with them directly. Not only will you have to ensure the station is operational to reach them, it seems that you will have to draw them out of hiding too by taking out a fair number of their compatriots first.

Not the simplest of jobs, but I'm sure you'll rise to the occasion.

All the best,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_eliminatespecific_fps_rockcracker:
I've been having a hard time tracking this target down. They're part of a gang known as the Claw Salamanders who tend to be quite itinerate. However, it seems the group has been trying to get an old QV Breaker Station operational again and I think this just may be the chance to take out ~mission(TargetName) once and for all. 

Start your search at ~mission(Location|Address).  These stations can apparently be quiet cavernous at  times so it may take a bit of effort to locate the target once you're on site.

However, I have all the confidence in your abilities,
Vaughn

A request has made its way to my desk regarding the untimely end of one ~mission(TargetName), a member of the Claw Salamander who is currently scuttling around an old QV Breaker Station. 

It is highly likely that you will find them at ~mission(Location|Address).  Be mindful though that with a station this large it may take a bit of searching to track them down. 

Hope you enjoy your time in Nyx,
Vaughn

There is a member of the Nyx gang the Claw Salamanders, ~mission(TargetName), who has made it on to my naughty list. They had been on the run for quite awhile, but just recently popped back up at an old mining station in the Keeger Belt. Our lucky day shall be their last.  

Word is that you can find them at ~mission(Location|Address).  Unfortunately, there is a strong chance you may have to do some repairs to the station itself before you can gain access to that particular area.

But I'm sure you're more than up to the challenge.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_eliminatespecific_fps_storm_h_des:
I've been conscripted to provide a trigger pull for a very motivated client. The target is <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4>, a loathsome character by all accounts who's seemed to relish the temporary authority that their mercenary position affords them. They believe their sadism to be righteous and my client would like to remind them otherwise.

They have recently been hired by ASD as part of a mercenary team at <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4>, so it won't be an easy approach as there will undoubtedly be other armed individuals. I'll expect you to react accordingly, but ~mission(TargetName|Last) is your target.

You will be paid upon completion.

All the best,

Vaughn

I have a new name for you to deal with: <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4>. A former Customs Agent in New Junction, ~mission(TargetName|Last) made a living preying upon local transporters until they were exposed and fired. Now it seems they've been hired to work security for ASD at <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4>. 

My client remembers ~mission(TargetName|Last) for their sins in Corel and wants them eliminated. As they are posted in a corporate facility, there will be additional security elements present, but I will entrust the approach to your expertise.

Good luck,

Vaughn

A previous target I had thought to have been eliminated seems to have resurfaced as a hired merc over at <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4> working for ASD. While I am supremely disappointed with the contractor who claimed to have eliminated <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4>, I'm going to re-open the original contract and give it to you to finish it.

They are currently stationed at an operational facility, so they will not be alone. Use your discretion in executing the contract, but know that <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> is the priority.

I trust you'll do better than my former subcontractor,

Vaughn

Have a difficult contract for a discerning operative. Target's name is <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4>. They're currently working as hired security for Associated Science & Development and posted at <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4>, a far cry from their previous career as a syndicate enforcer and bagman.

I'll need you to get in and take out <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> which is easier said then done as they will undoubtedly be entrenched with other corporate security forces, but I believe you'll figure it out.

All the best,

Vaughn
localization.vaughn_repui_description: Investigated by authorities in connection to dozens of assassinations, the identity of this shadowy individual or group of individuals known as Vaughn remains unknown. Vaughn keeps clients and contractors completely separate and deals with both only through spectrum, which has made it extremely difficult for law enforcement to learn the identity of the person(s) behind this broker service.
localization.vaughn_reputationjournal_terminated_body:
It has become readily apparent that your abilities do not meet the expected standards, meaning that you are not qualified to complete even the simplest of tasks.

To that end, I will no longer be utilizing your services.

One final note - I expect you to continue to respect my privacy.  If not, I will be forced to arrange for you to meet your more qualified replacement.

Farewell,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_reputationjournal_welcome_bodytex:
In light of you proving yourself more than capable , I wanted to formally welcome you to my employ and to make very clear two vital rules.

The first is that the details of who I am and what we do are extremely private. I expect you to maintain that privacy at all times. 

The second is that I expect a certain level of professionalism from those whom I deem to work with. What you do in your own time is of course no of my concern, but when you are engaged in a contract you should endeavor to be efficient, timely, and discreet. 

Follow those criterion and there is every hope that we should have a long and fruitful partnership.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_searchbody_space_e_desc_001:
A rather creative former contractor of ours with a knack for staging accidents was so swept up in their work that they forgot to confirm the death of <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> for us.

The target’s body should be located at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. I need you to give the hopefully deceased an inspection to ensure the job was completed to our standard. 

Do be careful when you arrive at the location. It wouldn’t surprise me if there was a few vultures lurking around.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
localization.vaughn_searchbody_space_h_desc_001:
<EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> was a name that proved particularly troublesome for some time. Whether a master of evasion or just unerringly lucky all of our attempts have thus far failed.

With that being said, it seems that someone else may have beaten us to the punch so to speak. We’d like you to visit <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and confirm if the target has indeed been neutralized. But be advised, I suspect they’re former crew may still be in the area, most likely out of a misplaced sense of loyalty. I’d suggest a crew of your own for this one, but will defer to your expertise.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
localization.vaughn_searchbody_space_intro_desc_001:
It has recently been brought to my attention that you may possess a set of skills that could be beneficial to the both of us.

Should you recognise my name, I have no doubt that you will be aware of the nature of my business. I am an intermediatory. I deal with the tedious logistics in order to execute the wishes of my clients. 

If you are interested in pursuing this line of work, I will first require proof of your abilities.

Let’s start simple. A client is very interested in discerning the current health of  <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> and are hoping we can deliver them some bad news. Their last contact with them placed their ship around <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.

If they have indeed shed this mortal coil, confirm their condition via your mobiGlas, then we may yet have more work for you.

Sincerely,
Vaughn
localization.vaughn_searchbody_space_m_desc_001:
Whilst we pride ourselves on our efficiency and general cleanliness when it comes to our work, sometimes our contractors can get a little carried away themselves. Circumstances surrounding a former contractor’s death, and more importantly, the target, are somewhat unclear to us.

We’ll need you to travel to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and locate <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4>’s body so we can deliver clear confirmation to our client. As for the former contractor… you needn’t concern yourself with them. Arrangements for disposal have already been made.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
localization.vaughn_searchbody_space_s_desc_001:
I have a very specific task that requires my best people. 

Something unusual seems to have occurred over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. One of our contractors seems to have gone rogue after completing their assignment, refusing to communicate with us, and indiscriminately attacking those they come across. Now, I have other methods for dealing with renegade assets but our client still requires confirmation of the original target’s death which we are unable to provide due to this pilot’s presence.

I need you to head to the location and identify that <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> is well and truly dead, preferably without being obliterated by this former, disgruntled contractor. As a fair warning, they were one of our most thorough, and ruthless employees, so extreme caution is advised. You will want to bring your most competent of allies to support you with this. 

Sincerely,

Vaughn
localization.vaughn_searchbody_space_ve_desc_001:
Despite having given the client my word that their target has been dealt with, they are disposed to bouts of paranoia, so they require additional digital evidence of their demise.

I’ll need you to head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and give the corpse a thorough once over. Whilst I’m confident <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> is taken care of, verification via your mobiGlas will hopefully bring some peace of mind to my client.

I can’t imagine you coming across any significant trouble, but in this line of work, some trouble is always to be expected.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
localization.vaughn_searchbody_space_vh_desc_001:
It is with deep disappointment that I send this message. A peerless contractor of ours was out on a job, but it seems like the target may have gotten the better of them.

I need you to travel to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and see if our contractor, <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4>, is truly gone.

I suspect that the location will be somewhat chaotic since there will most likely still be multiple threats on site. Therefore, a supporting crew is strongly advised.

Sincerely,

Vaughn
localization.vehicel_descanvl_valkyrie:
Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace 
Focus: Drop Ship

The Valkyrie ups the ante on troop transport. Designed to carry up to twenty soldiers, as well as vehicles, to the most hostile locations, this conflict-ready mil-spec craft is a formidable force, both offensively and defensively. Built with military and private defense contractors in mind, the Valkyrie is one of the most efficient and effective personnel transports in its class.
localization.vehicl_descmisc_hull_b:
Manufacturer: MISC
Focus: Medium Freight

The MISC Hull B is a rugged option for pilots seeking a dedicated cargo transport. While not as large as some of the other Hull-series models, the Hull B's smaller profile provides greater flexibility and more access options.
localization.vehicle_container_confidental: Reminder: Vehicle storage containers must be passcode locked at all times.
localization.vehicle_debugname: This is a 32 character long name
localization.vehicle_descaegs_avenger_stalker:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Interceptor

Initially designed as Aegis’ frontline carrier ship for the military, the Avenger Stalker took a different path, ultimately having a long and storied career as the standard patrol craft of the UEE Advocacy. Utilizing its cargo hold for prisoner transport, the Avenger features a sturdy, reliable hull and the capacity for larger-than-expected engine mounts.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_avenger_titan:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Light Freight 

Lacking the Prisoner Cells of the Stalker or the EMP Generator of the Warlock, the Titan’s hold is free to carry cargo. Couple that available space with the Avenger’s tried and true combat abilities and you’ve got a light cargo hauler that’s more than capable of handling itself in a fight.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_avenger_titan_renegade:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Light Freight

Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Renegade pays tribute to famed pilot Danny Solomon for his notable work with the Advocacy to bring justice to Bremen. This Avenger Titan comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting focused loadout and a custom special edition livery honoring this iconic ship.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_avenger_warlock:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Interdiction

The Avenger Warlock was built towards a single design philosophy: stop ships, don’t destroy them. Probably the closest to a non-lethal fighter, the Warlock is outfitted with a Behring REP-8 EMP Generator, capable of emitting a powerful electromagnetic wave to disable any electronics unfortunate enough to be within the blast radius.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_eclipse:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Stealth Bomber

The Aegis Eclipse is a bomber designed to get in and strike before it's ever even spotted. After extensive service with the UEE, this high-tech military equipment made its civilian market debut in 2947.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_firebird_collector_milt:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Stealth Fighter
 
When frontline skirmishes call for a swift and decisive offensive, the Sabre Firebird is the ideal medium fighter for any arsenal. Taking the already battle proven Sabre Raven, Aegis has designed the Firebird variant with an enhanced missile launcher capable of engaging with a wide array of threats.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_gladius:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Light Fighter

The Gladius is an older design which has been updated over the years to keep up with modern technology. In military circles, the Gladius is beloved for its performance and its simplicity. A fast, light fighter with a laser-focus on dogfighting, the Gladius is an ideal interceptor or escort ship.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_gladius_dunlevy:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Light Fighter 

Honor the famed Captain who shaped the course of the UEE Navy's elite fighter squadron with the Dunlevy variant for the Aegis Gladius. This special ship pays to tribute to Captain Alexandra Dunlevy and Squadron 42 with red highlights against a grey base paint and military-grade components.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_gladius_valiant:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Light Fighter 

Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Valiant pays tribute to famed defense pilot Condi Hillard for being the first Human on record to defeat a Vanduul in combat. This Gladius comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting focused loadout and a custom special edition livery honoring her iconic ship.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_hammerhead:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics 
Focus: Heavy Gunship

A fast patrol ship with multiple turrets designed to combat fighters, the Hammerhead is equally suited to support larger capital ships in a fleet or act as a flagship for fighter groups.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_idris:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Frigate

A mark two 'peacekeeper' variant developed for the UEE patrol services, the Idris-P strips the standard ship's ship-to-ship gun and spinal mount in favor of additional cargo capacity and superior speed.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_idris_m:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Frigate

Larger than a bomber but smaller than a ship-of-the-line, frigates occupy an interesting space in the pantheon of Naval warships. While they lack the heavy armor and the capital weaponry of a cruiser, the UEE Navy prizes its frigates as they are maneuverable and can be adapted for use in a wide-range of combat scenarios.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_idris_p:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Frigate

A mark two 'peacekeeper' variant developed for the UEE patrol services, the Idris-P strips the standard ship's ship-to-ship gun and spinal mount in favor of additional cargo capacity and superior speed.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_idris_p_collector_milit:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Frigate

A mark two 'peacekeeper' variant developed for the UEE patrol services, the Idris-P strips the standard ship's ship-to-ship gun and spinal mount in favor of additional cargo capacity and superior speed.

Wikelo here. Made useful modifications to make ship fight more hard. Very impressive.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_javelin:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Destroyer

Designed for use by the UEE military, the Javelin is a massive, modular capital ship that can be appropriated for entrepreneurial use. With a detailed interior, plenty of modular room options, and a high crew capacity, the Javelin is a ship that has made a name for itself in a variety of roles.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_reclaimer:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Heavy Salvage

The Aegis Reclaimer is an industrial salvage ship. Equipped with a reinforced cargo bay, a long-range jump drive and launch pods for unmanned drones, the Reclaimer is an ideal ship for taking advantage of deep space wrecks. Tractor beams, floodlights, scanner options and docking ports round out the tools on this capable, utilitarian spacecraft.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_reclaimer_teach:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Heavy Salvage

The Aegis Reclaimer is an industrial salvage ship. Equipped with a reinforced cargo bay, a long-range jump drive and launch pods for unmanned drones, the Reclaimer is an ideal ship for taking advantage of deep space wrecks. Tractor beams, floodlights, scanner options and docking ports round out the tools on this capable, utilitarian spacecraft.

Catering to the difficult work condition's of Nyx, Teach's Ship Shop has outfitted this special edition with a custom loadout featuring rugged components so you can better tackle the job at hand.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_redeemer:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Gunship 

Designed by Aegis Dynamics, the Redeemer is a powerful fighting ship capable of holding its own in combat with a powerful weapons payload. Dotted with turrets and missiles, the Redeemer also doubles as an armored landing craft capable of delivering soldiers to the frontlines.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_retaliator:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Modular

This civilian refit of the Retaliator updates the military ship's chassis with unladen space able to be fitted with various modules to suit your needs.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_retaliator_bomber:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Heavy Bomber

One of the United Empire of Earth's most powerful warbirds, Aegis Dynamics' Retaliator is a fearsome weapons platform designed to strike and kill capital ships. A key portion of the UEE's power projection, Retaliator squadrons have served with distinction against outlaws, the Vanduul, and elsewhere.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_sabre:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Stealth Fighter

Part of Aegis Dynamics’ Phase Two of new ship models, the Sabre was designed as a space superiority fighter for those situations where you need to leave a lighter footprint. Designed to be a rapid responder, the Sabre is more than capable of establishing battlefield dominance for any number of combat scenarios.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_sabre_comet:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Stealth Fighter

Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Comet pays tribute to famed pilot Captain Kamur Dalion for his work with Aegis to usher in a new era of combat ship design. This Sabre comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting focused loadout and a custom special edition livery honoring this iconic ship.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_sabre_firebird:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Stealth Fighter
 
When frontline skirmishes call for a swift and decisive offensive, the Sabre Firebird is the ideal medium fighter for any arsenal. Taking the already battle proven Sabre Raven, Aegis has designed the Firebird variant with an enhanced missile launcher capable of engaging with a wide array of threats.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_sabre_peregrine:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Racing
 
After seeing what fans of the Sabre Raven were able to accomplish with the fighter on the racetrack, the design team at Aegis Dynamics were inspired to craft an official racing variant for the agile ship. Enter the Sabre Peregrine. Streamlined and featuring additional thruster boosts, this nimble bird is ready to fly across the finish line.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_sabre_peregrine_collect:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Racing
 
After seeing what fans of the Sabre Raven were able to accomplish with the fighter on the racetrack, the design team at Aegis Dynamics were inspired to craft an official racing variant for the agile ship. Enter the Sabre Peregrine. Streamlined and featuring additional thruster boosts, this nimble bird is ready to fly across the finish line.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_sabre_raven:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics 
Focus: Interdiction

Aegis Dynamics have raised the bar yet again with their Raven variant, maintaining all the speed and maneuverability of its Sabre forebear, but with a lower ship signature, making it a fast, stealthy infiltrator.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_sabre_raven_ex:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics 
Focus: Interdiction
 
Aegis Dynamics have raised the bar yet again with their Raven variant. Nearing the speed and maneuverability of its Sabre forebearer but with a lower ship signature, the Raven is a fast, stealthy infiltrator. This special EX model reincorporates some of the offensive capabilities of the original Sabre while introducing a Quantum Dampener on the spine of the ship to help ensure enemies won't escape.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_tiburon,p:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Heavy Gunship

An evolution of a proven Aegis design, the Tiburon's anti-capital ship configuration comprises a spine mounted forward facing beam weapon, supplemented by side mounted turrets.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_vanguard:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Heavy Fighter

A hard-charging bulldog of a fighter which features extensive forward-mounted weaponry designed to tear through the shields and armor of other spacecraft. So-named because their multiple-jump range allows them to form the vanguard of any military expedition, Vanguards have seen extensive service against the Vanduul.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_vanguard_harbinger:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Heavy Fighter / Bomber

The Vanguard Harbinger is Earth's standard fighter/bomber, converting the standard Warden's escape pod into a potent bomb bay. The extended range of the Vanguard and the relatively small profile mean that it can go where carrier-based ships or larger strategic bombers don't, strike hard, and then make it back to base.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_vanguard_hoplite:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Drop Ship 

The Vanguard Hoplite is a cross between the winning Vanguard deep space fighter and a dedicated boarding ship. Adapted from proven assault ship designs, the Hoplite is the perfect tool for inserting an armored strike team with enough firepower to get them out again.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_vanguard_sentinel:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Heavy Fighter 

The Vanguard Sentinel is a ship that's designed to fight smart instead of taking enemies head on. The conversion features an AR cockpit, an external e-War pod, decoy missiles and a set of EMP charges. Vanguard Sentinels often provide necessary combat support for combined operations. A lone Sentinel is frequently paired with Harbinger bombers and Warden escorts for large attack missions.
localization.vehicle_descaegs_vulcan:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Medium Repair / Medium Refuel

Refuel. Repair. Rearm. Become a one-person support crew with Aegis Dynamics’ versatile Vulcan, supplying aid to pilots on the fly. Whether pinned down under heavy fire and in need of ammunition, low on quantum fuel after an ill-planned jump, or stranded in unknown space with a busted thruster, a pilot in distress can always count on a Vulcan and its cadre of drones to lend speedy, efficient assistance.
localization.vehicle_descanvl_arrow:
Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace 
Focus: Light Fighter

Unmatched design, blazing top speed, and ultra-responsive maneuverability make the Arrow the most agile scrapper in its class. With a robust weapons package that provides firepower to spare, this is truly the classic light fighter, updated for the next generation of combat.
localization.vehicle_descanvl_asgard:
Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace
Focus: Drop Ship
 
As the battles of today continue to grow in scale and complexity, Anvil Aerospace understands the impact a single vehicle can have on the outcome. Enter the Asgard. The next generation in ground vehicle transport, the Anvil Asgard features a quick-load ramp, a sizeable hold to securely store your assault vehicle of choice, and hefty array of armaments to ensure access to even the most combat-heavy of drop sites.
localization.vehicle_descanvl_asgard_collector_milita:
Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace
Focus: Drop Ship
